title: Computational Foundations for Strategic Coopetition: Formalizing Sequential Interaction and Reciprocity
comment: 81 pages, 19 figures. Fourth technical report in research program; should be read with companion arXiv:2510.18802, arXiv:2510.24909, and arXiv:2601.16237. Adapts and extends complex actor material from Pant (2021) doctoral dissertation, University of Toronto
summary: Strategic coopetition in multi-stakeholder systems requires understanding how cooperation persists through time without binding contracts. This technical report extends computational foundations for strategic coopetition to sequential interaction dynamics, bridging conceptual modeling (i* framework) with game-theoretic reciprocity analysis. We develop: (1) bounded reciprocity response functions mapping partner deviations to finite conditional responses, (2) memory-windowed history tracking capturing cognitive limitations over k recent periods, (3) structural reciprocity sensitivity derived from interdependence matrices where behavioral responses are amplified by structural dependencies, and (4) trust-gated reciprocity where trust modulates reciprocity responses. The framework applies to both human stakeholder interactions and multi-agent computational systems. Comprehensive validation across 15,625 parameter configurations demonstrates robust reciprocity effects, with all six behavioral targets exceeding thresholds: cooperation emergence (97.5%), defection punishment (100%), forgiveness dynamics (87.9%), asymmetric differentiation (100%), trust-reciprocity interaction (100%), and bounded responses (100%). Empirical validation using the Apple iOS App Store ecosystem (2008-2024) achieves 43/51 applicable points (84.3%), reproducing documented cooperation patterns across five ecosystem phases. Statistical significance confirmed at p < 0.001 with Cohen's d = 1.57. This report concludes the Foundations Series (TR-1 through TR-4) adopting uniaxial treatment where agents choose cooperation levels along a single continuum. Companion work on interdependence (arXiv:2510.18802), trust (arXiv:2510.24909), and collective action (arXiv:2601.16237) has been prepublished. Extensions Series (TR-5 through TR-8) introduces biaxial treatment where cooperation and competition are independent dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文为战略合作竞争（coopetition）建立了计算基础框架，通过有限记忆 reciprocity 响应函数、信任调节机制和结构依赖放大效应，在无约束契约条件下维持合作。15,625 参数配置验证和iOS生态系统实证（2008-2024）均证实框架有效性。
AI.motivation: 多利益相关者系统中的合作如何在缺乏正式约束的情况下持续存在？现有文献缺乏将概念建模（i*框架）与博弈论 reciprocity 分析相结合的动态模型。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为战略合作竞争提供可计算的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论框架：① 有限 reciprocity 响应函数（有限条件响应）；② k期记忆窗口追踪；③ 结构 reciprocity 敏感性（依赖矩阵放大行为响应）；④ 信任门控 reciprocity 机制。实证：iOS App Store生态系统（2008-2024）。
AI.result: 计算验证：15,625参数配置中，6项行为指标全部达标（合作涌现97.5%，背叛惩罚100%，宽恕动态87.9%，非对称区分100%，信任-reciprocity交互100%，有限响应100%）。实证验证：43/51适用点（84.3%），p<0.001，Cohen's d=1.57。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架成功整合了i*概念建模与博弈论 reciprocity 分析，适用于人类交互和多智能体系统。Foundations系列（TR-1~TR-4）采用单轴处理，Extensions系列（TR-5~TR-8）将引入双轴处理（合作与竞争作为独立维度）。

title: Free Information Disrupts Even Bayesian Crowds
summary: A core tenet underpinning the conception of contemporary information networks, such as social media platforms, is that users should not be constrained in the amount of information they can freely and willingly exchange with one another about a given topic. By means of a computational agent-based model, we show how even in groups of truth-seeking and cooperative agents with perfect information-processing abilities, unconstrained information exchange may lead to detrimental effects on the correctness of the group's beliefs. If unconstrained information exchange can be detrimental even among such idealized agents, it is prudent to assume it can also be so in practice. We therefore argue that constraints on information flow should be carefully considered in the design of communication networks with substantial societal impact, such as social media platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文用基于主体的计算模型（NetLogo）表明：即使群体成员都是完美、贝叶斯式且完全合作的"理想"信息处理者，在高同质性（homophily）互动结构下，无限制的信息交换反而会降低群体信念的正确性并加剧信念极化与认知不平等；因此"信息应当自由流动"作为社交媒体等通信网络的设计原则需要被限定与反思。
AI.motivation: 当代数字通信的核心信条是"信息想要自由"（information wants to be free）：在用户自愿的前提下，共享的信息越多，群体的认识论表现（epistemic performance）越好，这一信念贯穿社交媒体平台叙事，也渗透到教育、医疗、科研协作等场景。作者从"群体智慧"（wisdom of crowds）视角检验这一教条：既有研究（尤其是极化建模与智慧人群研究）多把信息交换简化为信念平均（belief averaging），未显式建模被交换的证据本身，也很少把"每次互动可交换的信息量"作为独立参数与同质性联合考察。若在个体信息处理与合作都达到理想上界时，无约束的信息流仍会造成损害，则现实场景更值得警惕——这构成对"信息自由"作为通信网络设计原则的方法论性质疑。
AI.method: 模型设定：世界有两个状态 A（真实）与 B（错误），先验 Pr(A)=Pr(B)=0.5；N=100 个 Bayesian 主体，每个初始持有一组私有证据，证据为 (s, q) 对——s∈{A,B} 为信号方向，q=Pr(s|A)=1−Pr(s|B)∈(0.5,1) 为信号质量（Bernoulli 试验质量），质量 q ~ Beta(2,9)/2+0.5（均值约 0.59），因此少量主体初始信念错误。互动：每个时间步随机配对，相似度 σ_{i,j,t}=1−|ℬ_j−ℬ_i|，配对概率 ∝ σ^h，h∈[0,10] 为同质性参数；沟通容量 k 决定每次互动交换的证据条数。交换是合作且"善意"的：发送方按其后验比例分享质量最高的证据（α=⌈ℬ(A)·k⌉ 条支持 A，β=⌊ℬ(B)·k⌋ 条支持 B），接收方对新证据按 Bayes 规则逐一更新后验。互动持续至后验跨过 0.5 阈值、信念不再变化的稳定态。指标：个体已实现认知增益 ρ_i=α_i/φ_i（相对完全信息后验的改进比例），并区分初始正确组 A 与初始错误组 B 的组级均值 W_A、W_B，总体均值 W，以及个体增益的 Gini 系数 G。统计：个体层面用多层模型（agent 嵌套于 run，100×70,000），组级/总体层面用线性回归，考察 k、h 及其交互项。实现于 NetLogo 6.2.0，代码与数据在 OSF 公开。
AI.result: 1) 轨迹层面：只有"高容量 + 低同质性"（panel iv）才使信念收敛到真实状态 A；"高容量 + 高同质性"（panel ii）表现最差，群体分裂为两极化阵营；低容量时无论同质性高低都只有中等表现。2) 多层回归：沟通容量 k 单独对个体认知增益影响极小（β=−0.01），但显著放大同质性的负面作用（交互 β=−0.12，同质性主效应 β=−0.48）；初始信念越接近正确状态，个体增益越大（β=0.63），且从高容量获益更多（交互 β=0.72）、受同质性损害更小（β=0.17）。3) 组级：A、B 两组平均增益均随 k 上升、随 h 下降；但 A 组中 k 的正效应占优（.26 vs −.16），B 组则 h 的负效应占优（.17 vs −.47），且 k 对同质性负面效应的放大在 B 组更强（−.17 vs −.12），导致两组的认知不平等 W_A−W_B 随 k（β=.11）、h（β=.65）及二者交互（β=.13）扩大。4) 总体层面：同质性负效应（β=−.34）压倒容量的正效应（β=.22），交互项 −.16 表明高容量进一步加剧总体损害；Gini 不平等上同质性（β=.38）同样压倒容量的均衡化作用（β=−.28），高容量使高同质性下的不平等更严重（β=.17）。5) 稳健性：结果对人口规模、初始信号分布与数量等变化稳健；在允许一对多广播、限制主体只分享支持自身后验的论据（非合作分享）、以及引入群体身份显著性（更愿接受内群体信息、拒绝外群体信息）等变体下结论大体一致。
AI.conclusion: 信息网络的"信息自由"原则不能脱离互动结构（尤其是同质性）来评估：当沟通发生在同质性社群内部时，更大的信息交换能力恰恰惩罚了最需要准确信息的弱势主体（初始信念错误者），加剧信念极化与认知不平等；适度的沟通容量反而能带来更大认知增益并提升群体智慧对同质性分区的鲁棒性。核心设计权衡是"同质性 × 沟通容量"。作者主张，在设计具有重大社会影响的通信网络（如社交媒体平台）时，应认真考虑对信息流的约束，而不是把"信息自由"当作无条件的设计原则。局限：结论限于二元决策场景、理想化的完美且合作的贝叶斯主体，以及极化过程中不涉及"负向影响"（negative influence）机制；未来可推广到序数型与多维决策问题，并研究真实群体中非理想信息处理与不合作倾向下的表现。

title: Optimizing Interventions for Agent-Based Infectious Disease Simulations
summary: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) are commonly used tools for controlling infectious disease transmission when pharmaceutical options are unavailable. Yet, identifying effective interventions that minimize societal disruption remains challenging. Agent-based simulation is a popular tool for analyzing the impact of possible interventions in epidemiology. However, automatically optimizing NPIs using agent-based simulations poses a complex problem because, in agent-based epidemiological models, interventions can target individuals based on multiple attributes, affect hierarchical group structures (e.g., schools, workplaces, and families), and be combined arbitrarily, resulting in a very large or even infinite search space. We aim to support decision-makers with our Agent-based Infectious Disease Intervention Optimization System (ADIOS) that optimizes NPIs for infectious disease simulations using Grammar-Guided Genetic Programming (GGGP). The core of ADIOS is a domain-specific language for expressing NPIs in agent-based simulations that structures the intervention search space through a context-free grammar. To make optimization more efficient, the search space can be further reduced by defining constraints that prevent the generation of semantically invalid intervention patterns. Using this constrained language and an interface that enables coupling with agent-based simulations, ADIOS adopts the GGGP approach for simulation-based optimization. Using the German Epidemic Micro-Simulation System (GEMS) as a case study, we demonstrate the potential of our approach to generate optimal interventions for realistic epidemiological models

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ADIOS（Agent-based Infectious Disease Intervention Optimization System），用语法引导的遗传编程（GGGP）自动优化基于智能体流行病仿真中的非药物干预（NPI）。核心是一套以上下文无关文法形式化的干预领域特定语言（DSL），配合"禁令（bans）"机制在生成前排除语义无效或冗余的干预模式，并用 GEMS 模型案例验证其在削减病假天数、失学/失工天数方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏疫苗或药物可用时，政策制定者只能依赖非药物干预（自我隔离、机构关闭等）来遏制传播，但这类措施会带来严重的社会经济代价（停工损失、学校关闭损害教育、长期隔离影响心理健康）。基于智能体的仿真（GEMS）虽能刻画异质人口结构与多层群体（家庭、学校、工作场所），但干预可依据多属性精确瞄准个体、可作用于层级群体、可任意组合，使得 NPI 搜索空间极为庞大甚至无穷。既有研究（ODE 优化、神经进化、贝叶斯优化）仅能调节事先给定干预的时间与强度，无法生成和演化结构复杂的干预本身；人工拟定策略也受限于决策者想象力。因此需要一个能够自动生成、组合并演化复杂 NPI 的决策支持系统。
AI.method: 1）DSL 与扩展上下文无关文法 <N,H,Σ,τ,P,Q,S>：干预 = [触发器](操作序列)，操作包括过滤器 a>a(p_a?)、g>g(p_g?)，映射 a2a/a2g/g2a/g2g（基于模型关系 r），措施 a!(p_a!)、g!(p_g!)，以及 & 并行组合；Σ/H 为通用部分，τ/Q 由用户按模型补充（如 GEMS 的 symptoms?、positive_test?、School/Household/Office、close!、self-isolate! 等）。2）Bans 机制：在生成前以 l ↛ {(h, {t'}) | h∈H} 形式禁止特定规则组合，self 解析为当前边终端、previous 继承上一条边的禁用集，从而阻止重复过滤器、重复自我隔离等语义等价模式。3）GGGP 流程：语法+ban 约束下生成解析树（max-depth 限制）→ 将解析树叶节点拼成 NPI 字符串并由解析器翻译为与模型交互的可执行实验规格（表现型）→ 运行仿真按目标函数计算适应度（定义为 1/(目标函数+1)）→ 通过克隆、锦标赛选择（size 3）、交叉（概率 0.7）、变异（概率 0.5）演化，且交叉/变异均需满足 bans（交叉点需标签相同且不违反禁令）。4）案例设置：GEMS v0.7.0 Saarland 人口模型，种群 10、最大深度 5、演化 4 代，每方案仿真一年，目标分别为 sick_days、lost_school_days、lost_work_days 及加权组合 (lost_work_days+lost_school_days+2*sick_days)。
AI.result: 四个场景均找到相对无干预基线显著改善目标指标的 NPI：场景1 [true]a!(self-isolate-14) 使病假天数由约 9.15 降至 0.04（实际导致全体长期隔离）；场景2 [true]a>a(positive_test?).a!(self-isolate-14) 失学天数由 0.67 降至 0.095，且失工、病假亦同步改善；场景3 由三支并行分支（按家庭规模分组的 7 天隔离 + 症状者 14 天隔离）构成，失工天数由 1.42 降至 0.14；场景4 组合目标得到「阳性检测者全家隔离 7 天」，病假 0.03、失工 0.13、失学 0.16。同时存在明显局限：场景3、4 的最优解在第 1–2 代即出现，整体收敛极快；场景1 中遗传算子几乎不起作用、效果等同随机搜索；场景2、4 第3→4代平均适应度反而下降，说明变异算子局部性弱（基因型小改动导致表现型剧变，如 symptoms?→adult?）；单次 GEMS 仿真耗时从数分钟到 10 小时以上，且未系统记录 NPI 与运行时间的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: ADIOS 证明了以 DSL+文法+禁令结构化搜索空间、并用 GGGP 演化复杂 NPI 是可行的通用范式，能生成人类难以手动的组合式干预（如「阳性者全家隔离」）。但当前实现的最终解质量高度依赖初始种群，遗传算子相对随机搜索优势有限，甚至可能陷入局部最优。后续工作包括：系统分析变异/交叉及种群规模、代数等超参数影响；改进变异局部性；研究 NPI 属性与仿真运行时间的相关性并探索并行化以降低计算成本；将方法推广到更多智能体流行病模型以验证灵活性；扩展 GEMS 专用语言以纳入更多触发器与措施选项以扩大搜索空间、缓解局部最优。作者认为，尽管案例仍暴露明显改进空间，自动生成与演化复杂 NPI 对智能体流行病模型的计算决策支持仍具前景。

title: A Role-Based LLM Framework for Structured Information Extraction from Healthy Food Policies
summary: Current Large Language Model (LLM) approaches for information extraction (IE) in the healthy food policy domain are often hindered by various factors, including misinformation, specifically hallucinations, misclassifications, and omissions that result from the structural diversity and inconsistency of policy documents. To address these limitations, this study proposes a role-based LLM framework that automates the IE from unstructured policy data by assigning specialized roles: an LLM policy analyst for metadata and mechanism classification, an LLM legal strategy specialist for identifying complex legal approaches, and an LLM food system expert for categorizing food system stages. This framework mimics expert analysis workflows by incorporating structured domain knowledge, including explicit definitions of legal mechanisms and classification criteria, into role-specific prompts. We evaluate the framework using 608 healthy food policies from the Healthy Food Policy Project (HFPP) database, comparing its performance against zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought (CoT) baselines using Llama-3.3-70B. Our proposed framework demonstrates superior performance in complex reasoning tasks, offering a reliable and transparent methodology for automating IE from health policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于角色的LLM框架，用于从健康食品政策中自动提取信息。该框架通过分配专门角色（政策分析师、法律策略专家、食品系统专家）来模拟专家分析工作流程，在608项健康饮食政策数据集上评估，使用Llama-3.3-70B模型，表现出优于零样本、少样本和思维链基线方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型（LLM）在健康食品政策领域的信息提取（IE）面临多重限制，包括因政策文档结构多样性和不一致性导致的幻觉、错误分类和遗漏问题。
AI.method: 提出基于角色的LLM框架，自动化处理非结构化政策数据的信息提取。该框架包含三个专门角色：(1) LLM政策分析师负责元数据和机制分类；(2) LLM法律策略专家负责识别复杂法律方法；(3) LLM食品系统专家负责分类食品系统阶段。框架通过将结构化领域知识（包括法律机制的明确定义和分类标准）融入角色特定提示中来模拟专家分析工作流程。使用Llama-3.3-70B模型进行评估。
AI.result: 在608项来自健康饮食政策项目（HFPP）数据库的政策上进行评估，与零样本、少样本和思维链（CoT）基线方法进行比较。结果表明，该框架在复杂推理任务中表现出色，提供了更可靠和透明的方法论。
AI.conclusion: 基于角色的LLM框架在健康政策信息提取任务中展示了优越性能，为从健康政策中自动化信息提取提供了可靠且透明的方法论。

title: ReFormeR: Learning and Applying Explicit Query Reformulation Patterns
summary: We present ReFormeR, a pattern-guided approach for query reformulation. Instead of prompting a language model to generate reformulations of a query directly, ReFormeR first elicits short reformulation patterns from pairs of initial queries and empirically stronger reformulations, consolidates them into a compact library of transferable reformulation patterns, and then selects an appropriate reformulation pattern for a new query given its retrieval context. The selected pattern constrains query reformulation to controlled operations such as sense disambiguation, vocabulary grounding, or discriminative facet addition, to name a few. As such, our proposed approach makes the reformulation policy explicit through these reformulation patterns, guiding the LLM towards targeted and effective query reformulations. Our extensive experiments on TREC DL 2019, DL 2020, and DL Hard show consistent improvements over classical feedback methods and recent LLM-based query reformulation and expansion approaches.

AI.tldr: ReFormeR是一种模式引导的查询重写方法，通过从查询对中提取可迁移的重写模式库，并基于检索上下文为新查询选择合适的模式来约束重写过程，而非直接让语言模型生成重写结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接让LLM生成查询改写，存在改写策略不明确、效果不稳定的问题。需要一种可控的、目标导向的查询重写方法。
AI.method: 1) 从初始查询与更强改写查询的配对中提取短重写模式；2) 将模式整合为紧凑的可迁移模式库；3) 根据新查询的检索上下文选择合适的模式；4) 用选定模式约束LLM进行目标性重写（如消歧、词汇落地、添加区分性方面等）。
AI.result: 在TREC DL 2019、DL 2020和DL Hard数据集上，ReFormeR相比传统反馈方法和近期LLM-based查询重写/扩展方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式化改写策略，模式引导的查询重写方法能够引导LLM生成更有针对性和有效性的查询改写。

title: Near-Optimal Parallel Approximate Counting via Sampling
summary:
The computational equivalence between approximate counting and sampling is well established for polynomial-time algorithms. The most efficient general reduction from counting to sampling is achieved via simulated annealing, where the counting problem is formulated in terms of estimating the ratio $Q={Z(β_{\max})}/{Z(β_{\min})}$ between partition functions $Z(β)=\sum_{x\in Ω} \exp(βH(x))$ of Gibbs distributions $μ_β$ over $Ω$ with Hamiltonian $H$, given access to a sampling oracle that produces samples from $μ_β$ for $β\in [β_{\min}, β_{\max}]$.
  The best bound achieved by known annealing algorithms with relative error $\varepsilon$ is $O(q \log h / \varepsilon^2)$, where $q, h$ are parameters which respectively bound $\ln Q$ and $H$. However, all known algorithms attaining this near-optimal complexity are inherently sequential, or *adaptive*: the queried parameters $β$ depend on previous samples.
  We develop a simple non-adaptive algorithm for approximate counting using $O(q \log^2 h / \varepsilon^2)$ samples, as well as an algorithm that achieves $O(q \log h / \varepsilon^2)$ samples with just two rounds of adaptivity, matching the best sample complexity of sequential algorithms. These algorithms naturally give rise to work-efficient parallel (RNC) counting algorithms.
  We discuss applications to RNC counting algorithms for several classic models, including the anti-ferromagnetic 2-spin, monomer-dimer and ferromagnetic Ising models.

AI.tldr: 论文研究近似计数与采样的计算等价性问题，提出新的非自适应和两轮自适应算法，样本复杂度分别为 O(q log²h/ε²) 和 O(q logh/ε²)，优于已知方法，并给出 RNC 并行计数算法。
AI.motivation: 现有最优的模拟退火计数算法本质上是顺序的或自适应的，查询的参数 β 依赖于先前样本。研究目标是开发非自适应或低自适应的算法，在保持相近样本复杂度的同时实现高效并行计算。
AI.method: 开发简单的非自适应近似计数算法，以及仅需两轮自适应性的算法。两种方法均基于 partition function 比例 Q = Z(β_max)/Z(β_min) 的估计。
AI.result: 非自适应算法使用 O(q log²h/ε²) 样本；两轮自适应算法使用 O(q logh/ε²) 样本，匹配顺序算法的最优样本复杂度。两种算法均可转化为工作高效的并行 RNC 计数算法。
AI.conclusion: 成功消除了自适应需求，实现高效并行计数算法，可应用于反铁磁 2 自旋、单体-二聚体和铁磁伊辛模型等多种经典模型的 RNC 计数问题。

title: EXaCTz: Guaranteed Extremum Graph and Contour Tree Preservation for Distributed- and GPU-Parallel Lossy Compression
summary: This paper introduces EXaCTz, a parallel algorithm that concurrently preserves extremum graphs and contour trees in lossy-compressed scalar field data. While error-bounded lossy compression is essential for large-scale scientific simulations and workflows, existing topology-preserving methods suffer from (1) a significant throughput disparity, where topology correction speeds are on the order of MB/s, lagging orders of magnitude behind compression speeds on the order of GB/s, (2) limited support for diverse topological descriptors, and (3) a lack of theoretical convergence bounds. To address these challenges, EXaCTz introduces a high-performance, bounded-iteration algorithm that enforces topological consistency by deriving targeted edits for decompressed data. Unlike prior methods that rely on explicit topology reconstruction, EXaCTz enforces consistent min/max neighbors of all vertices, along with global ordering among critical points. As such, the algorithm enforces consistent critical-point classification, saddle extremum connectivity, and the preservation of merge/split events. We theoretically prove the convergence of our algorithm, bounded by the longest path in a vulnerability graph that characterizes potential cascading effects during correction. Experiments on real-world datasets show that EXaCTz achieves a single-GPU throughput of up to 4.52 GB/s, outperforming the state-of-the-art contour-tree-preserving method (Gorski et al.) by up to 213x (with a single-core CPU implementation for fair comparison) and 3,285x (with a single-GPU version). In distributed environments, EXaCTz scales to 128 GPUs with 55.6\% efficiency (compared with 6.4\% for a naive parallelization), processing datasets of up to 512 GB in under 48 seconds and achieving an aggregate correction throughput of up to 32.69 GB/s.

AI.tldr: EXaCTz是一种并行算法，在有损压缩的标量场数据中同时保持极值图和轮廓树的拓扑一致性。该算法解决了现有拓扑保持方法存在的吞吐量差距大、拓扑描述符支持有限、缺乏理论收敛保证等问题，通过强制执行所有顶点的最小/最大邻居一致性以及关键点间的全局排序，实现了一致的临界点分类、鞍点-极值连通性以及分裂/合并事件的保持。
AI.motivation: 大尺度科学模拟和流工作流中，误差有界有损压缩至关重要，但现有拓扑保持方法存在三个主要问题：(1) 严重的吞吐量差距——拓扑校正速度仅为MB/s量级，而压缩速度可达GB/s量级；(2) 对多样化拓扑描述符的支持有限；(3) 缺乏理论收敛边界。这些问题限制了拓扑保持压缩在实际应用中的效率。
AI.method: EXaCTz提出了一种高性能、有界迭代算法，通过对解压缩数据推导针对性编辑来强制拓扑一致性。与显式拓扑重建方法不同，该算法通过强制所有顶点的最小/最大邻居一致性、关键点间的全局排序来实现：(1) 一致的临界点分类；(2) 鞍点-极值连通性保持；(3) 分裂/合并事件保持。算法收敛性被理论证明，收敛上界由脆弱性图中的最长路径刻画。
AI.result: 单GPU吞吐量达4.52 GB/s，比Gorski等人提出的最新轮廓树保持方法快213倍（单核CPU公平比较）或3285倍（单GPU版本）。分布式环境下可扩展至128个GPU，效率达55.6%（vs朴素并行化的6.4%），在48秒内处理512GB数据集，聚合校正吞吐量达32.69 GB/s。
AI.conclusion: EXaCTz通过有界迭代和针对性编辑策略，成功解决了拓扑保持压缩中的性能瓶颈问题。理论收敛性保证和优异的大规模实验结果表明，该方法在大规模科学数据处理中具有显著优势，为实时或准实时的拓扑感知压缩应用提供了可行方案。

title: Democratizing Foundations of Problem-Solving with AI: A Breadth-First Search Curriculum for Middle School Students
comment: Paper accepted to the 27th International Conference on AI in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: As AI becomes more common in students' everyday experiences, a major challenge for K-12 AI education is designing learning experiences that can be meaningfully integrated into existing subject-area instruction. This paper presents the design and implementation of an AI4K12-aligned curriculum that embeds AI learning goals within a rural middle school science classroom using Breadth-First Search (BFS) as an accessible entry point to AI problem-solving. Through unplugged activities and an interactive simulation environment, students learned BFS as a strategy for exploring networks and identifying shortest paths, then applied it to science contexts involving virus spread and contact tracing. To examine engagement and learning, we analyzed pre- and post-assessments, student work artifacts, and a teacher interview. Results suggest that students engaged productively with the curriculum, improved their understanding of BFS and AI problem-solving, and benefited from learning these ideas within ongoing science instruction. Teacher feedback further indicated that the module fit well within the science curriculum while supporting intended science learning outcomes. We conclude with curriculum and design considerations for broadening access to learning about problem-solving with AI in education.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并实施了一个与AI4K12框架对齐、嵌入乡村初中健康科学课堂的七天课程，用广度优先搜索（BFS）作为学生接触AI问题求解的低门槛入口。课程结合I-SAIL（基于Snap!的交互式学习环境）中的四个模拟活动与脱机（unplugged）活动，引导学生把BFS理解为在网络表示（节点与边）上逐层扩展、寻找最短路径的过程，并迁移到病毒传播与接触追踪等科学情境。研究结合前后测、学生作品与教师访谈，报告了理解提升与可行性证据，并给出面向教育的设计考量。
AI.motivation: K-12 AI教育面临的核心挑战是：正式的AI学习机会往往以独立工作坊或附加体验的形式出现，只能覆盖部分学生；而许多入门材料默认学生已具备编程或高等数学基础，从而把参与人群窄化到对AI本已有正面态度或更愿意报名的学生。为扩大参与面，作者主张把AI/计算思维内容整合进学科（尤其是科学）教学，使所有学生都能在常规课程中接触AI。另一动机是现有面向学生的AI交互工具（如Teachable Machine、PopBots、Calypso等）多聚焦于可观察的系统行为、错误与偏见，而不揭示AI系统"如何"得到输出的推理程序与内部表示，因此需要一个能让推理过程可视、可追踪的入门案例。作者选取BFS作为载体，因为它在网络表示上操作、逐层扩展、可追溯，是AI问题求解基础的清晰示例。
AI.method: 采用设计与实施的混合方法。研究场域为2025年秋季美国一所乡村公立初中（约11–14岁），覆盖三个年级共6个健康科学班（每班45分钟课时），由同一教师实施7天、约5小时的模块；参与学生103人，经家长同意与配对数据过滤后分析样本N=59（六年级14、七年级29、八年级16），前后测配对样本41人，已获NCSU IRB批准。课程与教师共同设计，遵循AI4K12"五大理念"之表征与推理，采用分阶段脚手架与Use-Modify-Create进阶：Day 1–3在I-SAIL（扩展Snap!的积木式环境，含自定义AI积木、可视化模拟与脚手架活动）中完成四个模拟活动（活动1用GPS式引导提出并检验最短路线；活动2显化BFS过程与frontier/visited术语并引导描摹；活动3减少指导、独立描摹；活动4在更大地图上按需请求提示完成最短路径）；Day 4为纸笔脱机描摹任务（记录"explored"与"path"列表）；Day 5为"荧光粉/UV灯"手部接触传播模拟与卡片式班级接触网络建模（绿/红标记感染状态，用网络距离讨论感染可能性）；Day 6在I-SAIL中用模拟检验温度、网络密度等因素对传播模式影响的假设；Day 7讨论职业路径与AI的社会影响。数据来源三方面：Activity 1前与Activity 4后施测的5题BFS知识前/后测（每题对错计分，总分为正确比例）；Day 2–3后的纸质BFS描摹工作表作品；以及实施后对授课教师的半结构化访谈。分析手段包括配对t检验、非参数Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Cohen's dz效应量、逐题分析、作品质性编码与访谈主题分析。
AI.result: RQ1：BFS知识前后测显著提升——前测 M=0.683 (SD=0.219)，后测 M=0.790 (SD=0.232)；配对t检验 t(40)=2.90, p=.006；Wilcoxon符号秩检验 W=87, p=.008；组内效应量 Cohen's dz=0.453（中度）。题目层面最大增益在K3（Δ=0.268），该题考察BFS如何找路径，正确答案描述为"从起点逐层向外扩展"。纸质描摹工作表中64.5%的学生能正确识别最短路径到目标状态，但书面过程记录普遍不完整：常跳过中间节点扩展及"待探索列表"的更新，且存在探索顺序记录不全或顺序错误的问题，提示学生的心理模型处于"不完整但正在形成"状态。RQ2（教师访谈）：教师认为课程与健康科学单元契合良好，同时支持了科学内容与AI概念的理解；把BFS与病毒传播、接触追踪相连接帮助学生看到该程序的相关性与目的；"动手/移动式+交互式"活动有效促进记忆，"更活跃的那天学生才真正开始理解并能回忆起当天所学"；教师建议简化教学语言、补充显性词汇教学、增加面向AI知识有限的教师的支持材料，并指出学生可能在课堂上声称理解但随后暴露困惑，需更频繁的知识检查与澄清机会。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将BFS作为"AI问题求解基础"嵌入常规学科（健康科学）教学，并以可视化模拟+脱机活动+师生共设的方式实施，可以让无编程背景、无先修要求的一般选修课学生有效参与AI学习并取得可测量的理解提升，同时契合既有科学课程与学习目标、降低教师实施门槛。作者据此提出面向K-12普及AI教育的课程与设计考量：通过视觉与脱机表征支撑概念可及性、与教育者合作以吸收课堂与社区视角、将AI课程置于学科情境中以使学生理解并关心AI的未来使用。同时提出开放的教学问题：课程应在何时强调逐步严格性、何时允许直觉性进展——过早要求完全的过程保真可能抑制意义建构；早期答对可能反映先于形式化程序对齐的直觉推理，未来研究可考察学生从"结果导向"策略向显式推理过渡的时机与教学干预方式，以及学科情境化方法如何帮助学生跨学科连接AI问题求解。

title: Know Your Streams: On the Conceptualization, Characterization, and Generation of Intentional Event Streams
summary: The shift toward IoT-enabled, sensor-driven systems has transformed how operational data is generated, favoring continuous, real-time event streams (ES) over static event logs. This evolution presents new challenges for Streaming Process Mining (SPM), which must cope with out-of-order events, concurrent activities, incomplete cases, and concept drifts. Yet, the evaluation of SPM algorithms remains rooted in outdated practices, relying on static logs or artificially streamified data that fail to reflect the complexities of real-world streams. To address this gap, we first perform a comprehensive review of data stream literature to identify stream characteristics currently not reflected in the SPM community. Next, we use this information to extend the conceptual foundation for ES. Finally, we propose Stream of Intent, a prototype generator to produce ES with specific features. Our evaluation shows excellence in producing reproducible, intentional ES for targeted benchmarking and adaptive algorithm development in SPM.

AI.tldr: 针对当前流式过程挖掘(SPM)算法评估仍依赖过时实践的问题，本文通过系统性文献综述识别了流数据特征，提出扩展事件流概念基础，并开发了Stream of Intent原型生成器，用于生成具有特定特征的可复现事件流。
AI.motivation: 当前SPM算法评估方法存在明显缺陷：依赖静态日志或人为"流化"的数据，无法真实反映物联网环境下连续实时事件流的复杂性（如乱序事件、并发活动、不完整案例、概念漂移等特征）。
AI.method: 1) 系统性文献综述，识别当前流数据特征；2) 扩展事件流概念基础；3) 开发Stream of Intent原型生成器
AI.result: 成功生成可复现的、意图驱动的事件流，适用于有针对性的基准测试和自适应算法开发。
AI.conclusion: Stream of Intent能有效产生符合真实场景复杂性的事件流，为SPM算法的评估和开发提供了更可靠的基准测试基础。

title: The Overlooked Repetitive Lengthening Form in Sentiment Analysis
summary: Individuals engaging in online communication frequently express personal opinions with informal styles (e.g., memes and emojis). While Language Models (LMs) with informal communications have been widely discussed, a unique and emphatic style, the Repetitive Lengthening Form (RLF), has been overlooked for years. In this paper, we explore answers to two research questions: 1) Is RLF important for sentiment analysis (SA)? 2) Can LMs understand RLF? Inspired by previous linguistic research, we curate \textbf{Lengthening}, the first multi-domain dataset with 850k samples focused on RLF for SA. Moreover, we introduce \textbf{Exp}lainable \textbf{Instruct}ion Tuning (\textbf{ExpInstruct}), a two-stage instruction tuning framework aimed to improve both performance and explainability of LLMs for RLF. We further propose a novel unified approach to quantify LMs' understanding of informal expressions. We show that RLF sentences are expressive expressions and can serve as signatures of document-level sentiment. Additionally, RLF has potential value for online content analysis. Our results show that fine-tuned Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) can surpass zero-shot GPT-4 in performance but not in explanation for RLF. Finally, we show ExpInstruct can improve the open-sourced LLMs to match zero-shot GPT-4 in performance and explainability for RLF with limited samples. Code and sample data are available at https://github.com/Tom-Owl/OverlookedRLF

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究社交媒体中被忽视的非正式风格「重复拉长形式」(RLF，如 loooove、amazing!!!!!)，回答两个问题：RLF 对情感分析是否重要？语言模型能否理解 RLF？作者构建了首个面向 RLF 情感分析的多域数据集 Lengthening（85 万样本，源自 4 个公开数据集、5 个领域），并提出两阶段可解释指令微调框架 ExpInstruct（GPT-4 CoT 生成词重要度分数 WIS + LLaMA2-13B LoRA 指令微调），同时提出统一的解释性量化指标 S_exp。结论：RLF 句是文档级情感的「签名」（RLF 组在所有模型上 Acc/F1 稳定高于无 RLF 组，人类评测同样验证）；微调后的 PLM 性能可超零样本 GPT-4 但解释性不足（「对了但理由不对」），ExpInstruct 仅用 1600 条样本即可让开源 LLaMA2 在性能与解释性上双双追平零样本 GPT-4。
AI.motivation: 在线社交媒体中存在大量非正式表达（meme、emoji、slogan、缩写等），已有工作对其与语言模型的关系做了广泛讨论，但有一种强调性极强的非正式风格——重复拉长形式（Repetitive Lengthening Form, RLF，如 loooove、love!!!!、year……）——多年来一直被忽视。RLF 在语言学上被视作对口语非言语提示的书面模拟（Kalman & Gergle 2014），早期研究指出它对情感词典增强和情感分析有潜在价值，但此前工作多停留在语言学与统计分析层面，缺乏针对现代 PLM/LLM 的系统性评测。其根本障碍是缺少专门聚焦 RLF 的数据集，使研究者既无法评估也无法改进模型对这类细微表达的理解。为此本文提出两个研究问题：1) RLF 对情感分析（SA）是否重要？2) LMs 能否理解 RLF？并从性能（performance）与可解释性（explainability）两个维度作答——因为已有研究表明模型常出现「对了但理由不对」（right for the wrong reasons）的现象。
AI.method:
1) 数据集构建（Lengthening, 85万样本）：数据源为 Amazon Reviews（Books/Electronics）、Yelp（Restaurants, 2021-02-16）、TripAdvisor（Hotels）、Twitter 四个公开数据集共 5 个领域；文档级标签由星级映射（1-2星为负、4-5星为正，3星中性被剔除），句子继承文档标签。RLF 泛化为两类：重复字母（Repetitive Letters, loooove）与重复标点（Repetitive Punctuation, amazing!!!!!）。生成流程三步：① 用 RLFsearch 正则在文档级筛出候选文档；② 句子切分并将少于五词的碎片并入前句以保极性，再用正则提取候选 RLF 句；③ 词级正则排除数字、URL、@开头词与金额，得到 RLF 词；用 Kalman & Gergle（2014）基于美式英语（PyEnchant）的算法求词根（loooove/loooovvve → love），并只保留泛化形式出现频率 >100 的实例；用 TweebankNLP 对词根打 POS 标签；再为每个 RLF 句从同文档随机配对一个无 RLF 句作为对照；最后对占优领域与拉长风格做下采样平衡（字母重复占20%、省略号8%）。

2) ExpInstruct（两阶段可解释指令微调）：阶段一提示 GPT-4 采用三步 CoT 生成词重要度分数 WIS——句子分解（保留标点）、逐词情感重要性打分（1-5）、结构化输出；阶段二以统一的指令模板 {Task Instruction}/{Input}/{Output} 对 LLaMA2-13B-chat 做 LoRA+SFT，同时训练两个任务：WIS 生成（输出 GPT-4 的结构化 WIS）与情感分类（输出文档级标签）。

3) 统一解释性量化方法：LLM 侧用提示式一次性推理产生 WIS（标签无关）；PLM 侧用基于遮挡（occlusion）的显著性方法，WIS[w_i]=|L[f(x),y]-L[f(x-w_i),y]|，以适配不提供损失/梯度的闭源模型；随后对 WIS 做 min-max + L1 归一化得到 WIS_norm，最终以 S_exp = 数据集上所有 RLF 词归一化 WIS 的均值作为可解释性得分。

4) 实验设置：3 个 PLM（RoBERTa-Large、GPT-2-Medium、T5-Base）分别在全量 85 万样本上微调（batch 64/32，lr 2e-5，3 次运行取均值±标准差）；LLM 侧从 Lengthening 分层采样 3000 条子集（按域分层，3 折交叉验证，每折 1.6k 训练）微调 LLaMA2-13B（4-bit 量化、LoRA rank 64/alpha 16、lr 2e-4、5 epoch）；GPT-4 与 LLaMA2 温度均设 0.2；全流程在单张 RTX A6000 上约一周完成。
AI.result:
RQ1（RLF 是否重要）：零样本下所有模型在 RLF 组的 Acc/F1 一致高于 w/o RLF 组（如 RoBERTa-Large 85.94/90.67 vs 84.40/89.56；GPT-4 86.26/90.12 vs 86.20/90.08），且该优势跨 Books/Electronics/Restaurants/Twitter/Hotels 五个域稳健成立；按句长分析显示句长 ≤80 字符（覆盖 >70% 句子）时差距尤为明显，故 RLF 句可视为文档级情感的签名。人类评测同样支持（RLF 组 90.01/92.52，w/o RLF 组 85.50/89.04，Krippendorff α=0.86），且零样本 GPT-4 已接近人类水平。用 Lengthening 微调后的模型迁移到文档级 SA 一致提升，平均 Acc +7.6%、F1 +4.5%（置信区间不重叠）。

RQ2（LMs 能否理解 RLF）：零样本 GPT-4 性能与解释性最佳（S_exp=0.38）；零样本 GPT-2 的 S_exp 虽高（字母/标点合计 0.49/0.39）但 Acc/F1 极低，说明「高解释性分数≠真理解」。所有微调 PLM 的 Acc/F1 均超零样本 GPT-4（RoBERTa-Large 91.59/94.59），但 S_exp（0.22-0.29）显著低于 GPT-4（0.38），呈现「对了但理由不对」。ExpInstruct 训练的 LLaMA2-13B 用 1600 条样本达到 Acc 87.20/F1 90.96、S_exp 0.35，在性能与解释性上同时逼近零样本 GPT-4（86.26/90.12、0.38）。

解释可靠性与消融：人工评测 WIS 可靠性（3 位标注者、200 样本）总体 IAA 0.44（中等），可靠性分与 S_exp 的相关系数达 0.91，验证统一解释性度量的有效性；样本量消融显示 500→1000→1600 时各指标单调提升但 1000 后增益放缓（S_exp 0.33→0.35→0.35）；指令策略消融显示仅 SA 指令能提升性能但 S_exp 仅 0.15，仅 WIS 指令能提升解释性（S_exp 0.35）却严重损害性能（Acc 72.60），二者联合最佳；泛化性实验中在 3k 子集上训练的 PLM 表现不及 ExpInstruct（90.80/94.03），ExpInstruct 在随机 3k OOD 数据上仍保持优势。另外，标点重复风格在三项指标上普遍强于字母重复风格，说明其情感表达力更强。
AI.conclusion:
本文的贡献在于把被忽视的 RLF 从语言学观察对象推进为可评测、可优化的 NLP 任务：其一，Lengthening 是首个面向 RLF 情感分析的多域大规模数据集（85 万样本，19,610 个唯一 RLF 词、1,677 个词根），为 UGC 短文本/口语化内容分析提供了基础资源；其二，ExpInstruct 以「GPT-4 生成 WIS → 开源 LLM 指令微调（性能任务 + 解释任务同模板）」的低成本路径，用少量样本（1.6k）把开源 LLaMA2 的性能与可解释性同时提升到零样本 GPT-4 水平，对闭源模型主导的评测生态具有现实意义；其三，跨架构（saliency vs prompting）的统一 WIS 归一化解释性指标 S_exp 打破了 PLM 与 LLM 之间不可比的方法壁垒，并经人工评测验证（相关系数 0.91）。

研究结论的实践含义：RLF 句子是文档级情感的强指示信号，尤其在句子短、非正式表达为主的社交媒体场景中，RLF 检测可作为内容分析的有效特征；同时提醒研究者，模型的高任务性能并不等于对关键语言现象的正确理解，必须配合可解释性度量进行验证。

局限性包括：用于可解释指令微调的 WIS 数据未经过人工校正（作者指出人工修正可进一步提升被指令微调的 LLaMA2）；未对 T5 做指令微调以对比；研究仅覆盖英文，尽管其数据集生成流程、ExpInstruct 框架与统一解释性度量被论证可直接迁移到其他语言（如西班牙语、罗马尼亚语、中文、阿拉伯语中的同类拉长形式）。

title: Identifying Privacy Concerns in Upcoming Software Release: A Peek into the Future
comment: Revising manuscript for IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: Identifying the features to be released in the next version of software, from a pool of potential candidates, is a challenging problem. User feedback from app stores is frequently used by software vendors for the evolution of apps across releases. Privacy feedback, although smaller in volume, carries a larger impact influencing app's success. Multiple existing work has focused on summarizing privacy concerns at the app level and has also shown that developers utilize feedback to implement security and privacy-related changes in subsequent releases. However, the current literature offers little support for release managers and developers in identifying privacy concerns prior to release. This gap exists as user reviews are typically available in app stores only after new features of a software system is released. In this paper, we introduce Pre-PI, a novel approach that summarizes privacy concerns for to-be-released features. Our method first maps existing features to semantically similar privacy reviews to learn feature-privacy review relations. We then simulate feedback for candidate features and generate concise summaries of privacy concerns. We evaluate Pre-PI across three real-world apps, and compare it with Hark, a state-of-the-art method that relies on post-release user feedback to identify privacy concerns. Results show that Pre-PI generates additional valid privacy concerns and identifies these concerns earlier than Hark, allowing proactive mitigation prior to release.

AI.tldr: Pre-PI是一种在软件版本发布前识别隐私问题的新方法，通过将现有功能映射到语义相似的隐私评论来学习功能-隐私评论关系，从而模拟待发布功能的反馈并生成隐私问题摘要，优于依赖发布后用户反馈的现有方法Hark。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只能在软件新功能发布后从应用商店获取用户反馈后才能分析隐私问题，无法在发布前帮助开发者和发布经理识别隐私问题，导致错失主动缓解隐私风险的时机。
AI.method: Pre-PI首先将现有功能映射到语义相似的隐私评论以学习功能-隐私评论关系，然后模拟待发布候选功能的反馈，最后生成简洁的隐私问题摘要。
AI.result: Pre-PI在三个真实应用上的评估显示，其能够生成额外的有效隐私问题，且识别时间早于Hark方法。
AI.conclusion: Pre-PI能够在上线前主动识别和缓解隐私问题，弥补了现有方法只能进行事后分析的不足。

title: DAXFS: A Lock-Free Shared Filesystem for CXL Disaggregated Memory
summary: CXL (Compute Express Link) enables multiple hosts to share byte-addressable memory with hardware cache coherence, but no existing filesystem exploits this for lock-free multi-host coordination. We present DaxFS, a Linux filesystem for CXL shared memory that uses cmpxchg atomic operations, which CXL makes coherent across host boundaries, as its sole coordination primitive. A CAS-based hash overlay enables lock-free concurrent writes from multiple hosts without any centralized coordinator. A cooperative shared page cache with a novel multi-host clock eviction algorithm (MH-clock) provides demand-paged caching in shared DAX memory, with fully decentralized victim selection via cmpxchg. We validate multi-host correctness using QEMU-emulated CXL 3.0, where two virtual hosts share a memory region with TCP-forwarded atomics. Under cross-host contention, DaxFS maintains >99% CAS accuracy with no lost updates. On single-host DRAM-backed DAX, DaxFS exceeds tmpfs throughput across all write workloads, achieving up to 2.68x higher random write throughput with 4 threads and 1.18x higher random read throughput at 64 KB. Preliminary GPU microbenchmarks show that the cmpxchg-based design extends to GPU threads performing page cache operations at PCIe 5.0 bandwidth limits.

AI.tldr: DaxFS 是一个约 2500 行 C 代码实现的 Linux 内核文件系统模块（可加载），专为 CXL 3.0 共享内存设计。它以 CXL 硬件保证一致的 64 位 cmpxchg 原子操作作为唯一协调原语，在无中心协调器、无分布式锁、无日志 journaling 的前提下实现多主机并发写入：核心是位于 DAX 内存中的 CAS 哈希覆盖层（16 字节桶、线性探测、63 位键编码区分数据页/inode/dirent/dirlist）、原子 bump 指针分配器与按类型无锁空闲链表；配合一个跨主机共享的协作式页缓存，其槽位元数据把状态、4 位 refcount 与 58 位 tag 打包进单个 64 位字以便单次 cmpxchg 原子更新，并提出完全去中心化的多主机 CLOCK 淘汰算法 MH-clock（冷 victim 选择、清除 ref_bit 并让出 CPU、重扫描强制淘汰三阶段，配合由 cmpxchg 推进的共享 evict_hand 后台扫描）。磁盘格式为扁平的「超级块 + 基础镜像 + 覆盖层 + 页缓存」四区域，各区域独立 4KB 头校验，目录为 271 字节定长线性数组（无指针环、可一次顺序扫描验证），读路径全程零拷贝（直接返回 DAX 指针、mmap 安装 PFN 映射、物理连续页合并为一次 copy_to_iter），跨主机一致性依靠 CXL 硬件一致性加 READ_ONCE 读取 i_size 与 smp_wmb/smp_rmb 内存序。文件系统支持 memremap 物理地址与 dma-buf 两种映射方式，可通过 DAXFS_IOC_GET_DMABUF 导出给 GPU 做 P2PDMA 零拷贝访问。
AI.motivation: CXL 3.0 的 GFAM（Global Fabric Attached Memory）配合设备一致性引擎 DCOH，首次让独立服务器在普通商用互连上以缓存行粒度对同一物理内存执行硬件一致的原子读-改-写操作，且软件一致性开销极小，这为共享内存系统抽象（类似 multikernel 问题）提供了新设计点。但现有系统软件并不适配：(1) per-host 复制——tmpfs、ext4-dax、NOVA 各维护各自的超级块/inode/dentry 缓存与页缓存，N 个主机对共享内存仍产生 N 份冗余副本，正好浪费了解耦内存所要汇聚的容量；(2) 缺乏多主机协调——ext4-dax 的 journaling 使用 per-host 事务 ID，NOVA 使用 per-CPU 日志，都无法处理跨主机并发写；最接近的 FamFS 采用单主日志重放模型，客户端不能创建、追加、截断或删除文件，也没有共享缓存与 CXL 原子协调；(3) 网络协议开销——NFS/CephFS/Lustre 在应用与字节可寻址内存之间插入网络协议，带来 μs 级延迟，而 CXL 内存本应是 ns 级 load/store；(4) GPU 数据路径——加载 70B FP16 模型需 140 GB，传统 read()+cudaMemcpy() 让每 GB 数据两次经过 CPU、一次跨 PCIe，GPUDirect Storage 虽绕过 CPU 但仍依赖块设备且不支持多主机共享与文件系统协调。此外，PCIe 3.0+ 的 AtomicOp TLP 与 CPU LOCK CMPXCHG 在内存控制器侧串行化，提供了让 GPU 线程参与同一协调机制的可能。论文据此提出三条设计要求：无中心协调器的无锁多主机写、跨主机单一共享缓存实例且状态转换相干以避免重复填充、以及应用直接 mmap 共享内存的零拷贝访问。
AI.method:
1) 布局与格式：在 DAX 映射的连续区域中顺序排列 Superblock(4KB)、Base Image(可选)、Inode Table(64B×N)、Data Area、Hash Overlay(可选，含 Bucket Array 16B×M 与 Pool)、Page Cache(可选，4KB 槽位+元数据)；支持 static/split/empty 三种模式。覆盖层池条目可变长：inode 32B（mode/uid/gid/size/时间戳，类型头在 offset 0）、数据页 4KB 无头（类型由哈希键编码推断，使连续分配页物理连续以便读路径合并）、dirent ~280B（含父 inode、名字、目标 inode、模式与删除墓碑标志）、dirlist 16B 作为每目录链表头；每类型条目有独立空闲链表，空闲链表头存于覆盖层头并以 cmpxchg 更新，复用条目前 8 字节作 next-free 指针。
2) 哈希覆盖层：16 字节桶 {uint64 state_key; uint64 pool_off;}，bit0 区分 FREE/USED，bits63:1 编码键。键编码为四类：数据页 (ino<<20)|pgoff（单文件支持 2^20 页即 4GB）、inode 元数据 (ino<<20)|0xFFFFF、目录链表头 (ino<<20)|0xFFFFE、目录项 FNV-1a(parent_ino,name)。插入协议为线性探测：计算 hash=key%bucket_count，读 state_key，若 FREE 则 cmpxchg(&state_key,0,key<<1|1) 抢占，失败则重试；已存在同键则更新/冲突，不同键则探测下一桶。池分配使用 atomic_cmpxchg 原子 bump 指针，元数据 8 字节对齐、数据页 PAGE_SIZE 对齐（既支持 PFN 映射又保证连续布局）。
3) 共享页缓存：槽位元数据 {__le64 state_tag; __le32 ref_bit; __le32 reserved;}，state_tag 的 bits[1:0] 为状态（FREE/PENDING/VALID），bits[5:2] 为 4 位 refcount，bits[63:6] 为 tag，三者打包以便单次 cmpxchg 原子更新。填充协议：探测 hash 起始的 8 个槽位，命中 VALID 则 CAS 增 refcount 固定并返回；找到 FREE 则 cmpxchg 抢占为 PENDING（tag），失败重试；随后 kernel_read 读入后端文件数据，再 cmpxchg 转 VALID；其他主机看到 PENDING 则自旋等待，避免重复读。
4) MH-clock 淘汰：完全去中心化，各主机在本地 8 槽探测窗口内三阶段选择 victim——(1) 找 ref_bit=0 且 refcount=0 的 VALID 槽，CAS 置 FREE 后重启填充；(2) 若全为热槽则清除其 ref_bit 并短暂 cpu_relax 让出 CPU；(3) 重扫，若仍无冷 victim 则强制淘汰首个 refcount=0 的 VALID 槽。另设后台 clock sweep，由赢得 cmpxchg 的主机把共享 evict_hand 原子推进 64 个槽并清除该窗口所有 VALID 槽的 ref_bit，输掉竞争者跳过，从而保证 ref_bit 在竞争下仍以受控速率衰减。refcount 保证正在被任一主机读取的槽永不被淘汰。
5) 一致性与读路径：i_size 权威值存于覆盖层 inode 条目，每次进入读路径用 READ_ONCE 刷新内核 VFS inode，避免显式失效消息；插入用 smp_wmb 保证先写池内容再写 pool_off，查找用 smp_rmb 保证读到完整条目（x86 上编译为屏障，ARM64 上为 fence）。读路径先查覆盖层键，命中直接返回池内指针；未命中回退基础镜像数据区；split 模式最后回退共享页缓存。mmap 直接安装 PFN 映射，数据页页对齐保证 PFN 有效。read_iter 检测物理连续页并合并为单次 copy_to_iter（16MB 顺序读从 4096 次拷贝降为 1 次）。目录操作：readdir 同时遍历基础镜像 dirent 数组与覆盖层链表（覆盖层优先），删除用墓碑条目。
6) 实现：注册 daxfs 文件系统类型，支持传统 mount(2) 与 Linux 5.6 引入的 fsopen/fsconfig/fsmount；物理地址路径用 memremap()（phys=/size= 选项），dma-buf 路径通过 FSCONFIG_SET_FD 传入 fd 并用 dma_buf_vmap() 获取内核映射，均绕过 dax_device 抽象。挂载时 validate 选项可单次顺序扫描完成超级块完整性、inode 边界、目录项引用与区域重叠校验，因无指针结构而无环注入/悬垂指针/无界遍历风险。GPU 侧通过 DAXFS_IOC_GET_DMABUF 导出 DAX 区域，修改版 NVIDIA 开放 GPU 内核模块注册为 pinned GPU 可访问内存，GPU 线程可发 Copy Engine 传输与 PCIe AtomicOp TLP 参与页缓存查找。
7) 评测环境：Platform A（双路 Xeon 48 核/96 线程、512GB DDR5、RTX 5090 PCIe 5.0 x16），512MB CMA 分配的 DRAM 区域以 memremap(MEMREMAP_WB) 模拟 CXL 写回路径；Platform B（Xeon Gold 5418Y），对比 ext4-dax 与 tmpfs。Linux 7.0、fio 3.x 同步 I/O 引擎，64MB 文件写后读，写测试间重格式化以保证冷覆盖层状态，覆盖层 400MB 池、65536 桶。多主机评测用修改版 QEMU 10.0，两个虚拟主机共享内存区域并经 TCP 转发 CXL 原子请求。
AI.result:
单主机 DRAM-backed DAX 上，DaxFS 在所有写工作负载上均超过 tmpfs：顺序写首次写 1.16–1.27×（4K 首次 1730 vs 1362 MiB/s，4K 重写 1.18×，1M 重写 1.09×），优势来自批量池分配（单次 cmpxchg 预留 N 个条目）与连续覆盖层布局摊薄逐页分配成本；重写时因全部页命中 per-inode xarray 而进一步扩大领先。顺序读 0.87–1.08× tmpfs，4K 时快 8%（直接 copy_to_iter 绕过 filemap_read/filemap_get_pages/folio 引用计数），1M 时为 0.87×。随机读在所有线程数下占优（4K 1 线程 1.14×、4 线程 1.13×、8 线程因带宽饱和降至 0.94×；64K 4 线程 15.05 vs 12.8 GiB/s，1.18×），因 xarray 填充后只读、无 RCU 宽限期与 folio 锁。随机写扩展最显著：4K 4 线程 4830 vs 1803 MiB/s，达 2.68×，因 tmpfs 在缺页处理时串行化于逐页锁与全局 i_pages xarray 锁，而 DaxFS 直接写入预分配覆盖页，数据路径无锁。相对 ext4-dax 优势显著：16MB 顺序读 59.2 MB/s 为其 6.2×，延迟 274.2 ms 对 1660.7 ms（6.1×）；stat 延迟 3528 ms，比 ext4-dax 快 4.6%、比 tmpfs 快 6.3%；但 readdir 33.8 ms 慢于 tmpfs(23.1) 与 ext4-dax(23.9)，源于需同时遍历基础镜像 dirent 数组与覆盖层链表。
多主机（QEMU 模拟 CXL 3.0，TCP 转发原子）下：CAS 成功率在所有线程数下保持 >99%，无丢失更新，高线程数下轻微下降源于共享桶竞争触发的设计内重试；并发插入在两主机产生一致覆盖层状态。模拟开销显著：DRAM 约 100 Mops/s 而 CXL 原子仅 1–3 Mops/s（慢 30–100×），批量（batch_200）可摊薄网络成本；CXL/DRAM 减速比约 500×–6000×，主要来自 TCP 转发延迟，真实 CXL 3.0 交换机预期可降至 μs 级。
GPU 侧（RTX 5090，PCIe 5.0，pinned host 内存）：易失读 commit_seq 529 ns（一次 PCIe 5.0 往返），CAS 增减 1811 ns（3.4×读，反映内存控制器串行化），锁获取+释放 2048 ns；页缓存快速路径（volatile 读+tag 比较）近线性扩展至 8 线程约 8 Mops/s，1024 线程达 500+ Mops/s，单次操作延迟从 910 ns 降至 <2 ns（warp 调度器摊薄 PCIe 延迟）；独立槽位上的 64 位 atomicCAS 在 512 线程达 11.7 Mops/s，饱和于 PCIe 5.0 AtomicOp 带宽上限约 11.5 Mops/s，说明瓶颈在 PCIe 带宽而非软件；锁竞争下每次获取时间随线程数下降（1 线程 2350 ns → 32 线程 150 ns）；冷缺失声明路径在全局 pending 计数器上串行化（1 线程 0.23 Mops/s，1024 线程降至 0.005 Mops/s），属设计使然，因声明是每文件页一次的罕见事件，稳态下 GPU 走 VALID 快速路径。端到端推算：加载 70B FP16 模型（140GB），传统 read()+cudaMemcpy() 需 140/12+140/50 ≈ 14.5 s，DaxFS GPU 直读 DAX 约 2.8 s；GPU 发起冷页声明最坏串行估计约 154 s，但实践中可流水线化并由 CPU 填充速率摊薄。
局限：扁平目录查找为 O(n)，约 10K 条目以上宜用覆盖层索引；覆盖层桶数创建时固定，动态扩缩容需跨主机 stop-the-world 迁移，建议负载因子 <70%（75% 时平均探测长 2.5，90% 时 5.5）；持久性依赖 ADR/eADR，未显式发 clflush/clwb，无 ADR 平台崩溃可能丢失近期插入；池不做压实，长期高频 churn 会碎片化；GPU 侧仅支持只读 dma-buf 访问，GPU 主动写未实现；不支持 mknod（设备/FIFO/socket）与扩展属性，文件名限 255 字符。
AI.conclusion: DaxFS 通过把 cmpxchg 作为唯一协调原语，为 CXL 3.0 共享内存提供了一个此前不存在的文件系统抽象层：在无中心协调器、无 journaling、无网络协议的前提下实现多主机锁-free 并发写、共享协作式缓存（MH-clock 去中心化淘汰）与统一零拷贝访问，填补了 FamFS 只能单主日志重放、NOVA/PMFS 等仅单主机 PM 存储、以及 EROFS/Slacker 只读镜像分发之间的空白。评测显示：QEMU 模拟的跨主机环境下 CAS 准确率 >99% 且无丢失更新，验证了锁-free 协议在真实跨主机竞争下的正确性；单主机 DRAM-backed DAX 上全面超过 tmpfs 的写负载（4 线程随机写最高 2.68×）、随机读最高 1.18×，并显著优于 ext4-dax（16MB 顺序读 6.2×、延迟 6.1×）与最低 stat 延迟；GPU 微基准表明基于 cmpxchg 的设计可自然延伸至 GPU 线程，槽位级 CAS 吞吐受限于 PCIe 5.0 AtomicOp 带宽而非软件开销，说明该设计未引入多余抽象层。随着 CXL 3.0 硬件成熟，DaxFS 可作为解耦内存池跨主机共享的即用文件系统层，其开源实现含内核模块、mkdaxfs 镜像工具与 daxfs-inspect 调试工具。

title: Runtime Burden Allocation for Structured LLM Routing in Agentic Expert Systems: A Full-Factorial Cross-Backend Methodology
summary:
Structured LLM routing is often treated as a prompt-engineering problem. We argue that it is, more fundamentally, a systems-level burden-allocation problem. As large language models (LLMs) become core control components in agentic AI systems, reliable structured routing must balance correctness, latency, and implementation cost under real deployment constraints. We show that this balance is shaped not only by prompts or schemas, but also by how structural work is allocated across the generation stack: whether output structure is emitted directly by the model, compressed during transport, or reconstructed locally after generation.
  We evaluate this formulation through a comprehensive full-factorial benchmark covering 48 deployment configurations and 15,552 requests across OpenAI, Gemini, and Llama backends. Our central finding is consequential: there is no universal best routing mode. Instead, backend-specific interaction effects dominate performance. Modes that remain highly reliable on Gemini and OpenAI can suffer substantial correctness degradation on Llama, while efficiency gains from compressed realization are strongly backend-dependent.
  Rather than presenting another isolated model comparison, this work contributes a deployable framework for reasoning about structured routing under heterogeneous backend conditions. We provide a cross-backend evaluation methodology and practical deployment guidance for navigating the correctness-cost-latency frontier in production-grade agentic expert systems.

AI.tldr: 论文将结构化LLM路由从提示工程问题重新定义为系统级负担分配问题，通过48种部署配置和15,552个请求的全因子基准测试发现：没有通用的最优路由模式，Gemini/OpenAI与Llama之间存在显著的可靠性差异，压缩实现的效率收益高度依赖后端。
AI.motivation: 结构化LLM路由通常被视为提示工程问题，但作者认为这本质上是系统级负担分配问题。在agentic AI系统中，可靠的结构化路由必须在正确性、延迟和实现成本之间取得平衡，这种平衡不仅取决于提示或模式，还取决于结构化工件如何在生成堆栈中分配——模型直接输出、在传输中压缩，还是在本地重建。
AI.method: 采用全因子基准测试设计，覆盖48种部署配置和15,552个请求，测试OpenAI、Gemini和Llama三个后端。重点研究输出结构的三个实现路径：直接发射、传输压缩和本地重建。
AI.result: 核心发现：1）不存在通用的最优路由模式；2）后端特定的交互效应主导性能表现；3）在Gemini和OpenAI上高度可靠的模式在Llama上会出现严重的正确性下降；4）压缩实现的效率收益高度依赖后端。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了一个可在异构后端条件下进行结构化路由推理的可部署框架，提供了跨后端评估方法论和生产级agentic专家系统的部署指导。

title: DySCo: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Effective Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) is critical across domains such as finance, meteorology, and energy. While extending the lookback window theoretically provides richer historical context, in practice, it often introduces irrelevant noise and computational redundancy, preventing models from effectively capturing complex long-term dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Compression (DySCo) framework. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed heuristics, DySCo introduces an Entropy-Guided Dynamic Sampling (EGDS) mechanism to autonomously identify and retain high-entropy segments while compressing redundant trends. Furthermore, we incorporate a Hierarchical Frequency-Enhanced Decomposition (HFED) strategy to separate high-frequency anomalies from low-frequency patterns, ensuring that critical details are preserved during sparse sampling. Finally, a Cross-Scale Interaction Mixer(CSIM) is designed to dynamically fuse global contexts with local representations, replacing simple linear aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that DySCo serves as a universal plug-and-play module, significantly enhancing the ability of mainstream models to capture long-term correlations with reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DySCo框架，通过动态语义压缩解决时间序列预测中长窗口引入噪声和计算冗余的问题，包含EGDS、HFED和CSIM三个核心组件，可作为通用即插即用模块提升主流模型的长期依赖捕捉能力。
AI.motivation: 传统方法扩展回溯窗口时引入无关噪声和计算冗余，无法有效捕捉复杂长期依赖关系
AI.method: 1) EGDS机制：熵引导动态采样，自主识别并保留高熵段，压缩冗余趋势；2) HFED策略：分层频域增强分解，分离高频异常与低频模式；3) CSIM模块：跨尺度交互混合器，动态融合全局上下文与局部表示
AI.result: DySCo作为通用即插即用模块，显著增强主流模型捕捉长期相关性能力，同时降低计算成本
AI.conclusion: 动态语义压缩策略能有效解决长窗口预测中的噪声冗余问题，框架具有良好的通用性和实用性

title: Systematic Analyses of Reinforcement Learning Controllers in Signalized Urban Corridors
summary: In this work, we extend our systematic capacity region perspective to multi-junction traffic networks, focussing on the special case of an urban corridor network. In particular, we train and evaluate centralized, fully decentralized, and parameter-sharing decentralized RL controllers, and compare their capacity regions and ATTs together with a classical baseline MaxPressure controller. Further, we show how the parametersharing controller may be generalised to be deployed on a larger network than it was originally trained on. In this setting, we show some initial findings that suggest that even though the junctions are not formally coordinated, traffic may self organise into `green waves'.

AI.tldr: 本文将作者此前的“容量区域（capacity region）”视角从单交叉口扩展到多交叉口城市走廊网络，在 SUMO 中训练并对比了集中式 PPO、完全去中心化 PPO、参数共享去中心化 PPO 三类 RL 信号控制器与 MaxPressure 经典基线。结果显示：三种 RL 控制器的稳定运行需求范围显著大于 MaxPressure（后者容量区域因走廊结构呈不对称），在所有控制器均稳定的“繁忙”需求下，集中式 PPO 的 ATT 最低、去中心化 PPO 次之、参数共享因路口角色不同而性能下降；但参数共享策略可直接迁移到规模更大的网络（13 个路口），在 l=700 m 时零停车比例达约 0.57，接近理论近优值，提示各路口虽无显式协调却通过车流 platoons 自组织出“绿波”。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 交通信号控制研究通常仅在单一需求设定下评估性能，缺乏对控制器在不同需求（交通量）水平下如何相互比较的系统性刻画。当需求超过控制器的服务能力时，排队持续增长、系统失稳并出现回溢（spillback）拥堵，此时直接比较平均行程时间（ATT）已无意义。作者主张性能比较应在“所有控制器均处于稳定状态”的需求条件下进行，因此延续其前作（Song et al., 2026）提出的容量区域概念——即控制器能维持稳定排队动态的需求组合集合——并将其推广到多交叉口网络，特别是城市走廊这一特例，以系统性地研究 RL 控制器的鲁棒性、泛化能力以及跨路口的自组织协调现象。
AI.method: 仿真平台为 SUMO。构建 n 个等间距（间距 l）信号化交叉口的走廊网络，各方向单车道、仅直行交通；车辆按独立泊松过程到达入口链路，入口设无限容量备份队列以储存未被服务的需求，通过备份队列统计判定某次仿真是否处于容量之内（是否稳定）。每个交叉口两个相位（NS/SN 与 WE/EW 交替），决策周期 17 s（切换相位时 2 s 黄灯 + 15 s 新相位）。基线为 MaxPressure 控制器。RL 采用 PPO，构建三种架构：(i) 集中式 PPO——单一控制器观测全网交通状态并输出所有路口决策；(ii) 完全去中心化 PPO——每个路口由独立控制器依据本地状态学习自身策略；(iii) 参数共享去中心化 PPO——强制所有路口共享同一策略，实现共享训练+去中心化执行。MDP 设定：状态为进口车道交通密度，动作空间二值（维持当前相位或切换），奖励为负排队长度；去中心化用本地负排队和，集中式用全网负排队总和。三种 RL 控制器均在 λ_NS=λ_WE=700 veh/h（接近 MaxPressure 容量上限）的单一需求设定下训练（500 次仿真、每次 10,000 s，至收敛），选取最高回报策略，再在不同的 (λ_NS, λ_WE) 需求组合上评估以估计容量区域并比较 ATT。此外将参数共享控制器直接部署到 13×1 走廊（λ_NS=λ_SN=100、λ_WE=800、λ_EW=0 以打破对称），变化 l 从 200 m 至 2000 m，用“零停车比例”（WE 方向车辆全程无停车通过走廊的比例）刻画绿波，并对比 n=1 情形与 0.93^13 的理论极限。
AI.result: （1）容量区域：以 n=3 为例，三种 RL 控制器稳定运行的需求配置集合显著大于 MaxPressure；MaxPressure 的容量区域明显不对称，因 WE/EW 方向车辆需穿越更多交叉口、受更多控制决策影响而更易拥堵，可行需求范围更窄；RL 控制器对协调复杂度更鲁棒。（2）ATT：在所有控制器均稳定的 λ_NS+λ_WE=1400 veh/h 繁忙场景下，集中式 PPO 始终最优（如 100/1300 需求下 64.87 s，1300/100 下 123.99 s），完全去中心化仅略差（65.29 s / 130.69 s），参数共享介于或接近两者之间（如 500/900 时 84.16 s 优于集中式 85.78 s；1000/400 时 113.44 s 劣于集中式 105.97 s）——参数共享提升了训练效率但因共享策略无法适配路口角色差异（J1、J3 位于网络边界，J2 仅承接 EW/WE 流量）而在 EW/WE 流量增大时性能下降。（3）跨网络泛化与绿波：参数共享控制器无需重新训练即可部署到 13 个交叉口网络，零停车比例随 l 增大先升后降，在 l=700 m（约 50 s 自由流行程）达到峰值约 0.57；同样配置下 n=1 的零停车比例约 0.93，而 0.93^13≈0.39~0.43（即 l→∞ 的极限），说明独立控制器通过 platoon 串联而间接耦合，逼近理论近优性能，表明无显式协调下可能出现自发“绿波”。
AI.conclusion: 结论与展望：RL 信号控制器相比经典 MaxPressure 具有更大的容量区域（在单点需求上训练即可泛化到稳定运行范围更广的需求空间），系统性比较应在容量区域内进行；集中式控制器在行程时间上最优而去中心化代价很小；参数共享去中心化以一定性能代价换取训练效率与跨网络即插即用部署能力，并可促成自组织绿波。作者指出实际部署的关键挑战有二：控制器需在训练集之外的需求条件下表现良好（容量区域是首个系统研究此类鲁棒性的尝试），以及需泛化到训练网络之外而无需从零训练；参数共享去中心化被视为有前景的解决组件，后续工作将研究向 n×n 网格网络的泛化。

title: STABLE: Efficient Hybrid Nearest Neighbor Search via Magnitude-Uniformity and Cardinality-Robustness
summary: Hybrid Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (Hybrid ANNS) is a foundational search technology for large-scale heterogeneous data and has gained significant attention in both academia and industry. However, current approaches overlook the heterogeneity in data distribution, thus ignoring two major challenges: the Compatibility Barrier for Similarity Magnitude Heterogeneity and the Tolerance Bottleneck to Attribute Cardinality. To overcome these issues, we propose the robuSt heTerogeneity-Aware hyBrid retrievaL framEwork, STABLE, designed for accurate, efficient, and robust hybrid ANNS under datasets with various distributions. Specifically, we introduce an enhAnced heterogeneoUs semanTic perceptiOn (AUTO) metric to achieve a joint measurement of feature similarity and attribute consistency, addressing similarity magnitude heterogeneity and improving robustness to datasets with various attribute cardinalities. Thereafter, we construct our Heterogeneous sEmantic reLation graPh (HELP) index based on AUTO to organize heterogeneous semantic relations. Finally, we employ a novel Dynamic Heterogeneity Routing method to ensure an efficient search. Extensive experiments on five feature vector benchmarks with various attribute cardinalities demonstrate the superior performance of STABLE.

AI.tldr: STABLE是一个用于大规模异构数据的混合近似最近邻搜索框架，通过AUTO度量解决相似度幅度异构性问题，通过HELP索引组织异构语义关系，并采用动态异构路由实现高效搜索，在多种属性基数的特征向量基准数据集上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 当前混合近似最近邻搜索方法忽视了数据分布的异构性，存在两个主要挑战：相似度幅度异构性导致的兼容性障碍，以及属性基数异构性带来的容忍瓶颈。这些问题导致现有方法在处理不同分布特征的数据集时准确性和鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: STABLE框架包含三个核心组件：1) AUTO度量（增强的异构语义感知度量），实现特征相似性与属性一致性的联合测量；2) HELP索引（异构图），基于AUTO组织异构语义关系；3) 动态异构路由方法，确保高效搜索。
AI.result: 在五个具有不同属性基数的特征向量基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了STABLE在准确率、效率和鲁棒性方面的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: STABLE框架能够有效应对数据分布异构性挑战，为大规模异构数据场景下的混合近似最近邻搜索提供了一种准确、高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Space-Efficient Text Indexing with Mismatches using Function Inversion
summary:
A classic data structure problem is to preprocess a string T of length $n$ so that, given a query $q$, we can quickly find all substrings of T with Hamming distance at most $k$ from the query string. Variants of this problem have seen significant research both in theory and in practice. For a wide parameter range, the best worst-case bounds are achieved by the "CGL tree" (Cole, Gottlieb, Lewenstein 2004), which achieves query time roughly $\tilde{O}(|q| + \log^k n + \# occ)$ where $\# occ$ is the size of the output, and space ${O}(n\log^k n)$. The CGL Tree space was recently improved to $O(n \log^{k-1} n)$ (Kociumaka, Radoszewski 2026).
  A natural question is whether a high space bound is necessary. How efficient can we make queries when the data structure is constrained to $O(n)$ space? While this question has seen extensive research, all known results have query time with unfavorable dependence on $n$, $k$, and the alphabet $Σ$. The state of the art query time (Chan et al. 2011) is roughly $\tilde{O}(|q| + |Σ|^k \log^{k^2 + k} n + \# occ)$.
  We give an $O(n)$-space data structure with query time roughly $\tilde{O}(|q| + \log^{4k} n + \log^{2k} n \# occ)$, with no dependence on $|Σ|$. Even if $|Σ| = O(1)$, this is the best known query time for linear space if $k\geq 3$ unless $\# occ$ is large. Our results give a smooth tradeoff between time and space. We also give the first sublinear-space results: we give a succinct data structure using only $o(n)$ space in addition to the text itself.
  Our main technical idea is to apply function inversion (Fiat, Naor 2000) to the CGL tree. Combining these techniques is not immediate; in fact, we revisit the exposition of both the Fiat-Naor data structure and the CGL tree to obtain our bounds. Along the way, we obtain improved performance for both data structures, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在O(n)空间约束下，如何高效回答字符串的Hamming距离查询问题。通过将Fiat-Naor函数求逆技术应用于CGL树，提出了一个O(n)空间的数据结构，查询时间约为O(|q| + log^{4k}n + log^{2k}n·#occ)，且与字母表大小无关。这是k≥3时线性空间下已知最优的查询时间，同时给出了空间-时间的平滑权衡以及首个亚线性空间结果。
AI.motivation: CGL树虽然具有优秀的查询时间复杂度，但其空间复杂度为O(n log^k n)。最近空间被优化到O(n log^{k-1}n)，但自然的问题是：在O(n)空间的约束下，查询效率能有多高？此前的研究虽然有进展，但查询时间对n、k和字母表Σ的依赖都不理想。本文旨在回答这个问题。
AI.method: 主要技术思路是将Fiat-Naor的函数求逆技术应用于CGL树。这一结合并非直接，需要重新审视Fiat-Naor数据结构和平滑权衡技术以及CGL树的描述，以获得更好的理论边界。
AI.result: 提出了一个O(n)空间的数据结构，查询时间约为O(|q| + log^{4k}n + log^{2k}n·#occ)，且与|Σ|无关。即使|Σ| = O(1)，当k≥3且#occ不大时，这也是已知最好的线性空间查询时间。同时给出了首个亚线性空间结果——仅使用o(n)额外空间的简洁数据结构。
AI.conclusion: 本文在O(n)空间约束下实现了最优的查询时间（k≥3时），提供了空间-时间的平滑权衡，并首次实现了亚线性空间的Hamming距离字符串索引。文中对Fiat-Naor数据结构和CGL树的改进也具有独立的研究价值。

title: ModTrans: Translating Real-world Models for Distributed Training Simulator
summary: Large-scale distributed training has been a research hot spot in machine learning systems for industry and academia in recent years. However, conducting experiments without physical machines and corresponding resources is difficult. One solution is to leverage distributed training simulators, but current ones like ASTRA-sim do not support importing real-world developed models, which poses challenges for ML researchers seeking to use them. Based on this challenge, we developed ModTrans, a translator supporting format translation from any real-world model to the ASTRA-sim simulator's input, removing the barrier between machine learning experts and machine learning system researchers. The experiment results show that ModTrans's cost is negligible.

AI.tldr: ModTrans是一个翻译器，可将任何真实世界的模型格式转换为ASTRA-sim模拟器的输入格式，解决现有分布式训练模拟器无法导入真实模型的问题，使机器学习专家能够便捷地利用模拟器进行实验研究。
AI.motivation: 大规模分布式训练是机器学习系统领域的热点研究问题，但缺乏物理机器和资源时难以进行实验验证。虽然ASTRA-sim等分布式训练模拟器提供了解决方案，但其不支持导入真实世界开发的模型，导致机器学习研究人员难以使用这些模拟器，形成了ML专家与ML系统研究者之间的壁垒。
AI.method: 开发了ModTrans翻译器，支持从任意真实世界模型到ASTRA-sim模拟器输入格式的格式转换，从而实现模型的无缝导入与模拟。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ModTrans的转换开销可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: ModTrans有效消除了机器学习专家与机器学习系统研究者之间的技术壁垒，使得ML专家能够便捷地利用ASTRA-sim等模拟器进行分布式训练相关的实验研究。

title: Training-Free Private Synthesis with Validation: A New Frontier for Practical Educational Data Sharing
summary: While secondary use of real-world data (RWD) in education offers substantial research opportunities, data sharing is often limited by privacy constraints. Differentially private synthetic data generation (DP-SDG) has emerged as a possible solution. However, educational RWD is fragmented across platforms and institutions and stored in different formats, so DP-SDG must be tailored to each dataset, requiring substantial engineering effort. In addition, such data are often small-sample and high-dimensional, making deep learning (DL)-based methods common but difficult to implement without specialist expertise. In this setting, it is also hard to achieve practically useful downstream utility. As a result, despite its theoretical promise, DP-SDG remains far from a practical solution in education. To address this issue, we propose a more practical two-stage method: (1) training-free, LLM-based DP-SDG is performed for sharing synthetic data and (2) on-demand real-data validation, where researchers submit code for remote validation of results. This simple method is designed for individual data custodians without extensive DP-SDG expertise. It can also be adapted to multi-shot synthesis, where data from different learner cohorts are synthesised regularly. We evaluate this method experimentally in both the one-shot and multi-shot synthesis settings using RWD collected over three years and conduct a case study with real researchers. Results show that LLM-based DP-SDG performs comparably to a DL-based baseline while greatly reducing engineering costs, and that non-DP validation causes measurable but moderate privacy leakage. Nonetheless, in the case study researchers reported that on average only 36% of synthetic findings are validated on real data. Overall, the paper provides a practical method for sharing educational RWD, while highlighting challenges in risk mitigation and epistemic precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种实用的两阶段差分隐私合成数据生成(DP-SDG)方法，用于教育领域的真实世界数据共享。该方法结合了基于LLM的无训练合成数据生成和按需真实数据验证，旨在降低隐私保护数据共享的技术门槛。
AI.motivation: 教育领域真实世界数据(RWD)的二次利用面临隐私限制和数据碎片化的挑战。现有的深度学习DP-SDG方法需要大量工程工作，且对小样本高维数据效果有限，难以实现实用的下游效用。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法：(1)基于LLM的无训练差分隐私合成数据生成，实现合成数据共享；(2)按需真实数据验证，研究人员提交代码进行远程结果验证。方法支持单次和多轮合成场景。实验采用三年收集的真实数据评估，并与深度学习方法对比。
AI.result: LLM-based DP-SDG与深度学习方法性能相当，同时大幅降低工程成本；非DP验证造成可测量但适度的隐私泄露。案例研究中，研究人员报告平均仅36%的合成数据发现能在真实数据上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为教育RWD共享提供了实用方案，但仍存在风险缓解和认识论精确性方面的挑战。未来需改进隐私风险控制，提高验证覆盖率。

title: CogPic: A Multimodal Dataset for Early Cognitive Impairment Assessment via Picture Description Tasks
summary: The automated evaluation of cognitive status utilizing multimedia technologies presents a promising frontier in early dementia diagnosis. However, the development of robust machine learning models for cognitive impairment detection is frequently hindered by the scarcity of large-scale, strictly synchronized, and clinically validated multimodal datasets. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce the CogPic database, a comprehensive multimodal benchmark meticulously designed for fine-grained cognitive impairment detection. The dataset comprises strictly synchronized audio, visual, and linguistic data continuously collected from 574 participants during a naturalistic picture description task. To establish highly reliable diagnostic ground truth, expert clinical neuropsychologists conducted exhaustive evaluations, stratifying participants into distinct cognitive groups through a comprehensive clinical consensus. Consequently, CogPic stands as the largest, most modality-rich, and most meticulously evaluated dataset of its kind to date. By conducting extensive benchmark experiments on the CogPic dataset, we establish an exceptionally robust, unbiased, and clinically generalizable foundation to propel future multimedia research in automated cognitive health assessment. Detailed information and access application procedures for our CogPic database are available at https://cogpic.github.io/.

AI.tldr: CogPic是一个用于认知障碍检测的大规模多模态基准数据库，收集了574名参与者在图片描述任务中的严格同步的音频、视觉和语言数据，并经过专家神经心理学家的临床评估验证，是目前同类中规模最大、模态最丰富、评估最详尽的数据集。
AI.motivation: 自动化认知状态评估在早期痴呆诊断中具有重要前景，但认知障碍检测的机器学习模型开发常受限于缺乏大规模、严格同步且经临床验证的多模态数据集。这一关键差距阻碍了该领域的发展。
AI.method: 建立CogPic数据库，包含574名参与者在自然图片描述任务中连续收集的严格同步音频、视觉和语言数据；由专家临床神经心理学家进行详尽评估，通过综合临床共识将参与者分层为不同认知组别。
AI.result: CogPic成为目前同类中规模最大、模态最丰富、评估最详尽的数据集；基于该数据集进行了广泛的基准实验，建立了稳健、无偏且具有临床可推广性的基础。
AI.conclusion: CogPic数据库为推动自动化认知健康评估的多媒体研究提供了强有力的基础，可用于未来多媒体研究中的认知障碍检测模型训练与验证。

title: Scaling Reasoning Tokens via RL and Parallel Thinking: Evidence From Competitive Programming
summary: We study how to scale reasoning token budgets for competitive programming through two complementary approaches: training-time reinforcement learning (RL) and test-time parallel thinking. During RL training, we observe an approximately log-linear relationship between validation accuracy and the average number of generated reasoning tokens over successive checkpoints, and show two ways to shift this training trajectory: verification RL warmup raises the starting point, while randomized clipping produces a steeper trend in the observed regime. As scaling single-generation reasoning during RL quickly becomes expensive under full attention, we introduce a multi-round parallel thinking pipeline that distributes the token budget across threads and rounds of generation, verification, and refinement. We train the model end-to-end on this pipeline to match the training objective to the test-time structure. Starting from Seed-OSS-36B, the full system with 16 threads and 16 rounds per thread matches the underlying RL model's oracle pass@16 at pass@1 using 7.6 million tokens per problem on average, and surpasses GPT-5-high on 456 hard competitive programming problems from AetherCode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补方法扩展竞争性编程的推理token预算：训练时强化学习（RL）和测试时并行思考。从Seed-OSS-36B出发，完整系统在16线程×16轮设置下，以760万token/问题的平均消耗达到oracle pass@16性能，并在AetherCode的456道难题上超越GPT-5-high。
AI.motivation: 当前全注意力机制下扩展单轮推理成本高昂，需要探索更高效的推理token预算扩展方法以提升竞争性编程任务的性能。
AI.method: 1. 训练时RL：发现验证准确率与生成推理token数量呈对数线性关系；通过验证RL预热提升起始点，随机裁剪增加趋势斜率。2. 测试时并行思考：多轮并行思考流程，将token预算分布在多线程和多轮次的生成、验证与精炼过程中；端到端训练模型以匹配测试时结构。
AI.result: 验证准确率与平均推理token数量呈近似对数线性关系；完整系统（16线程×16轮）以760万token/问题的平均消耗，在pass@1达到oracle pass@16水平；在456道AetherCode难题上超越GPT-5-high。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练时RL策略与测试时并行思考管道的结合，可有效扩展推理token预算，在高难度竞争性编程任务上达到SOTA性能，验证了两种方法互补扩展推理能力的可行性。

title: AI Engineering Blueprint for On-Premises Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are gaining traction in enterprise settings, yet stringent data protection regulations prevent many organizations from using cloud-based services, necessitating on-premises deployments. While existing blueprints and reference architectures focus on cloud deployments and lack enterprise-grade components, comprehensive on-premises implementation frameworks remain scarce.
  This paper aims to address this gap by presenting a comprehensive AI engineering blueprint for scalable on-premises enterprise RAG solutions. It is designed to address common challenges and streamline the integration of RAG into existing enterprise infrastructure. The blueprint provides: (1) an end-to-end reference architecture described using the 4+1 view model, (2) a reference application for on-premises deployment, and (3) best practices for tooling, development, and CI/CD pipelines, all publicly available on GitHub. Ongoing case studies and expert interviews with industry partners will assess its practical benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向企业本地部署的可扩展RAG（检索增强生成）系统完整AI工程蓝图，采用4+1视图模型描述端到端参考架构，并提供开源参考应用与CI/CD最佳实践，旨在帮助企业在严格数据保护法规下构建私有化RAG解决方案。
AI.motivation: 当前企业RAG系统面临两大挑战：一是数据保护法规限制导致许多组织无法使用云服务，必须采用本地部署；二是现有架构蓝图和参考设计主要面向云端部署，缺乏企业级组件支持，导致全面的本地部署实施框架严重匮乏。
AI.method: 该研究提出一套完整的AI工程蓝图，包含三个核心组成部分：(1) 采用4+1视图模型描述端到端参考架构；(2) 提供可本地部署的参考应用程序；(3) 编制工具链、开发和CI/CD流水线的最佳实践。相关资源已在GitHub上公开发布。
AI.result: 产出了面向本地部署场景的可扩展企业RAG解决方案完整蓝图，涵盖架构设计、应用实现和工程实践三大维度，并通过行业合作伙伴的案例研究和专家访谈持续验证其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该蓝图填补了企业本地RAG部署框架的空白，通过标准化架构和开源实现降低了企业级RAG系统的部署门槛，未来将通过实践案例进一步评估其在真实企业环境中的效益。

title: HACache: Leveraging Read Performance with Cache in a Heterogeneous Array
summary:
In cost-sensitive deployments, RAID arrays may combine SSDs with different performance levels. Such heterogeneity arises when aging SSDs degrade yet remain usable, or when failed drives are replaced with new devices of explicitly better performance. While this reduces procurement cost, it creates performance challenges: traditional striping mecahnism distributes requests evenly, but slower SSDs become bottlenecks, leaving faster ones underutilized and limiting overall bandwidth to the slowest drive.
  To address this, we propose HACache (Heterogeneity Adaptive Cache) for read-intensive workloads. HACache introduces high-performance SSDs as read caches to rebalance request distribution. First, we formalize the request diversion problem and solve it formally. Second, to support optimal diversion ratios searching at runtime, HACache adopts a two-phase request diversion ratio adjustment mechanism. Finally, a cache capacity regulation is adopted to adapt quotas for each backend SSD based on hit rates and request diversion needs. This design maximizes bandwidth utilization. Experiments show HACache improves heterogeneous RAID read performance significantly, with bandwidth gains of about 35\% in typical mixed configurations.

AI.tldr: HACache是一种面向异构SSD RAID阵列的读缓存机制，通过请求分流和缓存容量动态调控解决传统条带化导致的性能瓶颈问题，实验显示可提升带宽约35%。
AI.motivation: 在成本敏感的部署场景中，RAID阵列常混合使用不同性能级别的SSD（因老化降级或替换新盘）。传统条带化机制均匀分配请求，导致快速SSD未被充分利用，而慢速SSD成为瓶颈，整体带宽受限于最慢设备。
AI.method: 提出HACache，采用三项核心技术：（1）形式化定义并求解请求分流问题；（2）两阶段请求分流比调整机制，支持运行时最优分流比搜索；（3）基于命中率和分流需求的缓存容量动态调控机制，实现带宽最大化利用。
AI.result: 实验表明HACache在典型混合配置下可将异构RAID读带宽提升约35%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高性能SSD作为读缓存重新平衡请求分配，HACache有效解决了异构存储阵列的性能不均衡问题，显著提升系统整体带宽。

title: The Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework: A Validation Architecture for Simulated Potential Outcomes
summary: The fundamental problem of causal inference - that the counterfactual outcome for any individual is never observed - has shaped the entire methodology of the field. Every existing approach substitutes assumptions for missing data: ignorability, parallel trends, exclusion restrictions. None produces the counterfactual itself. This paper proposes the Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework (DTCF): rather than estimating the counterfactual statistically, we simulate it using a digital twin and subject the simulation to a hierarchical validation regime. We formalize the digital twin simulator as a stochastic mapping within the potential outcomes framework and introduce a hierarchy of twin fidelity assumptions - from marginal fidelity through joint fidelity to structural fidelity - each unlocking a progressively richer class of estimands. The central contribution is threefold. First, a five-level validation architecture converts the unfalsifiable claim that the simulator produces correct counterfactuals into falsifiable tests against observable data. Second, a formal decomposition separates causal quantities into those that are marginally validated (ATE, CATE, QTE - testable through observable-arm comparison) and those that are copula-dependent (the ITE distribution, probability of benefit/harm, variance of treatment effects - permanently reliant on the unobservable within-individual dependence structure). Third, bounding, sensitivity, and uncertainty quantification tools make the copula dependence explicit. The DTCF does not resolve the fundamental problem of causal inference. What it provides is a framework in which marginal causal claims become increasingly testable, joint causal claims become explicitly assumption-indexed, and the gap between the two is formally characterized.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数字孪生反事实框架(DTCF)，通过数字孪生模拟而非统计估计来生成反事实，并建立五级验证架构将不可证伪的主张转化为可检验的假设，同时将因果量分解为可边缘验证的部分和依赖copula依赖的部分。
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断方法（如 ignorability、parallel trends、exclusion restrictions）均以假设替代缺失数据，而非真正生成反事实本身。这一根本性问题限制了因果推断的可检验性和实用性。
AI.method: 1) 将数字孪生模拟器形式化为潜在结果框架内的随机映射；2) 引入分层孪生保真度假设（边缘保真度→联合保真度→结构保真度）；3) 构建五级验证架构；4) 对因果量进行形式化分解。
AI.result: 将因果量分离为：(1) 可边缘验证的量（ATE、CATE、QTE），可通过观测臂对比检验；(2) 依赖copula的量（ITE分布、收益/危害概率、治疗效应方差），永久依赖不可观测的个体内依赖结构。提供了边界估计、敏感度分析和不确定性量化工具。
AI.conclusion: DTCF并未解决因果推断的根本问题，但提供了一套框架：使边缘因果声明日益可检验，使联合因果声明明确标注假设索引，并形式化刻画两者间的差距。

title: Sven: Singular Value Descent as a Computationally Efficient Natural Gradient Method
summary: We introduce Sven (Singular Value dEsceNt), a new optimization algorithm for neural networks that exploits the natural decomposition of loss functions into a sum over individual data points, rather than reducing the full loss to a single scalar before computing a parameter update. Sven treats each data point's residual as a separate condition to be satisfied simultaneously, using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of the loss Jacobian to find the minimum-norm parameter update that best satisfies all conditions at once. In practice, this pseudoinverse is approximated via a truncated singular value decomposition, retaining only the $k$ most significant directions and incurring a computational overhead of only a factor of $k$ relative to stochastic gradient descent. This is in comparison to traditional natural gradient methods, which scale as the square of the number of parameters. We show that Sven can be understood as a natural gradient method generalized to the over-parametrized regime, recovering natural gradient descent in the under-parametrized limit. On regression tasks, Sven significantly outperforms standard first-order methods including Adam, converging faster and to a lower final loss, while remaining competitive with LBFGS at a fraction of the wall-time cost. We discuss the primary challenge to scaling, namely memory overhead, and propose mitigation strategies. Beyond standard machine learning benchmarks, we anticipate that Sven will find natural application in scientific computing settings where custom loss functions decompose into several conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出优化器 Sven（Singular Value dEsceNt）：把总损失视为逐样本条件之和对每个样本残差同时求解，用损失 Jacobian 的 Moore-Penrose 伪逆求最小范数参数更新 δθ = −η M⁺R；实践中以截断 SVD（保留 top-k 奇异方向并按 rtol 截断）近似 M⁺，并用 Gram 矩阵 G = MMᵀ 的 B×B 特征分解实现，使单步仅需常数次前向/反向传播（耗时约为 Adam 的 2–3 倍，MLP 上显存与 Adam 相当）。Sven 可视为在过参数化区域推广的自然梯度法，在欠参数化极限下还原自然梯度下降。
AI.motivation: 标准机器学习实践中，损失函数天然是逐样本条件之和 L(θ)=Σ_α ℓ^α(θ)，但主流优化器在求更新前就把这组"条件"压缩成单一标量，丢弃了这一结构信息。理论上更合理的自然梯度/二阶方法虽能给出预条件化方向，但计算代价随参数量平方增长（P×P 的 Fisher/GGN 矩阵），且在过参数化区（P>数据点数）度量矩阵奇异、无法求逆；而 K-FAC 等近似仍只能靠阻尼给出有偏更新。作者的动机是：直接在数据索引上分解损失，用每个样本的残差作为需同时满足的条件，以可在过参数化区自洽求解的最小范数更新取代昂贵的自然梯度，并给出可在现代网络规模上运行的实现。
AI.method: 1) 更新规则：对批量大小 B、参数量 P，取逐样本损失 Jacobian M∈R^{B×P}（每行为一个样本的损失梯度）与残差向量 R，用 Moore-Penrose 伪逆求 δθ = −η M⁺R；M⁺ 用截断 SVD 近似，只保留 k 个最大奇异值并把小于 rtol·σ₁ 的置零（实际使用的秩 r_used = min(k, #{σ_i > rtol·σ₁})）。2) 一般损失用有效残差 ℛ_eff = ℓ^(κ/2) 推广（默认 κ=2，即 L₂ 残差；κ 只通过截断与行缩放起作用）。3) 理论联系：欠参数化下 M⁺=(MᵀM)⁻¹Mᵀ，更新退化为自然梯度（与 FIM 度量 g_ij = Σ_x ∂f/∂θ_i ∂f/∂θ_j 一致）；过参数化下伪逆给出最小范数解。附录从函数梯度流/Hilbert 空间度量的角度给出直觉论证：若度量免费可得，损失按 e^{−4t} 指数衰减而非幂律。4) 高效实现：关键恒等式 M⁺R = Mᵀw，右奇异向量消去，更新只依赖 B×B 的 Gram 矩阵 G = MMᵀ 与一次向量-雅可比积 Mᵀw；用 forward/backward hooks 捕获每层输入输出，单次反向即得全部 B 个逐样本输出梯度，并逐层以 Hadamard 乘积 (g_l g_lᵀ)⊙(x_l x_lᵀ) 累加 G，全程不实例化 B×P 雅可比；G 用 float64 累加以缓解 cond(G)=cond(M)² 带来的分辨率损失。单步 = 两次前向-反向对 + 一次 B×B eigh，成本与 k 无关。5) 约束与回退：高效捕获要求层在样本间解耦、每层每样本只调用一次、无权重绑定/无 BatchNorm；否则回退到 full（物化 (B,P) 雅可比）或 chunked（分块捕获）后端。另有 micro-batch 聚合（μ 个样本合并为一个条件，μ→B 时退化为 SGD）与参数掩码两种降显存手段。
AI.result: 实验覆盖 1D 回归、随机多项式、MNIST（标签回归与交叉熵）、CIFAR-10/ResNet18、nanoGPT（tiny-Shakespeare）、GPT-2-small/FineWeb-edu，与 SGD、动量 SGD、RMSprop、Adam/AdamW、Polyak-SGD、随机 L-BFGS、SOAP、Shampoo、K-FAC、Muon/MuonW、HIG、JD 共 14 个基线对比（每方法做超参网格扫描 + 5 个确认种子，用配对差与 t 分布 95% 区间比较）。主要结论：(1) Sven 在多项式回归、MNIST、nanoGPT 上与 AdamW、Muon、SOAP 等最强基线相当或更好，整体排名稳定处于前 2–3，但从未在所有任务上压倒性最优；(2) HIG 在多项式任务上更优，但在 MNIST 上墙钟时间约为 Sven 的 10 倍，HIG 需对 (行数=批×输出维) 的模型雅可比做 SVD，在 Transformer/ResNet 规模不可行；(3) 效率上，hooks 后端单步约为 Adam 的 2.5–3×，MLP 上峰值显存与 Adam 持平、nanoGPT 略高、ResNet18 因 full 捕获达约 23 GB；naive 显式雅可比+随机 SVD 后端在时间与显存上均最差；(4) 奇异值谱分析显示不同任务谱形差异大（1D 高度层级化、MNIST/nanoGPT 谱平且被 rtol 截断较少），实际截断主要由 rtol 决定而非 k；截断丢弃的残差比例与任务相关（CIFAR-CE 训练末丢弃约 23% 残差，与其表现最差一致）；(5) 失败率统计显示低 rtol、大学习率处发散率上升（1D 上最低 rtol 约 50% 发散）；(6) 局限：BatchNorm/权重绑定架构无法使用高效后端，ResNet18/CIFAR-10 上 Sven 明显落后于 MuonW、SOAP、AdamW 且训练极慢；GPT-2-small 预实验（Sven 最差，墙钟 9.25 h vs Muon 2.95 h）因未调参只能视为初步结果；数据级过参数化（P/N）扫描未显示 Sven 相对基线的优势。
AI.conclusion: Sven 是一种把损失按数据索引分解、并用伪逆在过参数化区求解"同时最小化所有逐样本残差"的高效自然梯度型优化器：借助 Gram 矩阵实现，其单步代价仅为常数次前反向加一次小规模特征分解，摆脱了自然梯度 P² 的代价，同时在欠参数化极限还原自然梯度。作者定位其为现有优化工具箱的补充而非替代，可与权重衰减、梯度裁剪、学习率调度、动量、Adam 式缩放等组合使用。主要局限是内存/架构受限（BatchNorm、权重绑定、卷积/嵌入等需回退后端），以及在 CIFAR-10/ResNet18 与 GPT-2-scale 上表现不佳。后续方向包括：面向 LLM 的规模化训练、能处理 BatchNorm/权重绑定而不物化分块的高效捕获、以及用"解释残差比例"作为动态截断阈值的自适应超参规则；此外作者预期 Sven 在损失可分解为若干条件的科学计算（如理论物理中的配点/边界条件约束）中具有天然应用价值。

title: Multi-Agent Video Recommenders: Evolution, Patterns, and Open Challenges
comment: Accepted for publication in The Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM Companion 2026)
summary: Video recommender systems are among the most popular and impactful applications of AI, shaping content consumption and influencing culture for billions of users. Traditional single-model recommenders, which optimize static engagement metrics, are increasingly limited in addressing the dynamic requirements of modern platforms. In response, multi-agent architectures are redefining how video recommender systems serve, learn, and adapt to both users and datasets. These agent-based systems coordinate specialized agents responsible for video understanding, reasoning, memory, and feedback, to provide precise, explainable recommendations. In this survey, we trace the evolution of multi-agent video recommendation systems (MAVRS). We combine ideas from multi-agent recommender systems, foundation models, and conversational AI, culminating in the emerging field of large language model (LLM)-powered MAVRS. We present a taxonomy of collaborative patterns and analyze coordination mechanisms across diverse video domains, ranging from short-form clips to educational platforms. We discuss representative frameworks, including early multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems such as MMRF and recent LLM-driven architectures like MACRec and Agent4Rec, to illustrate these patterns. We also outline open challenges in scalability, multimodal understanding, incentive alignment, and identify research directions such as hybrid reinforcement learning-LLM systems, lifelong personalization and self-improving recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本论文是一篇关于多智能体视频推荐系统（MAVRS）的综述，涵盖从传统单模型推荐到基于LLM的多智能体架构的演进历程，提出分类体系，分析协作机制与代表框架，并指出可扩展性、多模态理解、激励对齐等开放挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统单模型推荐系统优化静态参与度指标，难以满足现代平台动态需求；多智能体架构通过协调专业化智能体（视频理解、推理、记忆、反馈），提供更精准、可解释的推荐，成为重新定义视频推荐系统的关键范式。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，融合多智能体推荐系统、基础模型和对话AI的思想；提出协作模式分类体系；分析跨短视频、教育等不同视频领域的协调机制；对早期MARL系统（如MMRF）与近期LLM驱动架构（如MACRec、Agent4Rec）进行对比分析。
AI.result: 系统梳理了MAVRS领域发展脉络，建立了包含协调模式的技术分类体系；识别了视频理解、推理、记忆、反馈等核心智能体功能模块；总结了从MARL到LLM驱动的技术演进路径。
AI.conclusion: MAVRS领域面临可扩展性、多模态理解、激励对齐等开放挑战；未来研究方向包括混合RL-LLM系统、终身个性化推荐和自改进推荐系统。

title: From BM25 to Corrective RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval Strategies for Text-and-Table Documents
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems critically depend on retrieval quality, yet no systematic comparison of modern retrieval methods exists for heterogeneous documents containing both text and tabular data. We benchmark ten retrieval strategies spanning sparse, dense, hybrid fusion, cross-encoder reranking, query expansion, index augmentation, and adaptive retrieval on a challenging financial QA benchmark of 23,088 queries over 7,318 documents with mixed text-and-table content. We evaluate retrieval quality via Recall@k, MRR, and nDCG, and end-to-end generation quality via Number Match, with paired bootstrap significance testing. Our results show that (1) a two-stage pipeline combining hybrid retrieval with neural reranking achieves Recall@5 of 0.816 and MRR@3 of 0.605, outperforming all single-stage methods by a large margin; (2) BM25 outperforms state-of-the-art dense retrieval on financial documents, challenging the common assumption that semantic search universally dominates; and (3) query expansion methods (HyDE, multi-query) and adaptive retrieval provide limited benefit for precise numerical queries, while contextual retrieval yields consistent gains. We provide ablation studies on fusion methods and reranker depth, actionable cost-accuracy recommendations, and release our full benchmark code.

AI.tldr: 本文对10种检索策略在金融QA基准（23,088条查询，7,318份混合文本和表格的文档）上进行了系统性评测。两阶段混合检索+神经重排pipeline表现最佳（Recall@5=0.816, MRR@3=0.605）；BM25在金融文档中优于先进稠密检索；查询扩展和自适应检索对精确数值查询收益有限。
AI.motivation: RAG系统严重依赖检索质量，但针对异构文档（包含文本和表格）的现代检索方法缺乏系统性对比研究。现有基准测试未能充分覆盖金融领域常见的多模态内容场景。
AI.method: 在包含23,088条查询和7,318份混合文本-表格文档的金融QA基准上，对10种检索策略（稀疏检索、稠密检索、混合融合、跨编码器重排、查询扩展、索引增强、自适应检索）进行系统评测。采用Recall@k、MRR、nDCG评估检索质量，Number Match评估端到端生成质量，并使用配对Bootstrap显著性检验。
AI.result: 1. 两阶段pipeline（混合检索+神经重排）达Recall@5=0.816、MRR@3=0.605，显著优于所有单阶段方法；2. BM25在金融文档上优于先进稠密检索，挑战了语义搜索普遍优于传统检索的假设；3. 查询扩展方法（HyDE、多查询）和自适应检索对精确数值查询收益有限，而上下文检索则带来一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于金融领域RAG系统，建议采用混合检索+神经重排的两阶段架构；BM25在结构化金融文档中仍具竞争力；精确数值查询场景下应避免过度依赖查询扩展。研究成果包括消融实验、成本-精度权衡建议及开源基准代码。

title: A divide and conquer strategy for multinomial particle filter resampling
summary: This work provides a new multinomial resampling procedure for particle filter resampling, focused on the case where the number of samples required is less than or equal to the size of the underlying discrete distribution. This setting is common in ensemble mixture model filters such as the Gaussian mixture filter. We show superiority of our approach with respect two of the best known multinomial sampling procedures both through a computational complexity analysis and through a numerical experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对粒子滤波器重采样的新型多项式重采样方法，特别适用于所需样本数小于等于底层离散分布规模的情况（如高斯混合滤波器）。通过计算复杂度分析和数值实验，证明了该方法优于两种已知最佳多项式采样方法。
AI.motivation: 在集成混合模型滤波器（如高斯混合滤波器）中，经常需要从离散分布中提取少于等于分布规模的样本，但现有多项式重采样方法在此场景下并非最优。
AI.method: 提出一种新的多项式重采样程序，针对样本数小于等于底层离散分布规模的特定情况进行优化。
AI.result: 该方法在计算复杂度上优于两种已知最佳的多项式采样程序，并通过数值实验验证了其优越性。
AI.conclusion: 新方法在特定重采样场景下具有更好的性能表现，可应用于粒子滤波器和集成混合模型滤波器。

title: DWDP: Distributed Weight Data Parallelism for High-Performance LLM Inference on NVL72
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference increasingly depends on multi-GPU execution, yet existing inference parallelization strategies require layer-wise inter-rank synchronization, making end-to-end performance sensitive to workload imbalance. We present DWDP (Distributed Weight Data Parallelism), an inference parallelization strategy that preserves data-parallel execution while offloading MoE weights across peer GPUs and fetching missing experts on demand. By removing collective inter-rank synchronization, DWDP allows each GPU to progress independently. We further address the practical overheads of this design with two optimizations for split-weight management and asynchronous remote-weight prefetch. Implemented in TensorRT-LLM and evaluated with DeepSeek-R1 on GB200 NVL72, DWDP improves end-to-end output TPS/GPU by 8.8% at comparable TPS/user in the 20-100 TPS/user serving range under 8K input sequence length and 1K output sequence length.

AI.tldr: DWDP是一种用于大型语言模型多GPU推理的并行化策略，通过将MoE权重卸载到对等GPU并按需获取缺失的专家，同时移除GPU间的集合同步，使每个GPU能够独立运行。结合TensorRT-LLM实现并在GB200 NVL72上测试DeepSeek-R1，在8K输入/1K输出序列长度下，TPS/GPU提升8.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理的多GPU并行化策略需要层间GPU间同步，导致端到端性能对工作负载不平衡敏感，限制了推理效率的提升。
AI.method: 提出DWDP（分布式权重数据并行），将MoE权重分片卸载到各对等GPU，按需获取缺失专家，同时移除集合式GPU间同步，使各GPU独立推进；并设计分片权重管理和异步远程权重预取两项优化。
AI.result: 在GB200 NVL72上使用DeepSeek-R1测试，8K输入序列和1K输出序列长度下，在20-100 TPS/user服务范围内，TPS/GPU提升8.8%，且TPS/user保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: DWDP通过消除同步开销和优化权重管理，能在保持数据并行执行优势的同时，有效提升多GPU推理的端到端吞吐量。

title: Teaching Students to Question the Machine: An AI Literacy Intervention Improves Students' Regulation of LLM Use in a Science Task
summary: The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in schools raises concerns about students' uncritical reliance on its outputs. Effective use of large language models (LLMs) requires not only technical knowledge but also the ability to monitor, evaluate, and regulate one's interaction with the system, processes closely tied to metacognitive regulation. These skills are still developing in middle school, making students particularly vulnerable to over-trust and premature acceptance of AI outputs. Because classroom time and teacher training resources are constrained, there is a pressing need to develop and evaluate AI literacy interventions that can be implemented under realistic school conditions. We report a controlled classroom study examining whether a two-hour AI literacy workshop improves students' interaction strategies and quality of final answers in LLM-supported science problem solving. A total of 116 students (grades 8-9; ages 13-15) completed six science investigation tasks using a generative AI system. Two days prior, the intervention group attended the workshop, which combined information about how LLMs work and fail with practical guidance on prompting and response evaluation; the control group received no training. Trained students showed less uncritical reliance on the system: they more often reformulated queries, asked follow-up questions, and more accurately judged response correctness, leading to better performance. In contrast, GenAI and metacognitive self-report scores did not predict performance, suggesting that effective use of generative AI depends less on self-reported measures and more on explicit training in interaction regulation. Overall, the results show that brief, scalable AI literacy instruction can meaningfully improve how middle-school students use generative AI in school-like learning activities.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了两小时AI素养工作坊对初中生在使用大语言模型（LLM）辅助科学问题解决中的影响，发现短期可扩展的干预训练能显著改善学生的AI交互策略和表现，但对元认知自评分数无显著影响。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在教育中的快速普及引发担忧：初中生的元认知调节能力尚在发展中，容易过度信任AI输出。由于课堂时间和教师培训资源有限，亟需开发可在现实学校条件下实施的AI素养干预方案。
AI.method: 采用对照组实验设计。116名8-9年级学生（13-15岁）使用生成式AI系统完成六项科学探究任务。干预组在任务前两天参加两小时工作坊（内容涵盖LLM工作原理、局限性、提示策略及响应评估）；对照组无培训。通过编码分析交互行为、准确性判断和最终表现来评估效果。
AI.result: 接受培训的学生表现出更少的盲目依赖行为：更频繁地重新表述查询、提出跟进问题、更准确地判断响应正确性，最终表现更好。相比之下，GenAI使用量和元认知自评分数均无法预测表现。
AI.conclusion: 简短、可扩展的AI素养教学能有效改善初中生在类课堂学习活动中使用生成式AI的方式。有效使用LLM更多取决于交互调节的显性训练，而非自我报告类指标。

title: GPU-RMQ: Accelerating Range Minimum Queries on Modern GPUs
summary: Range minimum queries are frequently used in string processing and database applications including biological sequence analysis, document retrieval, and web search. Hence, various data structures have been proposed for improving their efficiency on both CPUs and GPUs.Recent work has also shown that hardware-accelerated ray tracing on modern NVIDIA RTX graphic cards can be exploited to answer range minimum queries by expressing queries as rays, which are fired into a scene of triangles representing minima of ranges at different granularities. While these approaches are promising, they suffer from at least one of three issues: severe memory overhead, high index construction time, and low query throughput. This renders these methods practically unusable on larger arrays: For example, the state-of-art GPU-based approaches LCA and RTXRMQ exceed the memory capacity of an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU for input arrays of size >= 2^29. To tackle these problems, in this work, we present a new approach called GPU-RMQ which is based on a hierarchical approach. GPU-RMQ first constructs a hierarchy of range minimum summaries on top of the original array in a highly parallel fashion. For query answering, only the relevant portions of the hierarchy are then processed in an optimized massively-parallel scan operation.
