Additionally, GPU-RMQ is hybrid in design enabling the use of both ray tracing cores and CUDA cores across different levels of the hierarchy to handle queries. Our experimental evaluation shows that GPU-RMQ outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in terms of query throughput especially for larger arrays while offering a significantly lower memory footprint and up to two orders-of-magnitude faster index construction. In particular, it achieves up to ~8x higher throughput than LCA, ~17x higher throughput than RTXRMQ, and up to ~4800x higher throughput compared to an optimized CPU-based approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GPU-RMQ，一种基于层次化方法的新型GPU加速范围最小值查询数据结构，通过在数组上构建多层范围最小摘要，并结合光线追踪核心与CUDA核心的混合设计，显著提升查询吞吐量、降低内存占用、加快索引构建速度。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU-based RMQ方法（如LCA、RTXRMQ）存在三个核心问题：严重的内存开销、高索引构建时间和低查询吞吐量，导致这些方法在大规模数组（≥2^29）上无法在NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上运行。
AI.method: GPU-RMQ采用层次化架构：(1) 以高度并行方式在原始数组上构建范围最小摘要层次结构；(2) 查询时仅处理层次结构的相关部分，采用优化的大规模并行扫描操作；(3) 混合设计：不同层次级别协同使用光线追踪核心和CUDA核心处理查询。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：查询吞吐量方面比LCA提升约8倍，比RTXRMQ提升约17倍，比优化CPU方法提升约4800倍；同时内存占用显著降低，索引构建速度提升最高达两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: GPU-RMQ在处理大规模数组时具备明显优势，其层次化混合架构设计有效解决了现有方法的内存瓶颈问题，为生物序列分析、文档检索等大规模数据场景提供了高效的RMQ解决方案。

title: M2-Verify: A Large-Scale Multidomain Benchmark for Checking Multimodal Claim Consistency
summary: Evaluating scientific arguments requires assessing the strict consistency between a claim and its underlying multimodal evidence. However, existing benchmarks lack the scale, domain diversity, and visual complexity needed to evaluate this alignment realistically. To address this gap, we introduce M2-Verify, a large-scale multimodal dataset for checking scientific claim consistency. Sourced from PubMed and arXiv, M2-Verify provides over 469K instances across 16 domains, rigorously validated through expert audits. Extensive baseline experiments show that state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain robust consistency. While top models achieve up to 85.8\% Micro-F1 on low-complexity medical perturbations, performance drops to 61.6\% on high-complexity challenges like anatomical shifts. Furthermore, expert evaluations expose hallucinations when models generate scientific explanations for their alignment decisions. Finally, we demonstrate our dataset's utility and provide comprehensive usage guidelines.

AI.tldr: M2-Verify是一个用于检查科学声明一致性的大规模多模态数据集，包含超过469K个样本，涵盖16个领域。实验表明最先进的模型在不同复杂度任务上表现差异显著（85.8% vs 61.6%），且存在幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试缺乏足够的规模、领域多样性和视觉复杂性来真实评估科学声明与多模态证据之间的一致性对齐能力。
AI.method: 从PubMed和arXiv收集数据，构建大规模多模态数据集；通过专家审计进行严格验证；进行全面的基线实验评估。
AI.result: 最先进模型在低复杂度医学扰动任务上达到85.8% Micro-F1，但在高复杂度挑战（如解剖结构变化）上降至61.6%。专家评估发现模型在生成科学解释时存在幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: M2-Verify数据集能够有效揭示现有模型的局限性，为科学声明一致性评估提供了实用的基准和全面的使用指南。

title: Reproducible, Explainable, and Effective Evaluations of Agentic AI for Software Engineering
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the 2nd International Workshop on Responsible Software Engineering (ResponsibleSE 2026), co-located with FSE
summary: With the advancement of Agentic AI, researchers are increasingly leveraging autonomous agents to address challenges in software engineering (SE). However, the large language models (LLMs) that underpin these agents often function as black boxes, making it difficult to justify the superiority of Agentic AI approaches over baselines. Furthermore, missing information in the evaluation design description frequently renders the reproduction of results infeasible. To synthesize current evaluation practices for Agentic AI in SE, this study analyzes 18 papers on the topic, published or accepted by ICSE 2026, ICSE 2025, FSE 2025, ASE 2025, and ISSTA 2025. The analysis identifies prevailing approaches and their limitations in evaluating Agentic AI for SE, both in current research and potential future studies. To address these shortcomings, this position paper proposes a set of guidelines and recommendations designed to empower reproducible, explainable, and effective evaluations of Agentic AI in software engineering. In particular, we recommend that Agentic AI researchers make their Thought-Action-Result (TAR) trajectories and LLM interaction data, or summarized versions of these artifacts, publicly accessible. Doing so will enable subsequent studies to more effectively analyze the strengths and weaknesses of different Agentic AI approaches. To demonstrate the feasibility of such comparisons, we present a proof-of-concept case study that illustrates how TAR trajectories can support systematic analysis across approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于软件工程中Agentic AI评估的立场论文（position paper），通过分析18篇顶会论文，识别了当前评估方法的局限，并提出了包括公开TAR轨迹和LLM交互数据在内的可复现、可解释评估指南。
AI.motivation: 当前Agentic AI研究中，底层LLM如同黑盒运作，难以证明其相对于基线方法的优势；同时评估设计描述中的信息缺失使得结果复现不可行。
AI.method: 分析了18篇发表或接收于ICSE 2026、ICSE 2025、FSE 2025、ASE 2025和ISSTA 2025的论文，识别当前评估实践的现状与局限。
AI.result: 识别了当前及未来研究中评估Agentic AI for SE的主流方法及其局限性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套指南和建议，推荐研究者公开Thought-Action-Result (TAR)轨迹和LLM交互数据（或其摘要版本），以支持后续研究有效分析不同Agentic AI方法的优劣。提供了一个概念验证案例研究展示TAR轨迹如何支持跨方法的系统性分析。

title: IDEA2: Expert-in-the-loop competency question elicitation for collaborative ontology engineering
summary: Competency question (CQ) elicitation represents a critical but resource-intensive bottleneck in ontology engineering. This foundational phase is often hampered by the communication gap between domain experts, who possess the necessary knowledge, and ontology engineers, who formalise it. This paper introduces IDEA2, a novel, semi-automated workflow that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) within a collaborative, expert-in-the-loop process to address this challenge. The methodology is characterised by a core iterative loop: an initial LLM-based extraction of CQs from requirement documents, a co-creational review and feedback phase by domain experts on an accessible collaborative platform, and an iterative, feedback-driven reformulation of rejected CQs by an LLM until consensus is achieved. To ensure transparency and reproducibility, the entire lifecycle of each CQ is tracked using a provenance model that captures the full lineage of edits, anonymised feedback, and generation parameters. The workflow was validated in 2 real-world scenarios (scientific data, cultural heritage), demonstrating that IDEA2 can accelerate the requirements engineering process, improve the acceptance and relevance of the resulting CQs, and exhibit high usability and effectiveness among domain experts. We release all code and experiments at https://github.com/KE-UniLiv/IDEA2

AI.tldr: IDEA2是一个半自动化的竞任问题（CQ）提取工作流，整合大语言模型（LLM）与专家协作，通过迭代循环（LLM提取→专家反馈→LLM重写）解决本体工程中需求获取的瓶颈问题，并在科学数据和文化遗产两个领域验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 竞任问题（CQ）提取是本体工程中的关键但资源密集的瓶颈阶段，领域专家与本体工程师之间存在显著的沟通鸿沟，导致知识获取效率低下。
AI.method: 提出IDEA2工作流，包含核心迭代循环：1）LLM从需求文档中初始提取CQs；2）领域专家在协作平台上进行共同审查和反馈；3）LLM根据拒绝反馈迭代重写CQs直至达成共识。同时采用溯源模型追踪每个CQ的完整生命周期（编辑谱系、匿名反馈、生成参数）。
AI.result: 在科学数据和文化遗产两个真实场景中验证表明：IDEA2能够加速需求工程过程，提高CQ的接受度和相关性，领域专家报告了高可用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: IDEA2通过人机协作方式有效弥合了领域专家与本体工程师之间的沟通差距，为半自动化CQ提取提供了可复现、可追溯的解决方案。

title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning
summary:
Anticipating supply chain disruptions before they materialize is a core challenge for firms and policymakers alike. A key difficulty is learning to reason reliably about infrequent, high-impact events from noisy and unstructured inputs - a setting where general-purpose models struggle without task-specific adaptation. We introduce an end-to-end framework that trains LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts using realized disruption outcomes as supervision. The resulting model substantially outperforms strong baselines - including GPT-5 - on accuracy, calibration, and precision. We also show that training induces more structured and reliable probabilistic reasoning without explicit prompting. These results suggest a general pathway for training domain-specific forecasting models that produce decision-ready signals. To support transparency we open-source the evaluation dataset used in this study.
  Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LightningRodLabs/supply-chain-predictions

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端框架，使用真实 disruption 结果作为监督信号来训练 LLM 生成校准的概率预测，以应对供应链中断预测难题。该方法在准确率、校准性和精确度上显著优于包括 GPT-5 在内的强基线模型，并诱发了更结构化的概率推理能力。
AI.motivation: 核心挑战在于从嘈杂非结构化输入中学习推理稀有且高影响的 disruption 事件，传统通用模型缺乏任务适配能力。
AI.method: 端到端框架：使用 realized disruption outcomes 作为监督信号训练 LLM 生成校准的概率预测（calibrated probabilistic forecasts）。
AI.result: 在准确率、校准性和精确度上显著优于 GPT-5 等强基线；训练过程自发诱导出更结构化、可靠的概率推理能力，无需显式 prompting。
AI.conclusion: 为训练领域特定预测模型提供了通用路径，支持决策信号输出；已开源评估数据集（ Hugging Face）。

title: The Self Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
summary: Agentic AI shifts the investor's role from analytical execution to oversight. We present an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which approximately 50 specialized agents produce capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using over 20 competing methods, and critique and vote on each other's output. A researcher agent proposes new portfolio construction methods not yet represented, and a meta-agent compares past forecasts against realized returns and rewrites agent code and prompts to improve future performance. The entire pipeline is governed by the Investment Policy Statement--the same document that guides human portfolio managers can now constrain and direct autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"智能体式"战略资产配置流水线：由约50个专职智能体生成资本市场假设、用20余种相互竞争的方法构建组合，并相互批评与投票；一个研究员智能体负责提出尚不存在的全新组合构建方法，一个元智能体则将历史预测与实现收益对比，通过改写智能体代码与提示词持续改进。整个流程由投资政策声明（IPS）统一治理，使人类组合经理得以约束与指挥自主智能体。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是投资者角色的迁移：在智能体式AI（Agentic AI）时代，投资者的职能从"亲自执行分析"转向"监督与分析"（analytical execution → oversight）。具体而言：（1）传统资产配置流程中，资本市场假设（capital market assumptions）的推导、组合构建方法的筛选、参数选择等环节由人类分析师手工完成，效率低且难以穷尽方法空间；（2）单一模型或单一路径存在方法论偏见与过拟合风险，难以系统性地比较多类组合构建方法的优劣；（3）现有AI辅助工具多为"一次性问答"式，缺乏自我纠错与迭代改进机制，无法利用事后实现收益反馈提升前瞻性；（4）自主智能体在金融领域应用时，缺少一个可被人类投资者理解、审查并施加约束的治理框架，存在失控与不可问责的风险。因此需要一套既能大规模并行探索、又能被人类监督与方向引导的端到端智能体架构。
AI.method: 方法层面构建了一个多智能体（multi-agent）流水线，特征如下：（1）角色分工：约50个专用智能体，覆盖资本市场假设生成、组合构建、批评评审等职能；（2）组合构建采用"竞争式"（competing）范式，同时运行20种以上不同的组合构建方法以便横向比较；（3）智能体互评机制：各智能体对他方输出进行批判（critique）并以投票（vote）方式聚合决策，形成去中心化的共识/裁决层；（4）研究员智能体（researcher agent）具备"方法创新"职责，自主提出当前集合中尚未涵盖的新型组合构建方法，形成方法库的开放式扩展；（5）元智能体（meta-agent）承担反馈学习功能，将过去的预测与实际实现收益（realized returns）回测对照，据此改写下级智能体的代码与提示词（prompts），构成闭环迭代优化；（6）治理层：以投资政策声明（Investment Policy Statement, IPS）作为流水线的最高约束与指令文件，同一份文档既指导人类组合经理，也可用于约束和指挥自主智能体，从而使整套系统具备可审计性、指令一致性与人类在环（human-in-the-loop）的最终问责机制。
AI.result: 从所给摘要可确认的结果性事实包括：系统规模约为50个专业智能体；组合构建方法超过20种并以竞争方式并行运行；智能体之间实现了交叉批评与投票决策；具备由研究员智能体驱动的组合构建方法自动新增能力；元智能体实现了基于"预测—实现收益"对照的代码与提示词自动改写；全流程受IPS统一治理。摘要未披露任何量化的业绩指标（如夏普比率、收益、波动率、回测区间、投票一致性或改进幅度），因此关于该流水线是否在统计或经济意义上优于基准尚无法判断，属于需要在正文/附录中核验的关键点。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论性主张是：智能体式AI可将战略资产配置从"分析执行"重构为"监督治理"，其实现路径是由大规模专职智能体并行生成假设与竞争性组合、通过互评投票达成决策、由元智能体以实现收益反馈闭环改写智能体本身，并由IPS这一既有人类治理文件统一约束，从而在释放自动化广度的同时保留人类的控制权、方向引导与可问责性。整体上，该工作更接近一篇"架构/系统设计"型论文，其核心贡献在于把IPS从人类内部流程文档升格为智能体系统的治理接口，把"多智能体讨论 + 事后反馈自我改写"引入资产配置领域；其有效性证据与局限（成本、拥挤/共识偏差、投票的统计稳健性、IPS表达力对智能体行为的约束强度）需依赖完整的实验与回测部分加以评估。

title: Do We Need Bigger Models for Science? Task-Aware Retrieval with Small Language Models
summary: Scientific knowledge discovery increasingly relies on large language models, yet many existing scholarly assistants depend on proprietary systems with tens or hundreds of billions of parameters. Such reliance limits reproducibility and accessibility for the research community. In this work, we ask a simple question: do we need bigger models for scientific applications? Specifically, we investigate to what extent carefully designed retrieval pipelines can compensate for reduced model scale in scientific applications. We design a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework that performs task-aware routing to select specialized retrieval strategies based on the input query. The system further integrates evidence from full-text scientific papers and structured scholarly metadata, and employs compact instruction-tuned language models to generate responses with citations. We evaluate the framework across several scholarly tasks, focusing on scholarly question answering (QA), including single- and multi-document scenarios, as well as biomedical QA under domain shift and scientific text compression. Our findings demonstrate that retrieval and model scale are complementary rather than interchangeable. While retrieval design can partially compensate for smaller models, model capacity remains important for complex reasoning tasks. This work highlights retrieval and task-aware design as key factors for building practical and reproducible scholarly assistants.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了小型语言模型结合精心设计的检索管道是否能替代超大规模模型用于科学研究应用。研究设计了轻量级检索增强框架，包含任务感知路由机制，整合全文论文和结构化元数据，使用紧凑指令微调模型生成带引用的回答。
AI.motivation: 现有科学知识发现工具依赖具有数百亿参数的专有系统，限制了研究的可重复性和可及性。本文试图回答一个核心问题：在科学应用中，是否真的需要更大的模型？
AI.method: 设计轻量级检索增强框架：(1) 任务感知路由机制，根据输入查询选择专门的检索策略；(2) 整合全文科学论文和结构化学术元数据；(3) 使用紧凑指令微调语言模型生成带引用的回答。在多个学术任务上评估，包括单/多文档问答、生物医学问答（域转移场景）及科学文本压缩。
AI.result: 检索设计与模型规模是互补而非可互换的。检索设计可部分补偿较小模型的能力不足，但模型容量对复杂推理任务仍然至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 检索设计和任务感知架构是构建实用、可重复的学术助手的关键因素，可降低对超大规模专有模型的依赖。

title: Approximating the Permanent of a Random Matrix with Polynomially Small Mean: Zeros and Universality
summary:
We study algorithms for approximating the permanent of a random matrix when the entries are slightly biased away from zero. This question is motivated by the goal of understanding the classical complexity of linear optics and \emph{boson sampling} (Aaronson and Arkhipov '11; Eldar and Mehraban '17). Barvinok's interpolation method enables efficient approximation of the permanent, provided one can establish a sufficiently large zero-free region for the polynomial $\mathrm{per}(zJ + W)$, where $J$ is the all-ones matrix and $W$ is a random matrix with independent mean-zero entries.
  We show that when the entries of $W$ are standard complex Gaussians, all zeros of the random polynomial $\mathrm{per}(zJ + W)$ lie within a disk of radius $\tilde{O}(n^{-1/3})$, which yields an approximation algorithm when the bias of the entries is $\tildeΩ(n^{-1/3})$. Previously, there were no efficient algorithms at biases smaller than $1/\mathrm{polylog}(n)$, and it was unknown whether there typically exist zeros $z$ with $|z| \ge 1$. As a complementary result, we show that the bulk of the zeros, namely $(1 - ε)n$ of them, have magnitude $Θ(n^{-1/2})$. This prevents our interpolation method from contradicting the conjectured average-case hardness of approximating the permanent. We also establish analogous zero-free regions for the hardcore model on general graphs with complex vertex fugacities. In addition, we prove universality results establishing zero-free regions for random matrices $W$ with i.i.d. subexponential entries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当矩阵元素略微偏离零时，如何高效近似随机矩阵的积式(permanent)。通过分析随机多项式 per(zJ+W) 的零点分布，建立了半径为 Õ(n^(-1/3)) 的无零点区域，从而在偏置为 Ω̃(n^(-1/3)) 时实现高效近似算法。
AI.motivation: 理解线性光学和玻色采样(boson sampling)的经典复杂性。Barvinok的插值方法要求建立足够大的无零点区域，但此前在偏置小于 1/polylog(n) 时没有高效算法，且尚不清楚是否存在模大于等于1的零点。
AI.method: 1) 分析复高斯随机矩阵 W 对应的多项式 per(zJ+W) 的零点分布；2) 使用复分析工具控制零点位置；3) 对非高斯情形建立通用性结果（亚指数分布的i.i.d.条目）。
AI.result: 1) 零点全部位于半径为 Õ(n^(-1/3)) 的圆盘内；2) (1-ε)n 个零点的模为 Θ(n^(-1/2))；3) 当偏置为 Ω̃(n^(-1/3)) 时存在高效近似算法；4) 对于一般图上的硬核模型建立类似无零点区域；5) 对亚指数分布条目证明通用性。
AI.conclusion: 将可高效近似的最小偏置从 1/polylog(n) 降低到 Õ(n^(-1/3))，揭示了零点分布的精细结构（多数零点模为 Θ(n^(-1/2))），从而避免与积式近似平均情况复杂度的猜想矛盾。

title: Optimization Opportunities for Cloud-Based Data Pipeline Infrastructures
summary: Cloud infrastructure supports the efficient operation of data pipelines regarding requirements like cost, speed, and resource utilization. We present an integrated view of optimization opportunities for cloud-based data pipelines by conducting a systematic review of existing literature on optimization approaches to cloud infrastructure performance for data pipelines. Our study contributes a theory of optimization goals like minimizing cost, reducing execution time, and cost-makespan trade-offs, consisting of dimensions such as single vs. multi-cloud, batch vs. stream processing, etc. We highlight gaps in primary research, including the underexploration of multi-tenant environments and lack of industry evaluation, and suggest directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对云基础设施数据管道的优化方法进行了系统文献综述，提出了包含最小化成本、减少执行时间和成本-完工时间权衡等优化目标的理论框架，涵盖单云与多云、批处理与流处理等维度，并指出了多租户环境研究和行业评估方面的研究空白。
AI.motivation: 云基础设施需要优化数据管道的成本、速度和资源利用率，但目前缺乏对云数据管道优化方法的系统性整合理解。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，对现有云基础设施数据管道优化相关研究进行系统性梳理和分析。
AI.result: 提出了一个包含多维度的优化目标理论框架，涵盖成本最小化、执行时间减少、成本-完工时间权衡等目标，以及单云与多云、批处理与流处理等维度。
AI.conclusion: 指出了当前研究中的空白领域，包括多租户环境探索不足和缺乏行业评估验证，并提出了未来研究方向。

title: Generative AI Spotlights the Human Core of Data Science: Implications for Education
summary: Generative AI (GAI) reveals an irreducible human core at the center of data science: advances in GAI should sharpen, rather than diminish, the focus on human reasoning in data science education. GAI can now execute many routine data science workflows, including cleaning, summarizing, visualizing, modeling, and drafting reports. Yet the competencies that matter most remain irreducibly human: problem formulation, measurement and design, causal identification, statistical and computational reasoning, ethics and accountability, and sensemaking. Drawing on Donoho's Greater Data Science framework, Nolan and Temple Lang's vision of computational literacy, and the McLuhan-Culkin insight that we shape our tools and thereafter our tools shape us, this paper traces the emergence of data science through three converging lineages: Tukey's intellectual vision of data analysis as a science, the commercial logic of surveillance capitalism that created industrial demand for data scientists, and the academic programs that followed. Mapping GAI's impact onto Donoho's six divisions of Greater Data Science shows that computing with data (GDS3) has been substantially automated, while data gathering, preparation, and exploration (GDS1) and science about data science (GDS6) still require essential human input. The educational implication is that data science curricula should focus on this human core while teaching students how to contribute effectively within iterative prompt-output-prompt cycles using retrieval-augmented generation, and that learning outcomes and assessments should explicitly evaluate reasoning and judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文论述了生成式AI时代数据科学教育的核心方向：GAI可自动化执行数据清洗、可视化、建模等常规工作流，但问题界定、因果识别、伦理判断等高阶能力仍不可替代。作者基于Donoho的"更大数据科学"框架分析指出，计算与数据（GDS3）已大幅自动化，而数据收集准备（GDS1）和关于数据科学的科学（GDS6）仍需人类主导。教育启示是课程应聚焦人类核心能力，并训练学生在RAG迭代循环中有效协作。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（GAI）正在自动化许多常规数据科学工作流，但数据科学教育应如何应对这一变革？作者认为技术进步应强化而非弱化对人类推理的关注，需要重新明确数据科学教育中"不可替代的人类核心"是什么。
AI.method: （1）追溯数据科学三条汇交脉络：图基的数据分析科学愿景、监控资本主义的商业逻辑、学术项目发展；（2）将GAI影响映射到Donoho GDS六分框架（数据探索GDS1、计算与数据GDS3、数据科学科学GDS6）；（3）借鉴Nolan和Temple Lang的计算素养观及McLuhan-Culkin工具塑造论。
AI.result: GDS3（计算与数据）已被大幅自动化；GDS1（数据获取、准备、探索）和GDS6（关于数据科学的科学）仍需关键人类输入。人类不可替代的核心能力包括：问题界定、测量与设计、因果识别、统计与计算推理、伦理与问责、意义建构。
AI.conclusion: 数据科学课程应聚焦人类核心能力，教授学生如何在检索增强生成（RAG）的迭代提示-输出-提示循环中有效贡献，学习成果与评估应明确考查推理与判断能力。

title: BBC: Improving Large-k Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search with a Bucket-based Result Collector
summary: Although Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search has been extensively studied, large-k ANN queries that aim to retrieve a large number of nearest neighbors remain underexplored, despite their numerous real-world applications. Existing ANN methods face significant performance degradation for such queries. In this work, we first investigate the reasons for the performance degradation of quantization-based ANN indexes: (1) the inefficiency of existing top-k collectors, which incurs significant overhead in candidate maintenance, and (2) the reduced pruning effectiveness of quantization methods, which leads to a costly re-ranking process. To address this, we propose a novel bucket-based result collector (BBC) to enhance the efficiency of existing quantization-based ANN indexes for large-k ANN queries. BBC introduces two key components: (1) a bucket-based result buffer that organizes candidates into buckets by their distances to the query. This design reduces ranking costs and improves cache efficiency, enabling high performance maintenance of a candidate superset and a lightweight final selection of top-k results. (2) two re-ranking algorithms tailored for different types of quantization methods, which accelerate their re-ranking process by reducing either the number of candidate objects to be re-ranked or cache misses. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BBC accelerates existing quantization-based ANN methods by up to 3.8x at recall@k = 0.95 for large-k ANN queries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大k近似最近邻查询性能退化问题，提出了一种新的基于桶的结果收集器（BBC），通过基于桶的结果缓冲区和针对不同量化方法的两种重排序算法来提升性能，在真实数据集上实现最高3.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 大k近似最近邻（ANN）查询在现实应用中有重要需求，但现有ANN方法在此类查询上性能显著下降。原因包括：(1) 现有top-k收集器效率低下，在候选维护中产生显著开销；(2) 量化方法的剪枝效果降低，导致代价高昂的重排序过程。
AI.method: 提出基于桶的结果收集器（BBC），包含两个关键组件：(1) 基于桶的结果缓冲区——按候选对象到查询的距离组织成桶，降低排序成本并提高缓存效率，实现高效的候选超集维护和轻量级top-k结果最终选择；(2) 针对不同类型量化方法量身定制的两种重排序算法，通过减少重排序候选对象数量或缓存未命中来加速重排序过程。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，BBC在recall@k = 0.95的大k ANN查询中，可将现有基于量化的ANN方法加速最高达3.8倍。
AI.conclusion: BBC能有效增强现有基于量化的ANN索引在大k查询上的效率，通过改进候选维护机制和重排序过程，成功解决了大k ANN查询的性能瓶颈问题。

title: Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences
summary: Learning human preferences in language models remains fundamentally challenging, as reward modeling relies on subtle, subjective comparisons or shades of gray rather than clear-cut labels. This study investigates the limits of current approaches and proposes a feature-augmented framework to better capture the multidimensional nature of human judgment. Using the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset, we evaluate ten diverse large language models LLMs under a standard pairwise preference setting, where baseline performance remains below 0.74 ROC AUC, highlighting the difficulty of the task. To address this, we enrich textual representations with interpretable signals: response length, refusal indicators, toxicity scores and prompt response semantic similarity, enabling models to explicitly capture key aspects of helpfulness, safety and relevance. The proposed hybrid approach yields consistent improvements across all models, achieving up to 0.84 ROC AUC and significantly higher pairwise accuracy, with DeBERTav3Large demonstrating the best performance. Beyond accuracy, we integrate SHAP and LIME to provide fine-grained interpretability, revealing that model decisions depend on contextualized safety and supportive framing rather than isolated keywords. We further analyze bias amplification, showing that while individual features have weak marginal effects, their interactions influence preference learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中人类偏好学习的局限性，提出了一种特征增强框架，通过引入可解释信号（响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数、语义相似度）提升偏好建模性能，在Anthropic HHRLHF数据集上实现高达0.84 ROC AUC，并利用SHAP和LIME揭示模型决策依赖于情境化的安全和支持性框架。
AI.motivation: 当前人类偏好学习方法面临根本性挑战，因为奖励建模依赖于微妙、主观的比较而非明确的标签。基线模型在成对偏好设置下的ROC AUC低于0.74，突显了任务的困难性。
AI.method: 采用特征增强框架，使用Anthropic HHRLHF数据集评估10种不同LLM。增强的文本表示包含四种可解释信号：响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数和提示-响应语义相似度，以显式捕获有帮助性、安全性和相关性等关键方面。
AI.result: 混合方法在所有模型上实现了一致的改进，最高达到0.84 ROC AUC和显著更高的成对准确率，DeBERTav3Large表现最佳。SHAP和LIME分析表明，模型决策依赖于情境化的安全和支持性框架，而非孤立关键词。特征交互影响偏好学习，尽管单个特征边际效应较弱。
AI.conclusion: 特征增强方法能有效提升人类偏好学习性能，模型对安全性和支持性框架的敏感度是偏好判断的关键因素，特征交互在偏好学习中发挥重要作用。

title: Fuzzing with Agents? Generators Are All You Need
summary:
Modern generator-based fuzzing techniques combine lightweight input generators with coverage-guided mutation as a method of exploring deep execution paths in a target program. A complimentary approach in prior research focuses on creating highly customized, domain-specific generators that encode structural and semantic logic sufficient enough to reach deep program states; the challenge comes from the overhead of writing and testing these complex generators. We investigate whether AI coding agents can automatically synthesize such target-specific generators, and whether the resulting generators are strong enough to obviate the need for coverage guidance and mutation entirely.
  Our approach, Gentoo, is comprised of an LLM coding agent (provided terminal access and source code of the fuzz target and its library) instructed to iteratively synthesize and refine an input generator, and optionally provided fine-grained predicate-level coverage feedback. We evaluate three configurations of Gentoo against human-written generators on fuzz targets for 7 real-world Java libraries. Our findings show that agent-synthesized generators achieve statistically significantly higher branch coverage than human-written baseline generators on 4 of 7 benchmarks. Critically, the use of coverage guidance and mutation strategies is not statistically significantly beneficial for agent-synthesized generators, but is significant for all human-written generators, suggesting that structural and semantic logic encoded in the agent generators makes coverage guidance largely unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gentoo系统，利用LLM编码智能体自动合成针对特定模糊测试目标的输入生成器，探索AI是否能替代人工编写复杂的领域特定生成器。
AI.motivation: 当前基于生成器的模糊测试技术面临挑战：人工编写高度定制化的领域特定生成器需要大量时间和精力来编码程序的结构和语义逻辑。本研究旨在探索AI编码智能体是否能自动合成此类目标特定生成器，以及合成后的生成器是否足以替代传统的覆盖率引导变异策略。
AI.method: Gentoo系统由LLM编码智能体组成，可访问终端和目标模糊测试目标及其库的源代码，被指示迭代合成和优化输入生成器，并可选择性地提供细粒度的谓词级覆盖率反馈。实验评估了三种Gentoo配置，针对7个真实世界Java库的模糊测试目标，并与人工编写的生成器进行对比。
AI.result: 在7个基准测试中，智能体合成的生成器在4个上实现了统计上显著更高的分支覆盖率。关键发现：覆盖率引导和变异策略对智能体合成的生成器没有统计显著益处，但对所有人写生成器都有显著作用，表明智能体生成器编码的结构和语义逻辑使得覆盖率引导变得不必要。
AI.conclusion: AI编码智能体能够自动合成高质量的领域特定输入生成器，其编码的语义逻辑足以覆盖深层程序路径，从而无需依赖覆盖率引导和变异策略即可达到良好的测试效果。

title: Semantic Modeling for World-Centered Architectures
summary: We introduce world-centered multi-agent systems (WMAS) as an alternative to traditional agent-centered architectures, arguing that structured domains such as enterprises and institutional systems require a shared, explicit world representation to ensure semantic consistency, explainability, and long-term stability. We classify worlds along dimensions including ontological explicitness, normativity, etc. In WMAS, learning and coordination operate over a shared world model rather than isolated agent-local representations, enabling global consistency and verifiable system behavior. We propose semantic models as a mathematical formalism for representing such worlds. Finally, we present the Ontobox platform as a realization of WMAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出世界中心多智能体系统(WMAS)作为传统智能体中心架构的替代方案，强调在企业等结构化领域中需要共享、显式的世界表示以确保语义一致性、可解释性和长期稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统智能体中心架构在处理结构化领域(如企业、机构系统)时存在局限性，无法保证语义一致性、系统行为的可解释性和长期稳定性。
AI.method: 提出语义模型(Semantic Models)作为表示世界的数学形式化框架；沿本体显性、规范性等维度对世界进行分类。
AI.result: 在WMAS中，学习和协调操作基于共享世界模型而非孤立智能体本地表示，实现全局一致性和可验证的系统行为。
AI.conclusion: Ontobox平台作为WMAS的具体实现验证了该架构的可行性。

title: UQ-SHRED: uncertainty quantification of shallow recurrent decoder networks for sparse sensing via engression
summary: Reconstructing high-dimensional spatiotemporal fields from sparse sensor measurements is critical in a wide range of scientific applications. The SHallow REcurrent Decoder (SHRED) architecture is a recent state-of-the-art architecture that reconstructs high-quality spatial domain from hyper-sparse sensor measurement streams. An important limitation of SHRED is that in complex, data-scarce, high-frequency, or stochastic systems, portions of the spatiotemporal field must be modeled with valid uncertainty estimation. We introduce UQ-SHRED, a distributional learning framework for sparse sensing problems that provides uncertainty quantification through a neural network-based distributional regression called engression. UQ-SHRED models the uncertainty by learning the predictive distribution of the spatial state conditioned on the sensor history. By injecting stochastic noise into sensor inputs and training with an energy score loss, UQ-SHRED produces predictive distributions with minimal computational overhead, requiring only noise injection at the input and resampling through a single architecture without retraining or additional network structures. On complicated synthetic and real-life datasets including turbulent flow, atmospheric dynamics, neuroscience and astrophysics, UQ-SHRED provides a distributional approximation with well-calibrated confidence intervals. We further conduct ablation studies to understand how each model setting affects the quality of the UQ-SHRED performance, and its validity on uncertainty quantification over a set of different experimental setups.

AI.tldr: UQ-SHRED 通过在 SHRED 架构的传感器输入端拼接高斯噪声、并以严格适当评分规则 Energy Score 作为损失，实现稀疏感知下的完整条件分布学习；仅需单网络、推理时蒙特卡洛重采样即可得到逐时空点的置信区间，参数开销与状态维度无关，并在五个科学与工程数据集上获得良好校准与分布偏移下更稳健的退化表现。
AI.motivation: SHRED 等数据驱动稀疏感知方法虽能从超稀疏传感器流重建高维时空场，但其确定性点估计无法刻画传感器—状态映射中的固有歧义，难以支撑风险评估、异常检测等下游决策。已有深度学习 UQ 方法（贝叶斯神经网络、MC-dropout、深集成、异方差回归、归一化流/扩散模型）要么缺乏统计保证、要么需大量数据与计算（集成为例），且流形模型受可逆网络与迭代去噪限制。因此需要一个既能给出有效不确定度、又能保持单网络效率并在分布偏移下稳健的稀疏感知不确定性量化框架。
AI.method: 方法上采用 Shen 与 Meinshausen 提出的 engression 分布学习范式：设 G_θ(x, ε)=f_D(f_LSTM([x, ε]); θ)，每次前向传播采样 ε~N(0, I_{d_ε}) 并与长度为 L 的传感器滞后窗拼接，噪声在时间窗内保持恒定，经时间单元与浅层解码器传播到全空间场。训练目标为 Energy Score（CRPS 的多元推广，严格适当评分规则）：L_ES = ½(‖ŷ1−y‖+‖ŷ2−y‖) − ½‖ŷ1−ŷ2‖，由两次独立噪声前向传播有限样本估计，排斥项抑制模式坍塌、鼓励噪声实现的多样性。推理时抽取 K 个噪声样本得到经验预测分布，用插入式估计计算条件均值/方差/分位数与置信区间。理论上：定理1 在正则条件（条件律存在、有限一阶矩、模型类良设定、诱导分布有限一阶矩）下证明总体极小化 θ̂ 满足 P_θ̂(·|x)=L(y|x) 几乎处处；Remark1 给出误设下模型类是能量散度意义下的最优逼近；推论1 说明条件均值与协方差一致；定理2 由 Glivenko–Cantelli 引理得经验分位数几乎必然收敛到真实条件分位数。实验用校准度、CRPS、锐度（区间宽度）、区间分数 IS 与校准误差评估，数据涵盖 NOAA 海表温度、JHTDB 各向同性湍流、Allen Institute 神经 LFP、NASA SDO 171Å 太阳活动、1D 旋转爆震发动机瞬态（含 5 条初始条件扰动轨迹）；并在 1D RDE 上与 MC-dropout、深集成(M=10)、异方差高斯、末层 Laplace、分位数回归+CQR、split conformal 及 UQ-SHRED+conformal 对比；SST 数据上做时延、传感器数、噪声维度 d_ε、蒙特卡洛样本数 K、训练轮数的消融；另做时间外推稳定性对比（不同初始化下确定性 SHRED 方差约为 UQ-SHRED 的 3.3 倍）与能量分数 vs MSE 的消融。
AI.result: 五个数据集上 UQ-SHRED 的校准曲线接近对角线（如 SST 95% 标称对应 93.9% 实际覆盖，湍流 90.1%，神经 95.5%，太阳 94.6%），中位数预测紧贴真值且 RMSE 与确定性 SHRED 相当；置信带在 SST 季节转折、湍流剧烈波动、神经高频扰动、太阳耀斑及爆震波锋处展宽、在受传感器充分约束处收窄，且 95% CI 宽度空间分布与误差分布一致。1D RDE 上 UQ-SHRED 在较难轨迹（Run 1）取得最小校准误差 4.0 个百分点与最低区间分数 1.34，优于深集成（7.0/1.41）与 split conformal（7.5/3.04）；区间分数随轨迹难度退化斜率 5.1±1.8，优于深集成 6.9±1.2 与异方差高斯最高 10.2±2.7。参数开销为 4 d_h d_ε（如 12,800），与状态维度 m 无关，而异方差高斯/分位数回归/集成随 m 或 M 线性放大。消融表明：时延主要影响 RMSE 而对校准影响有限（L>10 后稳定）；传感器增多不显著改善覆盖，提示需按输入维度增大 d_ε；K≥100 可获得有效分位数；欠拟合（91.8%）与过拟合（91.6%）状态下 95% 覆盖仍近似有效，暗示早停有益。能量分数是关键：相同噪声注入下用 MSE 损失仅得到 56.5%（Run 0）/44.5%（Run 1）的 95% 覆盖，能量分数提升至 96.0%/91.0%。
AI.conclusion: UQ-SHRED 以“输入端噪声注入 + 能量分数损失 + 单网络蒙特卡洛重采样”的极简设计，把 SHRED 从点估计扩展为条件分布学习，在理论上有严格适当性支撑（总体最优处条件律一致、分位数渐近一致），在实验上兼顾校准、锐度与分布偏移稳健性，且参数开销与重建场维度无关、时间外推更稳定。其局限在于校准保证仅在总体最优且模型良设定时成立，有限数据下可能出现保守或过度自信（单条轨迹训练下的 RDE 强偏移即为一例），且缺乏有限样本覆盖保证，可通过保形校准（conformal）方法补足。

title: A Simple Average-case Analysis of Recursive Randomized Greedy MIS
summary:
We revisit the complexity analysis of the recursive version of the randomized greedy algorithm for computing a maximal independent set (MIS), originally analyzed by Yoshida, Yamamoto, and Ito (2009). They showed that, on average per vertex, the expected number of recursive calls made by this algorithm is upper bounded by the average degree of the input graph. While their analysis is clever and intricate, we provide a significantly simpler alternative that achieves the same guarantee.
  Our analysis is inspired by the recent work of Dalirrooyfard, Makarychev, and Mitrović (2024), who developed a potential-function-based argument to analyze a new algorithm for correlation clustering. We adapt this approach to the MIS setting, yielding a more direct and arguably more transparent analysis of the recursive randomized greedy MIS algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文重新分析了递归版随机贪心最大独立集（MIS）算法，证明了每顶点期望递归调用次数受平均度上界约束，但采用了比原证明更简单的势函数方法。
AI.motivation: Yoshida等人（2009）的原始分析复杂精妙但难以理解，本文旨在提供更简洁透明的分析方法。
AI.method: 借鉴Dalirrooyfard、Makarychev和Mitrović（2024）在相关聚类算法中开发的势函数方法，将其适配到MIS场景。
AI.result: 获得与原分析相同的上界保证：每顶点期望递归调用次数不超过图的平均度。
AI.conclusion: 势函数方法为递归随机贪心MIS算法提供了更直接、更透明的分析框架。

title: Intelligent Cloud Orchestration: A Hybrid Predictive and Heuristic Framework for Cost Optimization
summary: Cloud computing allows scalable resource provisioning, but dynamic workload changes often lead to higher costs due to over-provisioning. Machine learning (ML) approaches, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, are effective for predicting workload patterns at a higher level, but they can introduce delays during sudden traffic spikes. In contrast, mathematical heuristics like Game Theory provide fast and reliable scheduling decisions, but they do not account for future workload changes. To address this trade-off, this paper proposes a hybrid orchestration framework that combines LSTM-based predictive scaling with heuristic task allocation. The results show that this approach reduces infrastructure costs close to ML-based models while maintaining fast response times similar to heuristic methods. This work presents a practical approach for improving cost efficiency in cloud resource management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种云资源编排的混合框架：将LSTM预测性伸缩与博弈论启发式任务分配相结合，在成本上接近纯机器学习方案，同时保留启发式方法的快速响应能力。
AI.motivation: 云计算支持弹性资源供给，但工作负载的动态波动使按峰值配置的基础设施产生大量过度预留，推高运营成本。现有两类方法各有缺陷：LSTM等机器学习模型在高层级上能准确捕捉工作负载的时间序列规律，但在突发流量尖峰时预测滞后，容易造成资源不足或调度延迟；博弈论等数学启发式方法能给出快速、可靠的调度决策，却不考虑未来负载变化，资源准备同样依赖即时反应。二者在"预测准确性/前瞻性"与"响应速度"之间存在权衡，亟需一种兼具两者优势的编排机制。
AI.method: 构建混合式编排框架：以前瞻性的LSTM预测模块负责工作负载趋势预测与预置资源（预测性伸缩），以博弈论启发式模块负责运行时的任务分配与调度决策（快速启发式分配）。该设计利用LSTM的负载预判能力提前完成资源准备，弥补启发式方法缺乏未来视野的不足；同时借助启发式模块在流量突增时绕过预测延迟立即执行调度决策，规避纯ML方案在尖峰场景下的响应滞后，从而形成预测层与决策层的互补协作。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，混合方案的基础设施成本降低幅度接近基于机器学习的模型（成本效率与纯ML方法相当），而响应时间保持在与启发式方法相近的快速水平；在负载突增场景下有效缓解了纯ML预测带来的调度延迟问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出一个兼顾成本与性能的实用化云资源管理思路：把机器学习的"前瞻预测"与启发式的"即时决策"分置于编排流程的不同环节，可在降低过度预留成本的同时维持快速响应，为成本敏感的云资源编排提供了一种可落地的混合范式。

title: Optimizing Relational Queries over Array-Valued Data in Columnar Systems
summary: Modern analytical workloads increasingly combine relational data with array-valued attributes. While columnar database systems efficiently process such workloads, their ability to optimize queries that interleave relational operators with array manipulations remains limited. This paper introduces A3D-RA, an extended relational algebra supporting array-valued attributes, together with a comprehensive framework for algebraic reasoning and optimization. We formalize its data model and semantics, develop a complete set of equivalence-preserving transformation rules capturing pairwise interactions between relational and array operators, and propose a plan enumeration strategy with an optimality guarantee that remains polynomial in all non-join operators. We design A3D-RA as a modular, backend-independent optimization layer that can be instantiated over existing analytical database systems. Experimental results across three high-performance engines on a real-world workload show consistent performance gains enabled by the proposed algebraic optimization layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 A3D-RA：一种支持数组值属性的扩展关系代数，并配套一个与后端解耦的代数优化层。它定义了数据模型与形式语义，给出覆盖所有关系算子与数组算子两两交互的等价变换规则集（R1–R21），并提出在非 join 算子数量上保持多项式复杂度、且具最优性保证的算子排序与连接枚举方法。在 ClickHouse、Umbra、Snowflake 三种引擎上对 1 亿行级金融真实负载验证：ClickHouse 平均加速 11.02×（最高 38.75×），Snowflake XS 平均 5.35×，并使若干原生查询因内存超限而失败的用例得以执行。
AI.motivation: 现代分析型负载（金融时序、ML 特征向量、IoT 传感器）越来越多地在同一张反规范化事实表中同时使用关系结构与多维数组属性。列式引擎（ClickHouse、Snowflake、Umbra、DuckDB 等）擅长这类读密集负载，但现有数组支持多以专有扩展或 UDF 形式提供，缺乏统一的代数基础：优化器无法系统地推理关系算子（选择、投影、连接、聚合）与数组算子（arrayJoin、arrayFilter、derive）之间的交互，因此大量优化机会被浪费。Volcano 式的穷举重写规模呈指数增长不可行，而贪心式重写又缺乏全局最优保证——这正是本文要解决的核心缺口。
AI.method: 1）数据模型：元组为列名到值的偏函数，关系列集划分为标量列与数组列；引入"数组语义对应"关系（长度相同且逐位语义匹配）。2）代数 A3D-RA：保留 ⋈、σ、π，新增 ArrayJoin μ（解嵌套展开，可对等长多数组做位置对齐展开）、ArrayFilter φ（保持行数、按谓词裁剪数组，支持多数组协同过滤以保位置对应）、Derive δ（派生新列，对数组列用 arrayMap 逐元素作用）、Aggregation Γ（分组聚合，支持多聚合）；另定义"可逆谓词"以支持过滤下推。3）变换规则：对 6×7 算子对做系统化两两分析，得到 R1–R21 共 21 条保等价规则，分为 rule-based（无条件有益）与 cost-based（依赖代价/选择率）；含 R2.2（过滤下推转为 arrayFilter）、R4.2（arrayEnumerate 实现连接两侧数组元素对齐匹配）、R11.2/R13.2（利用可逆性把谓词推到原始列并可能消除派生列）、R17.x/R18–R21（引入预聚合，含 distributive aggregation 的 Agg(i)/Agg(f) 二阶段分解）。4）优化流程三阶段：预处理（投影上提、先应用引入新算子的 R2.2/R2.3）、枚举、后处理（迭代应用预聚合规则，因其具阻塞性故延后）。5）枚举算法：自顶向下连接图划分 + 单目算子排序；排序推广 Smith 定理的 rank (1-s)/c 为二维度——同时考虑竖向选择率与"横向选择率"（数组缩减比），给出 ≲ 关系；用前驱约束 DAG 表达语义依赖（series-parallel 时多项式可解，出现 Z 形结构时按 ≲ 加边启发式破环）；借助 API（相邻两两交换）性质证明最优性。6）代价模型：统计模块区分低基数精确频次、均匀分布均值、偏态分布 K-Means 聚类，并对数组列分别维护 array-level 与 row-level 分布统计。7）系统架构：Logical Plan Generator → Plan Optimization（规则/代价模型/枚举）→ Translator，可插拔后端，实例化为 A3DRA[ClickHouse]、A3DRA[Umbra]、A3DRA[Snowflake]。
AI.result: 真实负载（1 亿+ 行、18 条查询）：ClickHouse 上 16 条可翻译查询加速 2.84×–38.75×，均值 11.02×（Q16 从 614.6s 降至 15.9s），Q14/Q18 在原生下内存超限而优化后可成功执行（15.8s/13.5s）；Umbra 上 7 条原生内存失败的查询优化后成功（1.1–6.4s），6 条可执行查询均值加速 1.32×，另有 5 条因语言特性不支持无法翻译；Snowflake XS 上 13 条查询加速 1.76×–14.68×（均值 5.35×），Large 仓库上 1.17×–2.73×（均值 1.75×）。规则影响分析：过滤下推至 arrayJoin 之下带来 1.7×–4×（水平过滤单独在 Q4 达 3.8×），derive 下推带来 1.61×–2.79×，引入预聚合带来 1.52×–9.22×（Q4 达 9.22×）；可逆性分析显示 DF-J/J-DF 及 FJD/FDJ/JFD 三种计划间性能差异明显，优化器总能选出最优者。开销侧：18 条真实查询优化耗时 1.05–2.80s（均值 1.89s），优化回报率 ClickHouse 均值 70.4×（最高 515.7×）、Snowflake XS 21.5×，Umbra 与 Snowflake Large 仅 0.8×/1.1×。扩展性：pattern 数 1→150 时优化时间 0.024s→416s，log-log 回归指数 k≈2.0（R²>99%）；每 pattern 数组数 1→20 时 0.012s→14s，k≈2.2（R²=98.84%），增长因子稳定在 1.1–1.2。
AI.conclusion: 把数组操作提升为一等代数构造物，可让优化器对关系与数组算子做全局、系统性的联合重写，从而在不改动机身的前提下为现有分析型引擎释放可观性能收益；本文的规则集与排序枚举框架在语义上完备（覆盖全部算子对）、在复杂度上于非 join 算子维度保持多项式并给出最优性保证。局限性/后续方向包括：连接枚举本身仍为 NP-hard、复杂度随 join 数指数增长；统计与选择率估计较为粗糙（per-tuple 代价以数组平均长度近似）；Z 形前驱结构下的破环为启发式，可能牺牲最优性；部分查询因后端语言特性缺失无法翻译，框架对各引擎数组语义的表达能力边界仍待扩展。

title: Procedural Knowledge at Scale Improves Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as an effective way to improve language models on challenging reasoning tasks. However, most existing methods treat each problem in isolation and do not systematically reuse knowledge from prior reasoning trajectories. In particular, they underutilize procedural knowledge: how to reframe a problem, choose an approach, and verify or backtrack when needed. We introduce Reasoning Memory, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for reasoning models that explicitly retrieves and reuses procedural knowledge at scale. Starting from existing corpora of step-by-step reasoning trajectories, we decompose each trajectory into self-contained subquestion-subroutine pairs, yielding a datastore of 32 million compact procedural knowledge entries. At inference time, a lightweight in-thought prompt lets the model verbalize the core subquestion, retrieve relevant subroutines within its reasoning trace, and reason under diverse retrieved subroutines as implicit procedural priors. Across six math, science, and coding benchmarks, Reasoning Memory consistently outperforms RAG with document, trajectory, and template knowledge, as well as a compute-matched test-time scaling baseline. With a higher inference budget, it improves over no retrieval by up to 19.2% and over the strongest compute-matched baseline by 7.9% across task types. Ablation studies show that these gains come from two key factors: the broad procedural coverage of the source trajectories and our decomposition and retrieval design, which together enable effective extraction and reuse of procedural knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reasoning Memory框架，通过将32M推理轨迹分解为子问题-子程序对，构建大规模程序性知识库，在推理时动态检索并复用先验推理知识，在6个数学、科学和编程基准上最高提升19.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法将每个问题孤立处理，未能系统性地复用先前推理轨迹中的知识，尤其是程序性知识（包括如何重构问题、选择方法、验证和回溯）。这导致推理效率低下，重复劳动严重。
AI.method: Reasoning Memory是一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架：(1)从现有逐步推理轨迹语料库出发，将每条轨迹分解为自包含的子问题-子程序对，构建包含3200万条紧凑程序性知识条目的知识库；(2)推理时通过轻量级思维内提示让模型明确表达核心子问题，在推理轨迹内检索相关子程序，并将其作为隐式程序性先验进行推理。
AI.result: 在6个数学、科学和编程基准上，Reasoning Memory一致优于使用文档、轨迹和模板知识的RAG方法以及计算量匹配的测试时扩展基线。在更高推理预算下，相比无检索提升达19.2%，相比最强计算匹配基线提升7.9%。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明，性能提升来自两个关键因素：源推理轨迹的广泛程序性知识覆盖，以及分解与检索设计的有效性，两者共同实现了程序性知识的有效提取与复用。

title: MOVis: A Visual Analytics Tool for Surfacing Missed Patches Across Software Variants
summary: Clone-and-own development produces families of related software variants that evolve independently. As variants diverge, important fixes applied in one repository are often missing in others. PaReco has shown that thousands of such missed opportunity (MO) patches exist across real ecosystems, yet its textual output provides limited support for understanding where and how these fixes should be propagated. We present MOVis, a lightweight, interactive desktop tool that visualizes MO patches between a source and target variant. MOVis loads PaReco's MO classifications and presents patched and buggy hunks side-by-side, highlighting corresponding regions and exposing structural differences that hinder reuse. This design enables developers to quickly locate missed fixes, understand required adaptations, and more efficiently maintain consistency across software variants. The tool, replication package, and demonstration video are available at https://zenodo.org/records/18356553 and https://youtu.be/Ac-gjBxHJ3Y.

AI.tldr: MOVis是一款交互式桌面工具，用于可视化软件变体间的错失机会(MO)补丁。该工具加载PaReco的MO分类结果，以并排对比方式展示修复和缺陷代码块，突出显示对应区域，帮助开发者快速定位遗漏修复、理解所需适配，从而更高效地在软件变体间维护一致性。
AI.motivation: Clone-and-own开发模式产生的软件变体家族各自独立演化，导致一个仓库中的重要修复常缺失于其他变体。PaReco研究表明此类MO补丁在真实生态系统中数以千计，但其文本输出对理解和定位修复传播的位置和方式支持有限。
AI.method: MOVis加载PaReco的MO分类结果，以并排视图呈现修补和缺陷代码块，高亮显示对应区域，暴露阻碍重用的结构性差异。采用轻量级交互式桌面工具设计。
AI.result: 开发者可快速定位遗漏修复、理解所需适配、高效维护软件变体间一致性。工具、复现包及演示视频已公开可用。
AI.conclusion: MOVis通过可视化方法有效弥补了PaReco文本输出的不足，为软件变体维护提供了更直观的分析和决策支持。

title: Crashing Waves vs. Rising Tides: Preliminary Findings on AI Automation from Thousands of Worker Evaluations of Labor Market Tasks
summary: We propose that AI automation is a continuum between: (i) crashing waves where AI capabilities surge abruptly over small sets of tasks, and (ii) rising tides where the increase in AI capabilities is more continuous and broad-based. We test for these effects in preliminary evidence from an ongoing evaluation of AI capabilities across over 3,000 broad-based tasks derived from the U.S. Department of Labor O*NET categorization that are text-based and thus LLM-addressable. Based on more than 17,000 evaluations by workers from these jobs, we find little evidence of crashing waves (in contrast to recent work by METR), but substantial evidence that rising tides are the primary form of AI automation. AI performance is high and improving rapidly across a wide range of tasks. We estimate that, in 2024-Q2, AI models successfully complete tasks that take humans approximately 3-4 hours with about a 50% success rate, increasing to about 65% by 2025-Q3. If recent trends in AI capability growth persist, this pace of AI improvement implies that LLMs will be able to complete most text-related tasks with success rates of, on average, 80%-95% by 2029 at a minimally sufficient quality level. Achieving near-perfect success rates at this quality level or comparable success rates at superior quality would require several additional years. These AI capability improvements would impact the economy and labor market as organizations adopt AI, which could have a substantially longer timeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI自动化呈现两种模式：骤然涌动(crashing waves)和小幅上涨(rising tides)。通过对3000多个O*NET任务的评估，发现AI自动化主要以rising tides形式发展，而非crashing waves。2024年Q2，AI可在约50%成功率下完成人类需3-4小时的任务，到2025年Q3提升至65%。若趋势持续，到2029年AI将在大多数文本相关任务上达到80-95%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI自动化发展模式存在分歧。部分研究(如METR)认为AI能力在特定任务上呈"骤然涌动"式跳跃，而本文旨在检验这一假设，并系统评估AI在广泛任务上的能力演进。
AI.method: 基于美国劳工部O*NET数据库的3000+个文本类任务，由相关从业工作者进行17000+次AI能力评估，涵盖AI性能现状及改进速度的实证测试。
AI.result: 研究发现：1)几乎无证据支持"crashing waves"模式；2)"rising tides"是AI自动化的主要形式；3)AI性能在广泛任务上保持高水平且快速提升；4)2024-Q2时AI约50%成功率完成人类3-4小时任务，2025-Q3达65%。
AI.conclusion: 若当前AI能力增长趋势持续，到2029年LLM将在大多数文本任务上达到80-95%成功率。但AI对经济与劳动力市场的影响将需要更长时间才能显现，因为组织采用AI的timeline会更长。

title: An Online Machine Learning Multi-resolution Optimization Framework for Energy System Design Limit of Performance Analysis
summary: Designing reliable integrated energy systems for industrial processes requires optimization and verification models across multiple fidelities, from architecture-level sizing to high-fidelity dynamic operation. However, model mismatch across fidelities obscures the sources of performance loss and complicates the quantification of architecture-to-operation performance gaps. We propose an online, machine-learning-accelerated multi-resolution optimization framework that estimates an architecture-specific upper bound on achievable performance while minimizing expensive high-fidelity model evaluations. We demonstrate the approach on a pilot energy system supplying a 1 MW industrial heat load. First, we solve a multi-objective architecture optimization to select the system configuration and component capacities. We then develop an machine learning (ML)-accelerated multi-resolution, receding-horizon optimal control strategy that approaches the achievable-performance bound for the specified architecture, given the additional controls and dynamics not captured by the architectural optimization model. The ML-guided controller adaptively schedules the optimization resolution based on predictive uncertainty and warm-starts high-fidelity solves using elite low-fidelity solutions. Our results on the pilot case study show that the proposed multi-resolution strategy reduces the architecture-to-operation performance gap by up to 42% relative to a rule-based controller, while reducing required high-fidelity model evaluations by 34% relative to the same multi-fidelity approach without ML guidance, enabling faster and more reliable design verification. Together, these gains make high-fidelity verification tractable, providing a practical upper bound on achievable operational performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架，用于工业综合能源系统的设计与运行优化。该框架通过自适应调度优化分辨率和利用低保真解预热高精度求解器，有效弥合了架构设计级与高保真动态运行之间的性能差距，在1MW工业热负荷案例中实现了42%的性能差距缩减，同时减少34%的高保真模型评估次数。
AI.motivation: 工业综合能源系统的可靠设计需要在多个保真度层级进行优化与验证，从架构级容量规划到高保真动态运行。但多保真度模型之间的不匹配导致性能损失来源难以追溯，架构到运行阶段的性能差距难以量化，且高精度模型评估成本高昂。这促使研究者寻求一种能够高效利用多保真度模型、同时最小化高成本计算的方法。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个核心阶段：(1) 多目标架构优化阶段，用于选择系统配置和组件容量；(2) ML加速的多分辨率滚动时域最优控制阶段，使用精英低保真解预热高精度模型求解器，并根据预测不确定性自适应调度优化分辨率。ML引导的控制器能够识别何时需要高保真求解，何时可用低保真近似，从而在保证解质量的同时降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在1MW工业热负荷的试点能源系统案例中：① 相比规则型控制器，所提多分辨率策略将架构-运行性能差距缩减了42%；② 相比无ML引导的同类型多保真度方法，所需高保真模型评估次数减少34%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了通过智能化的分辨率调度和多保真度融合，可以实现更快、更可靠的综合能源系统设计验证，为实际工程应用提供了可达性能上界的实用估计工具。

title: Diagnosing Translated Benchmarks: An Automated Quality Assurance Study of the EU20 Benchmark Suite
summary: Machine-translated benchmark datasets reduce costs and offer scale, but noise, loss of structure, and uneven quality weaken confidence. What matters is not merely whether we can translate, but also whether we can measure and verify translation reliability at scale. We study translation quality in the EU20 benchmark suite, which comprises five established benchmarks translated into 20 languages, via a three-step automated quality assurance approach: (i) a structural corpus audit with targeted fixes; (ii) quality profiling using a neural metric (COMET, reference-free and reference-based) with translation service comparisons (DeepL / ChatGPT / Google); and (iii) an LLM-based span-level translation error landscape. Trends are consistent: datasets with lower COMET scores exhibit a higher share of accuracy/mistranslation errors at span level (notably HellaSwag; ARC is comparatively clean). Reference-based COMET on MMLU against human-edited samples points in the same direction. We release cleaned/corrected versions of the EU20 datasets, and code for reproducibility. In sum, automated quality assurance offers practical, scalable indicators that help prioritize review -- complementing, not replacing, human gold standards.

AI.tldr: 论文提出三步自动化质量保证方法来评估EU20基准套件（5个基准×20语言）的翻译质量，发现COMET分数较低的数据集存在更多准确性/误译错误，并发布了清洁校正后的数据集。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译基准数据集存在噪声、结构丢失和质量不均等问题，需要可扩展的方法来测量和验证翻译可靠性。
AI.method: 三步自动化质量保证流程：(i)结构化语料库审计与针对性修复；(ii)使用神经度量工具COMET（无参考和有参考模式）进行质量分析，比较三种翻译服务（DeepL/ChatGPT/Google）；(iii)基于LLM的span级翻译错误分析。
AI.result: 趋势一致：COMET分数较低的数据集在span级别呈现更高比例的准确性/误译错误（HellaSwag最明显，ARC相对干净）；基于参考的COMET分析MMLU与人编样本结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 自动化质量保证提供实用、可扩展的指标，有助于优先人工审查，但不能替代人类金标准。发布了EU20数据集的清洁/校正版本及可复现代码。

title: Sublinear-query relative-error testing of halfspaces
summary:
The relative-error property testing model was introduced in [CDHLNSY24] to facilitate the study of property testing for "sparse" Boolean-valued functions, i.e. ones for which only a small fraction of all input assignments satisfy the function. In this framework, the distance from the unknown target function $f$ that is being tested to a function $g$ is defined as $\mathrm{Vol}(f \mathop{\triangle} g)/\mathrm{Vol}(f)$, where the numerator is the fraction of inputs on which $f$ and $g$ disagree and the denominator is the fraction of inputs that satisfy $f$.
  Recent work [CDHNSY26] has shown that over the Boolean domain $\{0,1\}^n$, any relative-error testing algorithm for the fundamental class of halfspaces (i.e. linear threshold functions) must make $Ω(\log n)$ oracle calls. In this paper we complement the [CDHNSY26] lower bound by showing that halfspaces can be relative-error tested over $\mathbb{R}^n$ under the standard $N(0,I_n)$ Gaussian distribution using a sublinear number of oracle calls -- in particular, substantially fewer than would be required for learning. Our results use a wide range of tools including Hermite analysis, Gaussian isoperimetric inequalities, and geometric results on noise sensitivity and surface area.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了稀疏布尔值函数的相对误差性质测试模型，重点关注在实数域 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 上、高斯分布 $N(0, I_n)$ 下对半空间（线性阈值函数）进行测试。与已知在布尔域上需要 $\Omega(\log n)$ 次查询的下界形成对比，本文证明了在实数高斯域上可以用亚线性（sublinear）查询复杂度测试半空间，且远少于学习所需的查询数。
AI.motivation: 相对误差性质测试模型是 [CDHLNSY24] 为研究"稀疏"布尔值函数（即只有一小部分输入满足函数）的测试而引入的框架。[CDHNSY26] 已证明在布尔域 $\{0,1\}^n$ 上，任何半空间的相对误差测试算法都需要 $\Omega(\log n)$ 次 oracle 调用。本文旨在为该下界提供上界补充——在实数高斯分布下证明存在更高效的测试算法。
AI.method: 作者综合运用了多种数学工具：Hermite 分析（用于函数展开和正交多项式技术）、高斯等周不等式（用于体积和边界估计）以及噪声敏感性和表面积的几何结果（用于分析函数在噪声下的行为）。这些工具共同用于构建和证明关于半空间测试复杂度的算法。
AI.result: 在实数域 $\mathbb{R}^n$、标准高斯分布 $N(0, I_n)$ 下，半空间可以通过亚线性（sublinear）数量的 oracle 调用进行相对误差测试。这一复杂度显著低于 [CDHNSY26] 在布尔域上证明的 $\Omega(\log n)$ 下界，也远少于纯粹学习半空间所需的查询数量。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了相对误差测试研究中关于半空间的上界空白，揭示了测试复杂度与分布/域的选择之间的深刻联系：同一函数类在布尔域和高斯域上具有截然不同的测试复杂度。这表明在设计性质测试算法时，分布假设和域结构是关键的考量因素。

title: A Practical Two-Stage Framework for GPU Resource and Power Prediction in Heterogeneous HPC Systems
summary: Efficient utilization of GPU resources and power has become critical with the growing demand for GPUs in high-performance computing (HPC). In this paper, we analyze GPU utilization and GPU memory utilization, as well as the power consumption of the Vienna ab initio Simulation Package (VASP), using the Slurm workload manager historical logs and GPU performance metrics collected by NVIDIA's Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM). VASP is a widely used materials science application on Perlmutter at NERSC, an HPE Cray EX system based on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Using our insights from the resource utilization analysis of VASP applications, we propose a resource prediction framework to predict the average GPU power, maximum GPU utilization, and maximum GPU memory utilization values of heterogeneous HPC system applications to enable more efficient scheduling decisions and power-aware system operation. Our prediction framework consists of two stages: 1) using only the Slurm accounting logs as training data and 2) augmenting the training data with historical GPU profiling metrics collected with DCGM. The maximum GPU utilization predictions using only the Slurm submission features achieve up to 97% accuracy. Furthermore, features engineered from GPU-compute and memory activity metrics exhibit good correlations with average power utilization, and our runtime power usage prediction experiments result in up to 92% prediction accuracy. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of DCGM metrics in capturing application characteristics and highlight their potential for developing predictive models to support dynamic power management in HPC systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对NERSC Perlmutter超级计算机上的VASP材料科学应用，分析GPU利用率、GPU内存利用率和功耗，并提出一个两阶段资源预测框架来预测GPU功耗和利用率，为高效调度和功耗感知系统运维提供支持。
AI.motivation: 随着GPU在高性能计算中的需求增长，高效利用GPU资源和功耗管理变得至关重要。VASP是NERSC Perlmutter系统上广泛使用的材料科学应用，但缺乏对其GPU资源利用特征的深入分析。
AI.method: 使用Slurm工作负载管理器的历史日志和NVIDIA DCGM收集的GPU性能指标进行分析；提出两阶段资源预测框架：第一阶段仅使用Slurm accounting日志作为训练数据，第二阶段结合DCGM历史GPU性能指标增强训练数据。
AI.result: 仅使用Slurm提交特征的GPU最大利用率预测准确率达97%；从GPU计算和内存活动指标中提取的特征与平均功耗相关性良好，运行时功耗预测准确率达92%。
AI.conclusion: DCGM指标能有效捕获应用特征，可用于开发预测模型以支持HPC系统的动态功耗管理；Slurm日志特征结合DCGM指标为异构HPC系统的调度优化和功耗感知运维提供了可行方案。

title: Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin: LLM Output Diversity is Everything, Everywhere, All at Once
summary: Research on Large Language Models (LLMs) studies output variation across generation, reasoning, alignment, and representational analysis, often under the umbrella of "diversity." Yet the terminology remains fragmented, largely because the normative objectives underlying tasks are rarely made explicit. We introduce the Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin framework, which models output variation along a homogeneity-heterogeneity axis, where valuation is determined by the task and its normative objective. We organize tasks into four normative contexts: epistemic (factuality), interactional (user utility), societal (representation), and safety (robustness). For each, we examine the failure modes and vocabulary such as hallucination, mode collapse, bias, and erasure through which variation is studied. We apply the framework to analyze all pairwise cross-contextual interactions, revealing that optimizing for one objective, such as improving safety, can inadvertently harm demographic representation or creative diversity. We argue for context-aware evaluation of output variation, reframing it as a property shaped by task objectives rather than a model's intrinsic trait.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin"框架，将LLM输出变化建模为同质性-异质性轴，并将其置于四种规范性情境(认知性、交互性、社会性、安全性)中分析。研究揭示了跨情境优化的权衡问题，例如提升安全性可能损害人口代表性或创造性多样性，并主张将输出变化重新定义为受任务目标塑造的属性，而非模型内在特质。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM输出变化研究存在术语碎片化问题，缺乏统一的分析框架来整合认知、推理、对齐和表征分析等领域的工作。根本原因在于任务背后的规范性目标很少被明确阐述，导致"diversity"概念在不同情境下含义模糊。
AI.method: 提出MMHS框架，将输出变化沿"同质性-异质性"轴进行建模，评估标准由具体任务及其规范性目标决定。研究将任务分为四种规范性情境：认知性(事实性)、交互性(用户效用)、社会性(代表性)和安全性(鲁棒性)。系统分析各情境下的失败模式词汇(如幻觉、模式坍缩、偏见、抹除)，并对所有成对跨情境交互进行建模。
AI.result: 揭示了跨情境优化存在的隐性权衡：例如提升安全性可能意外损害人口代表性或创造性多样性。输出变化的最优水平高度依赖于具体任务情境，不存在统一的"适度"标准。
AI.conclusion: 应采用情境感知的输出变化评估方法，将其重新定义为受任务目标塑造的属性，而非模型的内在特质。这一视角转换对于设计更合理的LLM评估体系和训练策略具有重要意义。

title: Memory in the LLM Era: Modular Architectures and Strategies in a Unified Framework
summary: Memory emerges as the core module in the large language model (LLM)-based agents for long-horizon complex tasks (e.g., multi-turn dialogue, game playing, scientific discovery), where memory can enable knowledge accumulation, iterative reasoning and self-evolution. A number of memory methods have been proposed in the literature. However, these methods have not been systematically and comprehensively compared under the same experimental settings. In this paper, we first summarize a unified framework that incorporates all the existing agent memory methods from a high-level perspective. We then extensively compare representative agent memory methods on two well-known benchmarks and examine the effectiveness of all methods, providing a thorough analysis of those methods. As a byproduct of our experimental analysis, we also design a new memory method by exploiting modules in the existing methods, which outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. Finally, based on these findings, we offer promising future research opportunities. We believe that a deeper understanding of the behavior of existing methods can provide valuable new insights for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对大语言模型(LLM)智能体中的记忆方法进行了系统性综述与对比分析。现有记忆方法缺乏统一的实验比较框架，本文首先提出了一个统一框架整合所有现有方法，然后在两个基准测试上进行了广泛对比实验，并基于现有方法模块设计了一种新的记忆方法，性能超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在长时域复杂任务（如多轮对话、游戏、科学发现）中的应用日益广泛，记忆模块成为核心组件。但现有记忆方法缺乏系统性的统一比较框架，难以评估各方法的实际效果与优劣。
AI.method: 首先从高层视角提出统一框架，整合所有现有智能体记忆方法；然后在两个知名基准测试上广泛对比代表性记忆方法；作为实验分析的副产品，设计了新的记忆方法（利用现有方法中的模块组合）。
AI.result: 新设计的记忆方法在实验中超越了当前最优方法，验证了模块组合策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对现有方法的深入理解和系统比较，为未来智能体记忆研究提供了有价值的新见解和潜在的研究方向。

title: No Attacker Needed: Unintentional Cross-User Contamination in Shared-State LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate across repeated sessions, maintaining task states to ensure continuity. In many deployments, a single agent serves multiple users within a team or organization, reusing a shared knowledge layer across user identities. This shared persistence expands the failure surface: information that is locally valid for one user can silently degrade another user's outcome when the agent reapplies it without regard for scope. We refer to this failure mode as unintentional cross-user contamination (UCC). Unlike adversarial memory poisoning, UCC requires no attacker; it arises from benign interactions whose scope-bound artifacts persist and are later misapplied. We formalize UCC through a controlled evaluation protocol, introduce a taxonomy of three contamination types, and evaluate the problem in two shared-state mechanisms. Under raw shared state, benign interactions alone produce contamination rates of 57--71%. A write-time sanitization is effective when shared state is conversational, but leaves substantial residual risk when shared state includes executable artifacts, with contamination often manifesting as silent wrong answers. These results indicate that shared-state agents need artifact-level defenses beyond text-level sanitization to prevent silent cross-user failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统研究了「无意的跨用户污染」（Unintentional Cross-User Contamination, UCC）这一共享状态 LLM 智能体的鲁棒性失败模式：在多用户共享同一持久化状态（长期记忆库/持久化对话上下文）的部署中，用户的一次良性交互会把「仅在本地成立」的约定（语义重定义、转换/聚合规则、流程偏好）写入共享状态，随后被其他用户复用而静默地降低其任务正确性，无需任何攻击者。作者给出了形式化定义、受控评测协议、三类污染的分类法，并在两种共享状态机制（EHRAgent 共享记忆、MURMUR 共享上下文）上评估了写入时净化方法 SSI（Sanitized Shared Interaction）。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地依赖跨会话的持久状态（记忆缓冲、检索库、摘要、轨迹）以支持长程任务；在团队/组织级部署中，同一个智能体往往以「共享知识层」服务多个用户身份，为一位用户生成的内容会被另一用户检索或继承。现有智能体完整性研究几乎都以显式对抗者为前提（间接提示注入、恶意工具调用诱导、记忆投毒、MINJA/MURMUR 等跨用户攻击），关注「恶意内容是否到达有害目标」，而忽视了更常见的情形：源交互完全良性、无隐藏指令、无优化过的有害目标，仅因系统在复用时丢失了「该约定在何种范围内成立」这一条件，就把局部有效的产物当成普适规则，从而静默改变后续用户的答案、代码或工具行为。这带来三方面的空白：(1) 缺少对共享状态复用中「作用域失效」现象的形式化与可控度量；(2) 缺少对其发生率、类型学与机制依赖性的系统刻画；(3) 现有防御（写入时文本过滤、输入输出护栏、冲突知识检测）均以对抗威胁为设计目标，且只在文本层净化，无法处理嵌入在可执行产物（如 SQL 解决方案代码）中的范围绑定约定。
AI.method:
**形式化模型**：多用户智能体维护共享状态 S_t，通过写操作 W、读操作 R 和智能体函数 f 抽象：S_{t+1}=W(S_t,u_t,x_t,y_t,a_t)，z=R(S,u,x)，(y,a)=f(u,x,z)。该抽象同时覆盖「共享记忆库」（检索结构化记录片段）与「共享上下文」（暴露持久转录/摘要视图）两种机制。

**UCC 定义**：由用户 u_s 写入的状态片段 e_s，在后续用户 u_v≠u_s 的任务中影响了决策，且因被误当作通用规则而损害了 u_v 的正确性或任务效用；关键区分点在于 u_s 不是攻击者。

**受控评测协议**：令 S_t^+ 为写入源交互后的状态，对受害交互分别用干净状态 S_t 与污染状态 S_t^+ 运行，比较 (y_v^-,a_v^-) 与 (y_v^+,a_v^+)；若输出变化可归因于新增状态片段且在受害任务规范下有害，则判定为污染。这样可将「普通状态复用」与「有害状态复用」分离。

**分类学（三种效应类型）**：语义污染 SC（改变对请求的解释，如把 "last year" 解释为过去 12 个月）、转换污染 TC（改变聚合/过滤/归一化/去重/摘要规则，如取整规则）、程序污染 PC（改变动作模式、工作流默认或工具调用序列，如改用 COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) 的唯一患者计数）。三类可重叠。

**防御**：SSI 写入时净化器作为 W 路径上的拦截层，用 LLM 重写器 h(τ_t) 将原始轨迹改写为只保留可复用内容（核心任务、事实、与解题相关的步骤），移除用户特定偏好、格式/聚合指令、局部解释覆盖与流程约定；无法安全分离时输出 NONE 并放弃写入。只改写写入、不改读路径与推理。

**实验**：EHRAgent（临床数据库 SQL 生成，共享 (question, knowledge, solution) 三元组记忆库，MIMIC-III 与 eICU）与 MURMUR（Slack 领域，持久共享对话上下文）。手动设计 34 个良性源约定（MIMIC-III 11、eICU 14、Slack 9），每个搭配至多 3 个语义相关且预先过滤为「无污染时必定成功」的受害任务，每对独立跑 3 次；EHRAgent 用 top-4 余弦相似度检索（all-MiniLM-L6-v2），全部以 gpt-4o 为骨干（MURMUR 的用户模拟与断言评估亦为 gpt-4o，temperature=0）；EHRAgent 用精确匹配+宽松归一化判定，MURMUR 用 LLM-as-a-judge 判定是否体现了源约定。
AI.result:
**RQ1 发生率**：原始共享状态下，仅凭良性交互即造成 57.4%–70.7% 的污染率（EHRAgent/MIMIC-III 59.6%、eICU 70.7%、MURMUR/Slack 57.4%），证实 UCC 在无攻击者条件下普遍存在。

**RQ2 风险画像**：主导类型随机制而变。EHRAgent 中 SC/TC 最高（59–89%），PC 较低（44–64%），因为污染经由结构化记忆记录传播，SC/TC 常编码在记录的特定字段（问题中的阈值重定义、解决方案代码中的取整规则），而 PC 是整体工作流、难以被单条可检索记录捕获；MURMUR 中 SC/PC 主导（67–83%）、TC 很低（20%），因为完整对话历史被当作隐式规范吸收，且纯文本消息环境下的格式偏好很少影响正确性。

**RQ3 SSI 效果**：在所有数据集上均降低污染，但效果强烈依赖机制：Slack 近乎消除（57%→6%，三类均近零），eICU 大幅下降（71%→33%，主要由 TC 贡献），MIMIC-III 改善有限（60%→41%），残留风险显著。原因是共享状态为纯对话时可逐条消息净化，而 EHRAgent 的共享状态含可执行解决方案代码，文本净化无法完全覆盖。

**RQ4 残留机制**：共同原因是 SSI 只净化了约定的文本描述，未修改检索到的记忆条目中的解决方案代码，约定通过「示例复用」（exemplar reuse）继续传播。局部化约定（TC/SC）编码在可定位位置（单一 ROUND/DATE_TRUNC 调用、或收窄 "recent" 为 7 天内的 WHERE 子句），原则上可通过代码级干预移除，故 TC 在 eICU 上 67%→7%，但在 schema 更复杂的 MIMIC-III（17 张表、平均 2.7 表/查询、>50% 需 3 次以上 join）上仅 69%→47%，因为生成独立代码更困难、agent 更依赖检索到的模板；SC 类似（59%→28%、89%→63%）。普遍性约定（PC）不存在单一可删行，塑造整个 join 顺序、聚合步骤与控制流，因而连假设的代码级净化也难以处理：PC 降幅最小且跨数据集最稳定（MIMIC-III 44%→41%、eICU 64%→50%），残留源于约定结构本身而非 schema 复杂度。

**失败模式**：eICU 的污染失败几乎全部是「静默错误答案」（自信但不正确），最危险；MIMIC-III 中 41% 的失败为「无答案」（运行错误/空结果，因多表 schema 复杂度导致代码整体崩坏），至少可被用户察觉。作者据此指出：UCC 在 agent 能稳定产出输出的场景（简单 schema）下风险更高，因为失败不可见。此外 EHRAgent 的初始记忆库仅 4 条种子记录、源交互后变为 5 条，且源/受害查询被刻意设计为语义相似，检索到源条目是构造性预期。
AI.conclusion: UCC 是共享状态 LLM 智能体中区别于对抗性投毒的一类鲁棒性风险，其根源是系统保留了「持久化内容」却未保留「该内容成立的条件」。文本级写入时净化（SSI）在共享状态为纯对话时几乎完全有效，但面对含可执行产物的共享状态失效，因此需要超越文本层面的防御：artifact 级别的作用域控制与带溯源（provenance-aware）的检索，即为持久化产物标注来源元数据（哪个用户、哪个任务、哪个作用域）、在跨用户复用前强制重新验证，并从已净化的规格重新生成解决方案而非复用已编译的代码。作者同时指出了共享状态设计的内在张力：使共享状态有用的持久化，同样是使其危险的持久化；当前架构普遍缺少「何时可以复用」而非仅「持久化什么」的推理能力。伦理声明强调本文不设计也不评估对抗攻击，所有实验使用公开数据集（MIMIC-III、eICU、Slack），意在为共享状态智能体的开发者提供防护依据；复现材料包括模型配置、检索设置、评测标准、试验次数、SSI 净化提示词与 34 条源约定的完整清单。

title: From SWE-ZERO to SWE-HERO: Execution-free to Execution-based Fine-tuning for Software Engineering Agents
summary: We introduce SWE-ZERO to SWE-HERO, a two-stage SFT recipe that achieves state-of-the-art results on SWE-bench by distilling open-weight frontier LLMs. Our pipeline replaces resource-heavy dependencies with an evolutionary refinement strategy: (1) SWE-ZERO utilizes large-scale, execution-free trajectories to master code semantics and repository-level reasoning, and (2) SWE-HERO applies targeted, execution-backed refinement to transition these semantic intuitions into rigorous engineering workflows. Our empirical results set a new benchmark for open-source models of comparable size. We release a dataset of 300k SWE-ZERO and 13k SWE-HERO trajectories distilled from Qwen3-Coder-480B, alongside a suite of agents based on the Qwen2.5-Coder series. Notably, SWE-HERO-32B achieves a 62.2% resolution rate on SWE-bench Verified. Furthermore, despite being trained exclusively on Python, our agents demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability on SWE-bench Multilingual, reaching 44.1% and confirming the paradigm's generalizability across diverse languages.

AI.tldr: SWE-ZERO to SWE-HERO是一个两阶段SFT方案，通过蒸馏开源前沿LLM（Qwen3-Coder-480B）实现SWE-bench最优性能。SWE-ZERO侧重执行无关的大规模轨迹学习代码语义，SWE-HERO则进行执行信号引导的精细调优。该方案发布的SWE-HERO-32B模型在SWE-bench Verified达到62.2%准确率，并在多语言任务上展现44.1%的零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有软件工程智能体面临资源消耗大、泛化能力不足的问题。当前开源模型在SWE-bench上的表现与闭源前沿模型存在显著差距，需要探索更高效的训练范式。
AI.method: 两阶段SFT管道：(1) SWE-ZERO阶段：利用大规模执行无关轨迹数据（约300k条），习得代码语义理解和仓库级推理能力；(2) SWE-HERO阶段：使用精细的执行反馈信号（约13k条）进行针对性强化，实现语义直觉向严格工程工作流的转化。数据蒸馏源为Qwen3-Coder-480B，模型基座采用Qwen2.5-Coder系列。
AI.result: SWE-HERO-32B在SWE-bench Verified上达到62.2%解决率，刷新同规模开源模型记录。尽管仅在Python数据上训练，模型在SWE-bench Multilingual多语言基准上仍实现44.1%的零样本迁移准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行无关与执行引导两阶段分离的蒸馏策略，可有效将大规模语言模型的代码能力迁移至软件工程任务。该范式具有良好的语言无关泛化特性，为构建高效软件工程智能体提供了新路径。

title: CogBias: Measuring and Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts. While prior work has shown that LLMs exhibit cognitive biases behaviorally, whether these biases correspond to identifiable internal representations and can be mitigated through targeted intervention remains an open question. We define LLM cognitive bias as systematic, reproducible deviations from correct answers in tasks with computable ground-truth baselines, and introduce LLM CogBias, a benchmark organized around four families of cognitive biases: Judgment, Information Processing, Social, and Response. We evaluate three LLMs and find that cognitive biases emerge systematically across all four families, with magnitudes and debiasing responses that are strongly family-dependent: prompt-level debiasing substantially reduces Response biases but backfires for Judgment biases. Using linear probes under a contrastive design, we show that these biases are encoded as linearly separable directions in model activation space. Finally, we apply activation steering to modulate biased behavior, achieving 26--32\% reduction in bias score (fraction of biased responses) while preserving downstream capability on 25 benchmarks (Llama: negligible degradation; Qwen: up to $-$19.0pp for Judgment biases). Despite near-orthogonal bias representations across models (mean cosine similarity 0.01), steering reduces bias at similar rates across architectures ($r(246)$=.621, $p$<.001), suggesting shared functional organization.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出LLM认知偏差基准测试LLM CogBias，涵盖四类认知偏差（判断、信息处理、社会、响应）。通过对3个LLM的评估，发现认知偏差系统性地出现于所有类别中，且不同类别的去偏效果差异显著：提示级去偏方法对响应偏差有效，但对判断偏差反而适得其反。利用对比设计的线性探测发现偏差可在线性可分方向编码于模型激活空间中。激活干预方法在保持下游能力的前提下将偏差评分降低26-32%。尽管不同模型间偏差表示近乎正交（余弦相似度0.01），但干预效果跨架构相似（r=0.621, p<0.001），表明存在共享的功能组织结构。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛应用于高风险决策场景，已有研究表明LLM存在行为层面的认知偏差，但这些偏差是否对应可识别的内部表征，以及能否通过针对性干预进行缓解，仍是悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 1) 将LLM认知偏差定义为在具有可计算真值基准的任务中出现的系统性、可复现的正确答案偏离；2) 构建LLM CogBias基准测试，包含四类认知偏差家族；3) 对3个LLM进行评估；4) 采用对比设计的线性探测方法；5) 应用激活导向（activation steering）技术调节偏差行为。
AI.result: 1) 四类认知偏差系统性地出现，幅度和去偏响应具有显著的家族依赖性；2) 提示级去偏方法对响应偏差效果显著，但对判断偏差反而加重偏差；3) 偏差以线性可分方向编码于模型激活空间中；4) 激活导向在保留25个下游基准能力的同时，偏差评分降低26-32%；5) 尽管不同模型间偏差表示近乎正交（平均余弦相似度0.01），跨架构偏差降低率高度相关（r(246)=0.621, p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: LLM认知偏差具有可解释的内部表征，可通过激活导向有效干预。不同模型偏差表示虽正交但功能组织结构共享，激活导向是有效的去偏方法，但需考虑架构差异——Llama几乎无能力下降，Qwen对判断偏差的去偏可能导致高达-19.0pp的能力损失。

title: JetPrism: diagnosing convergence for generative simulation and inverse problems in nuclear physics
summary: High-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations and complex inverse problems, such as mapping smeared experimental observations to ground-truth states, are computationally intensive yet essential for robust data analysis. Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) offers a mathematically robust approach to accelerating these tasks, but we demonstrate its standard training loss is fundamentally misleading. In rigorous physics applications, CFM loss plateaus prematurely, serving as an unreliable indicator of true convergence and physical fidelity. To investigate this disconnect, we designed JetPrism, a configurable CFM framework acting as an efficient generative surrogate for evaluating unconditional generation and conditional detector unfolding. Using synthetic stress tests and a Jefferson Lab kinematic dataset ($γp \to ρ^0 p \to π^+π^- p$) relevant to the forthcoming Electron-Ion Collider (EIC), we establish that physics-informed metrics continue to improve significantly long after the standard loss converges. Consequently, we propose a multi-metric evaluation protocol incorporating marginal and pairwise $χ^2$ statistics, $W_1$ distances, correlation matrix distances ($D_{\mathrm{corr}}$), and nearest-neighbor distance ratios ($R_{\mathrm{NN}}$). By demonstrating that domain-specific evaluations must supersede generic loss metrics, this work establishes JetPrism as a dependable generative surrogate that ensures precise statistical agreement with ground-truth data without memorizing the training set. While demonstrated in nuclear physics, this diagnostic framework is readily extensible to parameter generation and complex inverse problems across broad domains. Potential applications span medical imaging, astrophysics, semiconductor discovery, and quantitative finance, where high-fidelity simulation, rigorous inversion, and generative reliability are critical.

AI.tldr: 本文（arXiv版名为 ScatterPrism，摘要版名为 JetPrism，已发表于 JINST 21 (2026) C07012）指出条件流匹配（CFM）的标准训练损失会过早平台化，无法作为模型真实物理保真度的收敛判据。作者提出一个可配置的 CFM 生成式代理框架（ScatterPrism），用 JLab 的 γp→ρ⁰p→π⁺π⁻p（MC-POM）数据与一组 1D 合成压力测试双重验证该"数据集无关病理"，并提出一套物理感知的多指标评估协议（1D/2D χ²、W₁、相关矩阵距离 D_corr、最近邻距离比 R_NN），证明物理指标在损失收敛后仍持续改善数百个 epoch，而模型在保持高保真分布重建的同时并未记忆训练集。
AI.motivation: 高保真蒙特卡洛模拟（尤其是 GEANT4 探测器响应）与探测器反卷积（unfolding）是亚原子物理数据流水线的算力瓶颈，JLab、EIC、LHC 等大型实验均受此困扰，CFM 作为无需模拟器训练的确定性生成加速方案被寄予厚望。然而作者在 JLab 核物理数据上发现：CFM 的速度场回归损失在约 20 个 epoch 后即进入平台期，而此时生成事件在物理观测量上（W₁、相关矩阵结构等）远未收敛，损失与真实物理保真度脱钩。这一"过早平台化/谱偏置（spectral bias）"现象此前无人系统研究，且被普遍误用为模型选择标准，存在把欠训练模型直接部署到物理分析中的风险。
AI.method: （1）数据：MC-POM 数据集，γp→ρ⁰p→π⁺π⁻p 独占光致产生，固定 8M 事件、8:1:1 划分（6.4M/0.8M/0.8M），24 维四动量经四动量守恒与冗余剔除后投影到 10 维相空间，标准化后再乘 5.0 以错开源/目标支撑集；探测器效应通过对 π± 各笛卡尔动量分量独立高斯涂抹 σ_smear∈{0.5,1.0,2.0} 模拟，并代数反推反冲质子（因涂抹破坏能量动量守恒，条件数据落在"破壳"流形上）；另建 1D 合成基准（高斯、高截断、多峰、高频尖刺、delta、均匀、指数等）用于拓扑失效模式诊断。（2）模型：CFM 线性条件路径 x_t=(1−t)x_0+tx_1、目标速度 x_1−x_0、损失为速度回归 MSE；无条件生成网络以 [x_t‖Fourier嵌入(t)] 为输入，条件反卷积网络额外把探测器条件 c 经两层 SiLU MLP 编码为 128 维拼接；两者共用 6 层残差 MLP（SiLU，隐层宽 512，~2.7M 参数）、AdamW、1e-4 学习率（ReduceLROnPlateau 衰减 0.5/patience 50）、batch 20K、1000 epoch；推理用自适应 DOPRI5 求解 ODE（生成 atol/rtol=1e−7，反卷积 1e−3），训练期验证用定步长 RK4 加速，checkpoint 选择依据 val/chi2_mean 而非 CFM 损失。（3）指标：1D 50 分箱 χ²、无分箱 CDF 的 W₁、45 组特征对的 2D 20×20 分箱 χ²、相关矩阵 Frobenius 距离 D_corr、最近邻距离比 R_NN= D̄_gen→train/D̄_train→train（用于记忆检测，并记录 D_gen→train、D_train→train 等辅助量）。
AI.result: MC-POM 上 CFM 损失约 20 epoch 平台化，而 W₁ 与 D_corr 持续改善至约 600 epoch，确认标准损失不可靠。测试集（0.8M 生成事件）无条件生成：χ²=33503.2、W₁=8.96×10⁻⁴、χ²_2D=33962.4、D_corr=1.53、R_NN≈1.00（泛化良好、无记忆）；t 通道仅在硬运动学截断处有轻微偏差（连续流的已知局限）。条件反卷积在 σ_smear=2.0/1.0/0.5 下 χ² 分别为 33364/33356/33346、W₁ 为 1.5×10⁻⁴~1.6×10⁻⁴、D_corr 为 1.44/1.48/2.11，反卷积不报告 R_NN（贴近训练流形在此为期望目标）。合成基准中 W₁ 低至 10⁻³ 量级，R_NN 多落在 0.54~15.39，Uniform-Flat 的 R_NN≈3650 被明确归因为分母趋零的几何伪影而非模型失效；欠训练时的典型失效模式为边界涂抹与独立峰之间的虚假桥接。性能上，单卡 A6000 训练 8.24×10⁵ samples/s、生成推理 3.04×10³ events/s、反卷积 8.33×10⁴ events/s，V100 相对 CPU 有约 32×（推理）/87×（训练）加速。
AI.conclusion: 领域专属的物理指标必须取代通用训练损失作为收敛与模型选择依据；ScatterPrism/JetPrism 作为可复现、可配置的 CFM 生成式代理框架，在合成与 JLab 数据上实现了与真值统计一致且未记忆训练集的高保真相空间生成与确定性反卷积，可作为昂贵 Monte Carlo 模拟的无分箱 AI 替代方案，并有望扩展到 HEP 喷注/高多重度末态、参数生成，以及医学成像、天体物理、分子动力学、量化金融等"由含噪观测映射到底层真值"的通用逆问题场景。局限与展望：仅在低多重度 NP 拓扑上验证、HEP 迁移待验证；硬截断处偏差与均匀密度的 R_NN 伪影需进一步处理；未来将原生接入 GEANT 探测器模拟、支持不确定性量化与架构消融、补充分布外泛化测试并引入显式物理感知损失函数以彻底消除无效生成。

title: Optimizing RAG Rerankers with LLM Feedback via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rerankers play a pivotal role in refining retrieval results for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. However, current reranking models are typically optimized on static human annotated relevance labels in isolation, decoupled from the downstream generation process. This isolation leads to a fundamental misalignment: documents identified as topically relevant by information retrieval metrics often fail to provide the actual utility required by the LLM for precise answer generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that directly aligns reranking with the LLM's generation quality. By formulating reranking as a sequential decision-making process, RRPO optimizes for context utility using LLM feedback, thereby eliminating the need for expensive human annotations. To ensure training stability, we further introduce a reference-anchored deterministic baseline. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that RRPO significantly outperforms strong baselines, including the powerful list-wise reranker RankZephyr. Further analysis highlights the versatility of our framework: it generalizes seamlessly to diverse readers (e.g., GPT-4o), integrates orthogonally with query expansion modules like Query2Doc, and remains robust even when trained with noisy supervisors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO)：把 RAG 中的重排序建模为有限步序贯决策（MDP），用冻结 LLM Reader 在每一步选文后的生成质量（EM+F1+Hit）作为奖励，直接以强化学习端到端优化重排器以最大化"上下文效用"，从而摆脱人工相关性标注；关键设计是用参考策略贪心 rollout 得到的确定性基线替代难训练的 critic 网络，并配合 PPO-clip + KL 惩罚 + 优势归一化稳定训练。在 HotpotQA/AmbigNQ 上显著超越强监督基线与 list-wise 的 RankZephyr，并能泛化到不同 Reader（含 GPT-4o）、与 Query2Doc 正交叠加、用小模型噪声监督器仍有效。
AI.motivation: 现有重排器普遍在孤立的监督范式下、以静态人工相关性标签（如 NDCG）为目标训练，与下游 LLM 生成过程完全解耦，产生根本性的目标错位：IR 指标判定为"话题相关"的文档（如"谁发现了青霉素"的长篇历史文章）往往并不具备 LLM 生成精确答案所需的实际效用（简洁时间线条目更有用）。因此需要在 RAG 流水线内部优化重排器本身，而非把它当作独立模块。同时，监督范式依赖昂贵人工标注，且 LLM 奖励离散、方差大、稀疏，导致 RL 中的价值网络（critic）难以训练、策略更新不稳。
AI.method:
**问题形式化**：给定查询 q 与检索器返回的 N 篇候选文档 𝒟（BM25 取 top-100），目标选出有序的 k 篇子集以最大化固定 LLM Reader 的生成质量。建模为有限步 MDP (𝒮,𝒜,P,R)：状态 s_t 为尚未被选中的候选文档集合（初始 s_1 = top-N）；动作为从 s_t 中选取一篇文档（无放回），转移确定性（s_{t+1}=s_t∖{d_c_t}）；奖励 r_t 由当前已选文档集合交给冻结 Reader 生成回答后，用 R_lm 评估得到。

**Agent/Policy**：以 pointwise 重排器 f_θ 作策略网络，对每个文档算 score_i = f_θ(q,d_i)，经 SoftMax 得初始概率 p_i；第 t 步选择文档 d_{c_t} 的概率为 π_θ(a_t|s_t) = p_{c_t} / Σ_{d_j∈s_t} p_j（无放回采样）。

**奖励**：response_t = Reader(INST, q, d_{c_1..c_t})，r_t = R_lm(ans, response_t)；实验采用统一奖励 R_lm = EM + 1.0·F1 + 1.0·Hit（Hit 命中为 +1，否则 −1）。

**目标函数**：借鉴 PPO 的裁剪目标 J(θ)=E[1/k Σ min(ρ_t Â_t, clip(ρ_t,1±ε)Â_t) − β·D_KL(π_θ‖π_ref)]，用重要性采样比 ρ_t = π_θ/π_ref 与 KL 惩罚（Ouyang 2022 的估计量）限制更新幅度。

**参考锚定的确定性基线（核心创新）**：由于 episode 短、奖励离散高方差，训练独立 critic 拟合 V(s_t) 效果差（连续输出难以匹配 LLM 评估的离散值，事实型 QA 尤甚）。改为用固定参考策略 π_ref 在候选集上做 t 步贪心 rollout 得到文档序列，交由 Reader 生成并评估，定义 V(s_t) = R_lm(ans, response'_t)，把 off-policy 的确定值注入 PPO 的 on-policy 框架，既免去 critic 又为优势估计提供稳定锚点。优势用 GAE（δ_t = r_t + γV(s_{t+1}) − V(s_t)，A_t = Σ(γλ)^{j−t}δ_j，γ=0.99、λ=0.95）计算，并在滑动窗口内做均值/方差归一化。

**训练加速**：Flash Attention + AMP 训练重排器、vLLM 部署 Reader、缓存 top-N 检索结果、temperature=0 的 LLM 响应重放（后期可减少近 50% 推理调用）、梯度累积（batch 32）。超参：HotpotQA 2 epoch/lr 2e-6/k_train=3，AmbigNQ 4 epoch/lr 1.6e-6/k_train=5，ε=0.2，β=0.1，AdamW，4×RTX3090 + 2×A6000。
AI.result:
**主结果**：HotpotQA 上 gte reranker 的 F1 从 41.23 提升到 43.22（+1.99），AmbigNQ 从 48.55 到 49.67（+1.12）；bge、jina、qwen3（decoder-only）等不同架构均有提升，paired t 检验 p<0.01（统计显著）。整体水平与 FLARE、DRAGIN 等高级 RAG 方法相当或更优。

**对比 list-wise SOTA**：RRPO（HotpotQA F1 46.38 / AmbigNQ 52.18）超过 RankZephyr（44.49 / 51.58）。

**泛化性**：可直接迁移到 Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B、Llama-3.1、GLM-4，以及闭源 Gemini-2.5-Flash、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、GPT-4o，无需针对 Reader 微调；跨多跳数据集 2WikiMultiHopQA（F1 31.42→32.48）和 MuSiQue 均有提升；面对 3 种不同 prompt 模板仍稳定优于基线（对 prompt 措辞不敏感）。

**正交性与鲁棒性**：与 Query2Doc 叠加后仍有增益（HotpotQA F1 42.06→44.10，AmbigNQ 53.14→54.10），体现"扩召回 vs 提效用"的互补；用更小更嘈杂的 Qwen2.5-3B 作为监督器训练的 RRPO-3B 仍带来提升，且能迁移到 7B/14B Reader（标签效率高）。

**消融与替代架构**：k_train=3 最优（k=1 上下文不足，k=5 噪声与注意力弥散）；相比 Listwise Bandit 与使用参数化 critic 的标准 PPO，RRPO 在 top-1 与 top-3 上均稳定更优，说明序贯逐步奖励有助于信用分配并优化整个文档集合效用；0.3B 的 RRPO 模型在 HotpotQA EM 上优于联合微调 7B 的 DynamicRAG（30.03 vs 29.40），体现轻量模块化优势。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是"优化上下文效用（context utility）显著优于仅优化语义相关性（relevance）"。RRPO 证明：把重排序当作由 LLM 生成效用信号引导的序贯决策、用参考锚定确定性基线替代不稳定 critic，可在完全免除人工相关性标注的前提下稳定训练出任务感知的重排策略；同时具备跨 Reader 泛化、可即插即用与叠加高级 RAG 组件、对噪声监督器鲁棒等性质，是一种可扩展、低成本的构建任务感知 RAG 系统的范式。局限在于 RRPO 只能重排初始检索给出的候选集，若 top-N 召回不足则改进空间天然受限（MuSiQue 上增益有限即为例证）。

title: Single-Pass Streaming CSPs via Two-Tier Sampling
summary:
We study the maximum constraint satisfaction problem, Max-CSP, in the streaming setting. Given $n$ variables, the constraints arrive sequentially in an arbitrary order, with each constraint involving only a small subset of the variables. The objective is to approximate the maximum fraction of constraints that can be satisfied by an optimal assignment in a single pass. The problem admits a trivial near-optimal solution with $O(n)$ space, so the major open problem in the literature has been the best approximation achievable when limiting the space to $o(n)$.
  The answer to the question above depends heavily on the CSP instance at hand. The integrality gap $α$ of an LP relaxation, known as the BasicLP, plays a central role. In particular, a major conjecture of the area is that in the single-pass streaming setting, for any fixed $\varepsilon > 0$, (i) an $(α-\varepsilon)$-approximation can be achieved with $o(n)$ space, and (ii) any $(α+\varepsilon)$-approximation requires $Ω(n)$ space.
  In this work, we fully resolve the first side of the conjecture by proving that an $(α- \varepsilon)$-approximation of Max-CSP can indeed be achieved using $n^{1-Ω_\varepsilon(1)}$ space and in a single pass. Given that Max-DiCut is a special case of Max-CSP, our algorithm fully recovers the recent result of [ABFS26, STOC'26] via a completely different algorithm and proof. On a technical level, our algorithm simulates a suitable local algorithm on a reduced graph using a technique that we call *two-tier sampling*: the algorithm combines both edge sampling and vertex sampling to handle high- and low-degree vertices at the same time.

AI.tldr: 研究在流式计算模式下，用次线性空间实现Max-CSP的近似算法。通过two-tier sampling技术，证明可达到BasicLP integrality gap α的近似比，空间复杂度为n^(1-Ω(1))，从而完全解决了一个重要猜想的第一部分。
AI.motivation: 流式设置下Max-CSP问题：约束顺序任意到达，需单趟处理逼近最大可满足约束比例。已知存在O(n)空间的平凡近优解，核心问题是o(n)空间下能实现何种近似比。
AI.method: 提出two-tier sampling技术：结合edge sampling和vertex sampling同时处理高低度顶点；通过在约简图上模拟合适的局部算法实现。
AI.result: 证明对于任意固定ε>0，可用n^(1-Ω_ε(1))空间单趟实现(α-ε)-近似。其中α为BasicLP的integrality gap。
AI.conclusion: 完全解决了一个重要猜想的第一部分：通过不同于ABFS26的全新算法恢复了Max-DiCut的结果，同时该技术可推广至一般Max-CSP。

title: What can be computed in average anonymous networks?
summary:
We study what deterministic distributed algorithms can compute on random input graphs in extremely weak models of distributed computing: all nodes are anonymous, and in each communication round, nodes broadcast a message to all their neighbors, receive a (multi)set of messages from their neighbors, and update their local state. These correspond to the SB and MB models introduced by Hella et al. [PODC 2012] and are strictly weaker than the standard port-numbering PN and LOCAL models.
  We investigate what can be computed almost surely on random input graphs. We give a one-round deterministic SB-algorithm using $O(\log n)$-bit messages that computes unique identifiers with high probability on anonymous networks sampled from $G(n,p)$, where $n^{\varepsilon-1} \le p \le 1/2$ and $\varepsilon>0$ is an arbitrarily small constant. This algorithm is inspired by canonical labeling techniques in graph isomorphism testing and can be used to "anonymize" existing distributed graph algorithms designed for the broadcast CONGEST and LOCAL models. In particular, we give a new anonymous algorithm that finds a triangle in $O(1/\varepsilon)$ rounds on the above input distribution.
  We also investigate computational power of natural analogs of "Monte Carlo" and "Las Vegas" distributed graph algorithms in the random graph setting, and establish some new collapse and hierarchy results. For example, our work shows the collapse of the weak model hierarchy of Hella et al. on $G(n,p)$, as apart from a vanishingly small fraction of input graphs, the SB model is as powerful as LOCAL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在随机图 G(n,p) 上，匿名（无标识符、无端口编号）确定性分布式算法到底能做什么。作者证明：在 n^{ε-1} ≤ p ≤ 1/2 范围内，可用 1 轮 SB* 模型（O(log n) 比特消息）以高概率确定性地生成唯一标识，从而以"仅多 1 轮"的代价把 LOCAL / B-CONGEST 算法"匿名化"；在平均情形下弱模型层次 SB⊊MB⊊VV⊊PN⊊LOCAL 发生坍缩（在 G(n,p) 上除可忽略比例的图外 SB 与 LOCAL 等价）；还给出 O(diam(G)) 轮（期望 O(1/ε) 轮）的匿名三角形查找算法，并证明四轮是"已知 n 的可靠（sound）匿名算法"解决所有问题的最优轮数。
AI.motivation: 在经典分布式模型中，很多图问题之所以不能由确定性匿名算法求解，纯粹是因为最坏情形图中存在对称性无法打破，通常需要额外输入（唯一标识符、随机比特流、局部着色等）来打破对称性。问题在于：如果把视线从最坏情形输入转向"绝大多数"输入（例如 Erdős–Rényi 随机图 G(n,p)），这些打破对称性的信息是否仍然必需？具体地，在 Hella 等人提出的极弱模型——集合广播模型 SB 与多重集广播模型 MB（严格弱于端口编号模型 PN 与 LOCAL 模型）中，随机图上究竟能计算出哪些东西？此前即便在非匿名设定下，分布式算法的平均情形复杂度也几乎未被系统研究（除少数孤立例子如 Hamilton 圈、局部对称性破除问题之外），因此本文试图为"平均情形下的匿名分布式计算"建立一个框架：引入确定性算法的"渐近几乎必然正确"（对应 Monte Carlo）与"可靠/sound"（对应 Las Vegas）两类概念，并系统刻画弱模型在随机图上的计算能力层次。
AI.method: 模型与记号：定义 SB（收到消息的集合）与 MB（收到消息的多重集）两个弱模型及其受限消息长度的 SB*/MB* 版本；节点匿名，本地输入仅为自身度数，另有 B-CONGEST（广播式 CONGEST）。问题定义为同构不变且逐连通分量的图问题 Π⊆Γ^V，并引入 M_{a.a.s.}（渐近几乎必然可解）、M_{snd}（可靠：要么给出正确解、要么所有节点输出 failed）、期望时间复杂度等概念。（1）唯一标识生成：Algorithm 1 让每个节点广播自身度数，收到邻居度数集合 S(v) 后按模 C 的剩余类分组求和得到向量 s(v)；Lemma 2.1 证明对任意常数 ε>0 存在足够大的常数 C 使得 n^{ε-1} ≤ p ≤ 1/2 时 a.a.s. 任意两点的 s(v) 不同。证明采用两阶段暴露（先暴露 u,v 的边，再暴露 N(v) 与 N(u) 内部边，最后暴露 U–X 边），把冲突事件归结为 Bin(n',p) 型独立随机变量的多重集问题；Claim A 用局部极限定理与 Chernoff 界说明"最大元素落在窄区间 J 内且重数 ≤ C"的概率为 1-o(n^{-10})，Claim B 用相邻二项分布概率比 (n'-b)p/((b+1)(1-p)) 证明在给定 a 的条件下 b 与 b' 的概率几乎相等，从而推出 P(s_X = s) = o(n^{-2})，再对所有点对用并合界完成。（2）匿名化：把 Theorem 1.1 与 LOCAL/B-CONGEST 算法结合，得到只需多 1 轮的模拟；结合 Turau 的 Hamilton 圈算法（O(log n) 轮，p ≥ log^{3/2}n/√n）与 Korhonen–Rybicki 的结果。（3）三角形查找：Lemma 3.1（"离心率引理"）证明在 p ≥ n^{ε-1} 下，以概率 1-exp(-n^c)，对每个节点 u 存在三角形 {x,y,z} 与 d∈{ecc(u)-2, ecc(u)-3}，使得 x 到 u 的距离为 d 且 x 是 y 在第 d 层唯一的邻居；其证明基于 Claim C 的三层大小界（|S_r(u)| 与 1/(2p(np))、1/p、1/(2p(np)^{δ-3}) 比较）与"小集合邻域膨胀"论证。算法：先在 O(diam) 轮内选 leader 并获知各节点到 leader 的距离与 ecc(u)，令 d=ecc(u)-3 与 ecc(u)-2，两层各广播标识并检测三角形，成功则传播 success，失败则 leader 广播 alarm 传播出 failed（故算法是 sound 的）；期望时间界由与 O(n) 轮的朴素枚举算法并行执行后按失败概率 exp(-n^c) 加权得到。（4）层次坍缩：把
