AI.tldr: 本文通过3×2因子实验（1B参数，1000步）揭示了归一化层与优化器的交互效应：Dynamic Erf（Derf）与Muon优化器存在显著负交互，gap从AdamW下的+0.31 nats扩大至Muon下的+0.97 nats（约3倍），而Dynamic Tanh（DyT）作为对照组无此惩罚效应。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM训练中，归一化层和优化器被视为独立设计选择，缺乏对两者交互效应的系统研究。Derf等新型归一化方法的评估通常仅在AdamW下进行，而Muon等新优化器也未在多种归一化策略下验证兼容性。
AI.method: 3×2因子实验设计：3种归一化方法（RMSNorm、Derf、DyT）× 2种优化器（AdamW、Muon），在1B参数规模和1000步训练条件下进行系统对比。
AI.result: Derf在Muon下相比RMSNorm的差距扩大至+0.97 nats（vs AdamW的+0.31 nats），增幅约3倍；DyT无此惩罚。问题根因：erf函数在Muon更快谱范数增长下出现饱和（信息压缩）和尺度盲区（忽视激活幅度）。两种修复方案：（1）EMA混合恢复运行尺度估计，可弥补84%的差距；（2）降低alpha从0.5至0.3，保持erf近线性区域，恢复约80%的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 归一化层与优化器的设计选择存在显著交互，不应独立处理。Derf需配合AdamW或调整alpha/架构使用才能发挥最佳性能。此发现对short pilot runs具有误导风险（无NaN/发散），需在充分长的训练中才能暴露。

title: DISCO-TAB: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Privacy-Preserving Synthesis of Complex Clinical Data
summary: The development of robust clinical decision support systems is frequently impeded by the scarcity of high-fidelity, privacy-preserving biomedical data. While Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for synthetic data generation, they often struggle to capture the complex, non-linear dependencies and severe class imbalances inherent in Electronic Health Records (EHR), leading to statistically plausible but clinically invalid records. To bridge this gap, we introduce DISCO-TAB (DIScriminator-guided COntrol for TABular synthesis), a novel framework that orchestrates a fine-tuned LLM with a multi-objective discriminator system optimized via Reinforcement Learning. Unlike prior methods relying on scalar feedback, DISCO-TAB evaluates synthesis at four granularities, token, sentence, feature, and row, while integrating Automated Constraint Discovery and Inverse-Frequency Reward Shaping to autonomously preserve latent medical logic and resolve minority-class collapse. We rigorously validate our framework across diverse benchmarks, including high-dimensional, small-sample medical datasets (e.g., Heart Failure, Parkinson's). Our results demonstrate that hierarchical feedback yields state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 38.2% improvement in downstream clinical classifier utility compared to GAN and Diffusion baselines, while ensuring exceptional statistical fidelity (JSD < 0.01) and robust resistance to membership inference attacks. This work establishes a new standard for generating trustworthy, utility-preserving synthetic tabular data for sensitive healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: DISCO-TAB（DIScriminator-guided COntrol for TABular synthesis）是一个把受约束的表格数据生成建模为序贯决策问题的层次化强化学习框架：用自动约束发现模块从真实EHR中提取显著特征依赖，用token/sentence/feature/row四级判别器组成的多目标判别器集合提供结构化稠密奖励，再以逆频率奖励塑形（IFRS）缓解类别不平衡，最后用PPO+KL正则微调GPT-2生成器。在9个（文中亦称10个）数据集上，TSTR效用相对最强基线最高提升38.2个百分点（Liver Disorders Δ=+0.382，Heart Failure F1=1.000），JSD<0.01，KS<0.035，抗成员推断，但无形式化差分隐私保证，且在大规模不平衡数据集（Diabetes）上略逊于商业基线。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持系统需要高保真、隐私保护的数据，但EHR受HIPAA/GDPR限制而分散；现有方法各有缺陷：GAN（CTGAN/MedGAN/TAEGAN）模式崩塌、系统性低估稀有但临床关键的患者亚群；扩散模型（TabDDPM/TabSyn）的高斯噪声会模糊细粒度临床阈值与罕见共病结构；LLM基线（GReaT/RealTabFormer/SynLLM/TAGAL）虽语义建模强，但属黑箱，会产生统计合理却临床无效的记录（如给男性分配妊娠诊断、非法ICD编码），且缺乏可解释的违规定位信号。同时医学数据存在严重类别不平衡、异质列类型（连续/离散/序数）与稀疏异质的多层次约束（语法有效性、局部语义一致性、特征级统计依赖、行列级整体连贯），单一似然目标或标量反馈无法表达。文章强调可解释性必须在生成过程中解决而非事后补做（post-hoc解释无法弥补内嵌不一致的合成数据）。
AI.method: （1）问题形式化：EHR行经schema感知线性化函数L转为自然语言序列S="[f1] is [v1], [f2] is [v2],…"，GPT-2骨干作为自回归策略/生成器P(S)=∏P(w_t|w_<t)；连续值用真实数据统计量标准化并固定小数精度，缺失值用保留标记[MISSING]。（2）自动约束发现：计算全局相关矩阵C（数值-数值用Pearson、类别-类别用Cramér's V、混合型用相关比），按阈值δ_thresh过滤后取top-k得P_crit，用于初始化特征级判别器，避免人工规则工程。（3）层次多目标判别器集合D_ens：D_token用双向LSTM在token级判语法有效性（相对正则/硬类型检查更可泛化、上下文敏感、可微）；D_sent用BERT-base在"特征-取值"子句级检测局部语义矛盾；D_feat用生成器末层隐状态对取值token均值池化得h_a⊕h_b，经MLP输出依赖保持分数（排除特征名token以防利用词汇线索）；D_row对全序列隐状态均值池化经MLP得整体真实度。各自以BCE损失训练真实/合成判别，L_disc=Σμ_k·L_disc^(k)（μ_k=1）。（4）奖励塑形RL：单条记录生成完后计算终端奖励R_raw=Σλ_k·D_k(S)（各粒度得分取均值聚合以保稳定），再按类别稀有度加权W_y=1+α·max(0,log(N_total/(N_y·|Y|)))，R_total=W_y·R_raw；用PPO裁剪目标+对参考策略的KL正则+价值函数MSE联合优化θ、φ，终端奖励广播到所有时间步。（5）防奖励利用：KL约束策略不偏离预训练参考模型、多粒度多目标难被单点利用、轨迹级（而非逐token）奖励、判别器持续用真实+合成样本更新。实现：Python 3.9/PyTorch 2.1.0、transformers 4.35.0、trl定制PPO、SDV 1.4.0；AdamW lr=2e-5线性衰减、PPO值网络lr=1.4e-5、clip=0.2、mini-batch 64、判别器lr=1e-4+谱归一化、最多100轮早停(patience=10)。
AI.result: TSTR效用（F1）：Heart Failure 1.000（最强基线0.877，Δ=+0.123；RealTabFormer 0.548、TabDDPM 0.665、MostlyAI 0.598接近随机）、Breast Cancer 0.994（Δ=+0.004）、Liver Disorders 0.990（Δ=+0.382）、Parkinsons 0.966（Δ=+0.080）、Obesity 0.929（Δ=+0.027，CTGAN 0.105、TAEGAN 0.215、TAGAL 0.790）、Diabetes 0.865（Δ=-0.104，MostlyAI 0.969更优）、German Credit 0.925（Δ=+0.275）、Bank Marketing 0.871（Δ=-0.014）、Census Income 0.862（Δ=-0.006）；六个医学集五个为正增益，非医学集仅具竞争力。统计保真：JSD均<0.026（多数<0.01），KL最低0.001，KS全部<0.035（对比TabDDPM Diabetes KS 0.553、RealTabFormer Heart Failure KS 0.147）。特征类型分解：数值JSD 0.038（接近MostlyAI 0.035），类别JSD 0.015（优于TAGAL 0.030、RealTabFormer 0.048），同时解决GAN类别崩塌与LLM数值不精确。隐私-效用：DCR>0（Heart Failure 1.27、Obesity 1.5、German Credit 1.9、Bank Mkt 18.5），TabDDPM DCR高达4830.6但Obesity效用崩至0.577；FAITH分解中DISCO-TAB Alignment 0.9839最高、Tracking 0.9920、Factuality 0.8750，但Integrity仅0.2303、总体FAITH 0.7703低于MostlyAI 0.9747与TAEGAN 0.9572。计算开销：平均显存5.0GB（vs TabDDPM 10.7、TabSyn 8.9），训练时间约为CTGAN的5.8倍，每epoch约26.3分钟。消融（24配置）：完整系统100%，去层次仅Row 86.9%，无RL的最小基线63.0%（相对提升37.0%）；去Row判别器降8.9%最大，去Sentence 4.0%，去Token 2.9%，去Feature 1.5%（但KS上升）；PPO在N<500稀疏奖励下比DPO高14.9%，DPO在大数据集上略优（99.2%）；IFRS在Diabetes上平衡准确率比SMOTE高12.3%，优于类权重(97.8%)与欠采样(89.8%)；RL+判别器100% > RL-only 71.3% ≈ Disc-only 78.6%，呈显著协同；两级简化版达94.2%性能但省29%算力。
AI.conclusion: DISCO-TAB通过将临床有效性显式编码进优化循环（层次化多粒度判别器+奖励塑形RL），在样本稀缺与严重类别不平衡的医学场景中显著优于GAN、扩散与agentic LLM基线，并把"统计可信"推进到"临床有效"，为可解释、隐私保护的数据合成树立新范式。局限与未来方向：不提供形式化差分隐私保证（隐私仅经验性审计：距离相似度与成员推断抵抗），约束发现仅覆盖成对统计关联而非高阶/因果依赖，继承预训练LLM的归纳偏置（可能引入错误先验），训练开销约为轻量GAN的5倍、难以在资源受限临床环境落地；未来将把DP机制嵌入RL奖励、把层次判别器扩展到多模态/患者轨迹数据，并引入因果发现与临床医生在环验证。作者亦声明使用Gemini辅助润色部分章节文字，核心科学主张、实验数据与架构设计未使用AI生成。

title: Swift-SVD: Theoretical Optimality Meets Practical Efficiency in Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: The deployment of Large Language Models is constrained by the memory and bandwidth demands of static weights and dynamic Key-Value cache. SVD-based compression provides a hardware-friendly solution to reduce these costs. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: some are suboptimal in reconstruction error, while others are theoretically optimal but practically inefficient. In this paper, we propose Swift-SVD, an activation-aware, closed-form compression framework that simultaneously guarantees theoretical optimum, practical efficiency and numerical stability. Swift-SVD incrementally aggregates covariance of output activations given a batch of inputs and performs a single eigenvalue decomposition after aggregation, enabling training-free, fast, and optimal layer-wise low-rank approximation. We employ effective rank to analyze local layer-wise compressibility and design a dynamic rank allocation strategy that jointly accounts for local reconstruction loss and end-to-end layer importance. Extensive experiments across six LLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that Swift-SVD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving optimal compression accuracy while delivering 3-70X speedups in end-to-end compression time. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Swift-SVD提出了一种激活感知的闭式压缩框架，通过在批次输入后聚合输出激活的协方差并执行单次特征值分解，实现训练-free、快速且最优的层间低秩近似。该方法利用有效秩分析局部层间可压缩性，设计了动态秩分配策略。实验涵盖6个LLM和8个数据集，相比现有方法在压缩精度上达到最优，同时实现3-70倍端到端压缩加速。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的部署受到静态权重和动态KV缓存的高内存和带宽需求制约。现有SVD压缩方法存在两大局限：部分方法重构误差非最优，另一部分虽理论最优但实际效率低下。
AI.method: Swift-SVD提出增量聚合批次输入的输出激活协方差，执行单次特征值分解，实现训练-free的最优层间低秩近似。采用有效秩分析局部层间可压缩性，设计了同时考虑局部重构损失和端到端层重要性的动态秩分配策略。
AI.result: 在6个LLM和8个数据集上的实验表明，Swift-SVD优于现有基线方法，在保持最优压缩精度的同时，实现了3-70倍的端到端压缩时间加速。
AI.conclusion: Swift-SVD成功实现了理论最优、实际效率和数值稳定性的统一，为LLM压缩提供了一种硬件友好的解决方案。

title: Source Known Identifiers: A Three-Tier Identity System for Distributed Applications
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables, submitted to PeerJ
summary:
Distributed applications need identifiers that satisfy storage efficiency, chronological sortability, origin metadata embedding, zero-lookup verifiability, confidentiality for external consumers, and multi-century addressability. Based on our literature survey, no existing scheme provides all six of these identifier properties within a unified system.
  This paper introduces Source Known Identifiers (SKIDs), a three-tier identity system that projects a single entity identity across trust boundaries, addressing all six properties. The first tier, Source Known ID (SKID), is a 64-bit signed integer embedding a timestamp with a 250-millisecond precision, application topology, and a per-entity-type sequence counter. It serves as the database primary key, providing compact storage (8 bytes) and natural B-tree ordering for optimized database indexing. The second tier, Source Known Entity ID (SKEID), extends the SKID into a 128-bit Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) compatible value by adding an entity type discriminator, an epoch selector, and a BLAKE3 keyed message authentication code (MAC). SKEIDs enable zero-lookup verification of identifier origin, integrity, and entity type within trusted environments, with a big-endian byte layout that preserves chronological ordering in lexicographic UUID string comparisons. The third tier, Secure SKEID, encrypts the entire SKEID using AES-256 symmetric encryption as a single-block pseudorandom permutation, producing ciphertext indistinguishable from random bytes while remaining compatible with standard UUID data-type parsers in string representation. Deterministic bidirectional transformations connect all three tiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Source Known Identifiers (SKIDs)三层标识系统，在单一实体身份跨越信任边界时，同时满足存储效率、时间可排序性、来源元数据嵌入、零查询可验证性、外部机密性及多世纪可寻址性等六项需求。
AI.motivation: 现有标识方案无法同时满足分布式应用对存储效率、时间排序、来源元数据嵌入、零查询验证、外部机密性和长期可寻址性这六项核心需求。
AI.method: 设计三层标识系统：(1) SKID：64位有符号整数，嵌入250毫秒精度时间戳、应用拓扑信息和实体类型序列计数器，8字节存储，支持B-tree索引自然排序；(2) SKEID：128位UUID兼容值，扩展加入实体类型区分符、历元选择器和BLAKE3 MAC，支持可信环境内零查询验证来源、完整性和实体类型，大端字节序保留UUID字符串字典序排列；(3) Secure SKEID：使用AES-256对称加密SKEID为单块伪随机置换，密文与随机字节不可区分且兼容标准UUID数据解析器。三层间建立确定性双向转换。
AI.result: SKIDs系统完整满足全部六项标识属性要求。
AI.conclusion: SKIDs通过三层递进架构，在统一系统内首次实现六项关键标识属性的融合，为分布式应用提供了安全、高效、可验证的标识解决方案。

title: NED-Tree: Bridging the Semantic Gap with Nonlinear Element Decomposition Tree for LLM Nonlinear Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating the translation of Operations Research (OR) problems from natural language to executable models is a critical challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in linear tasks, they suffer from severe performance degradation in real-world nonlinear scenarios due to semantic misalignment between mathematical formulations and solver codes, as well as unstable information extraction. In this study, we introduce NED-Tree, a systematic framework designed to bridge the semantic gap. NED-Tree employs (a) a sentence-by-sentence extraction strategy to ensure robust parameter mapping and traceability; and (b) a recursive tree-based structure that adaptively decomposes complex nonlinear terms into solver-compatible sub-elements. Additionally, we present NEXTOR, a novel benchmark specifically designed for complex nonlinear, extensive-constraint OR problems. Experiments across 10 benchmarks demonstrate that NED-Tree establishes a new state-of-the-art with 72.51% average accuracy, NED-Tree is the first framework that drives LLMs to resolve nonlinear modeling difficulties through element decomposition, achieving alignment between modeling semantics and code semantics. The NED-Tree framework and benchmark are accessible in the anonymous repository https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NORA-NEXTOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NED-Tree框架，通过句子级提取策略和递归树结构解决LLM在非线性OR问题建模中的语义对齐和信息提取难题，并发布NEXTOR基准测试数据集。实验在10个基准上达到72.51%平均准确率，为首个通过元素分解解决非线性建模困难的方法。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在将自然语言描述的运筹学(OR)问题转化为可执行模型时，在非线性场景下性能严重下降，主要原因包括：数学公式与求解器代码之间的语义错位，以及不稳定的信息提取能力。这限制了LLM在复杂实际OR问题中的应用。
AI.method: 提出NED-Tree框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 逐句提取策略，确保稳健的参数映射和可追溯性；(2) 递归树结构，将复杂非线性项自适应分解为求解器兼容的子元素。此外，构建NEXTOR基准测试，专门针对复杂非线性和大规模约束的OR问题。
AI.result: 在10个基准测试中达到72.51%的平均准确率，建立了新的最优水平。该方法是首个通过元素分解驱动LLM解决非线性建模困难，实现建模语义与代码语义对齐的框架。
AI.conclusion: NED-Tree通过语义桥接和自适应分解策略，有效解决了OR问题自动化建模中的核心瓶颈，为复杂非线性优化问题的AI辅助建模提供了新的技术路径。

title: Grounding AI-in-Education Development in Teachers' Voices: Findings from a National Survey in Indonesia
summary: Despite emerging use in Indonesian classrooms, there is limited large-scale, teacher-centred evidence on how AI is used in practice and what support teachers need, hindering the development of context-appropriate AI systems and policies. To address this gap, we conduct a nationwide survey of 349 K-12 teachers across elementary, junior high, and senior high schools. We find increasing use of AI for pedagogy, content development, and teaching media, although adoption remains uneven. Elementary teachers report more consistent use, while senior high teachers engage less; mid-career teachers assign higher importance to AI, and teachers in Eastern Indonesia perceive greater value. Across levels, teachers primarily use AI to reduce instructional preparation workload (e.g., assessment, lesson planning, and material development). However, generic outputs, infrastructure constraints, and limited contextual alignment continue to hinder effective classroom integration.

AI.tldr: 针对印尼K-12教师AI使用情况的首项大规模全国性调查研究，分析了349名教师的AI应用现状、差异化特征及主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 印尼课堂AI应用日益普及，但缺乏大规模、以教师为中心的研究证据，制约了情境适配AI系统与政策的开发。
AI.method: 对349名K-12教师（覆盖小学、初中、高中）开展全国性问卷调查。
AI.result:
1. AI应用范围：教学法、内容开发、教学媒体
2. 差异化特征：小学教师使用更稳定，高中教师参与度较低；中年教师重视程度更高；印尼东部地区教师感知价值更大
3. 核心应用场景：减轻教学准备负担（评估、备课、材料开发）
4. 主要障碍：输出内容泛化、基础设施限制、情境适配不足
AI.conclusion: 印尼教师AI应用呈增长态势但存在显著不均衡；需优化AI输出质量、加强基础设施支持、提升内容与当地教学情境的适配性。

title: ThinkTwice: Jointly Optimizing Large Language Models for Reasoning and Self-Refinement
summary: We introduce ThinkTwice, a simple two-phase framework that jointly optimizes LLMs to solve reasoning problems and refine the answers, based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In each pair of training steps, ThinkTwice first optimizes the model on solving reasoning problems, then optimizes it on refining its own solutions to the same problems, using the same binary correctness reward in both phases without correctness signals or critique annotations. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families including Qwen3-4B and Olmo3-7B, ThinkTwice substantially improves both reasoning and refinement performance over competitive online policy optimization baselines. Specifically, on Qwen3-4B, ThinkTwice outperforms GRPO on AIME by 5 percentage points before refinement and by 11.5 points after one self-refinement step, measured by pass@4. Analysis of the training dynamics of ThinkTwice reveals an implicit rectify-then-fortify curriculum: refinement predominantly corrects errors early in training and naturally shifts toward preserving already-correct solutions as the model improves, yielding a more rectified reward signal. Our work establishes joint training of reasoning and self-refinement as a principled and effective methodology for RLVR.

AI.tldr: ThinkTwice是一个基于GRPO的两阶段框架，通过联合优化LLM的推理能力和自改进能力来提升数学推理性能。在Qwen3-4B上，该方法在AIME基准上比GRPO提升5个百分点，经过一次自改进后提升11.5个百分点（pass@4）。
AI.motivation: 当前RLVR方法主要关注推理问题解决，但忽略了模型自我改进答案的能力。现有方法需要正确性信号或批评标注，增加了训练复杂度。
AI.method: ThinkTwice采用两阶段训练：①第一阶段优化模型解决推理问题；②第二阶段优化模型对同一问题的解答进行改进。两个阶段均使用相同的二元正确性奖励，无需正确性信号或批评标注。
AI.result: 在5个数学推理基准和2个模型家族（Qwen3-4B和Olmo3-7B）上显著优于竞争性在线策略优化基线。Qwen3-4B在AIME上，改进前提升5个百分点，经一次自我改进后提升11.5个百分点（pass@4）。
AI.conclusion: 训练动态分析揭示了隐式的"先纠正后巩固"课程：训练早期以纠正错误为主，后期自然转向保持正确解答，实现了更纠正性的奖励信号。联合训练推理和自改进是RLVR的有效方法论。

title: Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training
summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have emerged as a scalable gradient-free alternative to reinforcement learning based LLM fine-tuning, but it remains unclear whether comparable task performance implies comparable solutions in parameter space. We compare ES and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across four tasks in both single-task and sequential continual-learning settings. ES matches or exceeds GRPO in single-task accuracy and remains competitive sequentially when its iteration budget is controlled. Despite this similarity in task performance, the two methods produce markedly different model updates: ES makes much larger changes and induces broader off-task KL drift, whereas GRPO makes smaller, more localized updates. Strikingly, the ES and GRPO solutions are linearly connected with no loss barrier, even though their update directions are nearly orthogonal. We develop an analytical theory of ES that explains all these phenomena within a unified framework, showing how ES can accumulate large off-task movement on weakly informative directions while still making enough progress on the task to match gradient-based RL in downstream accuracy. These results show that gradient-free and gradient-based fine-tuning can reach similarly accurate yet geometrically distinct solutions, with important consequences for forgetting and knowledge preservation. The source code is publicly available: https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了无梯度方法（ES）与基于梯度的方法（GRPO）在LLM微调中的异同。尽管两种方法在任务性能上相当，但它们在参数空间产生几何上截然不同的更新：ES产生更大、更分散的更新，而GRPO更新更局部化。两种解虽然方向近乎正交，却可通过线性路径无损失地连接。这表明无梯度和基于梯度的微调方法能达到精度相当但几何结构迥异的解，对遗忘和知识保留有重要影响。
AI.motivation: Evolution Strategies（ES）作为可扩展的无梯度LLM微调方法，与基于梯度的强化学习方法（如GRPO）在任务性能上相当，但尚不清楚两者在参数空间中是否产生相似的解。这一问题对于理解不同微调方法的特性、遗忘行为和知识保留具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在四个任务上对比ES和GRPO，涵盖单任务学习和顺序持续学习两种设置。采用控制变量的迭代预算对比分析，并通过解析理论框架解释ES的行为特性。
AI.result: ES在单任务精度上匹配或超越GRPO；在控制迭代预算条件下，顺序学习中保持竞争力。但两种方法产生明显不同的模型更新：ES更新幅度更大，引发更广泛的离任务KL散度；GRPO更新更小、更局部化。值得注意的是，ES和GRPO的解虽方向近乎正交，却可通过线性路径无损失地连接。
AI.conclusion: 无梯度微调与基于梯度的微调方法可达到精度相当但几何结构上明显不同的解。ES通过在弱信息方向上累积大幅离任务移动，同时保留足够的任务进展。研究成果对理解遗忘机制和知识保留具有重要实践意义，代码已开源。

title: Fragile Reasoning: A Mechanistic Analysis of LLM Sensitivity to Meaning-Preserving Perturbations
summary: Large language models demonstrate strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet remain surprisingly fragile to meaning-preserving surface perturbations. We systematically evaluate three open-weight LLMs, Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, on 677 GSM8K problems paired with semantically equivalent variants generated through name substitution and number format paraphrasing. All three models exhibit substantial answer-flip rates (28.8%-45.1%), with number paraphrasing consistently more disruptive than name swaps. To trace the mechanistic basis of these failures, we introduce the Mechanistic Perturbation Diagnostics (MPD) framework, combining logit lens analysis, activation patching, component ablation, and the Cascading Amplification Index (CAI) into a unified diagnostic pipeline. CAI, a novel metric quantifying layer-wise divergence amplification, outperforms first divergence layer as a failure predictor for two of three architectures (AUC up to 0.679). Logit lens reveals that flipped samples diverge from correct predictions at significantly earlier layers than stable samples. Activation patching reveals a stark architectural divide in failure localizability: Llama-3 failures are recoverable by patching at specific layers (43/60 samples), while Mistral and Qwen failures are broadly distributed (3/60 and 0/60). Based on these diagnostic signals, we propose a mechanistic failure taxonomy (localized, distributed, and entangled) and validate it through targeted repair experiments: steering vectors and layer fine-tuning recover 12.2% of localized failures (Llama-3) but only 7.2% of entangled (Qwen) and 5.2% of distributed (Mistral) failures.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"语义保持扰动"下大语言模型数学推理脆弱性的机制层面分析。作者在GSM8K的677对语义等价问题上测试Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B，发现28.8%–45.1%的答案翻转率（数字格式改写危害大于姓名替换），并提出Mechanistic Perturbation Diagnostics (MPD)框架——融合logit lens、激活修补、组件消融与新提出的Cascading Amplification Index (CAI)——来定位失败的内部来源。核心发现是失败机制具有架构特异性：Llama-3为局部化（patching可恢复71.7%）、Mistral为分布式（5.0%）、Qwen为纠缠型（0%且MLP主导）。据此提出局部化/分布式/纠缠型失败分类法，并用定向修复实验验证其预测效力（局部化12.2%可恢复，纠缠7.2%，分布式5.2%）。
AI.motivation: 尽管开源7–8B模型在GSM8K等数学推理基准上准确率已超过75%，常被视为涌现推理能力的证据，但越来越多工作质疑这究竟反映真正的数学理解，还是对表层特征的脆弱模式匹配（Stolfo et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2024）。已有研究主要在行为层面刻画扰动敏感性（Shi et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2023），仅测量扰动下的准确率下降，无法回答"失败在模型内部何处、如何发生"。作者因此运用机制可解释性工具，追踪扰动诱导失败的内部机制来源，并检验其是否可通过定向干预修复，以弥合基准准确率与推理可靠性之间的落差。
AI.method: 三阶段方法：(1) 数据构建——从GSM8K测试集构造677对有效问题，其中姓名替换341对、数字格式改写336对（$5→5 dollars、60%→60 percent），剔除引入歧义的样本；(2) 成对鲁棒性评估——temperature=0贪心解码，固定提示词要求在####后输出答案，翻转定义为原题答对而扰动版答错 flip(q,q')=1[f(q)=a*]·1[f(q')≠a*]；(3) 机制分析——logit lens逐层投影h^(l)经W_U得p^(l)，定位首个分歧层并用Mann-Whitney U检验比较翻转/稳定样本；激活修补在分歧token位置将扰动运行的隐状态替换为原题隐状态（逐层测试恢复率）；组件消融对注意力与MLP子层输出做零消融以判断因果贡献；并提出Cascading Amplification Index CAI=(1/(L-l0))Σ1[Δ_{l+1}>Δ_l]，其中Δ_l为orig与pert在第l层的logit lens分布JSD，量化分歧在网络中的放大/衰减。实验设置：Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2（32层）、Llama-3-8B-Instruct（32层）、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（28层），float16加载；logit lens作用于全部677对，激活修补与组件消融作用于每模型前60个翻转样本。修复验证采用层微调（冻结其余参数，交叉熵+表示对齐损失，AdamW lr=1e-5、3轮）、steering向量（100个校准样本的原/扰动隐状态均值差，无需训练）与ROME秩一MLP权重编辑。
AI.result: 行为层面：三模型翻转率为Mistral 45.1%、Llama-3 33.5%、Qwen2.5-7B 28.8%；数字改写均更破坏（Mistral 63.1% vs 姓名27.3%）。logit lens：翻转样本首个分歧层显著更早（Mistral 9.1 vs 11.6，p=2.07e-4；Llama-3 13.0 vs 14.7，p=2.14e-2；Qwen 17.2 vs 19.5，p=9.23e-6），且更早分歧与更高翻转率相关。激活修补显示清晰架构分化：Llama-3可恢复43/60（71.7%），Mistral 3/60（5.0%），Qwen 0/60。组件消融：Mistral注意力主导（27/60 vs MLP 21/60，首现层11.8 vs 14.9），Llama-3两者均高（75%/77%），Qwen反转为MLP主导（29/60 vs 24/60，首现3.9 vs 5.2）。CAI在全部三模型上对翻转/稳定有显著差异（p=2.86e-15/7.39e-05/1.06e-02），作为失败预测器在Mistral（0.679 vs 0.579）与Llama-3（0.593 vs 0.540）优于首个分歧层，Qwen则相反（0.605 vs 0.560）；Mistral翻转/稳定的JSD比从第4层约1.7×增至末层9.9×。修复结果验证分类法预测的有序性：Llama-3层微调（L3–5）11.3%、steering 12.2%；Qwen层微调（L0,2,5）7.2%、steering 7.2%、ROME为负恢复（−1.1%，多数输出畸形）；Mistral层微调（L12,14,27）4.9%、steering 5.2%，符合localized > distributed ≈ entangled的预测。附录显示姓名替换类失败普遍比数字改写类更易修复。
AI.conclusion: 推理脆弱性并非单一现象，而是表现出架构特异性的失败模式：局部化（Llama-3，patching恢复71.7%）、分布式（Mistral，5.0%，中后期注意力冗余编码）、纠缠型（Qwen，0%，跨层跨组件的MLP主导敏感）。MPD框架将logit lens、激活修补、组件消融与CAI整合为可复用的诊断流水线，CAI在三种架构上均显著预测失败（AUC最高0.679）。分类法具有可操作性——其预测的修复难度排序得到独立干预实验验证，定向干预仅能恢复12.2%的局部化失败，而分布式与纠缠型仅为5–7%。未来工作包括验证这些失败模式在更大规模模型上的持续性、向其他推理领域的泛化，以及组合多种分类法引导的干预以提升恢复率。局限包括每模型仅60个翻转样本、仅7–8B规模、扰动类型限于两种、组件消融采用零消融近似、且分析聚焦答案token位置而可能遗漏更早推理步骤的影响。

title: Do Large Language Models Mentalize When They Teach?
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Workshop paper at ICML 2026
summary: How do LLMs decide what to teach next: by reasoning about a learner's knowledge, or by using simpler rules of thumb? We test this in a controlled task previously used to study human teaching strategies. On each trial, a teacher LLM sees a hypothetical learner's trajectory through a reward-annotated directed graph and must reveal a single edge so the learner would choose a better path if they replanned. We run a range of LLMs as simulated teachers and fit their trial-by-trial choices with the same cognitive models used for humans: a Bayes-Optimal teacher that infers which transitions the learner is missing (inverse planning), weaker Bayesian variants, heuristic baselines (e.g., reward based), and non-mentalizing utility models. In a baseline experiment matched to the stimuli presented to human subjects, most LLMs perform well, show little change in strategy over trials, and their graph-by-graph performance is similar to that of humans. Model comparison (BIC) shows that Bayes-Optimal teaching best explains most models' choices. When given a scaffolding intervention, models follow auxiliary inference- or reward-focused prompts, but these scaffolds do not reliably improve later teaching on heuristic-incongruent test graphs and can sometimes reduce performance. Overall, cognitive model fits provide insight into LLM tutoring policies and show that prompt compliance does not guarantee better teaching decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM作为教师在奖励标注的有向图中如何决定向学习者展示哪条边的教学策略。通过与人类认知模型（贝叶斯最优、启发式等）比较，发现大多数LLM表现出类似贝叶斯最优教师的推理方式，且性能与人类相似。提示干预虽能引导模型遵循特定策略，但不总能改善教学效果。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在教学中是采用对学习者知识的贝叶斯推理（心智理论），还是使用更简单的启发式规则。这对于理解LLM作为导师或教学助手的行为机制具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用与人类教学研究匹配的对照实验范式：教师LLM观察假设学习者在奖励标注有向图中的轨迹，需揭示一条边使学习者重新规划时能选择更好路径。测试多种LLM作为模拟教师，使用与人类相同的认知模型（贝叶斯最优教师、逆向规划、弱贝叶斯变体、启发式基线、非心理化效用模型）拟合逐试次选择，并进行提示干预实验。
AI.result: 大多数LLM表现良好，策略在不同试次间变化较小，跨图表现与人类相似。BIC模型比较显示贝叶斯最优教学最能解释大多数模型的选择。提示干预虽能引导模型遵循推理或奖励导向策略，但不能可靠地改善后续在违反启发式的测试图上的教学表现，有时甚至降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 认知模型拟合揭示了LLM的教学策略表现为近似贝叶斯最优的推理方式。提示依从性不能保证更好的教学决策，这为理解LLM tutoring策略提供了重要见解，并表明将LLM用于教育应用时需谨慎评估其实际推理能力而非表面提示响应。

title: Beyond Logit Adjustment: A Residual Decomposition Framework for Long-Tailed Reranking
summary: Long-tailed classification, where a small number of frequent classes dominate many rare ones, remains challenging because models systematically favor frequent classes at inference time. Existing post-hoc methods such as logit adjustment address this by adding a fixed classwise offset to the base-model logits. However, the correction required to restore the relative ranking of two classes need not be constant across inputs, and a fixed offset cannot adapt to such variation. We study this problem through Bayes-optimal reranking on a base-model top-k shortlist. The gap between the optimal score and the base score, the residual correction, decomposes into a classwise component that is constant within each class, and a pairwise component that depends on the input and competing labels. When the residual is purely classwise, a fixed offset suffices to recover the Bayes-optimal ordering. We further show that when the same label pair induces incompatible ordering constraints across contexts, no fixed offset can achieve this recovery. This decomposition leads to testable predictions regarding when pairwise correction can improve performance and when cannot. We develop REPAIR (Reranking via Pairwise residual correction), a lightweight post-hoc reranker that combines a shrinkage-stabilized classwise term with a linear pairwise term driven by competition features on the shortlist. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning image classification, species recognition, scene recognition, and rare disease diagnosis confirm that the decomposition explains where pairwise correction helps and where classwise correction alone suffices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长尾分类中后验重排序问题，提出REPAIR方法，通过将残差分解为类别级和成对级两部分来解释固定偏移量方法的局限性，并在五个基准数据集上验证了该分解能够预测何时需要成对校正。
AI.motivation: 现有后验方法（如logit adjustment）使用固定类别偏移量校正logits，但同一标签对在不同输入上下文下可能需要不同的排序校正，固定偏移无法适应这种变化，导致无法恢复贝叶斯最优排序。
AI.method: 1) 将残差校正分解为类别级（类内恒定）和成对级（依赖输入和竞争标签）；2) 理论证明当残差仅为类别级时固定偏移可恢复最优排序，但当标签对在不同上下文中产生冲突排序约束时任何固定偏移都无法做到；3) 提出REPAIR，结合收缩稳定的类别级项与基于短列表竞争特征的线性成对项。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集（涵盖图像分类、物种识别、场景识别和罕见病诊断）上的实验验证了该分解的有效性：能够解释何时成对校正能提升性能，何时仅靠类别级校正即可。
AI.conclusion: 残差的分解理论为长尾分类后验校正提供了可测试的预测框架，REPAIR作为轻量级后验重排序器，在需要成对校正的场景中优于固定偏移方法。

title: What Do Claim Verification Datasets Actually Test? A Reasoning Trace Analysis
summary: Despite rapid progress in claim verification, we lack a systematic understanding of what reasoning these benchmarks actually exercise. We generate structured reasoning traces for 24K claim-verification examples across 9 datasets using GPT-4o-mini and find that direct evidence extraction dominates, while multi-sentence synthesis and numerical reasoning are severely under-represented. A dataset-level breakdown reveals stark biases: some datasets almost exclusively test lexical matching, while others require information synthesis in roughly half of cases. Using a compact 1B-parameter reasoning verifier, we further characterize five error types and show that error profiles vary dramatically by domain -- general-domain verification is dominated by lexical overlap bias, scientific verification by overcautiousness, and mathematical verification by arithmetic reasoning failures. Our findings suggest that high benchmark scores primarily reflect retrieval-plus-entailment ability. We outline recommendations for building more challenging evaluation suites that better test the reasoning capabilities verification systems need.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了9个数据集共24K个claim验证样本的推理类型，发现直接证据提取占主导地位，而多句综合和数值推理严重不足。不同数据集存在显著偏差：错误模式因领域而异——通用领域受词汇重叠偏差主导，科学领域受过度谨慎影响，数学领域则受算术推理失败影响。高基准分数主要反映的是检索+蕴含能力，而非真正的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管claim验证领域进展迅速，但学界缺乏对现有基准测试实际考察何种推理能力的系统性理解。这导致难以准确评估模型在真实复杂推理场景中的表现。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o-mini为24K个claim验证样本生成结构化推理轨迹；利用紧凑的1B参数推理验证器识别五种错误类型。
AI.result: 直接证据提取占主导，多句综合与数值推理严重不足；数据集间偏差显著（有的几乎只测词汇匹配，有的约半数需信息综合）；五类错误被识别——通用领域以词汇重叠偏差为主，科学领域以过度谨慎为主，数学领域以算术推理失败为主。
AI.conclusion: 当前高基准分数主要反映检索+蕴含能力，而非深度推理能力。建议构建更具挑战性的评估套件，以更好地测试验证系统所需的推理能力。

title: Analysis of LLM Performance on AWS Bedrock: Receipt-item Categorisation Case Study
comment: Preprint. Accepted to the 19th International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering (ENASE 2026). Final version to be published by SCITEPRESS, http://www.scitepress.org
summary: This paper presents a systematic, cost-aware evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for receipt-item categorisation within a production-oriented classification framework. We compare four instruction-tuned models available through AWS Bedrock: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 4 Sonnet, Mixtral 8x7B Instruct, and Mistral 7B Instruct. The aim of the study was (1) to assess performance across accuracy, response stability, and token-level cost, and (2) to investigate what prompting methods, zero-shot or few-shot, are especially appropriate both in terms of accuracy and in terms of incurred costs. Results of our experiments demonstrated that Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves the most favourable balance between classification accuracy and cost efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文在 AWS Bedrock 上对四个指令微调模型（Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Claude 4 Sonnet、Mixtral 8x7B Instruct、Mistral 7B Instruct）在收据条目分类任务上的表现做了"准确率—成本"双维度评估，分两阶段：Phase 1 固定 schema-first 零样本提示做模型选型，Phase 2 在胜出的 Claude 3.7 上做提示层优化（细化类别集 → 加入消歧规则 → 加入少样本示例）。结论是：Claude 3.7 Sonnet 在准确率、结构稳定性和成本间取得最佳平衡；Phase 2 的"细化类别 + 规则消歧、零样本"变体在严格评估下把整体准确率从 90.7% 提升到 93.3%（宽松评估 95.6%），但单次调用成本约翻倍（$0.00395 → $0.00874）；少样本示例在增加 token 成本的同时并未带来准确率提升，因而不推荐用于生产。
AI.motivation: 收据/发票条目分类是财务分析类应用（如费用管理、预算 App）的关键环节，需要可靠地把自由文本的商品名映射到固定类别体系，以支撑可信赖的用户体验与财务洞察。现有 LLM 文本分类研究多集中在法律、社交媒体、作文评分等场景，缺少针对"收据条目—预定义类别体系"这一生产化任务的系统性模型横向对比，尤其缺少同时考虑准确率、输出稳定性（schema 遵从、数组长度一致性、幻觉率）与 token 级成本的开源/闭源模型权衡研究。作者还希望回答工程落地层面的问题：零样本还是少样本提示更合适？成本增加是否物有所值？本工作定位为"为大规模收据内容分析奠定基础"的初步原型式定性评估。
AI.method: 【数据】以 AWS Textract Evaluation 导出的单个 CSV 为基础，构建 389 条费用条目数据集：机器抽取的文本块 + 商家 + 总额；澳大利亚本地商家收据，65% 为三款手机（Galaxy A52 / Pixel 7 Pro / iPhone 13 Pro）拍摄的实体纸质小票，35% 为电子小票截图，仅 JPG/PNG。真实标签由第一、二作者依据标注指南人工逐条标注（含多义项时的严格单一标签原则），并互相复核。【Phase 1：模型选型】四模型作为黑盒，统一调用 Bedrock InvokeModel API，本地处理（避免 S3/Lambda/Textract 等额外费用），低并发以规避限流、结果缓存防重复推理。Claude 采用 system+user 双段提示，Mixtral/Mistral 采用单条合并提示；提示采用 schema-first 设计：硬编码类别列表、要求输出与条目数等长的 JSON 数组、禁止额外文本，并加入简单启发式规则以约束输出。评估指标包括准确率、平衡准确率、精确率、召回率、F1（micro/macro）、逐类准确率、JSON 数组长度一致率（幻觉/截断代理指标）、运行时间分布（mean/min/max）、输入输出 token 数与按公开定价估算的单次调用成本。数据极度不均衡（Pantry & Snacks 90、Eating Out 61，而 Pets/Electronics 等仅 1 条，Baby & Maternity、Entertainment、Transport & Fuel 无样本），故以平衡准确率与逐类报告校正。【Phase 2：提示优化】沿用同一数据集与编排流程，仅针对 Phase 1 选出的 Claude 3.7 测试四种配置：V1 基线零样本；V2 仅细化类别集（26→27 类，如新增 Frozen、Drinks、Meat & Seafood & Deli、Dairy & Eggs & Fridge，拆分 Cleaning & Maintenance 与 Home & Lifestyle）；V3 = V2 + 显式分类规则与消歧启发式（冷链 vs 常温、drinks vs coffee_tea、cafe/takeaway → eating_out 等）；V4 = V3 + 少样本示例。同时引入宽松评估（预测匹配主标签或合理替代标签即算正确）以量化标签内在歧义（约 389 条中 20 条，如 iced coffee 可归 drinks 或 dairy_eggs_fridge）。
AI.result: 【Phase 1】Claude 3.7 Sonnet 最优：准确率 0.902、P/R/F1 0.907/0.902/0.905、平衡准确率 0.773；Claude 4 Sonnet 次之（0.848/0.748）；Mixtral 8x7B 0.694（平衡 0.608）；Mistral 7B 0.596（平衡 0.492）。输出结构一致性差距显著：Claude 3.7 与 Claude 4 数组长度不匹配率 0.00%，Mixtral 约 1.9%，Mistral 约 9.3%（在单条目小票上多输出标签），即开源权重模型在 schema 遵从与类别级幻觉上明显更弱。运行时间：Mixtral 最快（均值 431 ms），Mistral 7B 均值 912 ms 但最坏达 15 351 ms 且方差极大，Claude 3.7 均值 1 265 ms、Claude 4 均值 1 433 ms（Claude 家族内部 3.7 稳定快于 4）。成本：仅 Claude 系列报告 token，平均 421 输入 + 24 输出 token，单次调用约 $0.00395，约每 1 美元 250 次推理；开源模型因 Bedrock 不提供 token 指标而无法量化成本。逐类结果在高频类目（Fresh Produce、Eating Out、Pantry & Snacks）上 Claude 优势明显，而在描述不标准化的家居/个护类目差距扩大；支持度极小的类目（Pets、Gifts & Occasions、Subscriptions、Travel & Holidays）百分比波动极大需谨慎解读。【Phase 2 严格评估】V1 整体准确率 90.7%、平衡 81.4%；V2 整体持平 90.7% 但平衡提升（82.2%）；V3 最优——整体准确率 93.3%、P/R/F1 约 93%、平衡准确率 83.9%；V4 回落至 92.5%（精确率 92.3%、召回 92.4%、F1 92.4%），未超越 V3。宽松评估下 V3 整体 95.6%（P 95.4/R 95.5/F1 95.5）、平衡 86.3%，V4 整体 95.4% 但平衡更高（90.4%）；即在现实用户容忍度下仅约 5% 条目真正分类错误。逐类上 V3 在 dairy_eggs_fridge（78%→100%）、eating_out（96.7%→100%）、other（50%→87.5%）提升显著，但 drinks（56.5%）、utilities_bills（60%）、travel_holidays（0%）仍是短板。【成本与时延】V1 421 输入 token / $0.00395 / 1 265 ms；V2 433 / $0.00416 / 1 359 ms；V3 979 / $0.00874 / 1 398 ms；V4 1 212 / $0.01067 / 1 439 ms。输出 token 基本恒定（24–26.5），故输入 token 成为成本主驱动；规则版成本约翻倍，规则+少样本版最高。
AI.conclusion: RQ1：即便不做任何微调、仅用简洁的 schema-first 提示，LLM 在收据条目分类上可达约 0.9 的准确率/精确率/召回率/F1。RQ2：Claude 3.7 Sonnet 在两个阶段一致展现出准确率、输出一致性与成本效率的最佳平衡，被选为生产环境的收据分类模型；Claude 4 Sonnet 精度相近但平均更慢，Mixtral 8x7B 与 Mistral 7B 更快更便宜却明显更不可靠（数组长度不匹配、类别级幻觉、最坏时延劣化）。RQ3：最优提示策略是"细化后的预定义类别集 + 显式规则化消歧 + 零样本"（Variant 3），严格评估下兼顾 93.3% 整体准确率与可接受的运行时/token 增长；少样本示例仅在平衡准确率上有边际收益，却显著推高输入 token 与成本，故不推荐用于生产。整体权衡建议：预算充足选 V3，预算紧张选 V2（仅细化类别、成本几乎不变而平衡准确率提升），V1 为最低成本基线。作者同时声明主要局限：数据集由同一团队在同一机构收集，缺少跨商家、跨小票类型、跨成像条件的统计多样性；属初步定性评估，人工标注虽经交叉复核仍可能存在误差；不支持 PDF 类小票；开源模型的 token 成本无法在 Bedrock 报告框架内量化；部分类目样本极少，指标敏感易被单条错误放大。

title: ByteRover: Agent-Native Memory Through LLM-Curated Hierarchical Context
summary: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends large language models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches universally treat memory as an external service that agents call into, delegating storage to separate pipelines of chunking, embedding, and graph extraction. This architectural separation means the system that stores knowledge does not understand it, leading to semantic drift between what the agent intended to remember and what the pipeline actually captured, loss of coordination context across agents, and fragile recovery after failures. In this paper, we propose ByteRover, an agent-native memory architecture that inverts the memory pipeline: the same LLM that reasons about a task also curates, structures, and retrieves knowledge. ByteRover represents knowledge in a hierarchical Context Tree, a file-based knowledge graph organized as Domain, Topic, Subtopic, and Entry, where each entry carries explicit relations, provenance, and an Adaptive Knowledge Lifecycle (AKL) with importance scoring, maturity tiers, and recency decay. Retrieval uses a 5-tier progressive strategy that resolves most queries at sub-100 ms latency without LLM calls, escalating to agentic reasoning only for novel questions. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that ByteRover achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LoCoMo and competitive results on LongMemEval while requiring zero external infrastructure, no vector database, no graph database, no embedding service, with all knowledge stored as human-readable markdown files on the local filesystem.

AI.tldr: ByteRover提出一种"智能体原生"记忆架构，将记忆管理内嵌到LLM本身，而非依赖外部管道。通过层级化的Context Tree知识表示和自适应生命周期管理，配合5级渐进式检索策略，在保持高准确率的同时实现亚100ms延迟，且完全无需外部基础设施，所有知识以Markdown文件存储。
AI.motivation: 现有MAG系统将记忆作为外部服务，存储管道（分块、嵌入、图提取）与推理LLM分离，导致语义漂移、跨智能体协调上下文丢失、故障恢复脆弱等问题。
AI.method: ByteRover反转记忆管道：同一LLM同时负责推理、策展、结构和检索知识。知识以Context Tree层级结构组织（Domain→Topic→Subtopic→Entry），每条记录携带显式关系和来源。采用自适应知识生命周期(AKL)机制，包含重要性评分、成熟度层级和时效衰减。检索采用5级渐进策略，大部分查询在亚100ms内通过非LLM方式解决，仅对新颖问题触发智能体推理。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上达到SOTA准确率，LongMemEval上具有竞争力。零外部基础设施依赖，无向量数据库、无图数据库、无嵌入服务，所有知识存储为本地可读Markdown文件。
AI.conclusion: 智能体原生记忆架构实现了"存储即理解"，消除外部基础设施依赖，在保持性能的同时显著提升效率、弹性和语义一致性。

title: Learning ECG Image Representations via Dual Physiological-Aware Alignments
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) are among the most widely used diagnostic tools for cardiovascular diseases, and a large amount of ECG data worldwide appears only in image form. However, most existing automated ECG analysis methods rely on access to raw signal recordings, limiting their applicability in real-world and resource-constrained settings. In this paper, we present ECG-Scan, a self-supervised framework for learning clinically generalized representations from ECG images through dual physiological-aware alignments: 1) Our approach optimizes image representation learning using multimodal contrastive alignment between image and gold-standard signal-text modalities. 2) We further integrate domain knowledge via soft-lead constraints, regularizing the reconstruction process and improving signal lead inter-consistency. Extensive benchmarking across multiple datasets and downstream tasks demonstrates that our image-based model achieves superior performance compared to existing image baselines and notably narrows the gap between ECG image and signal analysis. These results highlight the potential of self-supervised image modeling to unlock large-scale legacy ECG data and broaden access to automated cardiovascular diagnostics.

AI.tldr: ECG-Scan通过自监督学习框架，从ECG图像中学习可泛化的临床表征，采用多模态对比对齐和软导联约束的双重生理感知对齐策略，在多个数据集和下游任务上取得优异性能，缩小了ECG图像与信号分析之间的差距，有望解锁大规模遗留ECG图像数据。
AI.motivation: ECG数据在全球范围内大量仅以图像形式存在，但现有自动ECG分析方法大多依赖原始信号 recordings，导致在现实世界和资源受限环境中的应用受到严重限制。这促使研究者探索从ECG图像直接学习的方法。
AI.method: ECG-Scan采用双重重理感知对齐策略：1）通过多模态对比对齐，将图像表征与金标准信号-文本模态进行优化；2）整合领域知识（软导联约束）来正则化重建过程，提升信号导联间的一致性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和下游任务上的广泛基准测试表明，该图像模型性能优于现有图像基线方法，并显著缩小了ECG图像分析与信号分析之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 自监督图像建模具有解锁大规模遗留ECG图像数据并扩大自动化心血管诊断可及性的潜力。

title: PRCCF: A Persona-guided Retrieval and Causal-aware Cognitive Filtering Framework for Emotional Support Conversation
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL)
summary: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) aims to alleviate individual emotional distress by generating empathetic responses. However, existing methods face challenges in effectively supporting deep contextual understanding. To address this issue, we propose PRCCF, a Persona-guided Retrieval and Causality-aware Cognitive Filtering framework. Specifically, the framework incorporates a persona-guided retrieval mechanism that jointly models semantic compatibility and persona alignment to enhance response generation. Furthermore, it employs a causality-aware cognitive filtering module to prioritize causally relevant external knowledge, thereby improving contextual cognitive understanding for emotional reasoning. Extensive experiments on the ESConv dataset demonstrate that PRCCF outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both automatic metrics and human evaluations. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/YancyLyx/PRCCF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRCCF框架，通过人格引导检索和因果感知认知过滤机制，提升情感支持对话系统对上下文的深层理解和情感推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有情感支持对话方法在有效支持深层上下文理解方面面临挑战，难以准确把握用户情感状态并生成高质量的共情回复。
AI.method: 提出PRCCF框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 人格引导检索机制，联合建模语义兼容性和人格一致性；(2) 因果感知认知过滤模块，优先选择因果相关的外部知识。
AI.result: 在ESConv数据集上的实验表明，PRCCF在自动评估指标和人工评估上均优于当前最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过人格对齐和因果推理有效提升了情感支持对话的上下文认知理解和情感推理能力，为该领域提供了新的技术方案。

title: MM-ReCoder: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning and Self-Correction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in multimodal coding tasks such as chart-to-code generation. However, existing methods primarily rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires the model to learn code patterns through chart-code pairs but does not expose the model to a code execution environment. Moreover, while self-correction through execution feedback offers a potential route to improve coding quality, even state-of-the-art MLLMs have been shown to struggle with effective self-correction. In this work, we introduce MM-ReCoder, a chart-to-code generation model trained with reinforcement learning (RL) and equipped with self-correction ability. We propose a two-stage multi-turn self-correction RL strategy based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The first stage enhances the model's self-correction ability via rolling out a shared first turn, while the second stage improves the coding capability with full-trajectory optimization. MM-ReCoder learns to produce more accurate and executable code through the interaction with the environment and by iteratively correcting its own outputs. Our results on three chart-to-code benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of MM-ReCoder.

AI.tldr: MM-ReCoder是一种基于强化学习的图表到代码生成模型，通过两阶段多轮自纠正RL策略（基于GRPO）提升代码生成质量，在三个基准数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖监督微调（SFT），模型仅通过图表-代码对学习代码模式，但缺乏代码执行环境的交互。此外，即使是最先进的MLLMs在有效自纠正方面也存在困难。
AI.method: 提出两阶段多轮自纠正RL策略：阶段一通过共享首轮 rollout 增强自纠正能力；阶段二通过全轨迹优化提升编码能力。模型基于Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)进行训练。
AI.result: 在三个图表到代码基准数据集上达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: MM-ReCoder通过与环境的交互及迭代自纠正，能够生成更准确、可执行的代码。

title: ZEUS: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Only Second-Order Predictor
summary: Denoising generative models deliver high-fidelity generation but remain bottlenecked by inference latency due to the many iterative denoiser calls required during sampling. Training-free acceleration methods reduce latency by either sparsifying the model architecture or shortening the sampling trajectory. Current training-free acceleration methods are more complex than necessary: higher-order predictors amplify error under aggressive speedups, and architectural modifications hinder deployment. Beyond 2x acceleration, step skipping creates structural scarcity -- at most one fresh evaluation per local window -- leaving the computed output and its backward difference as the only causally grounded information. Based on this, we propose ZEUS, an acceleration method that predicts reduced denoiser evaluations using a second-order predictor, and stabilizes aggressive consecutive skipping with an interleaved scheme that avoids back-to-back extrapolations. ZEUS adds essentially zero overhead, no feature caches, and no architectural modifications, and it is compatible with different backbones, prediction objectives, and solver choices. Across image and video generation, ZEUS consistently improves the speed-fidelity performance over recent training-free baselines, achieving up to 3.2x end-to-end speedup while maintaining perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Ting-Justin-Jiang/ZEUS.

AI.tldr: ZEUS 是一种免训练（training-free）的扩散/流模型采样加速方法，仅依靠"观测信息集"（一次全评估输出 ψ_t 及其后向差分 Δ⁽¹⁾ψ_t）构造二阶预测器 ψ̂_{t-1} = 2ψ_t − ψ̂_{t+1}，并用"交错复用（interleaved）"调度在连续跳步时交替使用 2ψ_t − ψ̂_{t+1} 与 ψ_t，避免链式外推的误差放大。该方法零额外特征缓存、零架构改动、<20 行代码即可集成，兼容不同骨干/预测目标/求解器，在图像与视频生成上取得最高 3.2× 端到端加速并保持感知质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配的采样延迟瓶颈在于每步都需完整调用一次大型 denoiser（如 Wan2.1-14B 生成 5 秒视频在 H100 上超过 20 分钟）。免训练加速主要沿两条路径：架构冗余（token/注意力稀疏化，需要定制 CUDA kernel 与算子融合，难部署）与轨迹冗余（特征缓存/高阶外推，需要逐层特征缓存，显存开销随深度增长，高阶预测器在激进加速下误差累积）。作者提出两个反直觉论点：(i) 当前免训练加速的数值阶数过高——TaylorSeer 等使用 k≥3 阶 Taylor 展开，但在 >2× 加速下，任意三步窗口内最多只有一次新鲜评估，高阶预测只能链式依赖已近似的输出或引入陈旧评估，反而放大误差；(ii) 部署负担过重。作者观察到：在均匀 ≥2× 跳步的结构性稀缺下，唯一"因果可靠"的信息就是当前计算输出及其后向差分，因此二阶预测器已足够，高阶无益。
AI.method: 【统一记号】设网络输出 ψ_θ(x̂_t, s_t) = ψ_t（涵盖 ε、x_0、v、score、flow 五种参数化），ψ̂_t 表示被近似步的输出。PF-ODE 采样被离散为求解器步。【观测信息集】在第 t 步全评估处，状态 x̂_t 由求解器用信号 ψ̂_{t+1} 推进而来，故后向差分 Δ⁽¹⁾ψ_t ≔ ψ_t − ψ̂_{t+1} 编码了 denoiser 对该（已近似）状态的响应，{ψ_t, Δ⁽¹⁾ψ_t} 构成"观测信息集"，是零边际成本的完整因果记录。【二阶预测器】ψ̂_{t-1} = ψ_t + Δ⁽¹⁾ψ_t = 2ψ_t − ψ̂_{t+1}，仅需对两个输出张量做逐元素运算。【交错方案】对连续 r 个缩减步，ψ̂_{t−j} = 2ψ_t − ψ̂_{t+1}（j 奇）或 ψ_t（j 偶），即只做一次外推后重置锚点，绝不链式外推。【理论】Thm A.4：ψ_t = φ(t) + η_t 的信号-噪声分解；Thm A.5：(2,−1) 是对所有仿射趋势无偏的唯一权重，且在同方差下为两点估计器中的 BLUE，偏差 O(Δ²)；Thm A.10/A.11/A.12：两点估计在 C² 光滑下的 minimax 下界为 Ω(M₂Δ²)，二阶外推达到该率，故为极小极大最优；Thm A.13：单点复用下界为 Ω(M₁Δ)，差一个量级；Thm A.15：k 阶 Lagrange 外推噪声方差放大 Ω(4^kσ²)，Lebesgue 常数指数增长、Runge 现象敏感；Thm A.17：均匀 r≥2 跳步下不可能有连续两个新鲜步，(ψ_t, Δψ_t) 是唯一最小充分元组；Thm A.19/A.20/A.21：三种策略的偏差-方差权衡（Predictor-only 偏差 O(j²Δ²)/方差 Θ(j²σ²)；Reuse-only 偏差 O(jΔ)/方差 σ²；ZEUS 在 j=1 为 O(Δ²)，j>1 为 O(jΔ)，方差 ≤5σ²）。【实现】1:r 均匀跳步（r∈{2,3,4} 对应 Medium/Fast/Turbo），仅应用于轨迹中段 70%（前 20% 与后 10% 因曲率高保留全评估）。【实验】模型：SD2.1、SDXL、Flux.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-v1.5；求解器：Euler、DPM-Solver++(2)、DPM-Solver++(3)；数据：MS-COCO 2017 验证集 5000 prompt、Penguin Benchmark；指标 PSNR/LPIPS/SSIM/FID 与端到端墙钟加速比；基线含 DeepCache、AdaptiveDiffusion、SADA、TeaCache、ToCa、TaylorSeer、DiCache、SVG 系列、DiTFastAttn、Minference、PAB、SpargeAttn。
AI.result: 【预测器阶数消融】在 SDXL 上（1:1 均匀调度，1000 条 COCO prompt）：三阶 Lagrange 在 r=1/2/3 的误差（0.1283/0.2431/0.2593）均劣于二阶（0.119/0.1745/0.2034），二阶亦优于直接基于真值陈旧评估的二阶/三阶 Lagrange 基线（0.1115/0.1907/0.2246 与 0.1283/0.2431/0.2593），说明"更高阶≠更准"，且引入陈旧真值反而加大误差。【图像】SD-2.1/DPM++：ZEUS-Medium 1.85×、PSNR 25.72、LPIPS 0.104、FID 4.46，与 SADA（1.80×/26.34/0.094/4.02）相当；SDXL/DPM++：ZEUS-Medium 1.87×/29.17/0.084/3.59，与 SADA 1.86×/29.36/0.084/3.51 持平；FLUX/Euler：ZEUS-Medium 2.09×/PSNR 30.19/LPIPS 0.047/FID 1.53 显著优于 SADA 2.02×/0.060/1.95、TeaCache 2.00×/0.216/4.89、TaylorSeer 3.13×/0.430/10.08、DiCache 3.22×/0.270；ZEUS-Turbo 在 3.22× 下 LPIPS 0.171、FID 4.52，远优于 TaylorSeer 同速下 0.430/10.08。【视频】Wan2.1：ZEUS 1.76×/PSNR 29.00/SSIM 0.846/LPIPS 0.117，优于 SVG2（1.58×/25.81/0.854/0.138）与 SVG2-Turbo（1.89×/23.68/0.789/0.196）；ZEUS-Fast 2.24×/26.59/0.792/0.179 仍优于 SVG2-Turbo。CogVideoX：ZEUS 1.71×/32.50/0.893/0.060 显著优于 SVG 2.28×/29.99/0.910/0.112，ZEUS-Fast 2.00×/30.97/0.876/0.073。【其他消融】少步采样（Flux 25/15 步、SDXL 25/15 步）下 ZEUS 仍保持低 LPIPS；求解器阶数提升（Euler→DPM++2→DPM++3）时 PSNR/加速几乎不变而 LPIPS/FID 单调改善（0.095→0.084→0.079，FID 3.87→3.59→3.28）；FLUX-2-dev(64B) 4-bit 量化下 ZEUS-Medium 与 Turbo 峰值显存同为 23370 MB，验证 O(1) 显存开销。【稳定性】交错方案在连续缩减步数增加时保持稳定，匹配或优于 reuse-only 与 predictor-only。
AI.conclusion: ZEUS 证明"加速扩散模型只需一个二阶预测器"：在 >2× 加速导致的新鲜评估稀缺条件下，观测信息集 {ψ_t, Δ⁽¹⁾ψ_t} 已信息论上充分（达到 Δ² 的 minimax 最优率），一阶复用存在 Ω(Δ) 偏差下界，而 k>2 阶外推带来 Ω(4^k) 方差放大与插值不稳定，故高阶并非必要。该方法无架构侵入、无特征缓存、O(1) 显存、O(1) 时间开销、<20 行代码，可即插即用于任意 HuggingFace diffusers 流水线，跨 U-Net/DiT/MMDiT、五种预测目标与多种求解器，在 SD2.1/SDXL/Flux.1-dev/Wan2.1/CogVideoX 上一致推进速度-保真度 Pareto 前沿（最高 3.22× 端到端加速）。同时作者提示：加速会降低合成内容滥用成本，方法本身不增加安全防护，建议结合许可、溯源、安全过滤与限流等负责任部署措施，并注意反弹效应与高风险场景中的近似伪影风险。

title: PRISM: Probability Reallocation with In-Span Masking for Knowledge-Sensitive Alignment
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with token-level hard labels can amplify overconfident imitation of factually unsupported targets, causing hallucinations that propagate in multi-sentence generation. We study an augmented SFT setting in which training instances include coarse sentence-level factuality risk labels and inter-sentence dependency annotations, providing structured signals about where factual commitments are weakly supported. We propose \textbf{PRISM}, a differentiable risk-gated framework that modifies learning only at fact-critical positions. PRISM augments standard SFT with a lightweight, model-aware probability reallocation objective that penalizes high-confidence predictions on risky target tokens, with its scope controlled by span-level risk weights and model-aware gating. Experiments on hallucination-sensitive factual benchmarks and general evaluations show that PRISM improves factual aggregates across backbones while maintaining a competitive overall capability profile. Ablations further show that the auxiliary signal is most effective when used conservatively, and that knowledge masking and model-aware reallocation play complementary roles in balancing factual correction and capability preservation.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一种训练期的"风险门控"事实感知 SFT 框架：在标准交叉熵之外，只在由原子事实抽取定位出的"事实关键跨度"上加入一个模型感知的概率重分配（补余）损失，惩罚模型对"弱支持/高风险"标签 token 的过度自信；其作用域由句级风险权重（经依赖传播）与两级门控（偏好门 + 重分配后保持 top-1 的一致性门）共同控制。实验显示在三个基座上 Factual Avg 稳定提升且 Common Avg 不退化，λ=0.1 效果最佳；消融表明"知识掩码提供定位、模型感知重分配提供精度"，二者互补。
AI.motivation: 标准 SFT 使用 token 级硬标签做最大似然拟合，会放大模型对缺乏事实支撑目标的过度自信模仿，从而产生事实幻觉，并沿多句生成链路传播（例如摘要、开放域 QA、长文本生成中的幻觉累积）。既有缓解方案多依赖检索（RAG）、事后自检/一致性验证、偏好优化（DPO）或额外训练阶段，组件复杂，且未触及 SFT 内部"拟合不完美目标会强化错误陈述"这一根本张力。作者希望保持 SFT 的简洁性，仅在训练时注入结构化的粗粒度事实信号（句子级事实性风险标签 + 跨句依赖/支持关系 + 原子事实），定位"事实关键位置"，在不依赖训练期外部检索与显式替代目标的前提下抑制无支撑的事实承诺。同时受"知识错配（knowledge misalignment）"相关研究的启发：SFT 干预需要同时考虑监督信号是否与模型预训练知识对齐，以及训练信号如何塑造事实关键跨度上的置信度。
AI.method: **数据与信号构造**：以 lmsys_chat_1m_clean（DeepSeek-V3 重生成回答）构建单轮 SFT 对；对目标回复按句界切块（每块≤200 token），抽取原子事实并归纳有向跨块支持/依赖关系（含由用户输入支撑的关系），再经校验过滤得到 265,568 条"已验证实例"，含 3.29M 原子事实、867K 依赖边、3.14M 跨度标注。**信号映射**：定义 fact-active 掩码 m^fact（token 是否落在事实对齐跨度内）；句级风险 r_j∈[0,1] 经依赖传播得有效风险 r̃_j=max(r_j, max_{j'→j} r_j')，再映射为 token 级支持权重 w_t = 1 − r̃_sid(t)（w 越小风险越高）。**训练目标**：L = L_SFT + λ·L_comp。标准 SFT 为所有有效 token 上的归一化 NLL；辅助项在事实跨度上用补余损失 −log(1 − min(p^label, 1−ε)) 降低标签 token 概率，隐式按模型当前分布把概率质量重分配给替代 token。**模型感知两级门控**：g^pref（当前标签是否为 argmax）与 g^keep（按 w_t 重分配后标签是否仍满足 p^label·w(1−p^label) ≥ q(1−p^label·w)，q 为最大竞争 token 概率），最终权重 α_t = m^fact_t · g^pref_t · g^keep_t · (1−w_t)。**梯度分析**：α 视为常数（门控为不可导指示函数），梯度使 z_y 下降（比例 p_y）、其余 logit 按 p_k 上升（比例 p_y/(1−p_y)·p_k），即"模型分布加权"的概率重分配，且置信度越高惩罚越强（1/(1−p_y) 因子）。**训练**：teacher forcing，1 epoch，AdamW，lr 1e-5，cosine，warmup 0.05，max len 32768，全局 batch 128，DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 + CPU offload，BF16，FlashAttention-2；两损失分别按 N_sft 与 N_fact 归一化。**对比方法**：SFT、SEAL（选择性弃答 + [REJ] 推理惩罚）、NOVA（K=10, T=0.7 采样 + 内部一致性探针与语义等价聚类过滤，质量打分用现成 Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B-v0.2）、Knowledge Mask（屏蔽风险<1 的事实跨度，仅做 SFT）。**评测**：HHEM-2.1-Open、PopQA、TriviaQA（Contriever top-5 预检索文档的 grounded 协议）、MMLU(LMSYS split)、GSM8K、HumanEval(pass@1)、IFEval。基座：Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-8B-Base、Llama-3.1-8B。
AI.result: 主结果（Table 1）：PRISM 在三个基座上 Factual Avg 均优于 vanilla SFT 且 Common Avg 非负变化。Qwen3-4B：Factual Avg 74.01→74.49（HHEM 94.53→95.03、PopQA 58.54→59.54、TriviaQA 68.90 基本持平），Common Avg 75.35→77.06（主要由 IFEval 60.81→63.40 驱动）。Qwen3-8B：Factual Avg 72.98→75.73（HHEM 94.83→95.13、PopQA 54.90→60.83、TriviaQA 69.22→71.22），Common Avg 73.86→77.78。Llama-3.1-8B：Factual Avg 71.47→72.91（HHEM 88.12→89.76、PopQA 58.18→59.75、TriviaQA 68.10→69.23），Common Avg 47.31→47.97。对比基线：PRISM 的 Factual Avg 均达到或接近最佳（NOVA 在 Qwen3-8B 常见能力略优但事实性落后；SEAL 在 Qwen3-4B 上 HHEM 反降至 92.25；NOVA 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上大幅退化，HHEM 84.10、Factual Avg 67.15）。λ 消融（Table 2, Qwen3-4B）：λ=0.01→74.23、λ=0.1→76.93/77.06（最佳平衡）、λ=0.5→73.33、λ=1.0→73.85，呈现"事实性提升 vs 通用能力保持"的权衡，且非严格单调。组件消融（Table 3）：去掉模型感知重分配→Factual 75.54 / Common 74.99；去掉知识掩码→Factual 74.68 / Common 72.97（IFEval 大幅降至 52.31），说明掩码负责定位、模型感知门控负责精度。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 证明了一种轻量的训练期干预路径：仅凭粗粒度的原子事实与句级风险/依赖结构，即可通过模型感知的概率重分配，在不引入检索器、验证器或偏好阶段的前提下提升事实可靠性并保持通用能力。核心洞见有三：(1) 抑制无支撑目标上的过度自信需要"选择性 + 模型感知"，而非对所有事实 token 均匀惩罚；(2) 一致性门控（重分配后标签仍须为 top-1）避免了辅助目标偏离当前事实目标、转向替代续写这一隐性缺陷；(3) 辅助强度应保守设置（λ≈0.1），过强会干扰基础 SFT 目标、削弱推理与指令遵循的保持。局限与未来工作：依赖事实抽取与验证的可靠性、风险标签本身较粗（句级继承风险、事实跨度掩码为二元、α 不可导），以及通用能力增益主要来自指令遵循而非推理/代码；后续方向包括提升抽取与校验可靠性、以及跨领域与跨训练阶段的自适应调度。

title: CRaFT: Circuit-Guided Refusal Feature Selection via Cross-Layer Transcoders
summary: As safety concerns around large language models (LLMs) grow, understanding the internal mechanisms underlying refusal behavior has become increasingly important. Recent work has studied this behavior by identifying internal features associated with refusal and manipulating them to induce compliance with harmful requests. However, existing refusal feature selection methods rely on how strongly features activate on harmful prompts, which tends to capture superficial signals rather than the causal factors underlying the refusal decision. We propose CRaFT, a circuit-guided refusal feature selection framework that ranks features by their influence on the model's refusal-compliance decision using prompts near the refusal boundary. On Gemma-3-1B-it, CRaFT improves attack success rate (ASR) from 6.7% to 48.2% and outperforms baseline methods across multiple jailbreak benchmarks. These results suggest that circuit influence is a more reliable criterion than activation magnitude for identifying features that causally mediate refusal behavior.

AI.tldr: CRaFT 是一种基于交叉层转码器（CLT）与归因图的「电路引导式拒绝特征选择」方法：在 Gemma-3-1B-it 上，攻击成功率从 6.7% 提升至 57.4%，显著优于 GCG/AutoDAN/PAP 及 Refusal-Direction、Refusal-SAE 等引导基线，同时几乎不损害通用能力（MMLU/GSM8K/IFEval 变化在 ±0.5 分以内）。其核心主张是：判断拒绝特征应看「对下游 logit 的电路影响力」，而非激活幅度。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性导向的越狱/拒绝研究在选择拒绝特征时，主要依据特征在有害提示上的激活强度（频率或幅值），这类信号容易捕获表层的「话题、措辞、攻击模板」等伪相关特征，而非真正因果中介拒绝决策的组件；同时，密集拒绝方向（refusal direction）纠缠多重功能，干预会破坏通用能力；SAE 类稀疏基线虽更细粒度，但仍受激活统计量准则的局限。另一方面，CLT 与电路追踪（circuit tracing）已能刻画跨层特征对输出的贡献，但既有工作多用于单提示的人工分析，难以直接支撑大规模自动化的特征选择与干预。因此需要一个以因果影响量为排序准则、且能在受控边界条件下定位拒绝机制的方法。
AI.method: 方法分为四个环节。(1) CLT 基础：以 JumpReLU 编码器将每层 MLP 输入残差流编码为稀疏特征 a^ℓ_t = φ(W_enc^ℓ h^ℓ_t)，并以跨层解码器 ŵ^ℓ_t = Σ_{j≤ℓ} W^{j→ℓ}_dec a^j_t 重建各层 MLP 输出，训练目标为重建误差加稀疏正则。(2) 归因图与直接效应：在将 MLP 输出替换为 CLT 重建的前向过程中，节点为 CLT 特征激活与选定输出 logit，边权为 e_{s→q} = a_s ∂u_q/∂a_s，由自动微分与解码器贡献收缩得到。(3) 边界关键采样：从 WildJailbreak 有害训练集中，按首 token 分布计算 BCScore(p) = min{P_ℛ(p), P_𝒞(p)}（严格用 R={'I'}、C={'Okay'}，附录验证扩展 token 集不改变结论），取 Top-100 得到 D_BC；同时保留随机有害/良性跨组对照 D_H、D_B。(4) 影响力打分与特征选择：由直接效应边构成邻接矩阵 A_p，归一化后用 i_p(f) = [w_p Σ_r Ã_p^r]_f（对同一特征身份取节点最大值）聚合所有多跳路径至拒绝/顺从 logit 的贡献，得 ī_BC(f)，取 Top-K 特征；干预时按层缩放 a' = m(ℓ)·a，m(ℓ) = −γℓ/(L−1)，γ=3，默认仅引导 Top-1 特征。
AI.result: 在 JailBreakBench/HarmBench/AdvBench/SorryBench 上，CRaFT 平均 LG4-ASR 达 57.4%、JudgeScore 2.90，全面超过 Refusal-SAE（41.4/1.37）、Refusal-Direction（33.9/0.60）、PAP（13.1/1.19）、GCG（12.1/0.65）、AutoDAN（3.8/0.30）；无攻击基线为 6.7%/0.53。消融显示：跨组激活 3.0、边界激活 5.0（均接近基线），跨组影响力 34.0/0.67，边界影响力 62.0/2.95，说明「电路影响力」与「边界采样」二者缺一不可。跨模型上，gemma-3-270m-it 平均 9.6%→23.7%，Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 平均 1.5%→25.9%（约 17 倍），说明流程可迁移（但需模型特定特征与乘子微调）。能力保持方面，CRaFT 在 MMLU/GSM8K/IFEval-P/I 上变化为 +0.13/0.00/−0.50/+0.31，McNemar 检验 p>0.5；Refusal-Direction 则全面崩塌（MMLU/GSM8K 归零）。超参分析显示 γ 呈倒 U 型（峰值 γ=3，ASR 0.34→0.62→0.39，退化率随 γ 单调升至 11%），多特征同时引导会 destabilize（K=2/3 时退化 22/86 例），N∈{50,100,150,200} 时 top-3 特征排序稳定。运行成本上，一次性特征选择约 16.6 分钟，单次攻击 17.67 秒（与无引导的 17.96 秒基本无开销），远低于 GCG（~500 min）、AutoDAN（~1000 min）与 Steering-SAE 的 49.3 小时网格搜索。此外 LG4 分类器会把退化输出误判为 unsafe，故引入 StrongREJECT 式 Judge 评分（判官模型用 gpt-oss-20b，与 GPT-5.1 一致性 88.9%/97.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：电路层面的「影响力/因果路径贡献」比激活幅度更可靠地识别真正中介拒绝行为的特征；结合边界关键采样，可在单个有害请求内受控地分离拒绝与顺从两条竞争路径，从而把干预精确对准输出决策而非表层拒绝信号。CRaFT 在四个越狱基准上大幅超越提示攻击与引导基线，并产生更具体、更有说服力的顺从内容，同时保留通用能力，跨模型亦可实例化；作者也指出迁移时需少量模型特定调整（token 代理、乘子网格），并非参数无关的零成本迁移。该方向为研究和对齐模型的拒绝机制提供了可解释性工具路径，同时提示分类器式 ASR 评估存在退化误判的系统性缺陷。

title: Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation for Autonomy-Preserving Supportive Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language models deployed in supportive or advisory roles must balance helpfulness with preservation of user autonomy, yet standard alignment methods primarily optimize for helpfulness and harmlessness without explicitly modeling relational risks such as dependency reinforcement, overprotection, or coercive guidance. We introduce Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN), a state-dependent control framework in which a learned scalar signal derived from structured user state and dialogue context conditions response generation and candidate selection. We formalize this setting as an autonomy-preserving alignment problem and define a utility function that rewards autonomy support and helpfulness while penalizing dependency and coercion. We also construct a benchmark of relational failure modes in multi-turn dialogue, including reassurance dependence, manipulative care, overprotection, and boundary inconsistency. On this benchmark, care-conditioned candidate generation combined with utility-based reranking improves autonomy-preserving utility by +0.25 over supervised fine-tuning and +0.07 over preference optimization baselines while maintaining comparable supportiveness. Pilot human evaluation and zero-shot transfer to real emotional-support conversations show directional agreement with automated metrics. These results suggest that state-dependent control combined with utility-based selection is a practical approach to multi-objective alignment in autonomy-sensitive dialogue.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN) 框架，通过学习标量控制信号在状态依赖的方式下条件化响应生成和候选选择，以在对话系统中平衡帮助性与用户自主性 preservation。实验表明该方法在自动化指标和人工评估上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法主要优化帮助性和无害性，缺乏对关系性风险的显式建模（如依赖强化、过度保护、强制性指导）。这些风险可能导致用户对AI产生不健康的依赖或削弱其自主决策能力，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.method: (1) 将问题形式化为自主性保持的对齐问题，定义奖励自主性支持与帮助性、惩罚依赖与强制的效用函数；(2) 提出CCN框架，使用从用户状态和对话上下文中学习的标量信号条件化响应生成；(3) 构建包含四类关系失效模式的基准测试（安慰依赖、操控性关怀、过度保护、边界不一致）；(4) 结合基于效用的重排序进行候选生成。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，CCN相比监督微调提升+0.25自主性保持效用，相比偏好优化基线提升+0.07，同时保持相当的支持性。 pilot 人类评估和零样本迁移到真实情感支持对话的实验结果与自动指标方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖控制结合基于效用的选择是实现自主性敏感对话中多目标对齐的可行方法。该框架为设计更负责任的AI助手提供了新思路，强调在提供支持的同时尊重用户自主权。

title: On the Role of Reasoning Patterns in the Generalization Discrepancy of Long Chain-of-Thought Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories has become a pivotal phase in building large reasoning models. However, how CoT trajectories from different sources influence the generalization performance of models remains an open question. In this paper, we conduct a comparative study using two sources of verified CoT trajectories generated by two competing models, \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} and \texttt{gpt-oss-120b}, with their problem sets controlled to be identical. Despite their comparable performance, we uncover a striking paradox: lower training loss does not translate to better generalization. SFT on \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} data achieves remarkably lower training loss, yet exhibits significantly worse generalization performance on reasoning benchmarks compared to those trained on \texttt{gpt-oss-120b}. To understand this paradox, we perform a multi-faceted analysis probing token-level SFT loss and step-level reasoning behaviors. Our analysis reveals a difference in reasoning patterns. \texttt{gpt-oss-120b} exhibits highly convergent and deductive trajectories, whereas \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} favors a divergent and branch-heavy exploration pattern. Consequently, models trained with \texttt{DeepSeek-R1} data inherit inefficient exploration behaviors, often getting trapped in redundant exploratory branches that hinder them from reaching correct solutions. Building upon this insight, we propose a simple yet effective remedy of filtering out frequently branching trajectories to improve the generalization of SFT. Experiments show that training on selected \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} subsets surprisingly improves reasoning performance by up to 5.1% on AIME25, 5.5% on BeyondAIME, and on average 3.6% on five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文揭示了一个重要悖论：使用DeepSeek-R1-0528数据训练的模型虽然训练损失更低，但泛化性能反而更差。原因在于DeepSeek-R1-0528采用发散式探索推理模式，而gpt-oss-120b采用收敛式演绎推理模式。通过过滤掉频繁分支的轨迹，可以显著提升模型的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 构建大推理模型时，在长思维链轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）已成为关键阶段。然而，来自不同源的CoT轨迹如何影响模型的泛化性能仍不清楚。研究者试图探究两个性能相当的模型（DeepSeek-R1-0528和gpt-oss-120b）的CoT轨迹在SFT中的表现差异。
AI.method: 研究采用控制变量法，使用两个模型生成的验证CoT轨迹，在问题集相同的情况下进行对比实验。分析采用多维度方法，包括token级SFT损失分析和step级推理行为分析，以揭示不同数据源对模型泛化能力的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现了一个显著悖论：使用DeepSeek-R1-0528数据训练的模型训练损失更低，但泛化性能反而更差。gpt-oss-120b展现出高度收敛的演绎式推理轨迹，而DeepSeek-R1-0528倾向于发散式和分支繁重的探索模式。过滤频繁分支的轨迹后，在AIME25上提升5.1%，BeyondAIME上提升5.5%，五个基准测试平均提升3.6%。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹的模式（收敛vs发散）比训练损失更能预测模型的泛化性能。基于这一发现，提出通过过滤分支轨迹来改进SFT的简单有效方法，证明选择高质量推理轨迹对提升模型推理能力至关重要。

title: From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) tackle complex tasks by distributing expertise, though this often comes at the cost of heavy coordination overhead, context fragmentation, and brittle phase ordering. Distilling a MAS into a single-agent skill can bypass these costs, but this conversion lacks a principled answer for when and what to distill. Instead, the empirical outcome is surprisingly inconsistent: skill lift ranges from a 28% improvement to a 2% degradation across metrics of the exact same task. In this work, we reveal that skill utility is governed not by the task, but by the evaluation metric. We introduce Metric Freedom ($F$), the first a priori predictor of skill utility. $F$ measures the topological rigidity of a metric's scoring landscape by quantifying how output diversity couples with score variance via a Mantel test. Guided by $F$, we propose a two-stage adaptive distillation framework. Stage 1 acts as a selective extraction mechanism, extracting tools and knowledge while discarding restrictive structures on "free" metrics to preserve exploration. Stage 2 targets computationally intensive iterative refinement exclusively toward "rigid" metrics ($F \lesssim 0.6$) to eliminate trajectory-local overfitting. Evaluating across 4 tasks, 11 datasets, and 6 metrics, $F$ strongly predicts skill utility ($ρ= -0.62$, $p < 0.05$). Strikingly, identical agent trajectories yield diametrically opposite skill lifts under rigid versus free metrics, demonstrating that skill utility is fundamentally a metric-level property. Driven by this signal, our adaptive agent matches or exceeds the original MAS while reducing cost up to 8$\times$ and latency by up to 15$\times$.

AI.tldr: 多智能体工作流蒸馏为单智能体技能时，收益不由任务而由**评测指标**决定：同一批基座轨迹，在"刚性"指标下蒸馏后技能提升，在"自由"指标下反而下降。作者提出**行为-结果自由度 F**（F = 1 − Spearman(行为距离秩, 分数距离秩)，基于 Mantel 检验的样本估计），作为**合成前**的有符号诊断量，并用 **AdaSkill** 把"能力资源（工具/知识）"与"结构控制（流水线指令）"分开处理：保留能力、删除运行时编排、仅按 F 的冻结阈值决定是否继承源工作流的流水线条款。在 4 个结构化数据科学任务族、11 个数据集、6 个指标上，16 组能力匹配干预证实 F 与结构收益单调负相关（斜率 −9.04 效用点/单位 F，p<0.001；ROC AUC=1.000），最终技能在 6 个性能聚合中赢 5 个，同时推理成本降低约 30%、推理时间降低约 53%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）通过显式工作流（阶段化流程、工具调用、共享状态、验证与修复）把分析控制外置，能取得强性能，但部署时必须反复执行这一编排层，带来沉重的协调开销、上下文碎片化与脆弱的阶段顺序。将工作流蒸馏为单智能体"技能"可绕开这些成本，但缺乏一个原则性答案：**哪些工作流成分应当跨越"控制边界"**。经验结果是同一任务上的技能提升从 +28% 到 −2% 剧烈波动。作者进一步指出：MAS 工作流并非功能同质的对象——可调用工具与声明式知识属于"能力资源"，扩展智能体可做什么；而顺序规则、决策门、禁令等"流水线指引"是对源系统控制逻辑的转移，规定智能体探索哪些解。因此即便已发表的高性能工作流，其结构控制也未必在蒸馏后仍然有益。核心问题由此变为：**何时把工作流结构转移给单智能体技能才是有利的？** 另一线索是：同一批基座运行轨迹，仅更换打分器，同一管线的价值符号就会反转（Textbook 上 Full−Discard 在 MSA 下为 +19.6 点、在 MRE 下为 −10.3 点），说明技能效用是"指标层面"的属性而非任务属性。
AI.method:
**一、功能分解（能力 vs 结构）**：对源工作流做子句级功能划分——tool（可调用实现）、knowledge（不含动作指令的领域/模式/假设/工具语义命题）、pipeline（任何"状态→动作"映射：建议、禁令、编号步骤、条件分支、校验门、重试、停止规则；混合子句一律归 Pipeline）、orchestration（交接、共享状态、投票、辩论、控制循环，蒸馏后删除）。能力资源与结构条款不适用同一继承规则。

**二、Behavior-Outcome Freedom（F）**：设两次基座运行的行为距离 U=d(φ(Z),φ(Z'))、分数距离 V=|s(Z)−s(Z')|，定义 F = 1 − ρ_S(U,V)（总体 Spearman，秩用中位秩），样本估计用 Mantel 式 Spearman 系数 r_M（对上三角所有运行对求秩相关），F = 1 − r_M，取值 [0,2]。F_out 用任务自撰的行为表示（CD/FE/T2SQL 用 Jaccard 距离，CE 用所选估计方法类别指标+层级化"响应无关执行签名"：统计包、估计器调用、协变量/带宽/核/estimand 等）；F_trace 用去掉最终回复的过程轨迹嵌入（text-embedding-3-large，缩放余弦距离）。采样端用"多样性规划器"生成方法学上互异的先验以铺开探索性支撑；每题需 ≥3 个可识别问题（分数有变异）方可用于路由，否则默认 Discard。

**三、理论**（附录 A）：Thm A.1 结构收益分解 Lift(π)=a_π S_π G（方向对齐×干预强度×景观余地，Cauchy–Schwarz 界 |Lift|≤S_πG）；Prop A.2 几何可确定性 1−Γ_rank ≤ 2F−F²（F≈0 标记正向有序秩结构）；Thm A.3 有符号锚定秩转移 |Λ_π−κΔ_π| ≤ sqrt(2χ_π²{1−κρ_S(U,V)}/h)，κ=+1 误差∝√F、κ=−1 误差∝√(2−F) 且方向反转；Cor A.4 将序数结果校准回连续指标尺度；A.6 给出二元特化（强反相合可证书化"锚定收缩有害"）；Prop A.6 给出值域、单调不变性、退化与不可识别边界。F 是"效应修饰因子"而非候选收益的独立估计量。

**四、AdaSkill 转换器**（四阶段）：分析清点 → 校准一次后冻结（阈值 t 由开发regime估计，交叉拟合：留一家族外时用其余regime选 t 并对目标家族所有指标冻结不变；各折 t∈[0.426, 0.692]，0.65 仅作描述性参考）→ 移除编排、以路由向量把各指标模块联合合成单个技能（多指标族按其打分决策分模块合成，而非拼接）→ 子句级审计校验（discard 路由下隐藏在"知识"标题下的祈使句一律拒绝）。

**五、实验设计**：4 任务族（T2SQL/CE/CD/FE）、11 数据集、6 指标；任务合格源工作流 APEX-SQL、CAIS、MATMCD、FELA；对照 Base Agent、EvoSkill、Workflow Compiler；统一 Sonnet 4.6 后端，诊断/转换/评测数据角色隔离。证据链：RQ1 仅换打分器；RQ2 为机制检验——15 组原子 Pipeline-only 处理与 16 组能力匹配（Full vs Discard 保持工具/知识/编排完全相同、仅差流水线条款）干预，采用工作流regime固定效应 + 数据集聚类推断；RQ3 为留一regime冻结阈值的构造性检验。稳健性：GPT-5.1 全量复现、无规划器的独立运行对照、预算敏感性（$0.17/次运行）、bootstrap（按运行/问题重采样而非按运行对）。
AI.result:
**RQ1 指标反转**：同一 60 次基座运行仅换打分器，F_MSA_out=0.10 vs F_MRE_out=1.03（轨迹空间 0.55 vs 1.12）；加入响应无关执行签名后仍为 0.18 vs 1.09，回归器遍历后反转依然存在。能力匹配效应：Textbook MSA +19.6 / MRE −10.3；Real +25.0 / −2.1。

**RQ2 机制定位**：组件消融显示工具与知识收益随 F **上升**（r=0.67、0.52，Tools+Knowledge r=0.95），而 Pipeline 单独**反转**该序（r=−0.74），全组件组仍为负（r=−0.61）——反转被定位到结构转移。15 组原子 Pipeline-only 处理：Pearson r=−0.623（p=0.013）、Spearman ρ=−0.568（p=0.027）。16 组能力匹配干预：F 每升高 1 单位，Full−Discard 效用下降 9.04 点（95% CI [−13.23, −4.85]，p<0.001）；原生尺度 r=−0.797（p=0.0002）；阈值无关的 −F 排序 ROC AUC=1.000（精确 p=0.0002）；严格 K≥3 子集（13 组）斜率 −9.63、CI [−13.77, −5.48]，ROC AUC 仍 1.000；四个留一regime重拟合斜率均为负（−5.45 至 −9.77）。基线效用与处理效应无关（r=0.033, p=0.903），排除"难度代理"解释；无符号耦合量无法区分同向/反向，证明 F 的符号信息是必要的。

**RQ3 构造性结果**：留一regime冻结路由的归一化提升 31.19，优于 Always Full（21.84）与 Always Discard（21.93），保留全信息结果的 92.5%，并在 97.8% 的选择感知配对 bootstrap 样本中优于更强固定策略。最终 AdaSkill 在 6 个性能聚合中赢 5 个，比源工作流快 2.4–17.7×；T2SQL EX 67.1 vs APEX-SQL 68.5，但成本低 38%、延迟低 3.6×；CE 推理时间省 52.9%、推理成本省 30.1%，六个性能-成本面板中均位于非支配前沿。Freedom 探针成本 $6.12（M=N=6），在 3–382 次部署查询后即摊平转换成本。

**稳健性**：GPT-5.1 复现保持负序（输出空间 r=−0.71、轨迹空间 r=−0.79，18 个 dataset–metric 元组）；无多样性规划器时在 M=N=20 收敛到同一打分序（0.55 vs 0.53、0.85 vs 0.85），说明规划器加速覆盖而非制造反转；MSA 估计在 N≥5 稳定，M>6 后边际变化很小。
AI.conclusion:
结论层面：(1) 能力资源与流水线指引遵循不同机制——前者扩展智能体"能做什么"，后者是对可达解空间施加源侧控制的结构干预，其价值由**行为-结果几何**决定；(2) Behavior-Outcome Freedom 捕捉该几何，是一个**合成前的有符号诊断量**，提供结构性转移的几何支撑与排序，但它是效应修饰因子而非候选收益的独立估计量，具体方向仍需匹配干预测量；(3) AdaSkill 证明该机制可转为可执行策略：保留经验证的能力资源、删除运行时协调、依冻结阈值有条件继承流水线指引，从而在四个结构化数据科学任务族上以更低部署开销取得强性能。

局限与需谨慎之处：结论限于带显式管线控制与客观评分的结构化数据科学工作流；F 是指标、agent、表示与协议条件化的统计量，且要求基座运行存在有意义的分数变异；部分单元格可识别问题数很少（Spider 的 NSF/SRR 仅 K=1、0，只能作审计记录），AUC=1.000 与 r=−0.797 基于 16 个干预单元，样本量小；阈值校准依赖开发regime，家族排除折间 t 从 0.426 到 0.692 波动，说明边界仍需按域重估。此外需注意版本不一致：所给摘要描述的是早期版本（"Metric Freedom"、两阶段自适应蒸馏框架、4 任务/11 数据集/6 指标、ρ=−0.62、成本 8×、延迟 15×、刚性阈值 F≲0.6），而 arXiv 全文已改为"Behavior-Outcome Freedom"+AdaSkill（16 组干预、斜率 −9.04、LOFO 阈值 0.426–0.692、成本降幅按 Table 10 为 30.1%、延迟 52.9%），引用时应以正文为准。

title: Thinking While Listening: Fast-Slow Recurrence for Long-Horizon Sequential Modeling
summary: We extend the recent latent recurrent modeling to sequential input streams. By interleaving fast, recurrent latent updates with self-organizational ability between slow observation updates, our method facilitates the learning of stable internal structures that evolve alongside the input. This mechanism allows the model to maintain coherent and clustered representations over long horizons, improving out-of-distribution generalization in reinforcement learning and algorithmic tasks compared to sequential baselines such as LSTM, state space models, and Transformer variants.

AI.tldr: 本文将近年面向静态输入的"潜在循环推理"（LRM/Looped Transformer）改造为可在流式数据上持续运行的"快–慢递归"模型 FSRM：每个观测到来时用同一权重的递归核心 R 连续更新潜在状态 T 次（T>1）且状态不在观测间重置，从而在有界内存下学到紧凑的流级规则。核心设计准则是"状态依赖转移"+"逐特征维度的非线性混合"，二者兼备的核（如 AKOrN+FFN、Transformer、LSTM+FFN）OOD 泛化最强。在 Dyck-(30,5)（训练长度≤40，长度 10^5 时仍约 80% 准确率，Qwen3-4B 微调后在 20480 长度跌至约 50% 随机）、Local-Maze（19×19→39×39，OOD 0.673 vs 基线 0.306）与 Minigrid（DoorKey/MultiRoom/LavaCrossing，PPO）三类任务上，FSRM 均显著优于 LSTM、Mamba2、Transformer/TransformerXL、Looped TF、CTM、DeltaProduct 等基线；消融表明权重共享（而非堆深度）是关键，且模型规模增大不会消除增益。
AI.motivation: 研究"训练短、测试长"的流式任务 OOD 泛化：在训练时只能看到很短（甚至只有十几到几十步）的观测流，测试时必须在长度未知、上下文无法增长、内存有界的条件下持续推断流背后的紧凑规则（如 Dyck 语言的栈规则、迷宫中的几何/最短路规则）。作者认为瓶颈不在表达力（Dyck 可由固定深度自注意力网络表达，日志精度 Transformer 属 TC^0），而在"从短数据中可学习性"（learnability），因此需要重新审视持续递归（persistent recurrence）作为架构偏置的价值。已有工作（HRM、CTM、Coconut、Looped Transformer、AKOrN 等）多针对静态输入，未解决跨观测持续推断流级规则的问题；FSRM 是"潜在递归 + 跨流持续状态"的最小架构对应物。
AI.method: 模型：FSRM（Fast–Slow Recurrent Model）。给定观测编码 C_s = Encoder(O_s)，潜在状态按 Z_s(t+1) = R(Z_s(t), C_s) 更新，t=0..T-1，且 Z_{s+1}(0) = Z_s(T)（不重置），即每个观测做 T 次权重共享的快速更新，观测时钟 s 比潜在时钟 t 慢 T 倍；T=1 退化为 RNN，T>1 等价于 weight-tied deep transition。解码在每个流位置输出。\n核心 R 的设计准则：(i) 状态依赖转移——转移中线性算子的系数本身依赖 Z（如注意力矩阵 AttnMat_θ(Z)、门控/选择性投影），排除 σ(AZ+BC) 形式；(ii) 逐特征（维度）混合——在每个 token 的 d 维内做非线性混合（如 per-token MLP），区别于跨 token 轴的注意力混合。文中用 Table 1 对 Conv、Attention、MLP-Mixer、LSTM、Mamba2、Transformer、Linear Transformer、AKOrN+FFN 逐一归类。默认配置为 AKOrN+FFN 核、T=5（Maze/Dyck）、T=10（Minigrid）。AKOrN 核实现包括自注意力、MLP、反对称频率矩阵 Ω_i 的旋转动量、切空间投影 Proj_Z、球面归一化，并可用 GTA 作位置编码；Dyck 采用两层层级 FSRM（第二层读入长度 H=4 的历史队列）。\n任务与基线：Dyck-(30,5) 栈预测（只打分闭合括号与 *，训练长度≤40，OOD 用 1-regular run）；Local-Maze（7×7 自我中心视图，19×19 训练→39×39 评估）；Minigrid 三任务 PPO（稀疏奖励、7×7 观测，训练截断反传仅最后 5 次迭代）。基线包括 LSTM、Mamba2/S5、Transformer、TransformerXL、DeltaProduct、Looped TF、CTM，以及提示下的前沿 LLM（Gemini 3.0 Pro、Claude Opus 4.5、GPT-5.1 Thinking）和 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-4B-Base。评价：ID 验证集选模型，OOD 泛化单独报告；3（或 5）随机种子均值±标准差。
AI.result:
主要结果：
1) Dyck-(30,5)：FSRM 在训练长度 40 之外维持约 80% token 准确率直到 10^5 长度（比训练长三个数量级）；基线在超出训练长度后迅速退化；前沿 LLM 随长度增加快速崩溃且受输出 token 预算限制只能可靠评估到约 10^3；微调 Qwen3-4B-Base 在 20480 长度跌至约 50% 随机水平，比 FSRM 差约一个数量级。
2) Local-Maze：FSRM OOD 准确率 0.673（T=8）vs 基线 0.306（T=1）；T 扫描 1→0.306、2→0.431、4→0.595、5→0.612、8/16→0.673（饱和）；权重共享对照：共享 T=5 约 61%，换成 5 层非共享堆叠仅约 51%（参数更多），10 层更降至约 45% 且方差更大——说明增益来自权重共享循环而非深度/参数量。
3) Minigrid：DoorKey、MultiRoom、LavaCrossing 上 FSRM 的零样本 OOD 成功率均高于 LSTM、Mamba2、TransformerXL。
4) 核消融：同时满足 (i)(ii) 的核最强；MLP-Mixer（有 (ii) 无 (i)）明显较弱；FFN 消融显示 Conv/Attn/AKOrN 在 Local-Maze 上加 FFN 收益大，而 LSTM/Mamba2 内部已含维度混合、增益有限（Dyck 上则一致受益）；单纯 Transformer 核在 Dyck 上失效，而同样基于 TF 的 AKOrN+FFN 成功，说明机制 (1) 释放了表达潜力。
5) 模型规模对照：通道 64/128/256 的 OOD 准确率 0.692/0.670/0.727，增容并未带来过拟合，增益不能用"模型更小"解释；FSRM 参数量比基线小约一个数量级。
6) 机制分析：线性探针显示 FSRM 在冻结隐状态中保留全部 5 层栈内容，且在深度 5→10 的深度 OOD 下仍稳健（基线仅保留栈顶或随 opener age 丢失信息）；PCA 潜变量遍历显示 AKOrN+FFN 形成与栈更新对齐的有序轨迹（OOD 96.9%），Mamba2(51.0%)/Attention(76.4%)/纯 Mamba2(50.0%) 缺乏同样连贯结构；能量轨迹显示第一层按 token 身份组织、第二层按栈深度组织。
7) 代价：T=5 时推理约为 Mamba/Transformer 基线的 3 倍慢（PyTorch 实现，无专用 kernel）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：把静态输入的潜在递归推理与"跨观测不重置的持续递归"结合（FSRM），可在有界内存下把短序列中学到的流级规则外推到远超训练长度与训练分布的时程，是提升流式任务 OOD 泛化的有效架构偏置；关键要素是每个观测的多次权重共享潜在更新、状态依赖转移与逐特征非线性混合的结合，权重共享比加深更有益。\n局限：(1) 以并行性换表达力，每个观测需 T 次前向，推理慢于优化良好的 RNN/SSM 实现（尚未利用专用 GPU kernel 与递归并行化）；(2) 实验局限于"存在紧凑流级结构"的任务，不保证任意时程/分布下的正确计算或通用长上下文推理；(3) 为隔离核设计而固定/控制了内环迭代数 T，未涉及自适应 halting 与学习式计算分配；此外附录与正文的图号/编号存在少量不一致（如正文引用的图 4 分栏与附录图表编号、RQ 编号重复）。未来方向：自适应终止、测试时 T 缩放的快–慢平衡、递归友好并行化。

title: Development and multi-center evaluation of domain-adapted speech recognition for human-AI teaming in real-world gastrointestinal endoscopy
comment: Under review at npj Digital Medicine
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) is a critical interface for human-AI interaction in gastrointestinal endoscopy, yet its reliability in real-world clinical settings is limited by domain-specific terminology and complex acoustic conditions. Here, we present EndoASR, a domain-adapted ASR system designed for real-time deployment in endoscopic workflows. We develop a two-stage adaptation strategy based on synthetic endoscopy reports, targeting domain-specific language modeling and noise robustness. In retrospective evaluation across six endoscopists, EndoASR substantially improves both transcription accuracy and clinical usability, reducing character error rate (CER) from 20.52% to 14.14% and increasing medical term accuracy (Med ACC) from 54.30% to 87.59%. In a prospective multi-center study spanning five independent endoscopy centers, EndoASR demonstrates consistent generalization under heterogeneous real-world conditions. Compared with the baseline Paraformer model, CER is reduced from 16.20% to 14.97%, while Med ACC is improved from 61.63% to 84.16%, confirming its robustness in practical deployment scenarios. Notably, EndoASR achieves a real-time factor (RTF) of 0.005, significantly faster than Whisper-large-v3 (RTF 0.055), while maintaining a compact model size of 220M parameters, enabling efficient edge deployment. Furthermore, integration with large language models demonstrates that improved ASR quality directly enhances downstream structured information extraction and clinician-AI interaction. These results demonstrate that domain-adapted ASR can serve as a reliable interface for human-AI teaming in gastrointestinal endoscopy, with consistent performance validated across multi-center real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: EndoASR是一个针对胃肠内镜领域优化的自动语音识别系统，通过两阶段自适应策略（基于合成内镜报告）提升专业术语识别和噪声鲁棒性。在六名内镜医师的回顾性评估中，字符错误率从20.52%降至14.14%，医学术语准确率从54.30%提升至87.59%。五中心前瞻性研究中，该系统保持稳定泛化能力，RTF仅为0.005（远低于Whisper-large-v3的0.055），参数量仅220M，验证了其在真实临床场景中的可靠性和边缘部署可行性。
AI.motivation: ASR是胃肠内镜中人机交互的关键接口，但现有系统在真实临床环境中受限于领域专业术语识别困难和复杂声学条件，可靠性不足。临床场景对医学术语准确率要求极高，但通用ASR模型难以应对。
AI.method: 开发两阶段自适应策略：基于合成内镜报告数据，针对领域特定语言建模和噪声鲁棒性分别优化。回顾性评估在六名内镜医师中进行，前瞻性研究覆盖五个独立内镜中心。
AI.result: 回顾性评估：CER从20.52%降至14.14%，Med ACC从54.30%升至87.59%。前瞻性多中心研究：CER从16.20%降至14.97%，Med ACC从61.63%升至84.16%。RTF达0.005（Whisper-large-v3为0.055），模型仅220M参数。集成LLM后，下游信息抽取和临床交互质量直接受益于ASR提升。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应ASR可作为胃肠内镜人机协作的可靠接口，多中心真实临床环境验证其性能一致性。紧凑模型（220M）和高效推理（RTF 0.005）支持边缘部署，为临床AI辅助诊断提供实用化语音交互基础。

title: GraphWalk: Enabling Reasoning in Large Language Models through Tool-Based Graph Navigation
summary: The use of knowledge graphs for grounding agents in real-world Q&A applications has become increasingly common. Answering complex queries often requires multi-hop reasoning and the ability to navigate vast relational structures. Standard approaches rely on prompting techniques that steer large language models to reason over raw graph context, or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines where relevant subgraphs are injected into the context. These, however, face severe limitations with enterprise-scale KGs that cannot fit in even the largest context windows available today. We present GraphWalk, a problem-agnostic, training-free, tool-based framework that allows off-the-shelf LLMs to reason through sequential graph navigation, dramatically increasing performance across different tasks. Unlike task-specific agent frameworks that encode domain knowledge into specialized tools, GraphWalk equips the LLM with a minimal set of orthogonal graph operations sufficient to traverse any graph structure. We evaluate whether models equipped with GraphWalk can compose these operations into correct multi-step reasoning chains, where each tool call represents a verifiable step creating a transparent execution trace. We first demonstrate our approach on maze traversal, a problem non-reasoning models are completely unable to solve, then present results on graphs resembling real-world enterprise knowledge graphs. To isolate structural reasoning from world knowledge, we evaluate on entirely synthetic graphs with random, non-semantic labels. Our benchmark spans 12 query templates from basic retrieval to compound first-order logic queries. Results show that tool-based traversal yields substantial and consistent gains over in-context baselines across all model families tested, with gains becoming more pronounced as scale increases, precisely where in-context approaches fail catastrophically.

AI.tldr: GraphWalk是一种无需训练、问题无关的工具框架，使LLM能够通过顺序图导航进行多跳推理，解决企业级知识图谱无法适应上下文窗口的问题。
AI.motivation: 企业级知识图谱规模庞大，无法适配现有最大上下文窗口；标准RAG和提示工程方法在处理复杂多跳推理时存在严重局限性。
AI.method: 提出GraphWalk框架，为LLM配备一套最小的正交图操作集（正交遍历任意图结构），通过顺序图导航进行推理，每个工具调用代表一个可验证的步骤，形成透明执行轨迹。
AI.result: 在迷宫遍历、模拟企业知识图谱及全合成图（随机非语义标签）上的实验表明，工具遍历在所有测试模型家族中均显著且一致地优于上下文基线方法，且随着模型规模增大提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: GraphWalk能够使LLM在完全合成图上完成从基础检索到复合一阶逻辑查询的12种查询模板，证明结构化推理能力可与世界知识解耦，工具调用方法在模型规模化场景下优势突出。

title: Variational LSTM with Augmented Inputs: Nonlinear Response History Metamodeling with Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty
summary: Uncertainty propagation in high-dimensional nonlinear dynamic structural systems is pivotal in state-of-the-art performance-based design and risk assessment, where uncertainties from both excitations and structures, i.e., the aleatoric uncertainty, must be considered. This poses a significant challenge due to heavy computational demands. Machine learning techniques are thus introduced as metamodels to alleviate this burden. However, the "black box" nature of Machine learning models underscores the necessity of avoiding overly confident predictions, particularly when data and training efforts are insufficient. This creates a need, in addition to considering the aleatoric uncertainty, of estimating the uncertainty related to the prediction confidence, i.e., epistemic uncertainty, for machine learning-based metamodels. We developed a probabilistic metamodeling technique based on a variational long short-term memory (LSTM) with augmented inputs to simultaneously capture aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties. Key random system parameters are treated as augmented inputs alongside excitation series carrying record-to-record variability to capture the full range of aleatoric uncertainty. Meanwhile, epistemic uncertainty is effectively approximated via the Monte Carlo dropout scheme. Unlike computationally expensive full Bayesian approaches, this method incurs negligible additional training costs while enabling nearly cost-free uncertainty simulation. The proposed technique is demonstrated through multiple case studies involving stochastic seismic or wind excitations. Results show that the calibrated metamodels accurately reproduce nonlinear response time histories and provide confidence bounds indicating the associated epistemic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"变分LSTM + 增强输入"（augmented inputs）的概率代理模型（metamodel）方法，用于高维非线性动力结构系统在随机地震/风激励下的不确定性传播。该方法将关键随机系统参数作为增强输入拼接至激振序列，以同时刻画偶然不确定性（record-to-record变异性 + 系统参数不确定性），并通过蒙特卡洛 dropout 近似后验权重分布来量化认知不确定性，从而以几乎为零的额外训练成本实现不确定性的高效模拟。
AI.motivation: 面向性能化设计与风险评估，需要在高维非线性动力结构中传播激励（record-to-record变异性）与结构本身（材料、阻尼等参数）的随机性，即完整的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）。现行做法依赖高保真非线性时程分析的蒙特卡洛重复计算，计算代价不可承受，故需借助代理模型。但已有深度序列模型（NARX、CNN、LSTM、DeepONet）仅能显式传播记录间变异性，无法纳入系统参数不确定性；且"黑箱"性质使模型在数据与训练不足时易产生过度自信的预测，缺少对认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty，即预测置信度）的量化，这在安全关键任务中尤其危险。Kriging难以处理高维序列-序列映射，全贝叶斯/MCMC与Bootstrap在大模型下计算代价过高，Kullback-Leibler散度与后验解析解不可得。因此需要一种可扩展、能同时覆盖两类不确定性且计算开销可忽略的序列-序列代理建模框架。
AI.method: 整体框架由四步组成：(1) 数据生成——通过高保真数值积分（MATLAB四阶Runge-Kutta、OpenSees 3.7.1）求解含随机激励与随机系统参数的动力平衡方程，生成激励-系统-响应数据集D；(2) 数据处理——先做基于SVD的正交分解（POD）降维（保留能量占比达99.99%的前若干模态），再采用小波变换（6阶Daubechies）降采样以缩短时间序列，随后将系统参数实现θ复制为常数序列并与降维激振小波系数拼接成增强输入[c_p, θ]，同时对输入输出做归一化；(3) 网络校准——采用输入层 + 200隐藏单元的LSTM层 + 全连接层架构（输出为响应小波系数序列），在全连接层施加20% dropout以实现变分推断；由KL散度推导得到对偶形式的对数证据下界（ELBO），其等价于带dropout与L2正则的平方损失（本文取σ²→0以保持确定性映射）；小批量Adam优化、验证集监控早停，dropout掩码在整个时间序列上保持一致；(4) 不确定性传播——推理阶段生成多个dropout网络实现，对每组增强输入做MC采样得到响应集合，构造95%置信区间；激励与系统参数实现本身通过蒙特卡洛重复实现体现偶然不确定性。理论层面给出了后验预测分布、KL散度—ELBO推导、高斯混合变分分布（Gal & Ghahramani）与伯努利掩码的实现细节。
AI.result: 三个算例验证：(1) SDOF Bouc-Wen体系（随机参数ω、α，200组激励-系统对，Rezaeian-Der Kiureghian随机地震动模型），LSTM位移时历与数值解吻合，误差极小，峰位移沿等值线分布；(2) 六层非线性剪切建筑模型（Giuffre-Menegotto-Pinto本构，随机层重w与屈服后刚度比α，1000组30秒地震动+OpenSees直接积分），3层与6层DoF的位移时历、峰位移及层间滞回曲线均高度吻合，MC dropout给出滞回曲线的认知不确定性集合；(3) 37层钢框架（150m高，风洞数据驱动的POD风荷载模型生成600 s平稳风时程，随机Rayleigh阻尼因子η对数正态分布），基于3个POD模态降维，位移时历几乎零误差、峰位移沿等值线分布，且可通过逆小波变换+模态叠加快速恢复应变时历与构件纤维滞回曲线。值得注意的是，局部响应（应变、滞回）的认知不确定性显著高于整体位移——因局部响应由位移反推、对位移扰动敏感，而这一现象只有在显式量化认知不确定性时才可被发现。训练代价：算例1约671分钟（4万epoch），算例2约191分钟（1500 epoch），算例3约70分钟（2400 epoch）。
AI.conclusion: 所提变分LSTM增强输入代理模型可有效传播完整的偶然不确定性（记录间变异性+系统不确定性）与认知不确定性（通过MC dropout以置信区间和响应实现集合形式给出），弥补了现有深度序列代理模型仅能处理记录间变异性的缺陷，且相比全贝叶斯方法的训练额外开销可忽略、不确定性模拟近乎零成本；POD降维+小波降采样有效支撑了高维长时程结构的可扩展应用（验证至37层足尺钢框架、600 s风激励）。其工程意义在于为基于性能的设计与风险评估提供了定量刻画"有限数据与训练努力所带来的附加风险"的手段。局限与展望方面：系统不确定性通过输入增强注入，维度高时需借助敏感性分析与PCA筛选关键参数；模型仍不具备传统数值求解器的物理有效性保证，置信区间宽度依赖数据量与训练程度，故需按算例设定dropout率等超参并谨慎解读置信区间。

title: Optimizing EEG Graph Structure for Seizure Detection: An Information Bottleneck and Self-Supervised Learning Approach
comment: Accepted by IEEE 14th International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI)
summary: Seizure detection from EEG signals is highly challenging due to complex spatiotemporal dynamics and extreme inter-patient variability. To model them, recent methods construct dynamic graphs via statistical correlations, predefined similarity measures, or implicit learning, yet rarely account for EEG's noisy nature. Consequently, these graphs usually contain redundant or task-irrelevant connections, undermining model performance even with state-of-the-art architectures. In this paper, we present a new perspective for EEG seizure detection: jointly learning denoised dynamic graph structures and informative spatial-temporal representations guided by the Information Bottleneck (IB). Unlike prior approaches, our graph constructor explicitly accounts for the noisy characteristics of EEG data, producing compact and reliable connectivity patterns that better support downstream seizure detection. To further enhance representation learning, we employ a self-supervised Graph Masked AutoEncoder that reconstructs masked EEG signals based on dynamic graph context, promoting structure-aware and compact representations aligned with the IB principle. Bringing things together, we introduce Information Bottleneck-guided EEG SeizuRE DetectioN via SElf-Supervised Learning (IRENE), which explicitly learns dynamic graph structures and interpretable spatial-temporal EEG representations. IRENE addresses three core challenges: (i) Identifying the most informative nodes and edges; (ii) Explaining seizure propagation in the brain network; and (iii) Enhancing robustness against label scarcity and inter-patient variability.
