Extensive experiments on benchmark EEG datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in seizure detection and provides clinically meaningful insights into seizure dynamics. The source code is available at https://github.com/LabRAI/IRENE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IRENE框架：把信息瓶颈（IB）作为图结构学习的约束，通过自表达（self-expressiveness）公式显式学习EEG各导联的动态连接矩阵A_t，并用InfoNCE下界最大化I(A;Y)、Donsker-Varadhan上界压缩I(A;Z)，辅以时间平滑正则；再将IB学到的边置信度φ=|A(i,j)|注入Graph Transformer注意力（GSA-Attn），配合图掩码自编码器（GraphMAE，掩码率15%）做自监督预训练，最后两阶段微调完成癫痫检测与多类别分类。在TUSZ v1.5.2上，IRENE在12s/60s片段的检测任务取得F1 0.749/0.753、AUROC 0.908/0.916，全面优于LSTM、ResNet-LSTM、Dist-DCRNN、Corr-DCRNN、NeuroGNN、GraphS4mer；其学习到的图边密度仅0.16，接近专家标注真值图（0.0636 vs 0.0575），可定位F7、T3、T5等发作关键电极，具备临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: 癫痫检测需从含噪的多导联EEG中建模复杂的时空动态与脑区连接，但现有方法构造动态图时多依赖统计相关性（互相关）、预定义相似度（距离/时序/语义）或隐式学习，几乎未考虑EEG的强噪声特性，导致图结构包含大量冗余、与任务无关甚至虚假的连接；且预定义图在训练中固定、不可优化，限制了GNN消息传递的质量。此外，现有工作多将图结构与下游检测任务解耦，缺少生理合理性约束机制；而临床标注昂贵导致标签稀缺，且EEG存在严重的患者间与采集条件差异。因此需要一个显式学习、稀疏、任务相关、可解释且对标签稀缺鲁棒的图结构学习框架。
AI.method: IRENE（Information Bottleneck-guided EEG SeizuRE DetectioN via SElf-Supervised Learning）。整体为"图构建 + 结构感知编码器-解码器"两阶段框架。（1）信号处理：原始EEG转到频域以捕捉神经振荡，切分为12s/60s非重叠片段并z-score归一化。（2）IB引导的动态图构建：共享编码器将每个通道特征映射为节点嵌入Z_t∈R^{N×d×T}，用自表达形式 z_i = Σ_{j≠i} A_t(i,j) z_j 学习邻接矩阵A_t；目标函数 L_IB-Graph = ||Z_t − Z_t A_t||_F^2（自表达重建）+ λ1 I(A_t;Z_t)（冗余压缩）− λ2 I(A_t;Y_t)（信息最大化），互信息用InfoNCE对比下界估计I(A;Y)、Donsker-Varadhan变分上界估计I(A;Z)；另加时间一致性正则 L_smooth = ||A_t − A_{t−1}||_F^2 促使连接矩阵平滑演化；最终对|A_t(i,j)|做Min-Max归一化并按节点Top-K稀疏化得到Ã_t∈[0,1]^{N×N}。（3）结构感知编码器：每个block含两层GCN（由A*_t引导，捕捉局部邻域）与Graph Transformer块（全局自注意力）；GSA-Attn将边置信度φ_ij=|A_t(i,j)|以可学习系数γ加入注意力logit：α_ij = softmax_j(q_i^T k_j/√d + γ·φ_ij)，后接残差与LayerNorm。（4）自监督预训练：节点级（通道级patch）掩码（默认15%，替换为零向量或可学习token），解码器用共享MLP从隐表示重建被掩码节点特征，损失 L_pretrain = L_IB-Graph + λ3 L_smooth + λ4 L_recon（MSE）。（5）微调：冻结编码器，接MLP分类头，用交叉熵损失训练检测与多类别发作分类任务；训练用Adam（lr 3e-4，weight decay 1e-5），batch 32/64，5个随机种子取均值，验证AUROC早停。
AI.result: 在TUSZ v1.5.2（5612条EEG、3050条发作标注、19通道）上：检测任务12s片段 IRENE F1 0.749、Recall 0.782、AUROC 0.908，60s片段 F1 0.753、Recall 0.788、AUROC 0.916，均优于基线（Dist-DCRNN 0.713/0.695 F1，Corr-DCRNN 0.729/0.722，GraphS4mer 0.690/0.680，NeuroGNN 0.647/0.698，LSTM 0.580/0.592）；混淆矩阵显示对CF、GN、AB、CT等难检发作类型提升明显。RQ2：将IRENE中的IB图替换为其他构图方式后F1均下降（距离图0.705/0.709、互相关0.710/0.712、时序/语义相似更高但仍不及IB图）；边密度上IB图仅0.16，远低于互相关0.72、时序0.47、语义0.38、距离0.31。RQ3：消融显示去掉预训练下降最大（60s检测F1 0.721、AUROC 0.881），去掉IB图0.728/0.884，去掉GSA-Attn 0.733，去掉重建损失0.737，去掉时间平滑0.744，全量自编码0.732，而完整模型0.753/0.916（分类0.774/0.918）。可解释性：IRENE学习图的平均边密度0.0636，接近专家标注真值图0.0575（互相关0.369、时序0.197、语义0.183），且在发作期能强化F7、T3、T5等颞/中央/额区电极连接，与发作起始/传播模式吻合。
AI.conclusion: IRENE通过显式的IB引导动态图构建，把"图结构"本身作为瓶颈变量进行优化，得到稀疏、任务相关且具生理合理性的脑连接结构；再结合GSA-Attn结构先验与图掩码自编码器的自监督预训练，有效缓解标签稀缺与患者间差异，在TUSZ基准上一致超越现有图学习与深度学习基线，并提供可定位发作传播区域与致痫灶的可解释图，对临床诊断、手术规划及其他图结构化生物信号建模任务具有潜力。未来可扩展到更多图型生物信号任务并进一步强化临床验证。

title: Human-Guided Reasoning with Large Language Models for Vietnamese Speech Emotion Recognition
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Dataset of 2,764 Vietnamese speech samples across three emotion classes
summary: Vietnamese Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) remains challenging due to ambiguous acoustic patterns and the lack of reliable annotated data, especially in real-world conditions where emotional boundaries are not clearly separable. To address this problem, this paper proposes a human-machine collaborative framework that integrates human knowledge into the learning process rather than relying solely on data-driven models. The proposed framework is centered around LLM-based reasoning, where acoustic feature-based models are used to provide auxiliary signals such as confidence and feature-level evidence. A confidence-based routing mechanism is introduced to distinguish between easy and ambiguous samples, allowing uncertain cases to be delegated to LLMs for deeper reasoning guided by structured rules derived from human annotation behavior. In addition, an iterative refinement strategy is employed to continuously improve system performance through error analysis and rule updates. Experiments are conducted on a Vietnamese speech dataset of 2,764 samples across three emotion classes (calm, angry, panic), with high inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss Kappa = 0.8574), ensuring reliable ground truth. The proposed method achieves strong performance, reaching up to 86.59% accuracy and Macro F1 around 0.85-0.86, demonstrating its effectiveness in handling ambiguous and hard-to-classify cases. Overall, this work highlights the importance of combining data-driven models with human reasoning, providing a robust and model-agnostic approach for speech emotion recognition in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种人机协同的越南语语音情感识别框架，通过LLM推理和置信度路由机制处理模糊情感样本，在2,764个样本上达到86.59%准确率和0.85-0.86的Macro F1分数。
AI.motivation: 越南语语音情感识别(SER)面临挑战，原因包括：1) 声学模式模糊；2) 可靠标注数据匮乏；3) 现实场景中情感边界不清晰，难以分离。
AI.method: 提出人机协同框架：1) 基于LLM的推理中心；2) 基于声学特征的模型提供置信度和特征级证据；3) 置信度路由机制区分易分/模糊样本；4) 迭代优化策略（错误分析+规则更新）；5) 模糊样本由LLM基于结构化规则进行深度推理。
AI.result: 在越南语语音数据集（2,764样本，3类情感：平静/愤怒/恐慌）上验证，标注者一致性高（Fleiss Kappa = 0.8574）。方法达到86.59%准确率，Macro F1约0.85-0.86，有效处理模糊难分类样本。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调数据驱动模型与人类推理结合的重要性，提供了一种适用于低资源场景的鲁棒且模型无关的语音情感识别方法。

title: OSCAR: Orchestrated Self-verification and Cross-path Refinement
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose their denoising trajectories, offering a natural handle for inference-time control; accordingly, an ideal hallucination mitigation framework should intervene during generation using this model-native signal rather than relying on an externally trained hallucination classifier. Toward this, we formulate commitment uncertainty localization: given a denoising trajectory, identify token positions whose cross-chain entropy exceeds an unsupervised threshold before factually unreliable commitments propagate into self-consistent but incorrect outputs. We introduce a suite of trajectory-level assessments, including a cross-chain divergence-at-hallucination (CDH) metric, for principled comparison of localization methods. We also introduce OSCAR, a training-free inference-time framework operationalizing this formulation. OSCAR runs N parallel denoising chains with randomized reveal orders, computes cross-chain Shannon entropy to detect high-uncertainty positions, and then performs targeted remasking conditioned on retrieved evidence. Ablations confirm that localization and correction contribute complementary gains, robust across N in {4, 8, 16}. On TriviaQA, HotpotQA, RAGTruth, and CommonsenseQA using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, OSCAR enhances generation quality by significantly reducing hallucinated content and improving factual accuracy through uncertainty-guided remasking, which also facilitates more effective integration of retrieved evidence. Its native entropy-based uncertainty signal surpasses that of specialized trained detectors, highlighting an inherent capacity of diffusion language models to identify factual uncertainty that is not present in the sequential token commitment structure of autoregressive models. We are releasing the codebase1 to support future research on localization and uncertainty-aware generation in DLMs.

AI.tldr: OSCAR是一个无需训练的推理时框架，通过分析扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹，利用跨链香农熵检测高不确定性token位置，然后基于检索证据进行定向重掩码，从而有效减少幻觉并提升事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉缓解方法依赖外部训练的分类器，而非利用扩散语言模型原生的去噪轨迹信号。扩散模型的去噪轨迹为推理时控制提供了天然的处理窗口，但在生成过程中缺乏有效的机制来识别和纠正不可靠的token承诺，导致自洽但错误的内容传播。
AI.method: 提出承诺不确定性定位 formulation：给定去噪轨迹，识别跨链熵超过无监督阈值的token位置，防止不可靠承诺传播。引入跨链分叉-幻觉(CDH)指标评估定位方法。OSCAR框架运行N条并行去噪链（随机揭示顺序），计算跨链香农熵检测高不确定性位置，然后基于检索证据进行定向重掩码修正。
AI.result: 在TriviaQA、HotpotQA、RAGTruth和CommonsenseQA数据集上，使用LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B模型，OSCAR显著减少幻觉内容并提升事实准确性。该方法在N∈{4,8,16}配置下均表现稳健。定位和修正组件提供互补增益。其原生熵基不确定性信号优于专用训练检测器。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型具有识别事实不确定性的内在能力，这是自回归模型顺序token承诺结构所不具备的。该工作为DLM中定位和不确定性感知生成的后续研究提供了基础。

title: Learning from the Right Rollouts: Data Attribution for PPO-based LLM Post-Training
summary: Traditional RL algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) typically train on the entire rollout buffer, operating under the assumption that all generated episodes provide a beneficial optimization signal. However, these episodes frequently contain noisy or unfaithful reasoning, which can degrade model performance and slow down training. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Influence-Guided PPO (I-PPO)}, a novel framework that integrates data attribution into the RL post-training loop. By calculating an influence score for each episode using a gradient-based approximation, I-PPO identifies and eliminates episodes that are anti-aligned with a validation gradient. Our experiments demonstrate that I-PPO consistently outperforms SFT and PPO baselines. We show that our filtering process acts as an intrinsic early stopping mechanism, accelerating training efficiency while effectively reducing unfaithful CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: I-PPO是一种将数据归因技术融入RL后训练流程的新型框架，通过梯度近似计算每个episode的影响分数，识别并剔除与验证梯度反对齐的样本，从而提升训练效率并减少不忠实思维链推理。
AI.motivation: 传统PPO算法对所有 rollout 数据进行训练，假设所有生成的episode都能提供有益的优化信号。然而，这些episode经常包含噪声或不忠实的推理过程，这会降低模型性能并减慢训练速度。
AI.method: I-PPO通过梯度近似方法计算每个episode的影响分数（influence score），识别并剔除与验证梯度反对齐（anti-aligned）的episode。
AI.result: I-PPO在实验中一致性地优于SFT和PPO基线方法。过滤过程起到内在早停机制的作用，在加速训练效率的同时有效减少不忠实的CoT推理。
AI.conclusion: 数据归因技术可作为RL后训练中的有效样本筛选机制，通过主动识别和移除有害样本，能显著提升训练效率并改善模型输出的忠实度。

title: Detecting Toxic Language: Ontology and BERT-based Approaches for Bulgarian Text
summary: Toxic content detection in online communication remains a significant challenge, with current solutions often inadvertently blocking valuable information, including medical terms and text related to minority groups. This paper presents a more nu-anced approach to identifying toxicity in Bulgarian text while preserving access to essential information. The research explores two distinct methodologies for detecting toxic content. The developed methodologies have po-tential applications across diverse online platforms and content moderation systems. First, we propose an ontology that models the potentially toxic words in Bulgarian language. Then, we compose a dataset that comprises 4,384 manually anno-tated sentences from Bulgarian online forums across four categories: toxic language, medical terminology, non-toxic lan-guage, and terms related to minority communities. We then train a BERT-based model for toxic language classification, which reaches a 0.89 F1 macro score. The trained model is directly applicable in a real environment and can be integrated as a com-ponent of toxic content detection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对保加利亚语文本开发了一个细粒度有毒内容检测系统，通过构建本体模型和标注语料库（4,384句），训练BERT模型达到0.89的F1宏分数，在识别有毒内容的同时保留医疗术语和少数群体相关信息的访问。
AI.motivation: 当前有毒内容检测方案存在过度屏蔽问题，会错误拦截医疗术语和少数群体相关文本，导致有价值信息丢失。需要开发一种更精细的方法，在检测有害内容的同时保留对必要信息的访问。
AI.method: 研究提出两个核心方法：(1) 构建保加利亚语潜在有毒词汇本体模型；(2) 标注保加利亚语在线论坛语料库，包含4,384个手动标注句子，分为四类：有毒语言、医疗术语、非有毒语言、少数群体相关术语；基于标注数据训练BERT分类模型。
AI.result: BERT模型在保加利亚语有毒内容分类任务上达到0.89的F1宏分数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可直接应用于实际环境，作为有毒内容检测系统的组件集成到各类在线平台和内容审核系统中，具有跨平台泛化潜力。

title: Exploring Robust Multi-Agent Workflows for Environmental Data Management
summary: Embedding LLM-driven agents into environmental FAIR data management is compelling - they can externalize operational knowledge and scale curation across heterogeneous data and evolving conventions. However, replacing deterministic components with probabilistic workflows changes the failure mode: LLM pipelines may generate plausible but incorrect outputs that pass superficial checks and propagate into irreversible actions such as DOI minting and public release. We introduce EnviSmart, a production data management system deployed on campus-wide storage infrastructure for environmental research. EnviSmart treats reliability as an architectural property through two mechanisms: a three-track knowledge architecture that externalizes behaviors (governance constraints), domain knowledge (retrievable context), and skills (tool-using procedures) as persistent, interlocking artifacts; and a role-separated multi-agent design where deterministic validators and audited handoffs restore fail-stop semantics at trust boundaries before irreversible steps. We compare two production deployments. The University's GIS Center Ecological Archive (849 curated datasets) serves as a single-agent baseline. SF2Bench, a compound flooding benchmark comprising 2,452 monitoring stations and 8,557 published files spanning 39 years, validates the multi-agent workflow. The multi-agent approach improved both efficiency - completed by a single operator in two days with repeated artifact reuse across deployments - and reliability: audited handoffs detected and blocked a coordinate transformation error affecting all 2,452 stations before publication. A representative incident (ISS-004) demonstrated boundary-based containment with 10-minute detection latency, zero user exposure, and 80-minute resolution. This paper has been accepted at PEARC 2026.

AI.tldr: EnviSmart将LLM驱动的智能体嵌入环境FAIR数据管理，通过三轨知识架构（治理约束、领域知识、技能程序）和角色分离的多智能体设计，将可靠性作为架构属性，实现确定性验证器和审计交接以恢复失效停止语义，在SF2Bench基准测试中成功阻止了影响全部2452个监测站的坐标转换错误。
AI.motivation: 环境FAIR数据管理需要LLM智能体来扩展异构数据的策展，但概率性工作流改变了故障模式——LLM可能生成表面合理但实际错误的输出，并传播到DOI申请和公开发布等不可逆操作，需要重新设计可靠性机制。
AI.method: 1) 三轨知识架构：将行为（治理约束）、领域知识（可检索上下文）和技能（工具使用程序）外部化为持久化、互锁的制品；2) 角色分离多智能体设计：确定性验证器和审计交接在信任边界处恢复失效停止语义，在不可逆步骤前进行拦截。
AI.result: 多智能体方法在效率上实现单操作员两天完成、跨部署制品复用；在可靠性方面，审计交接检测并阻止了影响全部2452个监测站的坐标转换错误；ISS-004事件展示边界隔离，10分钟检测延迟、零用户暴露、80分钟解决。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体方法结合确定性验证器和审计交接能有效平衡LLM驱动数据管理的效率与可靠性，将可靠性从隐性需求转化为架构属性，为环境数据管理提供可验证的AI系统范式。

title: Training In-Context and In-Weights Mixtures Via Contrastive Context Sampling
summary:
We investigate training strategies that co-develop in-context learning (ICL) and in-weights learning (IWL), and the ability to switch between them based on context relevance. Although current LLMs exhibit both modes, standard task-specific fine-tuning often erodes ICL, motivating IC-Train - fine-tuning with in-context examples. Prior work has shown that emergence of ICL after IC-Train depends on factors such as task diversity and training duration.
  In this paper we show that the similarity structure between target inputs and context examples also plays an important role. Random context leads to loss of ICL and IWL dominance, while only similar examples in context causes ICL to degenerate to copying labels without regard to relevance. To address this, we propose a simple Contrastive-Context which enforces two types of contrasts: (1) mix of similar and random examples within a context to evolve a correct form of ICL, and (2) varying grades of similarity across contexts to evolve ICL-IWL mixtures. We present insights on the importance of such contrast with theoretical analysis of a minimal model. We validate with extensive empirical evaluation on four LLMs and several tasks. Diagnostic probes confirm that contrasted contexts yield stable ICL-IWL mixtures, avoiding collapse into pure ICL, IWL, or copying.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何协同训练模型的上下文内学习(ICL)和权重内学习(IWL)能力，提出Contrastive-Context方法，通过在上下文中混合相似和随机样本以及变化相似度等级，避免ICL退化为纯ICL、纯IWL或简单复制，实现稳定的ICL-IWL混合能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型虽同时具备ICL和IWL能力，但标准任务特定微调会侵蚀ICL能力。虽然已有IC-Train方法（通过上下文示例进行微调）可恢复ICL，但ICL的出现依赖于任务多样性和训练时长等因素。本文发现目标输入与上下文示例之间的相似性结构也是关键因素，但现有方法尚未充分考虑这一维度。
AI.method: 1. 分析相似性结构对ICL的影响：随机上下文导致ICL和IWL主导地位丧失；仅使用相似示例则使ICL退化为不考虑相关性的标签复制。2. 提出Contrastive-Context方法，包含两种对比机制：(1) 在上下文中混合相似和随机示例，培养正确形式的ICL；(2) 跨上下文变化相似度等级，培养ICL-IWL混合能力。3. 采用最小模型进行理论分析，并在大语言模型和多种任务上进行广泛实证验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用对比上下文的模型能够产生稳定的ICL-IWL混合能力，避免崩溃为纯ICL、纯IWL或简单复制模式。诊断探测证实了对比上下文策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 相似性结构是ICL发展的关键因素。Contrastive-Context通过引入对比机制（相似-随机混合和相似度等级变化），可有效训练出能够根据上下文相关性灵活切换ICL和IWL的模型。该方法为理解ICL与IWL的协同发展提供了新的视角。

title: LiveMathematicianBench: A Live Benchmark for Mathematician-Level Reasoning with Proof Sketches
summary: Mathematical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, and whether large language models (LLMs) can meaningfully perform it remains a central question in artificial intelligence and cognitive science. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, rigorous evaluation of their mathematical capabilities becomes a practical necessity. Existing benchmarks are limited by synthetic settings and data contamination. We present LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic multiple-choice benchmark for research-level mathematical reasoning built from recent arXiv papers published after model training cutoffs. By grounding evaluation in newly published theorems, it provides a realistic testbed beyond memorized patterns. The benchmark introduces a thirteen-category logical taxonomy of theorem types (e.g., implication, equivalence, existence, uniqueness), enabling fine-grained evaluation across reasoning forms. It employs a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline that uses high-level proof strategies to construct plausible but invalid answer choices reflecting misleading proof directions, increasing sensitivity to genuine understanding over surface-level matching. We also introduce a substitution-resistant mechanism to distinguish answer recognition from substantive reasoning. Evaluation shows the benchmark is far from saturated: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the best model, achieves only 43.5%. Under substitution-resistant evaluation, accuracy drops sharply: GPT-5.4 scores highest at 30.6%, while Gemini-3.1-pro-preview falls to 17.6%, below the 20% random baseline. A dual-mode protocol reveals that proof-sketch access yields consistent accuracy gains, suggesting models can leverage high-level proof strategies for reasoning. Overall, LiveMathematicianBench offers a scalable, contamination-resistant testbed for studying research-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: LiveMathematicianBench 是一个"活"的、可持续刷新的研究级数学推理基准：从模型训练截止日之后发表的 arXiv 论文中自动抽取主定理，按 13 类逻辑形式分类，生成带"证明梗概"引导的对抗性干扰项五选一题目，并引入"抗替换"选项机制以区分真正的推理与答案识别。发布版本含 177 道 hard 题；最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 仅 43.5%，在抗替换评测下 GPT-5.4 以 30.6% 领先而 Gemini 跌至 17.6%（低于 20% 随机基线）；提供证明梗概可带来约 +12~14 个百分点提升。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理基准（GSM8K、MATH、AIME、MathVista、Omni-Math、OlympiadBench、PutnamBench 等）多为竞赛式/合成题目，重计算、奖励启发式模式匹配，无法反映真实数学研究的本质（抽象、对技术性假设敏感、无预设解题路径），且前沿模型已饱和（常>90%）并因训练语料泄漏而记忆解题模板，改写题面或数值即崩塌。RealMath 虽直接取材 arXiv 降低污染风险，但只覆盖可自动验证的定理类型，缺少不等式、渐近关系、非构造性论证等常见研究任务。核心诉求有三：(1) 评测对象从"解题/考试"转向"定理理解与假设把握"；(2) 用持续可刷新、构造上无污染的真实研究材料替代静态数据集；(3) 区分"识别出正确陈述"与"实质性数学推理"（如选项替换、排除法等捷径）。
AI.method:
7 阶段自动化流水线（外加人工质检与源作者验证）：
1. 论文检索：按月抓取 arXiv API 的 math.* 类论文，严格晚于模型训练截止日，构造上无污染；
2. LaTeX 源提取：解析 e-print 归档，展开 \input/\include、剥离注释、拼接全文；
3. 定理抽取与分类：混合 agentic 架构——规则快路径（仅在 Introduction 中按 \newtheorem 环境优先级提取 theorem，失败时回退 LLM agent），配合自定义宏展开、\ref/\eqref 交叉引用解析（生成自足的 Expanded Theorem）、两层上下文恢复（前置段落加权打分 + 全文字锚术语检索）；再由 LLM 提炼 proof sketch；并按定理的逻辑形式划分为 13 类（算法/构造、渐近/极限、双条件/等价、分类/双射、存在、存在–全称、蕴含、独立性/相容性、不等式/界、不存在、唯一性、全称、全称–存在）；
4. 题目生成：按类别使用 13 套定制 system prompt 生成自足题干与正确项（要求"最强结论"式表述并锁定单一决定性数学特征，如量词作用域、界的锐性、渐近区间、存在 vs 唯一），含红旗检查与修复流程；再由 proof sketch 引导生成 4 个干扰项，采用四类扰动（受控扰动、语义弱化、语义强化、性质混淆）且随定理类型定制，并附对抗性复核改写；另设"抗替换"机制——对一定比例题目将正确项替换为元选项"其余选项中有一个正确，但可证明更强的结论"，要求模型同时判定真项与更强结论是否成立；质量量表 0–8（答案泄漏 ALS、套话回避 TAS、生成压力 GPS、干扰项质量 DQS），低于 5 分者剔除；
5. 干跑回溯过滤：仅给题干（不给选项）让裁判模型作答，若仅凭题干即可答对则判为 stem-trivial 并剔除；
6. 难度校准：每定理超量生成两套干扰项，用中等推理强度前沿模型测试，选出"模型答错但质量分最高"的最难变体，全对的定理整组丢弃；
7. 评测协议：双模态（Mode 1 选择题；Mode 2 提供证明梗概的 sketch-aware 选择），选项经确定性洗牌重标 A–E，全部题目 LaTeX 编译校验/自动修复。
最终 hard split 含 177 题（2025年11月–2026年2月各月切片），全部题目经研究级数学家复核，并在每个逻辑类别分层抽检约 10 例中间产物；另向源论文作者发出 10 份验证问卷（上下文充分性 7.8/10、是否捕捉承重内容 7.4/10、陈述改写准确性 7.3/10）。附录 E 另做 98 题固定定理消融，验证 sketch/类别引导/对抗复核三个组件对干扰项难度与准确率的影响。
AI.result: 标准设置下：Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 最高 43.5%，GPT-5.4(high) 41.8%，GPT-5.4(medium) 41.2%，远未饱和（随机 20%）。类别维度无单一模型全面占优：Gemini 在双条件/等价、分类/双射上更强，GPT-5.4 系列在蕴含、全称、不等式/界上更强；月度轨迹在切片间波动（部分模型 2026/01 最优但 2026/02 又回落），说明研究级推理不是单一维度能力。抗替换子集上（原选项子集 Gemini 达 67.4%、GPT-5.4 为 52.2%）：所有模型准确率骤降，GPT-5.4 以 30.6%（29.4%–30.6%）居首且仍高于随机，而 Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 跌至 17.6%，低于 20% 随机基线，表明模型高度依赖选项替换捷径。证明梗概带来一致增益：GPT-5.4(high) 41.8%→53.7%（+11.9pp），Gemini-3.1-pro-preview(high) 43.5%→57.1%（+13.6pp），且在抗替换子集上同样有效（Gemini 在该子集增益尤大），说明梗概提供的是承重结构信息而非定理复述。消融显示完整流程使求解器准确率从 72.4% 降至 61.2%（难度 +11.2pp），其中 proof sketch 贡献最大（去掉后升至 75.5%），类别感知引导贡献 +2.1pp，对抗复核 +1.0pp。成本分析显示 GPT-5.4 位于精度–token 前沿（high 41.8% 约 7.0k completion token，medium 41.2% 约 3.8k），而 Gemini 需约 15.3k，Qwen/Kimi/GPT-oss 消耗更高 token 但准确率不占优，说明单纯增加推理预算不足以提升研究级数学判断。
AI.conclusion: LiveMathematicianBench 通过"持续刷新 + 逻辑分类 + 证明梗概"三支柱，在构造上规避污染、把评测从陈述识别推向策略级理解，并成为可扩展的诊断性测试床：既可作为排行榜，也可用于定位模型在特定逻辑形式（蕴含、等价、存在、唯一性、渐近、界等）上的系统性弱点，进而回答"为何某些模型在某些推理形式上更强"这一可解释性问题，并支撑证明引导推理、工具使用与交互式数学探索等后续研究。论文也指出两点局限：基准只验证生成题目忠实于源论文陈述，并不独立认证源论文定理的正确性（依赖作者反馈与人工复核来降低但无法消除提取/继承误差）；源作者验证样本仅 10 份，非同行评审级验证。此外，选项设计本身会显著改变所测能力——抗替换选项暴露了标准多选题设置下的捷径依赖，这既解释了 Gemini 与 GPT-5.4 排名倒置，也说明基准设计是能力度量的关键变量。

title: ThinknCheck: Grounded Claim Verification with Compact, Reasoning-Driven, and Interpretable Models
summary: We present ThinknCheck, a 1B-parameter verifier for grounded claim verification that first produces a short, structured rationale and then a binary verdict. We construct LLMAggreFact-Think, a 24.1k reasoning-augmented training set derived from LLMAggreFact, and fine-tune a 4-bit Gemma3 model to follow this format. On LLMAggreFact, ThinknCheck attains 78.1 balanced accuracy (BAcc), surpassing MiniCheck-7B (77.4) with 7x fewer parameters; removing the reasoning step reduces BAcc to 57.5. On SciFact, ThinknCheck reaches 64.7 BAcc, a +14.7 absolute gain over MiniCheck-7B. By contrast, zero-shot chain-of-thought on the base Gemma3-1B harms accuracy relative to direct answers, and preference optimization with a simple format+accuracy reward underperforms supervised reasoning. To probe the latter, we introduce GSMClaims and a domain-specialized variant, ThinknCheck-Science, which improves across benchmarks, including 61.0\% accuracy on GSMClaims. Overall, explicit, supervised reasoning enables compact verifiers that are competitive while remaining resource-efficient and interpretable.

AI.tldr: ThinknCheck 是一个 1B 参数的文档级事实核查（claim verification）模型：先输出简短结构化推理链（<REASONING>），再给出二分类判定（<SOLUTION>: YES/NO）。作者用 GPT-4o-mini 为 LLMAggreFact 的 30.4K 样本补充推理链并过滤标签不一致项，得到 24.1K 的 LLMAggreFact-Think 数据集，LoRA 微调 4-bit 量化的 Gemma3-1B。模型在 LLMAggreFact 上达 78.1 BAcc（超过 7B 的 MiniCheck-7B 的 77.4），在 SciFact 上达 64.7 BAcc（较 MiniCheck +14.7）。消融显示：去掉推理步骤降至 57.5 BAcc（−20.6）；基础模型零样本 CoT 反而下降（55.7→51.4）；GRPO 偏好优化（格式+类别加权准确率奖励）也不如 SFT（52.6 / 74.2 vs 78.1）。此外作者提出 GSMClaims 基准（由 GSM8K 改写的 2,634 条正负样本）并训练 ThinknCheck-Science（+SciFact 614 +GSMClaims 398），GSMClaims 达 61.0% 准确率。分析还发现推理长度与准确率呈倒 U 型关系（中长推理最佳），并建立了跨基准的统一错误分类法。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查方法存在三类问题：一是需要多次 LLM 调用、计算开销大；二是依赖闭源大模型带来成本、隐私与数据安全顾虑；三是模型不透明、缺乏可解释的判定依据。同时，通用推理模型（o 系列、R1）规模越来越大，而资源受限场景（如医疗、科研等高风险领域）需要小而专的验证器。此外，文献表明小规模模型上的朴素思维链（CoT）常导致性能下降，且偏好优化（GRPO）在大规模有效但在 1B 规模尚未验证。作者的核心动机是：探索"显式监督推理"能否让紧凑模型在准确率与可解释性上同时胜任文档级事实核查，并回答"小模型需要多少'思考'才最优"。
AI.method: 任务形式化：从 ℳ: C×D→{0,1} 扩展为 ℛ: C×D→T×{0,1}，输出推理轨迹 T 与二值标签（沿用 Supported/NotSupported，将 Refutes 与 NotSupported 合并）。数据构建：(1) LLMAggreFact-Think——对 LLMAggreFact dev 的 30.4K (文档,声明) 对用 GPT-4o-mini 零样本生成结构化推理链与 YES/NO 标签，剔除与原标签不一致的样本（占比约 21%）后剩 24.1K 四元组 (claim, document, label, reasoning)；未采用 DeepSeek R1 轨迹因过于冗长，抽样 100 条人工校验；保留 20% 作开发集。(2) GSMClaims——用 GPT-4o 将 GSM8K 测试集改写为"参考文档 + 正向声明（正确计算值）+ 负向声明（貌似合理的错误值）"，得到 2,634 条平衡样本，检验算术推理能力。模型训练：以 4-bit 量化 Gemma3-1B 为骨干，LoRA（rank=64, alpha=64, lr=2e-4 线性衰减，更新 q/k/v/o 与 MLP gate/up/down 投影），A100 单卡 1 epoch、warmup 5、batch 4×累积 4、8bit-AdamW、weight decay 0.01；推理用 temperature=1.0、top_p=0.95、top_k=64，输出格式固定为 <REASONING>…</REASONING><SOLUTION>…</SOLUTION>。消融/对照：ThinknCheck-nothink（同数据同超参但不生成推理）、未微调 Gemma3-1B 直接问答与零样本 CoT、GRPO 变体（TRL 的 Dr.GRPO 损失 + GSPO，奖励 R=0.5·R_fmt+1.0·R_acc，R_fmt∈{+1,−1} 检查标签顺序，R_acc 为类别加权准确率 w_YES=0.6356、w_NO=2.3435、尺度 ±4.0；每提示采 5 个候选，prompt 上限 4,306 token、completion 上限 378 token，400 步，lr 5e-6，LoRA 由 SFT-400 检查点初始化，另做无 SFT warm start 的版本）。ThinknCheck-Science：在 LLMAggreFact-Think 基础上追加 SciFact 614 条与 GSMClaims 398 条推理增强样本，其余不变。评测：主指标 BAcc（LLMAggreFact 测试 29.3k、SciFact dev），GSMClaims 用准确率；显著性用 10k 次配对 bootstrap（p<0.05）。附加分析：按 Gemma 分词器对 <REASONING> 长度分十等分位统计 BAcc，并做三基准统一错误类型分布统计。
AI.result: 表1（LLMAggreFact / SciFact BAcc）：ThinknCheck 78.1 / 64.7；ThinknCheck-nothink 57.5 / 21.7；Gemma3-1B base 55.7；base+CoT 51.4；MiniCheck-7B 77.4 / 50.0；AlignScore 70.4；GPT-4 75.3、GPT-4o 75.9、Claude-Sonnet-3.5 77.2。即 ThinknCheck 以约 7 倍更少参数超过 MiniCheck-7B 与零样本闭源模型，并显著优于消融（+20.6 点）与非推理基线；SciFact 上较 MiniCheck 提升 +14.7 绝对点。偏好优化：GRPO 从基座起 52.6 BAcc（低于基座 55.7），从 SFT warm start 起 74.2（低于 78.1），人工审计显示其倾向"词面重叠捷径"（声明复用文档措辞即判 Yes）。表2 跨基准：ThinknCheck-Science 在三项评测上全面最优——LLMAggreFact 79.2、SciFact 66.4、GSMClaims 61.0%（相对 ThinknCheck-1B 的 52.2% 提升 17% 相对增益），而 MiniCheck-7B 的 GSMClaims 仅 51.3%、nothink 为 49.4%。推理长度分析呈倒 U 型：中等长度推理 BAcc 最高，极短链召回高于精确率（浅层匹配触发宽松"YES"），极长链召回低于精确率（保守、假阴性增多）；作者强调长度非因果，只是与实例难度共变。错误分析（统一分类法）：LLMAggreFact 以词面重叠偏置（5.3%）与证据聚合不足（4.6%）为主；SciFact 以过度谨慎（41.4%）与否定/时序错误（32.8%）为主；GSMClaims 以算术推理错误为主（43.2%）。GRPO 优化增加了词面重叠型假阳性的占比。
AI.conclusion: 显式监督推理能让紧凑模型成为实用的事实核查器：在算力、隐私或延迟受限时，1B 的 ThinknCheck 可作为 grounded verification 的可落地组件，既准确又可解释（先给理由后给判定）。结论要点：监督推理（而非零样本 CoT 或粗粒度偏好奖励）是小模型的关键路径；推理监督显著提升准确率与域外泛化；推理长度存在"适度最优"区间而非越长越好，说明现有核查数据集偏重表层匹配而低估了证据综合与算术能力。作者提出 GSMClaims 与 ThinknCheck-Science 填补这些空白。后续方向：构造更难且平衡、需多句综合与数值推理的数据集；为算术引入轻量工具（如计算器）；学习自适应推理预算；扩展到真正的长上下文多文档场景（≥10k token）；校准输出 logits 作为可靠置信度；并对 GRPO 采用更强的 KL/行为克隆约束或更长训练以重新评估偏好优化。所有数据集与模型以 Apache 2.0 发布。局限：CoT 仅测单一提示/解码配置，GRPO 为简短双项奖励与 400 步短训练下的负面结论而非对偏好优化的普遍否定；未压测 32k 上下文上限；推理 span 使用固定最大解码预算。

title: Pseudo-Quantized Actor-Critic Algorithm for Robustness to Noisy Temporal Difference Error
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal difference (TD) errors are widely adopted for optimizing value and policy functions. However, since the TD error is defined by a bootstrap method, its computation tends to be noisy and destabilize learning. Heuristics to improve the accuracy of TD errors, such as target networks and ensemble models, have been introduced so far. While these are essential approaches for the current deep RL algorithms, they cause side effects like increased computational cost and reduced learning efficiency. Therefore, this paper revisits the TD learning algorithm based on control as inference, deriving a novel algorithm capable of robust learning against noisy TD errors. First, the distribution model of optimality, a binary random variable, is represented by a sigmoid function. Alongside forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler divergences, this new model derives a robust learning rule: when the sigmoid function saturates with a large TD error probably due to noise, the gradient vanishes, implicitly excluding it from learning. Furthermore, the two divergences exhibit distinct gradient-vanishing characteristics. Building on these analyses, the optimality is decomposed into multiple levels to achieve pseudo-quantization of TD errors, aiming for further noise reduction. Additionally, a Jensen-Shannon divergence-based approach is approximately derived to inherit the characteristics of both divergences. These benefits are verified through RL benchmarks, demonstrating stable learning even when heuristics are insufficient or rewards contain noise.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"控制即推断"(control as inference)重新推导了时序差分(TD)学习算法，提出伪量化演员-评论家算法 PQAC：用 sigmoid 函数建模"最优性"二元随机变量的概率（保证输出恒在[0,1]，无需估计乌托邦点即可满足概率质量函数定义），推导出反向KL与前向KL两种非线性 TD 误差形式——前者在价值估计逼近上下界时权重饱和、梯度消失，后者对误差项本身饱和。据此将最优性分解为 L+1 个层级（伪量化），并近似推导基于 Jensen-Shannon 散度的学习规则以继承两种KL的优势。实验表明 PQAC 在奖励含噪、去掉集成/弱化目标网络启发式、引导式奖励（模仿奖励）以及高维动作空间任务中均比标准 actor-critic 与 MME 更稳定有效。
AI.motivation: TD 误差因自举（bootstrap）机制缺乏真实目标，在非线性函数逼近下波动剧烈，是深度强化学习不稳定的主因。现有缓解手段（目标网络、集成模型）属于启发式：目标网络因参数延迟更新降低样本效率；集成模型依赖 min/max/median 统计量会产生不连续梯度波动；两者都需要额外网络，带来显存与计算开销，在机器人等嵌入式系统上代价明显。作者希望从理论上导出一种无需（或少依赖）这些启发式、对噪声 TD 误差具有内在鲁棒性的学习规则。另一动机是现有鲁棒 TD 学习方法多在梯度层面做截断/裁剪（如 smooth L1、梯度范数阈值），阈值难以设定，且无法真正排除错误数据；作者转而从"控制即推断"的概率建模出发，让错误数据在概率饱和时被隐式剔除。
AI.method: 1) 概率模型：将 p(O=1|s)=σ(λ_O(V(s)−μ_O))、p(O=1|s,a)=σ(λ_O(Q(s,a)−μ_O))，μ_O 取回报上下界中点、λ_O 与锐度 λ 关联。2) 推导：代入 Bayes 形式的最优/非最优策略，值函数目标用 KL(p(O|s)||p(O|s,a))（反向）或 KL(p(O|s,a)||p(O|s))（正向），策略目标为两个条件策略的对数比差；解析求得梯度并做对齐（乘 1/λ_O 与 σ_V σ̄_V）以得到共同的"非线性 TD 误差"权重：δ^RKL=λ_O σ_V σ̄_V δ，δ^FKL=σ_{δ+V}−σ_V。3) 分析：|δ|≪1 时两者近似相等；RKL 的非线性在权重项（饱和即梯度消失），FKL 的非线性在误差项（限幅 ±0.5 但饱和时仍保留正/负梯度）。4) 伪量化：定义 p(O=1)=∏_l p(O_l=1)，各层 μ_Ol 等距分布、λ_O=λ(L+1)/(R_u−R_l)，KL 可加分解，梯度按层求和平均，得 δ*=L^{-1}Σ_l δ*(δ;μ_Ol,λ_O)。5) JS 融合：推导 ∇_ζ JS(p_ζ|q)∝E[∇ln p_ζ · ln D]，D=p_ζ/(p_ζ+q)，并用 softplus 重写公共权重项以保证数值稳定；采用改进的对齐（值梯度乘 1/(λ_O√(σ_Vσ̄_V))，策略梯度乘 √(σ_Vσ̄_V)）以兼顾两者的对称/镜像等高线特性，避免 Jeffreys 直接相加导致的饱和性丧失。6) 实现：2×100 隐层、Squish 激活、RMSNorm、集成低估值估计、Student-t 策略分布、AdaTerm、CAT-soft 目标更新、ERC 稳定化，L+1=5、λ=4，R_u/l 以 EMA 在线更新；MuJoCo/Gymnasium 任务，28 个随机种子、每种子 100 episode，以四分位距均值（IQM）评估，噪声实验用 performance profile。
AI.result: (1) 量化层级：L+1=2（仅边界饱和）效果不足；L+1=10、20 改善甚微且 Pusher 下降；取 L+1=5 兼顾效果与计算量（并与人类五点评分机制类比）。(2) 散度融合：RKL 擅长稳定 HalfCheetah，FKL 擅长提升 Pusher 成功率；Jeffreys（两者梯度均值）继承了各自的缺点，接近较差一方；JS 接近各自优势方，成功继承双重优点。(3) 噪声鲁棒性（NoEnsemble / Polyak 更新 / 高斯噪声奖励）：HalfCheetah 中 FKL、Vanilla 鲁棒性差，RKL 与 JS 相当优秀，MME 最佳但在 0.9 阈值以上被超过；Pusher 中 MME 极脆弱，FKL 与 JS 表现出优异鲁棒性。(4) 引导式奖励（模仿奖励，基于专家策略采样的随机奖励）：MME 完全失败（其基于 Q 值的梯度易受错误梯度影响），PQAC 稳定优于标准 RL；'E'→'A' 的性能退化幅度与标准 RL 相当，说明限制来自模仿奖励本身而非鲁棒性不足。(5) 高维动作空间（Ant 12 维、Swimmer 14 维）：标准 RL 无法求解，MME 在 Ant 最佳但极不稳定，PQAC 在 Ant 稳定优于 Vanilla、在 Swimmer 显著优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: PQAC 通过对最优性概率的 sigmoid 建模与多级分解，在不依赖额外目标网络/集成规模的前提下实现了对噪声 TD 误差的鲁棒学习：饱和机制隐式剔除了由估计误差或奖励噪声引发的离群数据，伪量化把该剔除扩展到多层级，JS 近似则兼顾前向/反向 KL 的不同非线性特性。作者认为该方法可作为偏好型奖励（人类在环、基础模型微调）与高维机器人控制（人形机器人、灵巧手、冗余肌骨系统）等新场景的基础技术，但需与主动探索方法结合以弥补隐式剔除数据带来的样本效率损失；未来改进方向包括更鲁棒的 R_u,l 估计以及 μ_Ol 的非均匀优化。局限包括：依赖手动设定的回报上下界与锐度超参、JS 梯度为近似推导、实验均在模拟器中且以箱线图/IQM 呈现而缺乏统计显著性检验、以及未与完整鲁棒 TD 学习文献做统一协议比较。

title: Taming CATS: Controllable Automatic Text Simplification through Instruction Fine-Tuning with Control Tokens
summary: Controllable Automatic Text Simplification (CATS) produces user-tailored outputs, yet controllability is often treated as a decoding problem and evaluated with metrics that are not reflective to the measure of control. We observe that controllability in ATS is significantly constrained by data and evaluation. To this end, we introduce a domain-agnostic CATS framework based on instruction fine-tuning with discrete control tokens, steering open-source models to target readability levels and compression rates. Across three model families with different model sizes (Llama, Mistral, Qwen; 1-14B) and four domains (medicine, public administration, news, encyclopedic text), we find that smaller models (1-3B) can be competitive, but reliable controllability strongly depends on whether the training data encodes sufficient variation in the target attribute. Readability control (FKGL, ARI, Dale-Chall) is learned consistently, whereas compression control underperforms due to limited signal variability in the existing corpora. We further show that standard simplification and similarity metrics are insufficient for measuring control, motivating error-based measures for target-output alignment. Finally, our sampling and stratification experiments demonstrate that naive splits can introduce distributional mismatch that undermines both training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可控文本简化（CATS）中的可控性评估问题，提出基于指令微调的可控框架，实验表明小模型（1-3B）具有竞争力，但可控性高度依赖训练数据的属性变异程度，且标准评估指标不足以衡量控制效果。
AI.motivation: 当前CATS中的可控性通常被视为解码问题，评估指标不能真实反映控制效果。可控性在很大程度上受限于数据和评估方法本身。
AI.method: 提出基于指令微调与离散控制令牌的可控文本简化框架，针对可读性等级和压缩率进行控制。在三个模型族（Llama、Mistral、Qwen，1-14B）和四个领域（医学、公共管理、新闻、百科）进行实验。
AI.result: 1）小模型（1-3B）可具有竞争力，但可靠的可控性取决于训练数据是否包含目标属性的充分变异；2）可读性控制（FKGL、ARI、Dale-Chall）学习效果一致，而压缩率控制因语料库信号变异性有限而表现不佳；3）标准简化与相似度指标不足以衡量控制效果，需开发基于误差的衡量方法；4）朴素数据划分会引入分布不匹配，损害训练和评估。
AI.conclusion: 本框架证明指令微调结合离散控制令牌可有效实现文本简化控制，但控制效果受限于训练数据质量与评估指标设计。未来需开发更精准的可控性评估方法，并重视训练数据的属性变异程度与合理的数据划分策略。

title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based evolution is a promising approach for open-ended discovery, where progress requires sustained search and knowledge accumulation. Existing methods still rely heavily on fixed heuristics and hard-coded exploration rules, which limit the autonomy of LLM agents. We present CORAL, the first framework for autonomous multi-agent evolution on open-ended problems. CORAL replaces rigid control with long-running agents that explore, reflect, and collaborate through shared persistent memory, asynchronous multi-agent execution, and heartbeat-based interventions. It also provides practical safeguards, including isolated workspaces, evaluator separation, resource management, and agent session and health management. Evaluated on diverse mathematical, algorithmic, and systems optimization tasks, CORAL sets new state-of-the-art results on 10 tasks, achieving 3-10 times higher improvement rates with far fewer evaluations than fixed evolutionary search baselines across tasks. On Anthropic's kernel engineering task, four co-evolving agents improve the best known score from 1363 to 1103 cycles. Mechanistic analyses further show how these gains arise from knowledge reuse and multi-agent exploration and communication. Together, these results suggest that greater agent autonomy and multi-agent evolution can substantially improve open-ended discovery. Code is available at https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/CORAL.

AI.tldr: CORAL是首个用于开放性问题的自主多智能体进化框架，通过共享持久记忆、异步多智能体执行和基于心跳的干预机制，取代僵化的控制策略。在数学、算法和系统优化任务中取得10项SOTA，改进率提升3-10倍。在Anthropic内核工程任务中，四智能体协同进化将最佳分数从1363提升至1103。
AI.motivation: LLM进化是开放性发现的有前途方法，但现有方法仍依赖固定启发式和硬编码探索规则，限制了LLM智能体的自主性。
AI.method: CORAL框架：使用长期运行的智能体进行探索、反思和协作；共享持久记忆；异步多智能体执行；基于心跳的干预机制；隔离工作空间、评估器分离、资源管理、智能体会话和健康管理的安全保障。
AI.result: 在多样化数学、算法和系统优化任务中创下10项SOTA，改进率提升3-10倍，评估次数更少。在Anthropic内核工程任务中，四协同进化智能体将最佳分数从1363提升至1103。
AI.conclusion: 更大的智能体自主性和多智能体进化可显著提升开放性发现能力。知识复用和多智能体探索与通信是性能提升的关键机制。

title: Expert-Choice Routing Enables Adaptive Computation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel, non-autoregressive text generation, yet existing DLM mixture-of-experts (MoE) models inherit token-choice (TC) routing from autoregressive systems, leading to load imbalance and rigid computation allocation. We show that expert-choice (EC) routing is a better fit for DLMs: it provides deterministic load balancing by design, yielding higher throughput and faster convergence than TC. Building on the property that EC capacity is externally controllable, we introduce timestep-dependent expert capacity, which varies expert allocation according to the denoising step. We find that allocating more capacity to low-mask-ratio steps consistently achieves the best performance under matched FLOPs, and provide a mechanistic explanation: tokens in low-mask-ratio contexts exhibit an order-of-magnitude higher learning efficiency, so concentrating compute on these steps yields the largest marginal return. Finally, we show that existing pretrained TC DLMs can be retrofitted to EC by replacing only the router, achieving faster convergence and improved accuracy across diverse downstream tasks. Together, these results establish EC routing as a superior paradigm for DLM MoE models and demonstrate that computation in DLMs can be treated as an adaptive policy rather than a fixed architectural constant. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangshuibai/EC-DLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将专家选择（EC）路由替代传统DPM MoE中的token选择（TC）路由，显著提升扩散语言模型的并行生成效率。通过引入时间步相关的专家容量机制，发现对低mask-ratio步骤分配更多计算资源可获得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有DPM MoE模型沿用自回归系统的token选择（TC）路由机制，导致负载不均衡和计算资源分配僵化，限制了DPM并行生成的优势发挥。
AI.method: 1）采用专家选择（EC）路由实现确定性负载均衡；2）提出时间步依赖的专家容量机制，根据去噪阶段动态调整专家资源分配；3）对预训练TC模型进行路由替换微调。
AI.result: EC路由在相同FLOPs下实现更高吞吐量和更快收敛；低mask-ratio步骤的学习效率比高mask-ratio步骤高一个数量级，集中计算资源于此阶段可获最大边际收益；现有TC模型可通过仅替换路由器实现性能提升。
AI.conclusion: EC路由是DPM MoE模型的更优范式，DLM中的计算分配可作为自适应策略而非固定架构常数，这为扩散语言模型的效率优化提供了新思路。

title: DEFT: Distribution-guided Efficient Fine-Tuning for Human Alignment
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), using algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), aligns Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values but is costly and unstable. Alternatives have been proposed to replace PPO or integrate Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and contrastive learning for direct fine-tuning and value alignment. However, these methods still require voluminous data to learn preferences and may weaken the generalization ability of LLMs. To further enhance alignment efficiency and performance while mitigating the loss of generalization ability, this paper introduces Distribution-guided Efficient Fine-Tuning (DEFT), an efficient alignment framework incorporating data filtering and distributional guidance by calculating the differential distribution reward based on the output distribution of language model and the discrepancy distribution of preference data. A small yet high-quality subset is filtered from the raw data using a differential distribution reward, which is then incorporated into existing alignment methods to guide the model's output distribution. Experimental results demonstrate that the methods enhanced by DEFT outperform the original methods in both alignment capability and generalization ability, with significantly reduced training time.

AI.tldr: DEFT通过差分分布奖励机制筛选高质量小数据集，结合分布引导增强LLM对齐效果和泛化能力，同时显著降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: RLHF（如PPO算法）在对齐大型语言模型与人类价值观方面效果显著，但存在成本高昂、训练不稳定的问题。现有替代方案虽能部分改善，但仍需大量偏好数据，且可能削弱模型的泛化能力。如何在保证对齐性能的同时提升效率并维持泛化能力，是核心挑战。
AI.method: DEFT（Distribution-guided Efficient Fine-Tuning）框架包含两个关键组件：1）基于语言模型输出分布与偏好数据差异分布计算差分分布奖励（differential distribution reward）；2）利用该奖励从原始数据中筛选出规模小但质量高的子集。将筛选后的数据整合至现有对齐方法中，引导模型的输出分布朝向期望方向优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，集成DEFT的方法在原始对齐方法基础上，对齐能力与泛化能力均有提升，同时训练时间显著缩短。
AI.conclusion: DEFT通过数据过滤与分布引导机制，有效提升了LLM对齐的效率与效果，且兼顾了模型的泛化能力，为高效模型对齐提供了新思路。

title: Ontology-Aware Design Patterns for Clinical AI Systems: Translating Reification Theory into Software Architecture
comment: 7 design patterns, 3 tables, 1 figure, arXiv cs.AI preprint
summary: Clinical AI systems routinely train on health data structurally distorted by documentation workflows, billing incentives, and terminology fragmentation. Prior work has characterised the mechanisms of this distortion: the three-forces model of documentary enactment, the reification feedback loop through which AI may amplify coding artefacts, and terminology governance failures that allow semantic drift to accumulate. Yet translating these insights into implementable software architecture remains an open problem. This paper proposes seven ontology-aware design patterns in Gang-of-Four pattern language for building clinical AI pipelines resilient to ontological distortion. The patterns address data ingestion validation (Ontological Checkpoint), low-frequency signal preservation (Dormancy-Aware Pipeline), continuous drift monitoring (Drift Sentinel), parallel representation maintenance (Dual-Ontology Layer), feedback loop interruption (Reification Circuit Breaker), terminology evolution management (Terminology Version Gate), and pluggable regulatory compliance (Regulatory Compliance Adapter). Each pattern is specified with Problem, Forces, Solution, Consequences, Known Uses, and Related Patterns. We illustrate their composition in a reference architecture for a primary care AI system and provide a walkthrough tracing all seven patterns through a diabetes risk prediction scenario. This paper does not report empirical validation; it offers a design vocabulary grounded in theoretical analysis, subject to future evaluation in production systems. Three patterns have partial precedent in existing systems; the remaining four have not been formally described. Limitations include the absence of runtime benchmarks and restriction to the German and EU regulatory context.

AI.tldr: 本文针对临床AI系统在结构扭曲的健康数据上训练的问题，提出使用Gang-of-Four模式语言定义七个本体感知设计模式，以构建能抵抗本体扭曲的临床AI管道。这是一项设计理论研究，尚未经过实证验证。
AI.motivation: 临床AI系统训练数据存在系统性扭曲，来源包括文档工作流、计费激励和术语碎片化。现有研究已识别出扭曲机制（三力模型、再化反馈循环、术语治理失败），但缺乏将这些洞见转化为可实施软件架构的具体方案。
AI.method: 采用Gang-of-Four设计模式语言，为临床AI管道设计七个本体感知模式：Ontological Checkpoint（数据摄入验证）、Dormancy-Aware Pipeline（低频信号保留）、Drift Sentinel（漂移监控）、Dual-Ontology Layer（双本体层）、Reification Circuit Breaker（再化断路器）、Terminology Version Gate（术语版本门控）、Regulatory Compliance Adapter（合规适配器）。每个模式按Problem-Forces-Solution-Consequences-Known Uses-Related Patterns格式规范描述。
AI.result: 提出7个设计模式及参考架构，通过糖尿病风险预测场景演示模式组合。3个模式有部分先例，4个为全新形式化描述。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于提供基于理论分析的设计词汇库，为构建抗扭曲临床AI系统奠定架构基础。局限性包括：缺乏运行时基准测试、仅针对德国/EU监管环境、未经生产系统验证。

title: CRIT: Graph-Based Automatic Data Synthesis to Enhance Cross-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Real-world reasoning often requires combining information across modalities, connecting textual context with visual cues in a multi-hop process. Yet, most multimodal benchmarks fail to capture this ability: they typically rely on single images or set of images, where answers can be inferred from a single modality alone. This limitation is mirrored in the training data, where interleaved image-text content rarely enforces complementary, multi-hop reasoning. As a result, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate and produce reasoning traces poorly grounded in visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce CRIT, a new dataset and benchmark built with a graph-based automatic pipeline for generating complex cross-modal reasoning tasks. CRIT consists of diverse domains ranging from natural images, videos, and text-rich sources, and includes a manually verified test set for reliable evaluation. Experiments on this benchmark reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle on such reasoning tasks. Models trained on CRIT show significant gains in cross-modal multi-hop reasoning, including strong improvements on SPIQA and other standard multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CRIT是一个新的数据集和基准测试，旨在评估和提升视觉-语言模型（VLM）在跨模态多跳推理方面的能力。它通过基于图的自动管线构建，支持多种领域（自然图像、视频、富文本等），并包含人工验证的测试集。实验表明，现有SOTA模型在此类推理任务上表现不佳，但在CRIT上训练的模型不仅提升了跨模态多跳推理能力，还在SPIQA等其他多模态基准上取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在真实世界的推理任务中表现不佳，原因在于：(1) 现有基准测试通常依赖单张或一组图像，答案可从单一模态推断；(2) 训练数据中交错的图像-文本内容很少强制执行互补的多跳推理；(3) 因此VLMs频繁产生幻觉，推理过程缺乏视觉证据的充分支撑。
AI.method: 构建了基于图（graph-based）的自动管线来生成复杂的跨模态推理任务。数据集涵盖多种领域（自然图像、视频、富文本源），并包含人工验证的测试集以确保评估的可靠性。
AI.result: 即使是最先进的模型在CRIT的推理任务上仍存在困难，但通过在CRIT上微调，模型在跨模态多跳推理上获得了显著提升，并在SPIQA等其他标准多模态基准上展现出正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: CRIT数据集和基准测试成功填补了跨模态多跳推理评估的空白，为提升VLM的视觉理解和推理能力提供了有效的训练资源。

title: PLOT: Enhancing Preference Learning via Optimal Transport
summary: Preference learning in Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced significantly, yet existing methods remain limited by modest performance gains, high computational costs, hyperparameter sensitivity, and insufficient modeling of global token-level relationships. We introduce PLOT, which enhances Preference Learning in fine-tuning-based alignment through a token-level loss derived from Optimal Transport. By formulating preference learning as an Optimal Transport Problem, PLOT aligns model outputs with human preferences while preserving the original distribution of LLMs, ensuring stability and robustness. Furthermore, PLOT leverages token embeddings to capture semantic relationships, enabling globally informed optimization. Experiments across two preference categories - Human Values and Logic & Problem Solving - spanning seven subpreferences demonstrate that PLOT consistently improves alignment performance while maintaining fluency and coherence. These results substantiate optimal transport as a principled methodology for preference learning, establishing a theoretically grounded framework that provides new insights for preference learning of LLMs.

AI.tldr: PLOT提出了一种基于最优传输理论的偏好学习方法，通过token级别的损失函数改进LLM对齐。该方法在保持模型分布稳定性的同时，利用token嵌入捕捉语义关系，实现全局优化的偏好学习。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好学习方法存在性能提升有限、高计算成本、超参数敏感以及token级别全局关系建模不足等问题，亟需一种理论基础扎实且效果稳定的新方法。
AI.method: 将偏好学习形式化为最优传输问题，设计token级别的损失函数，通过token嵌入捕捉语义关系，实现全局优化的偏好对齐，同时保持LLM原始分布的稳定性。
AI.result: 在两类偏好（人类价值观、逻辑与问题解决）共七个子偏好的实验中，PLOT一致性地提升了对齐性能，同时保持了语言的流畅性和连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 最优传输理论可作为偏好学习的原则性方法论，为LLM偏好学习提供理论支撑和新的研究视角。

title: ContextBudget: Budget-Aware Context Management for Long-Horizon Search Agents
summary: LLM-based agents show strong potential for long-horizon reasoning, yet their context size is limited by deployment factors (e.g., memory, latency, and cost), yielding a constrained context budget. As interaction histories grow, this induces a trade-off between retaining past information and staying within the context limit. To address this challenge, we propose Budget-Aware Context Management (BACM), which formulates context management as a sequential decision problem with a context budget constraint. It enables agents to assess the available budget before incorporating new observations and decide when and how much of the interaction history to compress. We further develop BACM-RL, an end-to-end curriculum-based reinforcement learning approach that learns compression strategies under varying context budgets. Experiments on compositional multi-objective QA and long-horizon web browsing benchmarks show that BACM-RL consistently outperforms prior methods across model scales and task complexities, achieving over $1.6\times$ gains over strong baselines in high-complexity settings, while maintaining strong advantages as budgets shrink, where most methods exhibit a downward performance trend.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ContextBudget（预算感知上下文管理 BACM）及其强化学习版本 BACM-RL：把长程搜索智能体的上下文压缩建模为带上下文窗口预算约束的序贯决策问题，用「预算条件状态 + 延迟加载观测」让智能体在纳入新观测前先评估剩余容量，并通过 commit-block 聚合（None/Partial/Full）自适应决定何时压、压多少、保留什么；再用多轮 GRPO + 渐进收紧的预算课程（8k→4k）端到端优化。在组合式多目标 QA 与长程网页浏览基准上，BACM-RL 跨 7B/30B 骨干一致优于 ReAct、Search-R1、Summary Agent、MEM1，高复杂度设定下相对强基线提升超 1.6×（32 目标下 4.545 vs 0.909，约 5×），且在预算从 16k 收紧到 4k 时性能几乎不变，而多数方法随预算收缩而显著退化。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程推理中交互历史线性膨胀，而部署侧的显存、延迟、成本决定了有限的上下文窗口，形成“保留历史 vs 遵守上下文上限”的天然权衡。现有上下文压缩方法（Summary Agent、MemAgent、MEM1 等）多为 budget-free 的静态/周期性压缩，缺乏对当前剩余预算的显式条件化，导致两类失效：预算宽松时过度压缩、抹除研究关键证据；预算紧张时压缩不足、上下文溢出并引发推理脆弱或截断。已有 budget-aware 推理扩展工作（token 预算、工具调用预算）调节的是计算/动作数量，而非上下文窗口本身成为瓶颈时的主动历史压缩。因此需要一个在推理过程中依据实时预算信号动态调节压缩强度与信息保真的机制。
AI.method: 框架：BACM 将上下文管理形式化为预算约束的序贯决策问题。1) 预算条件状态与延迟加载：状态扩展为 b_t=(s_t, r_t, |o_t|)，r_t=B-|C_t| 为剩余预算，|o_t| 为待加载观测的 token 长度（长度可观测、内容隐藏）；策略先采样精炼动作 u_t 产生 C'_t 满足 |C'_t| ≤ B-|o_t|，再拼接观测得到 C_{t+1}=C'_t⊕o_t，从而在纳入新信息前预留容量，而非事后被动压缩。2) Commit-block 聚合：上下文被划分为 K 个语义连贯段，动作空间为互斥的 Null（∅，不压缩）、Partial（非空真子集 S，|S| 决定压缩强度）、Full（[K]，全量聚合），压缩决策与推理动作共享统一动作空间由同一策略生成。3) 优化：BACM-RL 将多轮 GRPO 扩展到该决策过程。奖励为最终答案 F1，但仅当整条轨迹在每一轮满足 |C_{i,t}| ≤ B_max^(j) 时才计入，否则奖励归零；组相对优势 A_i=(R̃-mean)/(std+ε)，轨迹级优势广播到所有 token 做 token 级 PPO 式裁剪目标，再加 KL 惩罚。采用 5 阶段渐进课程（每阶段 60 步共 300 步），max_model_len 从 8192 线性降至 4096（每阶段降 1024），并配合溢出敏感的正则化。实现基于 verl 框架，GRPO 组大小 5、学习率 1e-6、余弦调度 + 100 warmup、KL 系数 0.001，压缩调用每任务上限 10 次；实际提示中以 usable_limit=max_model_len−1000 安全裕度计算 remaining_budget 与 remaining_pct，并以 fold_commit_ids ∈ {NONE, ALL, 具体 id 列表} + merged_commit 的 tool_call 形式输出。
AI.result: 主结果（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct / Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct，8k 预算）：BrowseComp-Plus 平均准确率上 BACM-RL 达 0.127（7B）与 0.147（30B），后者超过使用 128k 上下文的 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Inst-2507 的 ReAct（0.136）；同时优于 ReAct、Search-R1、Summary、MEM1（30B 上 MEM1 为 0.131）。多目标 QA 累计 F1 上 BACM-RL 全面领先：30B 在 2/8/16/32 目标为 1.032/3.587/6.255/4.545，7B 为 0.909/2.790/4.011/2.938；相对 MEM1 在 32 目标下约 5.0×（4.545 vs 0.909），相对非 RL 消融 4.545 vs 0.208。预算鲁棒性：从 16k 收紧到 4k，BACM-RL 几乎不变，4k/32 目标下 2.06 vs 最佳基线 1.21（1.7×）；而 ReAct/Search-R1 仅在简单任务与宽预算下有竞争力，MEM1 因逐轮过度压缩丢信息，Summary 因延迟压缩而推理失败。压缩效率：8k 预算下轻负载（2/8 目标）相对 MEM1 提升 8.3%/18.7% F1 的同时压缩调用减少 41.7%/35.8%（1.92→1.12、2.15→1.38），重负载（16/32 目标）压缩调用增加 43%/109% 而 F1 提升 67%/143%。消融：去掉预算元数据（Ours w/o B）性能显著下降；仅给 Search-R1 加预算元数据几乎无提升；延迟加载优于预加载（如 32 目标 2.938 vs 2.818）；渐进课程优于静态 8k（16/32 目标 1.391/1.319）和随机预算（训练在 180 步后奖励崩塌、KL 尖峰）。行为分析：预算充足 45.7% 用 NONE，中等 30.6% 用 Selective，紧预算 28.7% 用 ALL。效率统计上，简单任务 token 用量不随预算增长（16k 峰值 2033 vs 4k 峰值 1986），16 目标下峰值 3538 低于 Summary 的 4939。附录亦承认局限：轨迹级 RL 奖励稀疏延迟、聚合粒度偏粗（仅段级，可延伸 token/span 级显著性）、评测环境有限（未覆盖开放式工具使用、多模态、人机交互）。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明“预算无关”的上下文压缩会在长程智能体中造成信息丢失或上下文溢出；将上下文压缩建模为以预算为条件信号的序贯决策问题，并用带渐进预算课程与溢出惩罚的多轮 GRPO 端到端优化，可以显著提升长程推理在严格上下文约束下的鲁棒性，且增益在预算最紧、任务最复杂时最大。核心启示是：有效的上下文管理需要对 token 做自适应分配，而非一味激进压缩或延迟摘要；预算信号必须直接条件化于压缩策略本身。后续方向包括引入中间监督/层级奖励以缓解稀疏信用分配、更细粒度的显著性估计，以及向更真实多样环境的泛化验证。

title: Label Shift Estimation With Incremental Prior Update
summary: An assumption often made in supervised learning is that the training and testing sets have the same label distribution. However, in real-life scenarios, this assumption rarely holds. For example, medical diagnosis result distributions change over time and across locations; fraud detection models must adapt as patterns of fraudulent activity shift; the category distribution of social media posts changes based on trending topics and user demographics. In the task of label shift estimation, the goal is to estimate the changing label distribution $p_t(y)$ in the testing set, assuming the likelihood $p(x|y)$ does not change, implying no concept drift. In this paper, we propose a new approach for post-hoc label shift estimation, unlike previous methods that perform moment matching with confusion matrix estimated from a validation set or maximize the likelihood of the new data with an expectation-maximization algorithm. We aim to incrementally update the prior on each sample, adjusting each posterior for more accurate label shift estimation. The proposed method is based on intuitive assumptions on classifiers that are generally true for modern probabilistic classifiers. The proposed method relies on a weaker notion of calibration compared to other methods. As a post-hoc approach for label shift estimation, the proposed method is versatile and can be applied to any black-box probabilistic classifier. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and MNIST show that the proposed method consistently outperforms the current state-of-the-art maximum likelihood-based methods under different calibrations and varying intensities of label shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于增量更新先验的后验标签分布估计方法，用于解决训练集与测试集标签分布不同的问题（标签偏移）。该方法对现代概率分类器有直观的假设依赖，且只需要较弱的校准概念即可工作。
AI.motivation: 监督学习中假设训练集与测试集标签分布相同，但实际场景中往往不成立（如医疗诊断、欺诈检测、社交媒体分类等）。现有方法如混淆矩阵矩匹配或EM算法存在局限性，需要一种更灵活的后验标签偏移估计方法。
AI.method: 提出一种后验标签偏移估计方法，通过对每个样本增量更新先验，调整后验概率以实现更准确的标签偏移估计。该方法基于对现代概率分类器的一般性直觉假设，具有比现有方法更弱的校准要求，可作为即插即用的方法应用于任意黑盒概率分类器。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不同校准程度和不同强度标签偏移条件下，持续优于当前最先进的最大似然方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过更弱的校准假设和增量更新机制，提供了一种通用且有效的标签偏移后验估计框架，在实际应用中具有广泛的适用性和鲁棒性。

title: From Guessing to Placeholding: A Cost-Theoretic Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Code Completion
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional proficiency in code completion, they typically adhere to a Hard Completion (HC) paradigm, compelling the generation of fully concrete code even amidst insufficient context. Our analysis of 3 million real-world interactions exposes the limitations of this strategy: 61% of the generated suggestions were either edited after acceptance or rejected despite exhibiting over 80% similarity to the user's subsequent code, suggesting that models frequently make erroneous predictions at specific token positions. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Placeholder Completion (APC), a collaborative framework that extends HC by strategically outputting explicit placeholders at high-entropy positions, allowing users to fill directly via IDE navigation. Theoretically, we formulate code completion as a cost-minimization problem under uncertainty. Premised on the observation that filling placeholders incurs lower cost than correcting errors, we prove the existence of a critical entropy threshold above which APC achieves strictly lower expected cost than HC. We instantiate this framework by constructing training data from filtered real-world edit logs and design a cost-based reward function for reinforcement learning. Extensive evaluations across 1.5B--14B parameter models demonstrate that APC reduces expected editing costs from 19% to 50% while preserving standard HC performance. Our work provides both a theoretical foundation and a practical training framework for uncertainty-aware code completion, demonstrating that adaptive abstention can be learned end-to-end without sacrificing conventional completion quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应占位符补全(APC)框架，通过在模型不确定的高熵位置输出显式占位符而非硬性生成完整代码，解决LLM代码补全中的错误预测问题。理论证明存在临界熵阈值，超过该阈值后APC的期望成本严格低于传统硬补全(HC)。实验表明APC可降低19%-50%的编辑成本。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码补全采用"硬补全"(HC)范式，强制生成完整代码，但分析300万真实交互发现：61%的建议在接收后被编辑或被拒绝（尽管与用户后续代码相似度超80%），表明模型常在特定token位置产生错误预测。
AI.method: 1) 将代码补全形式化为不确定性下的成本最小化问题；2) 基于"填充占位符成本低于修正错误"的观察，证明存在临界熵阈值使APC优于HC；3) 从真实编辑日志过滤构建训练数据；4) 设计基于成本的强化学习奖励函数。
AI.result: 在1.5B-14B参数模型上验证，APC在保持标准HC性能的同时，将期望编辑成本降低19%-50%。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了不确定性感知代码补全的理论基础和实践训练框架，证明了自适应放弃（adaptive abstention）可以端到端学习，且不牺牲传统补全质量。

title: M3D-BFS: a Multi-stage Dynamic Fusion Strategy for Sample-Adaptive Multi-Modal Brain Network Analysis
summary: Multi-modal fusion is of great significance in neuroscience which integrates information from different modalities and can achieve better performance than uni-modal methods in downstream tasks. Current multi-modal fusion methods in brain networks, which mainly focus on structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) modalities, are static in nature. They feed different samples into the same model with identical computation, ignoring inherent difference between input samples. This lack of sample adaptation hinders model's further performance. To this end, we innovatively propose a multi-stage dynamic fusion strategy (M3D-BFS) for sample-adaptive multi-modal brain network analysis. Unlike other static fusion methods, we design different mixture-of-experts (MoEs) for uni- and multi-modal representations where modules can adaptively change as input sample changes during inference. To alleviate issue of MoE where training of experts may be collapsed, we divide our method into 3 stages. We first train uni-modal encoders respectively, then pretrain single experts of MoEs before finally finetuning the whole model. A multi-modal disentanglement loss is designed to enhance the final representations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work for dynamic fusion for multi-modal brain network analysis. Extensive experiments on different real-world datasets demonstrates the superiority of M3D-BFS.

AI.tldr: M3D-BFS是一种面向多模态脑网络分析的多阶段动态融合框架，通过混合专家（MoE）门控机制实现样本自适应的模态特异性与跨模态融合表征计算，分三阶段训练（单模态编码器预训练→单专家预训练→MoE微调），并引入多模态解耦损失；在HCP性别分类与ZDXX抑郁症分类上分别取得81.21%和80.85%的准确率，优于所有对比方法。
AI.motivation: 现有神经科学中的多模态脑网络融合方法（以结构连接SC与功能连接FC为主）本质上是静态的：所有样本都通过同一套模型、相同计算路径得到预测，忽略了样本间固有的差异（如不同个体脑区连接强度与拓扑结构差异），缺乏样本级适应性，限制了性能上限。计算机视觉与自然语言处理领域已有"多模态动态融合"（如MoGE、DynMM）的成功先例，但该思想尚未被引入脑网络分析。此外，直接训练MoE存在专家坍塌（expert collapse）与负载不均衡问题，导致训练不稳定、退化为单一专家。
AI.method: 提出M3D-BFS（Multi-stage, Multi-Modal Dynamic-Brain Fusion Strategy）。1) 单模态编码器预训练：以两层GCN为编码器f_φ_m、MLP为分类器g_θ_m，分别在SC与FC上用交叉熵训练，缓解多模态直接训练的"模态惰性"，其权重作为后续软对齐的教师。2) 单专家预训练（stage 2）：将SC/FC编码表示投影后送入三类MLP专家——SC专属、FC专属与融合专家（输入为SC与FC拼接），经READOUT后拼接并由FFN预测；损失为L_stage2 = L_ce + β·(L_distill + L_contrast)，其中单模态引导蒸馏损失用KL散度对齐stage 1教师logits以保留单模态性能，对比损失L_contrast（CMBP，基于InfoNCE的双向SC↔FC批内配对对齐）用于拉近SC/FC表示。3) MoE微调（stage 3）：将单专家替换为两层MoE（MLP作为专家与门控网络，门控输出加高斯噪声后取top-k，k=1，即每个脑区在推理时动态选择唯一专家），用stage 2的单专家权重初始化各专家，仅训练MoE块、冻结其余模块；引入重要性损失与负载损失（基于变异系数CV）抑制专家坍塌；并设计多模态解耦损失L_disen，以拼接后的z_anchor为正样本、其余模态表示为负样本的对比形式，使SC/FC/Fusion三类嵌入尽可能正交且与任务相关；L_stage3 = L_ce + α·L_moe + (1−α)·L_disen。模型与MoE结构均与具体专家类型解耦。
AI.result: 在HCP（560女/479男，性别分类）与ZDXX（94对照/93 MDD患者）两个真实数据集上以10次10折交叉验证评估五项指标（ACC/SEN/SPE/F1/AUC）。M3D-BFS在HCP上ACC 81.21%、AUC 80.80%，在ZDXX上ACC 80.85%、AUC 80.74%，均为最优，相比次优方法分别提升2.28%和2.73%，且标准差较小（0.85%）。消融实验表明：蒸馏（S1.A1）使ACC从76.84%升至78.16%；加入对比损失（S2.A2）与解耦损失（S3.A1）进一步提升至81.21%（HCP），ZDXX上从77.28%逐步提升至80.85%，说明各阶段与各子模块均有贡献。敏感性分析显示HCP最优超参数为α=0.6、β=0.3，专家数k在1–6范围内精度变化较小。可视化表明融合MoE中SC/FC专家比例未出现100%/0%的坍塌，训练后专家分布较未预训练模型更均衡，验证了多阶段策略对专家坍塌的缓解作用。
AI.conclusion: M3D-BFS是首个面向多模态脑网络分析的样本级动态融合工作，通过MoE门控实现随样本动态切换的单模态与跨模态表征计算，三阶段渐进训练（单模态预训练→单专家预训练→MoE微调）有效规避了专家坍塌，多模态解耦损失进一步增强了单模态与融合嵌入的任务相关性，实验证明其在真实多模态脑网络下游任务（性别与抑郁症分类）上优于现有静态融合方法。局限在于目前仅在两个数据集、两类任务上验证，动态门控本身的额外复杂度与跨数据集泛化性仍有待进一步评估；未来工作将考虑数据分布存在固有偏差的更复杂情形。

title: Cognitive Energy Modeling for Neuroadaptive Human-Machine Systems using EEG and WGAN-GP
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive insight into the brain's cognitive and emotional dynamics. However, modeling how these states evolve in real time and quantifying the energy required for such transitions remains a major challenge. The Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP) offers a principled probabilistic framework to model the most efficient evolution between the brain states, interpreted as a measure of cognitive energy cost. While generative models such as GANs have been widely used to augment EEG data, it remains unclear whether synthetic EEG preserves the underlying dynamical structure required for transition-based analysis. In this work, we address this gap by using SBP-derived transport cost as a metric to evaluate whether GAN-generated EEG retains the distributional geometry necessary for energy-based modeling of cognitive state transitions. We compare transition energies derived from real and synthetic EEG collected during Stroop tasks and demonstrate strong agreement across group and participant-level analyses. These results indicate that synthetic EEG preserves the transition structure required for SBP-based modeling, enabling its use in data-efficient neuroadaptive systems. We further present a framework in which SBP-derived cognitive energy serves as a control signal for adaptive human-machine systems, supporting real-time adjustment of system behavior in response to user cognitive and affective state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP)衍生的传输成本作为评估指标，验证GAN生成的合成EEG是否保留了真实EEG的认知状态转换能量结构。研究结果表明，合成EEG能够有效保留转换动力学特征，可应用于数据高效的神经自适应系统。
AI.motivation: 当前EEG研究面临两大挑战：(1) 如何实时建模大脑认知和情感状态的动态演化；(2) 如何量化状态转换所需的认知能量成本。此外，GAN生成的合成EEG是否能保留进行状态转换分析所需的底层动力学结构尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP)作为概率框架建模状态演化；使用SBP衍生的传输成本作为评估指标；在Stroop任务期间收集真实EEG和合成EEG数据，进行群体级和个体级分析对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，真实EEG与合成EEG在状态转换能量方面表现出强一致性，合成EEG成功保留了进行SBP建模所需的转换几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 合成EEG可有效用于SBP建模，支持数据高效的神经自适应系统开发；SBP衍生的认知能量可作为控制信号，实现人机系统的实时行为调整。

title: Beyond Detection: Ethical Foundations for Automated Dyslexic Error Attribution
summary: Dyslexic spelling errors exhibit systematic phonological and orthographic patterns that distinguish them from the errors produced by typically developing writers. While this observation has motivated dyslexic-specific spell-checking and assistive writing tools, prior work has focused predominantly on error correction rather than attribution, and has largely neglected the ethical risks. The risk of harmful labelling, covert screening, algorithmic bias, and institutional misuse that automated classification of learners entails requires the development of robust ethical and legal frameworks for research in this area. This paper addresses both gaps. We formulate dyslexic error attribution as a binary classification task. Given a misspelt word and its correct target form, determine whether the error pattern is characteristic of a dyslexic or non-dyslexic writer. We develop a comprehensive feature set capturing orthographic, phonological, and morphological properties of each error, and propose a twin-input neural model evaluated against traditional machine learning baselines under writer-independent conditions. The neural model achieves 93.01% accuracy and an F1-score of 94.01%, with phonetically plausible errors and vowel confusions emerging as the strongest attribution signals. We situate these technical results within an explicit ethics-first framework, analysing fairness across subgroups, the interpretability requirements of educational deployment, and the conditions, consent, transparency, human oversight, and recourse, under which a system could be responsibly used. We provide concrete guidelines for ethical deployment and an open discussion of the systems limitations and misuse potential. Our results demonstrate that dyslexic error attribution is feasible at high accuracy while underscoring that feasibility alone is insufficient for deployment in high-stakes educational contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文将"阅读障碍拼写错误归因"（给定一个拼错词及其正确形式，判断该错误模式是否具有阅读障碍书写者特征）形式化为一个独立的二分类基准任务：构建涵盖正字法、音系、形态与写作者产出量的综合特征集，用字符n-gram TF-IDF 文本分支 + 数值特征分支的双输入神经网络，在写作者独立（GroupShuffleSplit）评测下取得 93.01% 准确率、94.01% F1、AUC 0.9274，显著优于最佳传统基线（随机森林 85.2%）；消融显示工程特征为主要信号来源（仅特征分支已达 92.47%），而文本分支单独仅 71.94%，二者互补。论文的核心贡献在于把"伦理优先"确立为设计前提：系统分析假阳性/假阴性伤害、隐性筛查与标签化风险、公平性（共病亚组中 ADD/ADHD 确诊亚组出现"高准确率但召回为 0"的隐性失效）、可解释性、同意与人在环治理，并结合 EU AI Act 等监管框架提出 8 条部署准则与明确禁止用途。核心结论是：技术上高准确率的归因并不构成在高利害教育场景中部署的正当理由，部署前必须完成代表性人口学数据上的公平性验证与长期治理监督。
AI.motivation:
1) 技术缺口：现有阅读障碍相关 NLP 与拼写纠错文献（如 Kukich 1992；Brill & Moore 2000；Rello 等 2017；Pedler 2007；Rauschenberger 等 2018；Tiwari 等 2025）几乎全部把作者视为需抑制的噪声源，只做"纠错"而不做"归因"；没有任何研究把"该拼写错误是否源自阅读障碍书写者"作为独立任务进行基准评测。
2) 理论缺口：阅读障碍错误具有系统性音系—正字法特征（Bourassa & Treiman 2003；Tops 等 2012），且在拼写年龄匹配条件下与典型发展儿童仍呈现不同错误画像（Landerl & Wimmer 2008），说明错误模式承载认知画像信息而非仅为词难度的代理。
3) 伦理缺口：自动归因意味着对学习者进行敏感的心理/神经属性分类，可能导致污名化标签、隐蔽监控、算法偏见（Blodgett 等 2020；Mehrabi 等 2021；Noble 2018）与机构滥用（如雇主/高校的隐性筛查）；已有教育 AI 伦理综述（Holstein 等 2019；Prinsloo & Slade 2015；Scully 等 2025；Zhu 等 2025；Varsik & Vosberg 2024）显示偏见、黑箱与问责缺口是相互耦合的结构性风险，但均未应用于该问题。
4) 作者主张的提问方式不是"能否检测"，而是"何时、在何种条件下才适合使用"，将公平、可解释、同意、问责视为从数据集构建到部署建议全流程的一级设计标准，而非事后附加的合规约束。
AI.method:
任务与数据：自建"语言学拼写数据集"——21 名英国出生、母语为英语的在校大学生在 15 分钟写作任务中产生的 921 个唯一拼写错误；参与者须披露神经多样性诊断，被建议接受正式评估者标为疑似病例（非确诊）；标注含视觉压力、ADD/ADHD（疑似/确诊）、读写困难/字迹障碍、ASD、SLCN 等共病维度（由伦理审查批准并取得知情同意）。
特征工程：三层特征——(a) 正字法层：正确/错误词长、元音/辅音/标点/空格计数、是否构成真词错误、Damerau–Levenshtein 编辑距离、错误类型（插入/遗漏/空间错误/替换/转置/标点/大小写/数字/多重错误）、涉事字母对；(b) 音系层：是否为"音系合理"错误（phonetically plausible）、是否落入阅读障碍常见混淆字母集（p/b/d/q 等）、元音混淆；(c) 写作者产出量层：Essay_Word_Count、Error_Frequency、Essay_Error_Density。
建模与评测：文本编码为字符 n-gram TF-IDF（对"错误词+正确词"拼接），数值特征走独立浅层分支，两分支 ReLU + BatchNorm + Dropout，拼接后接分类头与 sigmoid；Adam 初始学习率 3e-4，验证 AUC 早停 + ReduceLROnPlateau；对比基线为逻辑回归、RBF-SVC、KNN、随机森林、高斯朴素贝叶斯；过滤差异 >50% 的词对；70/20/10 划分并用 GroupShuffleSplit（以 CandidateID 为组键）验证写作者独立性；指标含 accuracy、precision/recall、F1、AUC，另加 Brier、ECE、Youden 最优阈值与阈值-敏感度权衡分析；消融设四条件（A 仅文本、B 仅工程特征、C 去除产出量特征、D 完整）；子群分析按错误类型、音系合理性、共病剖面拆分；XAI 手段提及注意力可视化与 SHAP。伦理方法学为文献+规范分析：结合残障正义/价值敏感设计、EU AI Act（附件 III、Art.6(2)、13、16、29、72）、英国 AI 白皮书、FTC/教育部 OCR、GDPR 与机构伦理委员会治理模型，输出 8 条部署准则与"有益 vs 禁止"用例清单。
AI.result:
性能：双分支 NN 达 93.01% 准确率 / 94.01% F1 / AUC 0.9274，优于随机森林 85.2%/85.8%/0.8597、逻辑回归 84.60%/85.24%/0.8551、SVC 82.56%、KNN 82.50%，高斯朴素贝叶斯接近失效（48.90%/54.10%/AUC 0.4818）。混淆矩阵 TP=102、TN=71、FP=7、FN=6，类别别准确率 94.44%（阅读障碍）vs 91.03%（非阅读障碍），误差近似对称。
校准与稳健性：Brier 0.0439（较 0.25 无技巧基线改善约 82%），ECE 0.1098（中度失校准，中段概率区存在过度自信），Youden 最优阈值 τ=0.7368 显著高于 0.50 默认值，作者指出 0.50 会不必要地抬高假阳性。
消融：仅文本 71.94%/F1 0.6745/AUC 0.7109（确有真实信号但不足）；仅工程特征 92.47%/0.9307/0.9050（主信号源）；去除产出量特征降至 81.94%/0.8386/0.8348（-11.07% acc、-0.0926 AUC），说明产出量特征携带非冗余信号；作者据写作者分组划分与随机划分结果"一致"判断不存在写作者层面泄漏，主张保留完整模型，同时承认 Essay_Length 与 Error_Frequency 具更高身份代理风险。
可解释性与信号：逻辑回归权重与随机森林重要性收敛于三项——音系合理错误指示符、阅读障碍常见字母混淆集成员、错误词与正确词的元音数差异；音系合理错误准确率 98.46%（F1 0.9875/召回 0.9753），非音系错误 90.3%（F1 0.9059/召回 0.9005），差距 Δ≈0.08。
错误类型子群：替换与（单参与者产生的）大小写/空间错误 100%，遗漏 94.44%，多重错误 94.12%，转置 92.86%，插入 86.44%，音系类 85.71%。典型假阳性包括 "definately"、"seperate"（在非阅读障碍人群中亦高频）及低频不规则词元音混淆；假阴性集中于近邻键单字母替换（"tham"→"than"）与高频词中的补偿性策略。
共病子群：视觉压力存在、ADD/ADHD 疑似组呈满分（n=102/106，作者警示小样本下与随机波动一致，不构成优势证据）；ADD/ADHD 确诊组（n=27）准确率 88.89% 但 F1 与召回均为 0.00——高准确率掩盖正类完全失效，是聚合指标失真的典型案例；读写困难/字迹障碍组表现略优（98.46%）；ASD 与 SLCN 验证集零正例，无法量化。
公平性边界：全部参与者为英国出生、英语母语大学生，缺性别、年龄、社会经济地位、L1、方言等元数据，故无法开展族群/语言背景/年龄维度的公平性评估；作者明确将"人口学公平性评估"定为部署前置条件而非未来工作。
共病/书写水平等未见结论之外，总体归因具备高准确度，验证"技术可行"命题成立；但公平性与治理证据尚不足以支撑教育场景部署。
AI.conclusion:
结论与贡献：(1) 以"伦理优先"重构问题定义——不只评准确率，还评公平、可解释与情境适切性，并区分许可与禁止用例；(2) 首次在写作者独立条件下对"阅读障碍错误归因"任务进行基准评测并建立可比模型谱系；(3) 以消融与子群分析暴露失效模式，尤其指出产出量特征（Essay_Length/Error_Frequency/Essay_Error_Density）既是性能来源也是身份代理的伦理风险来源；(4) 给出可操作部署准则（仅限 opt-in 辅助场景、以证据解释预测、任何后果性用途须人类专家复核、专项知情同意与隐私保护、持续偏差审计与公平性监测、申诉与覆写机制、用户局限培训、伦理委员会常态监督），并结合 EU AI Act 高风险 AI 义务（提供者/部署者/机构问责分工、事后监测与严重事件报告）与"nothing about us without us"残障权利原则，构建多层治理框架；明确禁止无同意强制筛查、惩罚性评估、监控式用途与招生/雇佣等高利害决策。
适用场景：自愿开启的阅读障碍感知拼写检查与辅助写作、作为转介信号的教师端筛查支持（须强制告知学生与家长、不得视为诊断）、以音系合理性加权候选词的自适应拼写纠错。
局限与保留意见（我的评估）：核心不确定性在于"归因"的语义——模型实际预测的更接近"作者身份/水平"而非"该错误本身是否具阅读障碍特征"，而单条错误对个体归因在临床意义上并不成立；产出量特征的收益与身份泄漏难以在如此小样本（921 错误 / 21 名作者，且类别极度不平衡）上分离，作者的泄漏论证仅以"结果一致"表述而未给出写作者分组划分的具体数值与方差估计。统计严谨性偏弱：未报告置信区间、重复划分或显著性检验，阈值 τ=0.74 与各子群最优值在同一验证/测试集上选择，存在乐观偏差风险；ECE 0.1098 与中段过度自信对筛查用途仍偏大；文中非音系准确率"90.08%"与表 6 的 0.9031 不一致，且文本提及注意力可视化与 SHAP 却未给出实证解释分析结果。泛化证据薄弱：单一 15 分钟写作任务、单一年龄层、单一方言，单词级孤立判断缺乏篇章上下文与" developed compensatory strategies" 写作者的对照分析；"阅读障碍"为二分类的硬边界，掩盖了谱系特征。
因此更稳妥的读法是：本工作提供的是一个方法学原型与治理草案，其结论应限定为"在严格 opt-in、人类复核、不作诊断用途的窄场景中可作为辅助信号"，任何面向高利害教育决策的推广都必须以代表性人群（覆盖方言、L2、不同年龄与严重度）的重测、外部验证、持续偏差审计与法规合规为前提；作者本身亦指出"技术可行不等于部署正当"，这一张力是全文最有价值也最应被保留的部分。

title: Hierarchical Memory Orchestration for Personalized Persistent Agents
summary: While long-term memory is essential for intelligent agents to maintain consistent historical awareness, the accumulation of extensive interaction data often leads to performance bottlenecks. Naive storage expansion increases retrieval noise and computational latency, overwhelming the reasoning capacity of models deployed on constrained personal devices. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Memory Orchestration (HMO), a framework that organizes interaction history into a three-tiered directory driven by user-centric contextual relevance. Our system maintains a compact primary cache, coupling recent and pivotal memories with an evolving user profile to ensure agent reasoning remains aligned with individual behavioral traits. This primary cache is complemented by a high-priority secondary layer, both of which are managed within a global archive of the full interaction history. Crucially, the user persona dictates memory redistribution across this hierarchy, promoting records mapped to long-term patterns toward more active tiers while relegating less relevant information. This targeted orchestration surfaces historical knowledge precisely when needed while maintaining a lean and efficient active search space. Evaluations on multiple benchmarks achieve state-of-the-art performance. Real-world deployments in ecosystems like OpenClaw demonstrate that HMO significantly enhances agent fluidity and personalization.

AI.tldr: HMO提出一种三层记忆编排框架，通过用户中心上下文相关性管理交互历史。系统由紧凑的主缓存（近期+关键记忆+用户画像）、高优先级次级层和全局存档组成。用户画像驱动记忆重新分配，将映射到长期模式的记录提升至活跃层。评估达到最优性能，已在OpenClaw生态中部署。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆对智能体维持历史一致性至关重要，但大量交互数据的累积导致性能瓶颈：存储扩展增加检索噪声和计算延迟，削弱部署在受限个人设备上的模型推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Memory Orchestration (HMO)框架，将交互历史组织为三层目录结构，由用户中心上下文相关性驱动。系统维护紧凑主缓存（耦合近期记忆、关键记忆与演化用户画像），配合高优先级次级层，二者均在全局存档（全量交互历史）内管理。用户画像决定记忆重新分配，促进映射长期模式的记录向活跃层提升。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 在OpenClaw等生态系统中的真实部署表明，HMO显著增强了智能体的流畅性和个性化能力。

title: Coupled Query-Key Dynamics for Attention
summary: Standard scaled dot-product attention computes scores from static, independent projections of the input. We show that evolving queries and keys \emph{jointly} through shared learned dynamics before scoring - which we call \textbf{coupled QK dynamics} - improves language modeling perplexity and training stability. On WikiText-103 at 60M parameters, coupled dynamics achieves 22.55--22.62 perplexity vs.\ 24.22 for standard attention ($-$6.6--6.9\%), with only 0.11\% additional parameters (shared across both instantiations). A structural ablation isolates coupling as the active ingredient: a symplectic (Hamiltonian) and a non-symplectic (Euler) integrator perform identically when both couple Q and K, while an uncoupled MLP baseline of matched capacity reaches only 23.81 with 8$\times$ higher seed variance. The integration step count (1--7) is similarly irrelevant - a single coupled step suffices. A compute-matched comparison reveals that coupling is a \emph{sample-efficiency} mechanism: standard attention trained for 2.4$\times$ longer (matching wall-clock) reaches the same perplexity, but requires 2.4$\times$ more tokens. The advantage scales to 150M ($-$6.7\%) but narrows at 350M ($-$1.0\%), where Differential Attention (18.93) overtakes coupled dynamics (19.35). The benefit is corpus-dependent: coupling helps on domain-coherent text (WikiText-103 $-$6.6\%, PubMed $-$4.5\%) but degrades on heterogeneous web text ($+$10.3\%) and shows no benefit on GLUE. We characterize when coupling helps and when it does not, providing practical guidelines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「耦合 QK 动力学」（coupled query-key dynamics）：在打分前用共享的可逆仿射耦合（alternating affine coupling，源自非保体积 normalizing flow）对每个 token 自身的 (q,k) 做联合演化，保留原始点积与 softmax 不变、可逆且初始化为恒等、仅增加约 0.13%–0.33% 参数。核心结论不是「耦合单独更强」，而是「耦合可与已有注意力方法叠加」：在 WikiText-103 上把耦合加在 Differential Attention 之上，150M 与 455M 均显著降低困惑度（455M 六种子 p=0.003，2.1% 相对降幅，经 Bonferroni 校正与留出测试集复现），而单独使用的耦合收益随规模衰减至不显著；容量对照表明增益来自「双向联合耦合」结构而非参数量，可逆性是保证其跨规模可靠的唯一前提，代价是 4%–10% 训练吞吐与 11%–23% 显存开销。
AI.motivation: 标准缩放点积注意力把 Q 与 K 视为输入的两次彼此独立的线性投影，二者在产生注意力分数的点积之前从无交互。近年的改进多集中在「打分阶段」（Differential Attention 做双 softmax 差分、Multi-Token Attention 在分数图上卷积）或「投影归一化阶段」（QK-Norm、fully normalized Transformer），而「打分前对 (q,k) 做联合变换」这一设计维度被忽视；同时存在两个顾虑：预打分变换可能只是单纯增加 head 容量（必须与参数量做匹配对照），且小规模收益常随规模增大而消失（需在真正部署的规模上检验）。论文因此把联合预打分变换定位为与现有注意力方法互补、可组合的「设计轴」，而非替代品；「dynamics」一词指多轮耦合演化，而非时序微分方程（哈密顿力学类比仅为其灵感来源，记录于附录 J）。
AI.method: 【结构】在每层每个 head 内插入可学习映射 C:(Q,K)→(Q̃,K̃)，作用范围限于同一 token 自身的 q 与 k，不引入位置间配对交互，不改动 softmax 与后续结构；因此可作为「drop-in 替换」叠加到任意打分阶段方法之上。【具体实现】交替仿射耦合（式 2–3）：k' = k⊙exp(s_θ(q)) + t_θ(q)，q' = q⊙exp(s_φ(k')) + t_φ(k')，先由 query 条件化 key 更新，再用更新后的 key 条件化 query 更新；s,t 为两层 MLP（SiLU 激活、输出层零初始化），保证初始化时严格等于恒等映射；对任意网络取值均可逆，其对数体积变化为 Σs_θ(q)+Σs_φ(k')，一般非零即非保体积；log-scale 裁剪至 [-3,3]；仅用 1 轮耦合。【理论动机】交替坐标耦合流在足够深度下是任意可逆光滑映射的通用逼近器（Teshima et al. 2020），而纯加性（保体积）耦合被证明表达受限；论文明确说明这只是动机而非对所训练浅层实现的通用性主张，结论由消融实验支撑。【组合实验】Coupling+Differential Attention、Coupling+Multi-Token Attention、Coupling+QK-Norm；因零初始化，每个组合变体在初始化时精确退化为其基线方法。【训练协议】WikiText-103 解码器 Transformer，60M/150M/455M 三档，30K 步 AdamW+cosine，序列长 512，GPT-2 BPE 词表，RMSNorm+SwiGLU+学习式位置编码（另做 RoPE 消融）；主比较 3 种子，455M Differential 组合 6 种子；单侧 Welch t 检验 + Cohen's d，17 个比较的 Bonferroni 族（α≈0.0029）。【对照】独立非线性投影、非可逆 cross-MLP（参数量更大）、线性混合（5× 参数）、以及保持双向交互但改为同步更新（丧失可逆性）的最小差异变体；另含容量对照、跨语料（FineWeb-Edu）、零样本迁移（LAMBADA/HellaSwag）、MQAR 联想回忆、注意力秩与熵、训练预算曲线分析。
AI.result: 【耦合族阶梯】60M：标准 24.20→单向仿射 24.04→交替仿射 23.92；从单向到交替为强显著步（p=0.006，d=4.4），中间步仅边缘（p=0.077）——与表达力论证一致，即交替非保体积形式才是有效成分。【单独使用的增益随规模衰减】60M −1.18%（p=0.025）、150M −0.74%（p=0.015）、455M −0.36%（不显著，p=0.19）；作者说明固定 token 预算（约 0.49B，token/参数比从 8.2 降到 1.1）导致大模型训练不足，该混杂无法与真实规模效应分离。【核心组合结果】Coupling+Differential 在 150M 为 20.92 vs 21.10（p=0.024），455M 为 18.79 vs 18.89（六种子 p=0.003，d=2.1；留出测试集 20.88 vs 21.02，p=0.002），并通过 Bonferroni 校正；RoPE 序列长 512/1024/2048 上相对降幅 1.05%/1.54%/2.06%（1024 的 p=0.0015 通过校正，512/2048 未通过，仅作描述性）；Multi-Token Attention（p=0.128/0.16）与 QK-Norm（150M p=0.001 显著，455M p=0.08）方向一致但不显著，455M 上仅 Differential 组合保持显著。【归因对照】60M：独立非线性 24.13（不显著）、cross-MLP 24.04、线性混合 24.34 均劣于耦合 23.92；455M 上 non-invertible cross-MLP 与基线无差异（p=0.51），证明增益非容量所致；同步（非可逆）耦合在 455M 保留增益（18.78，p=0.042）但在 150M 严重劣于基线（22.17 vs 21.10，p=0.0001，甚至低于标准注意力），说明增益来自双向联合耦合，而可逆性是跨规模可靠性的关键（唯一在所有规模都优于基线的预打分变体）。【训练预算分析】组合在 455M 的相对差距 8K 步即 −0.37%，15K 达 −0.66% 并稳定至 29K 步（后半期 −0.02%/1K 步），与「仅优化速度」的预测相反；单独耦合差距则在后期收敛（+0.02%/1K 步）。【跨语料与迁移】FineWeb-Edu 60M：标准 45.30、耦合 44.78、Diff 45.12、组合 44.35（两种子，仅描述性）；零样本 455M：组合在 LAMBADA（0.272 vs 0.263，p=0.04）与 HellaSwag（0.310 vs 0.306，p=0.15）最佳，单独耦合在两项上低于标准注意力。【机制刻画】MQAR 中 4 对 KV 时耦合更准更稳（0.99±0.01 vs 0.92±0.14），8 对最难设置下耦合崩溃（0.18±0.00，锐利指针头被平滑抑制），加入 Differential Attention 后全网格恢复 1.00。【秩与熵】预 softmax 有效秩各变体一致约 14.4（由因果掩码主导）；后 softmax 秩在 L16–L23 上耦合 53.5 vs 标准 46.2，Diff 组合 45.3 vs 42.5，仅为温和效应，未突破秩坍缩界；注意力熵剖面无解释方差缩减的熵效应。【开销】参数 +0.33%（60M）/+0.13%（455M）；组合相对 Differential Attention 的吞吐开销 60M 约 8–10%、455M 长 512 为 7.4%、长 2048 为 4.1%，峰值显存开销 17%/23%/11%（MLP 未融合，融合 kernel 可缩小差距）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心主张是「组合性」而非「独立胜出」：耦合（coupled QK dynamics）应被视为可叠加在打分阶段方法之上的可组合预打分变换轴，而非标准注意力的直接替代品。实践建议：已使用 Differential Attention 等打分阶段方法的实践者可用极小参数开销（455M 仅 +0.13%）换取小而一致的困惑度下降（455M 显著），并需权衡 4%–10% 吞吐与 11%–23% 显存开销；单独使用耦合仅建议在 150M 以下规模。作者坦承的局限：单独增益随规模消失且最大仅测到 455M；固定 token 预算使大模型训练不足，规模效应与训练欠拟合无法分离；Multi-Token Attention 组合仅为方向性而非显著；组合结论仅在 Differential Attention 上于「单独收益已消失」的规模得到确证，QK-Norm 在其设置下本身并非有竞争力的基线，因此「是否普遍可加」仍开放；FineWeb-Edu 仅两种子无显著性；MQAR 与秩分析基于单一小合成设置，机制未必与完整语言建模一致；实验仅覆盖单一模型族。后续方向：更大规模的组合比较、耦合与打分阶段方法联合调参、跨模型族验证，以及实现融合 kernel 以缩小延迟差距。附注：所给摘要与所给 arXiv 全文在数值与结论上不一致（摘要给出 60M 上 22.55–22.62 vs 24.22、350M 时 Differential 反超、PubMed/GLUE 的语料依赖性、以及「样本效率机制」的计算匹配比较；全文则给出 24.20→23.92、最大规模 455M、无 GLUE/PubMed 实验），故两份材料应视为不同版本，上述分析以全文实验为准。

title: SURE: Synergistic Uncertainty-aware Reasoning for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversations (MERC) requires integrating multimodal signals while being robust to noise and modeling contextual reasoning. Existing approaches often emphasize fusion but overlook uncertainty in noisy features and fine-grained reasoning. We propose SURE (Synergistic Uncertainty-aware REasoning) for MERC, a framework that improves robustness and contextual modeling. SURE consists of three components: an Uncertainty-Aware Mixture-of-Experts module to handle modality-specific noise, an Iterative Reasoning module for multi-turn reasoning over context, and a Transformer Gate module to capture intra- and inter-modal interactions. Experiments on benchmark MERC datasets show that SURE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in robust multimodal reasoning. These results highlight the importance of uncertainty modeling and iterative reasoning in advancing emotion recognition in conversational settings.

AI.tldr: SURE是一个用于对话中多模态情绪识别的框架，通过不确定性感知混合专家模块、迭代推理模块和Transformer门控模块三个组件，提升模型在噪声环境下的鲁棒性和上下文建模能力，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在融合多模态信号时存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 对噪声特征的不确定性处理不足；(2) 缺乏细粒度的上下文推理能力。现有的融合策略往往简单叠加多模态信息，忽视了模态特异性噪声和上下文依赖性。
AI.method: SURE框架包含三个核心模块：① Uncertainty-Aware MoE（混合专家）模块——针对模态特异性噪声进行建模；② Iterative Reasoning（迭代推理）模块——支持多轮上下文推理；③ Transformer Gate模块——捕获模态内和跨模态交互。
AI.result: 在多个基准MERC数据集上的实验表明，SURE一致性地超越了当前最优方法，验证了其在多模态推理任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性建模和迭代推理是提升对话场景中情绪识别性能的关键要素。

title: Can Heterogeneous Language Models Be Fused?
summary: Model merging aims to integrate multiple expert models into a single model that inherits their complementary strengths without incurring the inference-time cost of ensembling. Recent progress has shown that merging can be highly effective when all source models are \emph{homogeneous}, i.e., derived from the same pretrained backbone and therefore share aligned parameter coordinates or compatible task vectors. Yet this assumption is increasingly unrealistic in open model ecosystems, where useful experts are often built on different families such as Llama, Qwen, and Mistral. In such \emph{heterogeneous} settings, direct weight-space fusion becomes ill-posed due to architectural mismatch, latent basis misalignment, and amplified cross-source conflict. We address this problem with \texttt{HeteroFusion} for heterogeneous language model fusion, which consists of two key components: topology-based alignment that transfers knowledge across heterogeneous backbones by matching functional module structures instead of raw tensor coordinates, and conflict-aware denoising that suppresses incompatible or noisy transfer signals during fusion. We further provide analytical justification showing that preserving the target adapter basis while predicting structured updates leads to a stable and well-conditioned transfer process. Across heterogeneous transfer, multi-source fusion, noisy-source robustness, and cross-family generalization settings, \texttt{HeteroFusion} consistently outperforms strong merging, fusion, and ensemble baselines.

AI.tldr: HeteroFusion解决异构语言模型融合问题，通过拓扑对齐和冲突感知去噪两大组件，在跨模型家族、多源融合、噪声鲁棒性和跨家族泛化等场景中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统模型合并方法依赖同构模型（相同预训练骨干），但开放模型生态中专家模型常来自不同家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral等）。异构场景下存在架构不匹配、潜在基对齐错位、跨源冲突加剧等问题，直接权重空间融合失效。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方案：1）拓扑对齐——通过匹配功能模块结构而非原始张量坐标实现跨异构骨干的知识迁移；2）冲突感知去噪——抑制融合过程中不兼容或噪声传输信号。理论分析表明，保持目标适配器基同时预测结构化更新可实现稳定、条件良好的迁移过程。
AI.result: 在异构迁移、多源融合、噪声源鲁棒性、跨家族泛化四类设置中，HeteroFusion一致性地超越强大的合并、融合和集成基线方法。
AI.conclusion: HeteroFusion为异构语言模型融合提供了有效解决方案，证明了通过功能拓扑匹配而非坐标对齐处理异构性的可行性，为开放模型生态中的模型集成开辟了新路径。

title: MiCA Learns More Knowledge Than LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning
summary: Minor Component Adaptation (MiCA) is a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models that focuses on adapting underutilized subspaces of model representations. Unlike conventional methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which target dominant subspaces, MiCA leverages Singular Value Decomposition to identify subspaces related to minor singular vectors associated with the least significant singular values and constrains the update of parameters during fine-tuning to those directions. This strategy leads to up to 5.9x improvement in knowledge acquisition under optimized training hyperparameters and a minimal parameter footprint of 6-60% compared to LoRA. These results suggest that constraining adaptation to minor singular directions provides a more efficient and stable mechanism for integrating new knowledge into pre-trained language models.

AI.tldr: MiCA是一种针对大型语言模型的新型参数高效微调方法，通过SVD识别与最小奇异值相关的次要奇异向量子空间，并将参数更新约束在这些方向上，实现比LoRA更少的参数（6-60%）和高达5.9倍的知识获取改进。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）通常针对模型表示中的主导子空间进行适配，但作者认为这些方向可能已被充分利用；相反，未被充分利用的次要子空间可能更适合整合新知识，且更具参数效率。
AI.method: 利用奇异值分解（SVD）识别与最小奇异值相关的次要奇异向量子空间，在微调过程中将参数更新约束在这些次要奇异方向上，而非传统方法所关注的主导方向。
AI.result: 在优化的训练超参数下，MiCA相比LoRA实现了高达5.9倍的知识获取提升，参数占用仅为LoRA的6-60%，且具有更好的稳定性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 将适配约束在次要奇异方向上为将新知识集成到预训练语言模型中提供了一种更高效、更稳定的机制，表明次要子空间可能是知识整合的关键靶点。

title: Is Clinical Text Enough? A Multimodal Study on Mortality Prediction in Heart Failure Patients
summary: Accurate short-term mortality prediction in heart failure (HF) remains challenging, particularly when relying on structured electronic health record (EHR) data alone. We evaluate transformer-based models on a French HF cohort, comparing text-only, structured-only, multimodal, and LLM-based approaches. Our results show that enriching clinical text with entity-level representations improves prediction over CLS embeddings alone, and that supervised multimodal fusion of text and structured variables achieves the best overall performance. In contrast, large language models perform inconsistently across modalities and decoding strategies, with text-only prompts outperforming structured or multimodal inputs. These findings highlight that entity-aware multimodal transformers offer the most reliable solution for short-term HF outcome prediction, while current LLM prompting remains limited for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本研究在法国心衰队列中评估了基于Transformer的模型对短期死亡率预测的效果，比较了纯文本、纯结构化、多模态融合和LLM四种方法。结果表明，融合文本和结构化数据的监督多模态方法表现最佳，而当前LLM方法的性能不稳定，纯文本提示反而优于结构化或多模态输入。
AI.motivation: 心衰(HF)患者的短期死亡率预测仍具挑战性，尤其是在仅依赖结构化电子健康记录(EHR)数据时，现有方法难以充分捕捉临床信息。
AI.method: 在法国心衰队列上评估基于Transformer的模型，比较四种方法：纯文本、纯结构化、多模态融合以及基于大语言模型(LLM)的方法。研究重点关注实体级表示是否优于CLS嵌入，以及不同模态组合的效果。
AI.result: 实体级表示相比CLS嵌入可提升预测效果；监督多模态融合（文本+结构化变量）取得最佳整体性能；LLM在不同模态和解码策略下表现不一致，其中纯文本提示优于结构化或多模态输入。
AI.conclusion: 实体感知多模态Transformer是心衰短期预后预测最可靠的解决方案，而当前LLM提示方法在临床决策支持中的应用仍有局限性。

title: EvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
summary: Anthropic proposes the concept of skills for LLM agents to tackle multi-step professional tasks that simple tool invocations cannot address. A tool is a single, self-contained function, whereas a skill is a structured bundle of interdependent multi-file artifacts. Currently, skill generation is not only label-intensive due to manual authoring, but also may suffer from human--machine cognitive misalignment, which can lead to degraded agent performance, as evidenced by evaluations on SkillsBench. Therefore, we aim to enable agents to autonomously generate skills. However, existing self-evolving methods designed for tools cannot be directly applied to skills due to their increased complexity. To address these issues, we propose EvoSkills, a self-evolving skills framework that enables agents to autonomously construct complex, multi-file skill packages.
