Models performed well on commonly discussed topics but struggled with specialized health data. These results indicate that LLM uncertainty estimates require statistical correction before they can be used in decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了11个大语言模型在贝叶斯引述任务（估计人口统计量并给出95%可信区间）中的表现，发现三个核心结论：更强的模型估计更准确，但增加推理算力（low/medium/high reasoning effort）并无一致增益；所有模型都严重过度自信，95%区间的实际覆盖率仅9%–44%；共形预测（conformal prediction）可有效校准并恢复名义覆盖率。附带的初步实验显示，赋予模型网页搜索会降低强模型的准确度、仅小幅改善弱模型。结论是：LLM输出的不确定性估计必须经过统计校准后才能用于决策支持。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯引述（Bayesian elicitation）是让人类专家在掌握先验知识但缺乏数据时，给出未知量（如患病率、人格特质分布比例、劳动市场指标）的概率估计，并附带不确定性区间。研究动机在于：随着大语言模型被提议作为"人类专家替身"来承担此类结构化估计与不确定性量化任务，其输出可靠性究竟如何、是否随模型规模与推理能力提升而改善、以及其置信度是否可信，均缺乏实证检验。作者希望回答：(1) 更强的模型是否给出更准确的点估计与区间；(2) 增大"思考量"（reasoning effort）是否改善结果；(3) LLM 的自报不确定性是否存在系统性过度自信偏差，能否用统计方法（如共形预测）修正；以及 (4) 联网检索是否是一种有效的提升手段。
AI.method: 实验设计为让11个大语言模型对多类人口统计量（健康患病率、人格特质分布、劳动市场数据等）给出点估计及95%可信区间，覆盖不同能力规模与三档推理投入（low/medium/high reasoning effort）。比较的评估维度包括：点估计的准确度（与真实总体统计量的接近程度）、区间的经验覆盖率（标称95%下的实际命中率）、推理投入与表现的关联、模型规模与表现的关联。校准环节采用共形预测：以模型输出的区间（或残差）为统计对象做保序/分位校准，按交换性假设构造校正区间，重新计算覆盖率以检验其是否回归名义水平。此外做了一个初步实验：为部分模型提供网页搜索工具，对比引入检索前后准确度的变化。题目涵盖常被讨论的话题与专门健康数据两类，用于考察主题熟悉度的影响。
AI.result: 三点主要发现：第一，更大、更强的模型点估计更准确，但提高推理努力程度并没有带来一致的改进（低/中/高推理设置之间无单调提升）；第二，所有模型均表现出严重的过度自信——标称95%的可信区间实际仅在9%–44%的情况下覆盖真值，远低于名义水平，说明LLM自报的不确定性被系统性低估；第三，共形预测校准可有效修正该过度自信，通过扩展区间达到预期的覆盖水平。此外，初步实验显示赋予模型网页搜索会**降低**原本已准确模型的表现，同时仅对较弱模型带来小幅改善，说明检索并非通用增益手段。模型在广为讨论的话题上表现良好，但在专业化健康数据上表现吃力。
AI.conclusion: LLM 具备一定程度的统计知识可用于贝叶斯式估计，且其准确性随模型能力提升而改善；但推理算力的额外投入与外部检索接入都不能可靠地提升估计质量或不确定性质量。最关键的是，LLM 直接给出的可信区间存在严重校准缺陷，不能直接用于风险敏感决策；必须经过共形预测等统计后处理校准，恢复名义覆盖率后再投入使用。作者据此指出：任何将LLM用作"不确定性感知的分析代理/专家替代"的应用，都应把统计校准作为必要环节。

title: Towards Intrinsically Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification in Industrial Data-Driven Models via Diffusion Sampler
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. Copyright has been transferred to IEEE. Reuse of this material is subject to IEEE copyright restrictions
summary: In modern process industries, data-driven models are important tools for real-time monitoring when key performance indicators are difficult to measure directly. While accurate predictions are essential, reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is equally critical for safety, reliability, and decision-making, but remains a major challenge in current data-driven approaches. In this work, we introduce a diffusion-based posterior sampling framework that inherently produces well-calibrated predictive uncertainty via faithful posterior sampling, eliminating the need for post-hoc calibration. In extensive evaluations on synthetic distributions, the Raman-based phenylacetic acid soft sensor benchmark, and a real ammonia synthesis case study, our method achieves practical improvements over existing UQ techniques in both uncertainty calibration and predictive accuracy. These results highlight diffusion samplers as a principled and scalable paradigm for advancing uncertainty-aware modeling in industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的后验采样框架，用于工业过程中的不确定性量化，实现无需后验校准的预测不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 在现代流程工业中，数据驱动模型是实时监控的重要工具，但关键性能指标往往难以直接测量。尽管准确的预测至关重要，但可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于安全性、可靠性和决策同样关键，而当前数据驱动方法在这方面仍面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散模型的后验采样框架，通过忠实的后验采样内在产生良好校准的预测不确定性，无需后验校准。
AI.result: 在合成分布、拉曼基苯乙酸软传感器基准测试和真实氨合成案例研究中，该方法在不确定校准和预测准确性方面均优于现有UQ技术。
AI.conclusion: 扩散采样器是推进工业应用不确定性感知建模的原则性和可扩展范式。

title: BraiNCA: brain-inspired neural cellular automata and applications to morphogenesis and motor control
summary: Most of the Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) defined in the literature have a common theme: they are based on regular grids with a Moore neighborhood (one-hop neighbour). They do not take into account long-range connections and more complex topologies as we can find in the brain. In this paper, we introduce BraiNCA, a brain-inspired NCA with an attention layer, long-range connections and complex topology. BraiNCAs shows better results in terms of robustness and speed of learning on the two tasks compared to Vanilla NCAs establishing that incorporating attention-based message selection together with explicit long-range edges can yield more sample-efficient and damage-tolerant self-organization than purely local, grid-based update rules. These results support the hypothesis that, for tasks requiring distributed coordination over extended spatial and temporal scales, the choice of interaction topology and the ability to dynamically route information will impact the robustness and speed of learning of an NCA. More broadly, BraiNCA provides brain-inspired NCA formulation that preserves the decentralized local update principle while better reflecting non-local connectivity patterns, making it a promising substrate for studying collective computation under biologically-realistic network structure and evolving cognitive substrates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BraiNCA：一种受脑启发的神经细胞自动机，在传统网格 NCA 基础上加入注意力层、显式长程连接与非网格拓扑，在形态发生（16×16 细胞自组织出笑脸图案）与运动控制（Gymnasium LunarLander-v3）两个任务上对比 Vanilla NCA。形态发生实验中长程连接与更大邻域显著加快学习（最优 5×5+长程相对 3×3 Vanilla 的平均成功时间降低 54.3%，2.19× 加速）；LunarLander 实验中 somatotopic 的 T 形拓扑显著提升成功率与收敛速度，而该任务上长程连接反而略微拖累鲁棒性。结论：交互拓扑与动态信息路由的选择会实质影响 NCA 的自组织效率与损伤耐受性。
AI.motivation: 主流 NCA 几乎都建立在规则二维网格的 Moore 邻域（一跳邻接）之上，缺少长程连接与脑式复杂拓扑；而大脑网络具有稀疏、模块化、hub 主导、小世界与 somatotopic（拓扑组织）等结构特性，脑启发 AI 强调把这类连接约束引入模型设计。已有 GNCA 类工作虽把 NCA 推广到任意交互图，但未在生物形态发生与运动控制任务上与 Vanilla NCA 正面对比，也未系统考察不同长程连接模式。
AI.method: 构建 BraiNCA：每个细胞维护 C 维状态与可选环境输入 s=[c;ρ]；对局部邻域 N 与稀疏长程邻域 L 分别用两套 MLP（64 隐单元、GELU）注意力打分并 softmax 归一化，聚合为 n 与 l；经 f_Z 组合成交互向量 z，再经 f_msg（可拼接系统级反馈 u 与外部输入 o）得到 m；状态更新用 GRU（维持时间记忆）+ 前馈 refine 网络（残差连接 c^{t+1}=h^t+r^t）。形态发生任务：16×16、256 细胞、3 类细胞（背景/轮廓/五官），C=9（3 可见 softmax + 6 隐藏），T=35 步，随机高斯初始化，交叉熵损失仅在末步计算，BPTT+Adam(lr=1e-3)，5000 episodes，早停 98% 像素准确；长程连接用 Zipf 分布 hub（每 hub 出边≤6）的无标度随机过程生成。四条件（3×3/5×5 × Vanilla/长程），各 50 次随机种子 42–91。LunarLander 任务：C=12，注意力输入含状态、上一激活与 2D 位置编码（S=15）；网格划分为四个动作区域（NOOP/LEFT/MAIN/RIGHT），每区 softmax 加权 fire logit 聚合为 4 路 logit，softmax 策略采样动作，每环境步执行 3 次 NCA 内部更新；REINFORCE + 熵正则（γ=0.99），动作 logit 加高斯噪声，Adam(lr=1e-3, wd=1e-4) + 梯度裁剪，10000 episodes，成功阈值累计奖励≥260；风扰动 5.0、湍流 1.5；拓扑含 16×16 象限（Vanilla/长程）与 24×16 的 T 形四 8×8 区域（T-Shape/T-Shape+LR），长程采用 patch 方案（每区中心 3×3 patch 随机采样，每区 6 个目标，共 12 个长程邻居，NOOP 不参与）。统计：成功率、达成功所需 episodes、收敛方差、最佳评估奖励，生存分析（log-rank、RMST 置换检验，未成功右删失于 10000 episodes），各条件约 1000–1300 次独立运行。
AI.result: 形态发生：四条件 100% 达到成功。3×3 长程将 RMST 从 658.4 降至 454.2 episodes（−31.0%，log-rank p=5.48e-6）；5×5 长程从 383.6 降至 301.2（−21.5%，p=4.22e-4）；Vanilla 条件邻域 3×3→5×5 从 658.4 降至 383.6（−41.7%）；最优 5×5+长程相对基线 3×3 Vanilla 从 658.4 降至 301.2（−54.3%，2.19× 加速，p=9.46e-20），显示长程连接与更大邻域独立且协同地提升样本效率。LunarLander：成功率 Vanilla 84.3%、长程 77.4%、T-Shape 88.4%、T-Shape+长程 85.4%；Vanilla 显著优于长程（Fisher 单侧 p=3.90e-6），T-Shape 显著优于 Vanilla（p=0.00137）与长程（p=1.01e-13），T-Shape+长程优于长程（p=1.05e-7）但与 Vanilla 无显著差异。RMST 依次为 5248.0 / 5768.6 / 5018.1 / 5316.3 episodes，T-Shape 相对 Vanilla 减少 229.9、相对长程减少 750.5 episodes。即体拓扑/功能区域化提升鲁棒性与学习速度，而长程连接在该任务上反而略微有害（作者归因于长程 patch 组织过于简单）。
AI.conclusion: BraiNCA 证明在保留“去中心化局部更新”原则的同时，引入注意力式消息选择、显式长程边与非规则拓扑可带来更样本高效、更耐损伤的自组织；拓扑与功能区域化（somatotopy）对学习速度与鲁棒性影响显著，但长程连接受任务与连线方案影响（形态发生有益、LunarLander 略负）。局限：长程拓扑为固定先验而非可发育学习；未来方向是随细胞状态共同“生长”出每细胞的长程亲和矩阵，构建形态与连接协同发育的虚拟生物体，并作为研究集体计算与自演化认知基质的实验平台。

title: Robust Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Spectral Contrast
summary: Spectral graph contrastive learning has emerged as a unified paradigm for handling both homophilic and heterophilic graphs by leveraging high-frequency components. However, we identify a fundamental spectral dilemma: while high-frequency signals are indispensable for encoding heterophily, our theoretical analysis proves they exhibit significantly higher variance under spectrally concentrated perturbations. We derive a regret lower bound showing that existing global (node-agnostic) spectral fusion is provably sub-optimal: on mixed graphs with separated node-wise frequency preferences, any global fusion strategy incurs non-vanishing regret relative to a node-wise oracle. To escape this bound, we propose ASPECT, a framework that resolves this dilemma through a reliability-aware spectral gating mechanism. Formulated as a minimax game, ASPECT employs a node-wise gate that dynamically re-weights frequency channels based on their stability against a purpose-built adversary, which explicitly targets spectral energy distributions via a Rayleigh quotient penalty. This design forces the encoder to learn representations that are both structurally discriminative and spectrally robust. Empirical results show that ASPECT achieves new state-of-the-art performance on 8 out of 9 benchmarks, effectively decoupling meaningful structural heterophily from incidental noise.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ASPECT：一个在节点级别自适应融合低频/高频谱视图的谱图对比学习方法。核心动机是理论证明——在节点谱偏好异质且分离的混合图上，图级（节点无关）的谱融合存在不可消除的遗憾下界 Regret ≥ (μ/2)·(p₋p₊/(p₋+p₊))·Δ²。方法上用节点级门控 MLP_g 预测每个节点的低/高频混合权重 m_v，并以通道级对比损失构造效用感知的软策略目标（熵正则化 softmax），再以二元交叉熵正则项 L_pol 训练门控；可选扩展 ASPECT-S 通过生成图结构/特征扰动估计通道敏感度，并以 Rayleigh 商差作为谱搜索偏置引导扰动生成。实验表明 ASPECT 在 9 个同配/异配基准中 8 个取得最优干净精度并全面优于节点无关融合的 PolyGCL，ASPECT-S 在联合扰动下于全部评测数据集最优、平均精度跌幅仅 6.51%（PolyGCL 为 13.22%）。
AI.motivation: 谱图对比学习（spectral GCL）通过同时构造低频与高频视图，成为统一处理同配（homophily）与异配（heterophily）图的主流范式：高频分量对编码异配结构不可或缺。然而现有方法（PolyGCL、HLCL、S3GCL 等）在获得两个谱通道后，多采用图级或节点无关的固定规则进行融合，把"融合"当作架构细节处理。论文指出这一设计存在结构性缺陷：真实图常呈混合结构，不同节点的最优谱偏好（依赖平滑低频信息还是依赖非平滑高频信息）差异显著，单一全局混合系数不可能对所有节点同时近似最优，因此有必要把融合粒度提升到节点级。第二个动机来自鲁棒性：标准对比目标并不显式约束表示对图结构/节点特征扰动的敏感性，而高频信号在频谱集中式扰动下方差更大，导致"低风险但高敏感"的最优系数在扰动场景下可能失效。
AI.method:
【理论】定理2.1：设对比代理风险 R_v(α) 满足 μ-二次增长（Assumption B.2），且存在两个占比 p₋,p₊>0 的分离谱偏好子群，其最优融合集分别落在 [0,a₋] 与 [a₊,1]（Δ=a₊−a₋>0），则最优全局融合相对节点级 oracle 的遗憾满足 Regret ≥ (μ/2)·(p₋p₊/(p₋+p₊))·Δ²（在两子群覆盖全图时化为 (μ/2)r(1−r)Δ²）。证明基于 dist²(α, A_v*) 的下界与一维分段二次函数的精确极小化（最优 α*=(p₋a₋+p₊a₊)/(p₋+p₊)）。定理2.2：在损失对嵌入 L-Lipschitz 假设下，扰动感知风险满足 R_v^Q(m) ≤ E_v(m) + L·S_v(m)；附录 B.5 证明归一化 InfoNCE 的 Lipschitz 常数 ≤ 2/τ；命题 B.5 说明标准风险最优系数可能对扰动上界次优；命题 B.6（最坏情况扰动目标上界任意支撑于 Q_v 的局部偏移分布）与 B.7（熵正则化通道选择问题的唯一极小解即 softmax(-B/τ_g)，构成策略目标的插值式解释）支撑方法设计。

【方法 ASPECT】(a) 用可学习谱滤波器构造双通道：以重标定拉普拉斯 L̃=2L/λ_max−I 上的 K 阶截断 Chebyshev 多项式近似，滤波器值在 Chebyshev 节点上以可学习增量参数化（高通单调非减 γ_i^H=Σ_{j≤i}ReLU(δ_j^H)，低通单调非增 γ_i^L=ReLU(δ_0^L)−Σ_{j≥1}ReLU(δ_j^L)），再经离散 Chebyshev 变换解析恢复多项式系数，两通道共享投影网络 f_θ。(b) 节点级谱策略：m_v=σ(MLP_g([z_{L,v}‖z_{H,v}]))，融合表示 z_v=m_v z_{L,v}+(1−m_v)z_{H,v}。(c) 标准对比目标 L_std：融合表示与增强视图表示之间的归一化 InfoNCE。(d) 效用感知策略正则：通道级对比损失 ℓ^std_{c,v} 经批内（跨两通道联合）归一化得通道成本 b_{c,v}，softmax(-b/τ_g) 得到软目标 m̃_v（stop-gradient），以 BCE 形式的 L_pol 推动门控靠近该目标；总损失 L_ASPECT = L_std + λ_pol·L_pol。

【方法 ASPECT-S】(a) 内层扰动生成：在固定编码器与"干净图门控"的前提下，最大化 J_pert = L_gen + λ_ray·Φ_ray，其中 Φ_ray = R(A_pert, Z_L^pert) − R(A_pert, Z_H^pert)，Rayleigh 商 R(A,Z)=Tr(ZᵀL_A Z)/Tr(ZᵀZ) 度量 Dirichlet 平滑度/高频能量差；最大化该项即偏好"能打破低频-高频相对谱轮廓"的扰动，用稀疏拉普拉斯-向量乘计算，无需特征分解。(b) 通道稳定性损失 L_stab = Σ_v [m_v·ℓ_NCE(z_{L,v}^pert, z_v) + (1−m_v)·ℓ_NCE(z_{H,v}^pert, z_v)]，内层最大化、外层最小化。(c) 敏感度感知策略目标：经验敏感度 d̂_{c,v}=‖z^pert_{c,v}−z_{c,v}‖₂，经批内归一化后以权重 λ_s 叠加到通道成本 b_{c,v} 上。(d) 外层目标 L = L_std + λ_stab·L_stab + λ_pol·L_pol。

【工程优化】稀疏候选边集搜索（避免 O(|V|²)）、特征扰动预算约束、warmup + 每 r 轮才生成一次扰动、策略目标与通道分数全部 detach（不增加编码器前向）、采样式对比打分避免 O(n²) 相似度矩阵。复杂度：编码器 O(Kmd)；ASPECT-S 额外 O((T_pert/r)(Kmd + m_cand + q_f + md))，额外内存 O(nd + m_cand + q_f)。
AI.result:
【干净性能】9 个基准（Cora/Citeseer/Pubmed + Cornell/Texas/Wisconsin/Actor/Chameleon/Squirrel），10 次 60/20/20 划分自监督预训练 + 冻结编码器线性探针。ASPECT 在全基线对比中 8/9 数据集最优、余下 1 个次优：Cora 88.94、Citeseer 81.82、Pubmed 87.75、Cornell 89.18、Texas 91.76、Wisconsin 90.03、Actor 42.64、Chameleon 72.88、Squirrel 59.39（次优）。相较最直接的节点无关双谱基线 PolyGCL，ASPECT 在全部 9 个数据集上均提升（如 Cornell 89.18 vs 82.62、Texas 91.76 vs 88.03、Squirrel 59.39 vs 56.49）。ASPECT-S 干净性能保持竞争力（Squirrel 59.91 最优，多项次优）。

【扰动性能】固定预算联合扰动（Metattack 扰动 10% 边 + 随机掩蔽 10% 特征）：ASPECT-S 在全部评测数据集取得最高扰动精度（Cora 85.30、Citeseer 78.86、Pubmed 84.93、Actor 39.20、Chameleon 66.97、Squirrel 50.17），平均相对精度跌幅 6.51%，显著优于 ASPECT（11.01%）、PolyGCL（13.22%）、ARIEL（9.22%）等；变量预算（0%–25% 联合扫描）曲线显示 ASPECT-S 退化更平缓。

【消融】将节点级策略替换为全局融合在 Cora/Pubmed/Actor/Squirrel 的干净与扰动精度上全面下降（如 Pubmed 86.93 vs 87.75、Squirrel 57.05 vs 59.39）；去掉策略正则 L_pol 退化更明显（Pubmed 扰动 79.17 vs 82.38）；去掉 Rayleigh 偏置削弱扰动性能（Squirrel 47.61 vs 50.17）；去掉敏感度项的策略目标带来更大退化。

【策略行为】m_v 未坍缩为全局常数：Cora 偏向大 m_v（低频），Squirrel 分布更宽（节点级异质性更强）；分箱后平均 m_v 随 b_{H,v}−b_{L,v} 单调上升，即低频通道代价更低时门控给出更大低频权重，验证了策略与通道级证据的一致性。

【实验规范】超参用 Optuna 在原论文推荐配置附近搜索，仅以干净图验证集精度选择（不使用扰动数据调参）；HLCL 因无兼容官方实现而引用 PolyGCL 论文报告值并排除于扰动评测，DPGCL、LOHA 因无可用实现未纳入比较。
AI.conclusion: 论文把"谱融合粒度"确立为频域感知图自监督学习的一个关键设计维度：理论证明在节点谱偏好异质且分离的混合图上，节点无关的全局融合存在不可消除的遗憾，因而必须允许逐节点改变频谱混合；据此提出 ASPECT，以节点级谱策略 + 通道级对比证据驱动的效用感知正则实现该融合，并在可选的 ASPECT-S 分支中借助生成扰动与 Rayleigh 谱搜索偏置把通道敏感度纳入策略目标，使表示在结构与特征扰动下更稳定。实验支持两个结论：节点级自适应融合在同配与异配图上均优于节点无关的全局融合基线；稳定性感知训练进一步大幅降低扰动下的精度退化，且不显著损害干净性能。局限包括：ASPECT-S 的扰动生成带来额外训练开销、仅支持两通道（未涉及多频带或节点相关滤波器族）、生成扰动只是敏感度的经验探针而非理论项的精确优化、评测局限于传导式节点分类，规模更大/归纳/时序图与更多下游任务有待验证。另需注意摘要中"极小极大博弈/对抗者/高频信号方差显著更高"的表述强于正文形式化内容：正文理论是在表示/融合层面的分析（遗憾下界、Lipschitz 敏感度上界），假设条件（μ-二次增长、两个分离偏好子群）较强且为条件性结论，方法侧的"极小极大"实际体现为内层最大化 J_pert 的对抗式扰动生成。

title: Prosodic ABX: A Language-Agnostic Method for Measuring Prosodic Contrast in Speech Representations
summary: Speech representations from self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to be sensitive to phonemic contrasts, but their sensitivity to prosodic contrasts has not been directly measured. The ABX discrimination task has been used to measure phonemic contrast in S3M representations via minimal pairs. We introduce prosodic ABX, an extension of this framework to evaluate prosodic contrast with only a handful of examples and no explicit labels. Also, we build and release a dataset of English and Japanese minimal pairs and use it along with a Mandarin dataset to evaluate contrast in English stress, Japanese pitch accent, and Mandarin tone. Finally, we show that model and layer rankings are often preserved across several experimental conditions, making it practical for low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"韵律ABX"任务框架，用于评估自监督语音模型(S3Ms)对韵律对比的敏感性，并在英语重音、日语音高重音和汉语声调三种韵律现象上进行实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督语音模型在音素对比敏感度方面已有研究，但对韵律对比(如重音、声调、音高重音)的敏感性缺乏直接测量方法。研究者需要一种无需标注数据且样本量小的评估工具。
AI.method: 提出"prosodic ABX"任务框架，扩展原有的ABX辨别任务；构建并发布英语和日语最小对立对数据集，结合普通话数据集；针对英语重音、日语音高重音、汉语声调进行韵律对比评估实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，模型排名和层排名在不同实验条件下具有较高一致性，说明该评估方法具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: prosodic ABX框架可有效评估S3Ms对韵律对比的敏感性，且方法实用性较强，适用于低资源场景。

title: Probabilistic classification from possibilistic data: computing Kullback-Leibler projection with a possibility distribution
summary: We consider learning with possibilistic supervision for multi-class classification. For each training instance, the supervision is a normalized possibility distribution that expresses graded plausibility over the classes. From this possibility distribution, we construct a non-empty closed convex set of admissible probability distributions by combining two requirements: probabilistic compatibility with the possibility and necessity measures induced by the possibility distribution, and linear shape constraints that must be satisfied to preserve the qualitative structure of the possibility distribution. Thus, classes with the same possibility degree receive equal probabilities, and if a class has a strictly larger possibility degree than another class, then it receives a strictly larger probability. Given a strictly positive probability vector output by a model for an instance, we compute its Kullback-Leibler projection onto the admissible set. This projection yields the closest admissible probability distribution in Kullback-Leibler sense. We can then train the model by minimizing the divergence between the prediction and its projection, which quantifies the smallest adjustment needed to satisfy the induced dominance and shape constraints. The projection is computed with Dykstra's algorithm using Bregman projections associated with the negative entropy, and we provide explicit formulas for the projections onto each constraint set. Experiments conducted on synthetic data and on a real-world natural language inference task, based on the ChaosNLI dataset, show that the proposed projection algorithm is efficient enough for practical use, and that the resulting projection-based learning objective can improve predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于可能性理论的多分类学习方法，将可能性分布转换为满足约束的可达概率分布，并通过Kullback-Leibler投影和Dykstra算法进行优化，在合成数据和ChaosNLI数据集上验证了算法的有效性和性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统的概率分类器难以处理可能性 supervision（可能性分布形式），需要一种方法来处理可能性分布与概率分布之间的转换，同时保持可能性分布的定性结构（如类间排序关系）。
AI.method: 1. 从可能性分布构建封闭凸的可达概率分布集合，结合概率兼容性和线性形状约束（相同可能性度对应相等概率，严格大于关系对应严格概率优势）；2. 对模型输出的正概率向量，使用负熵相关的Bregman投影，通过Dykstra算法计算到可达集的最优KL投影；3. 最小化预测与投影之间的散度进行训练。
AI.result: 投影算法计算高效（满足实际应用需求），基于投影的学习目标能够提升预测性能，在合成数据和ChaosNLI自然语言推理数据集上验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法成功桥接了可能性理论与概率学习，为处理非标准监督信息提供了一种有效框架，在保持定性约束的同时实现了可比的预测性能。

title: DDCL-INCRT: A Self-Organising Transformer with Hierarchical Prototype Structure (Theoretical Foundations)
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Neural Networks (Elsevier)
summary:
Modern neural networks of the transformer family require the practitioner to decide, before training begins, how many attention heads to use, how deep the network should be, and how wide each component should be. These decisions are made without knowledge of the task, producing architectures that are systematically larger than necessary: empirical studies find that a substantial fraction of heads and layers can be removed after training without performance loss.
  This paper introduces DDCL-INCRT, an architecture that determines its own structure during training. Two complementary ideas are combined. The first, DDCL (Deep Dual Competitive Learning), replaces the feedforward block with a dictionary of learned prototype vectors representing the most informative directions in the data. The prototypes spread apart automatically, driven by the training objective, without explicit regularisation. The second, INCRT (Incremental Transformer), controls the number of heads: starting from one, it adds a new head only when the directional information uncaptured by existing heads exceeds a threshold.
  The main theoretical finding is that these two mechanisms reinforce each other: each new head amplifies prototype separation, which in turn raises the signal triggering the next addition. At convergence, the network self-organises into a hierarchy of heads ordered by representational granularity. This hierarchical structure is proved to be unique and minimal, the smallest architecture sufficient for the task, under the stated conditions. Formal guarantees of stability, convergence, and pruning safety are established throughout.
  The architecture is not something one designs. It is something one derives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DDCL-INCRT：一种在训练过程中自行决定自身结构（注意力头数）的 Transformer 架构。它把每层的前馈网络（MLP）替换为 DDCL 竞争原型层（用可学习的原型向量字典替代固定权重矩阵，损失可精确分解为聚类保真项+非负分离项，从而自带抗塌缩力、端到端可微），并用 INCRT 机制按残差方向能量的谱阈值决定何时新增/剪枝注意力头。核心理论结论是二者的互增强回路：每次扩容都严格放大原型分离力，分离又抬高下一次扩容信号；收敛时网络自组织为按表征粒度排序的唯一最小充分层级原型结构，并给出全局 Lyapunov 稳定性、离散时间步长条件、剪枝安全与有限收敛等保证。
AI.motivation: 现代 Transformer 的头数、层数、前馈宽度必须在训练前由实践者凭网格搜索或经验指定，与任务性质无关，因而系统性地过度参数化：实证研究表明多数注意力头与层在训练后可被删除而不损失性能（LLM 中约 50% 注意力层可裁剪），且这一冗余并非架构搜索失败，而是结构性的——先前工作（DDCL-Attention 的"通道销毁定理"）证明固定的随机初始化前馈块会系统性丢弃注意力计算出的方向性（反对称）信息，架构只能用更多头来补偿。已有替代方案各有缺陷：后验剪枝/压缩浪费训练算力且冗余已被"先造后剪"；NAS 计算开销大且无形式化收敛保证；渐进式增长方法的判据多为启发式（层复制、泰勒近似）或全局搜索，无法给出"最小充分"保证；原型类方法（VQ-VAE、Slot Attention）离散分配不可微或需近似。因此需要一个在训练中由任务几何自行决定规模、并能给出严格理论保证的架构。
AI.method: 方法由三个部分组成。（1）DDCL 原型层：每层前馈块替换为 K 个原型向量 P⊂R^m，token 以温度 T 的软最近邻规则分配 q_nk（softmax of −‖z_n−p_k‖²/T），层输出为软质心 μ_n=Σ_k q_nk p_k；训练损失 L_q=Σ q_nk‖z_n−p_k‖² 可精确分解为 L_OLS+V，V≥0 为分离项，其梯度 ∇_P V=2PΣ_q（Σ_q 为软分配协方差，半正定）构成天然抗塌缩分离力，且全层端到端可微、无需 straight-through 估计量。（2）INCRT 增长/剪枝机制：将注意力权重积 M=W_Q W_Kᵀ 分解为对称 M_s 与反对称 M_a，定义残差矩阵 A_res=P⊥ X M_a XᵀP⊥（P⊥ 为已捕获子空间的正交投影）；当 λ_max(A_res)>θ_w 时沿 v_1(A_res) 初始化新头（原型生于残差方向最大的地方），低于阈值则停止增长；当头能量 Γ_h<φ_g 时剪除该头。（3）理论工具：全局分段自由能 Lyapunov 函数（跨增长、剪枝、训练步均非增）、三时间尺度奇异摄动/Tikhonov 分析、Weyl 不等式与特征值交错、贪心匹配追踪最优性，以及离散 SGD 步长条件（η_T≪η_P≪η⁺）。证明路线：先证增长严格放大 F_sep=‖∇_P V‖_F²（增益 ∝ λ_max(A_res)/T²），再证温度自发分化为 local/global 两组，再证方向信息损失 I(l) 严格优于 MLP，再证有限收敛、剪枝安全、离散时间扩展，最后刻画收敛时的层级结构与唯一性。
AI.result: 主要理论结果：(1) 互增强（Thm 1–2）：每次 INCRT 扩容后 F_sep 非减且严格增加，增益下界 (32/T²)[s₀²θ_w·Var̄[p*]/K²−C₀]，故"增长扩大原型可分离空间、原型分离抬高谱信号"形成自强化回路。(2) 尺度自发分化（Thm 3）：可训练温度单调下降并按 σ⁽ʰ⁾(0)∝λ_max(A_res⁽ʰ⁾)·S(P) 分裂为局部头（硬分配、T→T_min、离散原型词表）与全局头（软分配、连续质心），与架构设计无关。(3) 严格优于 MLP（Thm 4）：方向信息损失 I(l) 在每层几乎必然满足 I_DDCL<I_MLP（随机初始化下等号事件概率为零），增益下界随 d 增大趋于 1。(4) 有限收敛（Thm 5）：增长步数 K*≤K*_INCRT≤d，除 INCRT 基线外仅需新增"驻留时间 > 温度收敛时间"这一假设。(5) 剪枝安全（Thm 6）：原型子空间正交使被剪头的 F_sep 精确可分解，损失 ≤O(φ_g²)，存活头的原型展度 S(P) 机器精度不变且每头平均分离力不降。(6) 离散时间（Thm 7、Cor 9）：在 η_T<(T_min)³/(3σ_max)、η_P<2/L_P 等条件下所有连续时间结论以 O(η) 误差保持，剪枝安全为代数事件因而精确无误。(7) 全局稳定性（Thm 8、9）：构造覆盖增长/剪枝事件的分段自由能 W，在增长与剪枝时刻均不增，轨迹有界，LaSalle 不变集为 A*；并用迭代奇异摄动给出不含拟静态近似的显式耗散率下界，闭合了 DDCL-Attention 提出的开放问题。(8) 层级结构（Thm 10、Cor 14–16）：收敛后头部按 λ⁽ʰ⁾ 严格降序、温度严格升序排列，形成"分辨率谱"；覆盖度 ≥1−ε_θw；分数分离力严格单调递减且比值有下界；谱序在 (C1) 下几乎必然唯一，即任务唯一确定的最小充分层级；层级数、各层分辨率、local/global 边界均可由增长历史读出。实验仅作数值验证：合成数据上 λ⁽ʰ⁾ 单调下降、温度按序发散（Spearman −1.00）、分离力单调；BERT/SST-2 冻结编码器上 6 次剪枝事件全部以机器精度通过；端到端 SST-2 上增长至 6 头、λ_max 严格递减（4.36→2.38→2.15→1.35→0.84）、原型展度全正、验证准确率 69.4%，但 F_sep 未完全单调，作者归因于端到端共同适应（co-adaptation）。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张"架构不是被设计出来的，而是被推导出来的"：把"设计→训练→分析"的常规流程倒置为由可测量的不充分性（structure emerges from measurable insufficiency）驱动的自组织，七项性质（方向信息保持、分离放大、尺度分化、有限最小架构、剪枝安全、全局稳定、唯一层级结构）在明示且可检验的假设下被同时证明为共涌现结果；增长历史因此可作为任务方向复杂度的"测量"，类似 PCA 的解释方差阈值，回答"这个任务究竟需要多少注意力头"。需要明确的边界：这是纯理论论文，严格优势仅在自定义的方向信息损失指标 I(l) 意义上成立，并不主张任务精度、困惑度或训练速度上的优越性；大量结果继承自作者先前的 DDCL/INCRT/DDCL-Attention 工作（表格 1 明确区分继承/扩展/新证），且依赖大量正则性、谱隙与步长假设。实验只是可证伪的数值说明（含一处与单调性预测的部分偏离），大规模 NLP 基准验证仍在进行中。开放方向：完整三时间尺度随机逼近论证、在线 SGD 扩展到 mini-batch、以及将 INCRT 的深度增长判据与本文宽度层级唯一性结果的整合与相互作用。

title: Reliable Control-Point Selection for Steering Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Steering vectors offer a training-free mechanism for controlling reasoning behaviors in large language models, but constructing effective vectors requires identifying genuine behavioral signals in the model's hidden states. For behaviors that can be toggled via prompts, this is straightforward. However, many reasoning behaviors -- such as self-reflection -- emerge spontaneously and resist prompt-level control. Current methods detect these behaviors through keyword matching in chain-of-thought traces, implicitly assuming that every detected boundary encodes a genuine behavioral signal. We show that this assumption is overwhelmingly wrong: across 541 keyword-detected boundaries, 93.3\% are behaviorally unstable, failing to reproduce the detected behavior under re-generation from the same prefix. We develop a probabilistic model that formalizes intrinsic reasoning behaviors as stochastic events with context-dependent trigger probabilities, and show that unstable boundaries dilute the steering signal. Guided by this analysis, we propose stability filtering, which retains only boundaries where the model consistently reproduces the target behavior. Combined with a content-subspace projection that removes residual question-specific noise, our method achieves 0.784 accuracy on MATH-500 (+5.0 over the strongest baseline). The resulting steering vectors transfer across models in the same architecture family without re-extraction, improving Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-1.5B (+5.0) and DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview (+6.0). Code is available at https://github.com/zhmzm/stability-steering.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型推理行为控制中的转向向量（steering vectors）构建问题，发现现有基于关键词匹配的检测方法存在严重缺陷：93.3%的检测边界行为不稳定，无法在相同前缀下复现目标行为。作者提出稳定性过滤方法，仅保留能稳定复现目标行为的边界，并结合内容子空间投影去除问题特异性噪声，在MATH-500上达到78.4%准确率（+5.0%），且向量可跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有的转向向量构建方法依赖于关键词匹配来检测模型隐藏状态中的推理行为信号，但这种方法隐含假设每个检测到的边界都编码了真实的行为信号。作者通过实验证明这一假设是错误的——大多数检测到的边界是行为不稳定的，无法在重新生成时复现检测到的行为，这严重稀释了转向信号的效果。
AI.method: 1）建立概率模型，将内在推理行为形式化为具有上下文相关触发概率的随机事件；2）提出稳定性过滤（stability filtering），仅保留模型能一致复现目标行为的边界；3）结合内容子空间投影去除残留的问题特异性噪声。
AI.result: 在MATH-500基准上达到78.4%准确率，较最强基线提升5.0%；转向向量可在同一架构家族的不同模型间迁移，在Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-1.5B上提升5.0%，DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview上提升6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性是评估推理行为边界的必要条件，而非可选标准。通过过滤不稳定边界并投影到内容子空间，可以构建更有效的转向向量，实现跨模型泛化的推理行为控制。

title: Qiana: A First-Order Formalism to Quantify over Contexts and Formulas with Temporality
summary: We introduce Qiana, a logic framework for reasoning on formulas that are true only in specific contexts. In Qiana, it is possible to quantify over both formulas and contexts to express, e.g., that ``everyone knows everything Alice says''. Qiana also permits paraconsistent logics within contexts, so that contexts can contain contradictions. Furthermore, Qiana is based on first-order logic, and is finitely axiomatizable, so that Qiana theories are compatible with pre-existing first-order logic theorem provers. We show how Qiana can be used to represent temporality, event calculus, and modal logic. We also discuss different design alternatives of Qiana.

AI.tldr: Qiana（Quantifying over Agents and Assertions）是一个基于一阶逻辑（FOL）的形式化框架，通过把公式"引用"为项（quoted formula as term）并引入特殊真值谓词 𝕋、转义算子 ℚ 以及上下文谓词 ist，使逻辑能够同时支持：真相表示（ist(c,φ)→φ）、公式量化（∀φ）、上下文量化（∀c）以及半可判定性四项要求，并可有限公理化，从而兼容现成的一阶定理证明器（ATP/TPTP，如 Vampire）。论文进一步将事件演算（Shanahan 2000）用于时间性推理、给出多排序（many-sorted）类型化版本，并证明 K/T/S4/S5/D 等标准模态系统可在 Qiana 中等价表述。
AI.motivation: McCarthy (1987, 1993) 提出上下文（context）概念：命题只在特定上下文中为真，以 ist(c,φ) 表示。但现有方案各有缺陷：模态逻辑（Buvac & Mason 1993、Halpern & Moses 1992）无法量化公式、上下文；高阶逻辑量化的是谓词而非语法公式且通常不可半判定；Moore (1981) 的引用方案上下文受限（多世界语义假设上下文全知）、无有限公理化；KIF/Common Logic 无完备证明理论；Brewka 等的桥接规则框架、描述逻辑类方法（RDF-star、命名图）均不能同时满足四项要求。此外，真理表示要求会引发 Tarski (1936) 真理不可定义定理导致的自指矛盾问题，且需要半可判定性以支持自动推理。
AI.method: 核心思路：把公式编码为项（quoting），即把每个逻辑联结词、变量、谓词、函数符号替换为新的一元/多元函数符号（下划线符号 z̄），使得公式成为可被量化的对象；引入转义算子 ℚ 支持引用的嵌套（并允许在引用中注入变量）；引入一元真值谓词 𝕋，且规定可引用公式集合 ℒ_q 中不得含 𝕋，从而规避 Tarski 悖论；引入上下文谓词 ist(c, φ̄)。具体包括：(1) 形式定义引用集 𝒯̄/ℒ̄/𝒬、可引用项/公式集 𝒯_q/ℒ_q、引用函数 μ 与反引用 μ⁻¹、带引号变量的替换 [x̄←t]_q；(2) 真值公理 A_truth: 𝕋(μ(φ))↔φ，并给出可计算版本 A1–A4（原子/∧/¬/∀，∀ 通过把 x̄ 替换为 ℚ(x) 实现）；(3) 上下文推理公理 A5–A11（合取析取、双否定、结合/交换/分配、分离规则 modus ponens、∀ 实例化）；(4) Qiana 闭包 H_C = H ∪ A1–A11，理论可半判定；(5) 有限公理化：引入工具符号 =、Term、Wft、E（求值）、Sub（逻辑内替换），构造有限集 H_C^fin 与 H_C 等可满足（coherent 等价，Theorem 4 与推论），公式数为 O(|S|²)，并给出 Python→TPTP 翻译器；(6) 应用：以《罗密欧与朱丽叶》为例演示信念推理、上下文内旁一致性（反爆炸律，可选加公理恢复）、两个故事版本（原作/同人）的差异建模；(7) 时间性：将 Shanahan 的事件演算公理 EC1–EC7 改写为 Qiana 形式，用引用公式作为 fluent，讨论框架问题（Qiana 用普通 FOL 蕴涵而非 circumscription，故相对于 EC 是可靠的但不完备）；(8) 类型化版本：多排序 FOL，类型集合 {o, q, c, τ, a}，给出类型化公理；(9) 模态逻辑：以 0 元函数符号 □ 作为上下文、ist(□, φ̄) 表示 □φ，引入 Wff 与 Tauto 谓词刻画重言式与必然化规则，构造 H_QK/H_QT/H_Q4/H_Q5/H_QD 并证明与 K/T/S4/S5/D 等价。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：μ 在 ℒ_q 上单射且 μ⁻¹∘μ = id；禁止引用 𝕋 保证任何 S^{-𝕋} 相干理论在 A_truth 闭包下仍相干（规避 Tarski 定理）；A1–A4 蕴涵 A_truth；Qiana 闭包 H_C 的蕴涵问题半可判定；H_C 与有限公理化 H_C^fin 相干性等价，且对任意 φ 有 H_C ⊨ φ ⟺ H_C^fin ⊨ φ；有限化公式规模为 O(|S|²)，且可引用变量数有限不损失推理能力（任何推导只用到有限个变量）；实测用 Vampire 在 0.05 秒内自动证明罗密欧与朱丽叶双双死亡；paraconsistency 示例中上下文内可同时蕴涵 p 与 ¬p 但不蕴涵任意无关陈述（除非添加爆炸公理）；时间扩展相对事件演算可靠但不完备（不引入 circumscription）；Qiana 中的模态系统 K/T/S4/S5/D 与标准模态逻辑相互蕴涵（等价命题及其双向证明）。作者指出 Qiana 是首个同时满足真相表示、公式量化、上下文量化与半可判定性的框架。
AI.conclusion: Qiana 首次在一个基于一阶逻辑、可有限公理化的框架内同时实现了对上下文和公式的量化，并保持与现有自动化定理证明器的兼容性，可用于信念/信念集建模、故事与假设情景（含假新闻、法律推理、多视角）、上下文内的旁一致性推理；通过事件演算获得时间性，通过多排序逻辑改善类型区分，通过模态翻译兼容既有模态系统。作者预期其可用于构建面向上下文与信念推理的解释性系统，未来工作是将自然语言知识翻译为 Qiana 并开发相应工具。局限：有限公理化需要为可引用变量做有限化处理（虽不影响推理力），类型化版本使公理化显著变长，Qiana 不采用 circumscription 因而时间推理相对事件演算不完备，上下文内项的解释未被强制（需额外公理），且整体为半可判定而非可判定。

title: LI-DSN: A Layer-wise Interactive Dual-Stream Network for EEG Decoding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into brain activity, offering high temporal resolution crucial for understanding and interacting with neural processes through brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Current dual-stream neural networks for EEG often process temporal and spatial features independently through parallel branches, delaying their integration until a final, late-stage fusion. This design inherently leads to an "information silo" problem, precluding intermediate cross-stream refinement and hindering spatial-temporal decompositions essential for full feature utilization. We propose LI-DSN, a layer-wise interactive dual-stream network that facilitates progressive, cross-stream communication at each layer, thereby overcoming the limitations of late-fusion paradigms. LI-DSN introduces a novel Temporal-Spatial Integration Attention (TSIA) mechanism, which constructs a Spatial Affinity Correlation Matrix (SACM) to capture inter-electrode spatial structural relationships and a Temporal Channel Aggregation Matrix (TCAM) to integrate cosine-gated temporal dynamics under spatial guidance. Furthermore, we employ an adaptive fusion strategy with learnable channel weights to optimize the integration of dual-stream features. Extensive experiments across eight diverse EEG datasets, encompassing motor imagery (MI) classification, emotion recognition, and steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP), consistently demonstrate that LI-DSN significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline models, showcasing its superior robustness and decoding performance. The code will be publicized after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LI-DSN（Layer-wise Interactive Dual-Stream Network），一种逐层交互式双流EEG解码网络。其核心是TSIA机制（SACM空间亲和相关矩阵 + TCAM时间通道聚合矩阵 + 乘法门控融合），配合可学习通道权重的自适应融合头，在8个EEG数据集（MI、情绪识别、SSVEP）上以121.3K参数、6.12M FLOPs显著超越13个SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有双流/多分支EEG解码网络（BiHDM、DBConformer、MSVTNet、DMSACNN等）虽将时间与空间特征解耦并行提取，但两支流在网络深层几乎无中间通信，仅在分类阶段做拼接或简单门控融合（late fusion），形成"信息孤岛"问题：各支流在孤立表征空间中演化，丢失早期跨流互指导与上下文化机会；且与EEG本质耦合的时空动态及神经生理证据相违背，导致特征未被充分利用，尤其在低信噪比、强个体差异和少通道（如BNCI2014004仅3通道）条件下性能受限。同时现有融合多基于静态权重或末层注意力，缺乏层级化的渐进式跨流交互机制。
AI.method: 方法：1) 双流分词：Temporal Tokenizer用逐点卷积+深度卷积+BN+GELU做时间下采样得Z_t∈R^{P×D}；Spatial Tokenizer对每通道独立编码（线性投影+BN+GELU+AvgPool+展平+线性映射）得Z_s∈R^{C×D}。2) 每层加可学习位置/电极位置嵌入后经FFN块（LN+残差双线性+GELU+Dropout）。3) TSIA三阶段：SACM——Y1=Z_sW1+E_pos、Y2=Z_sW2+E_pos，A_s=softmax(Y1Y2ᵗ/√d_h)∈R^{H×C×C}，再以L2范数重要性向量ω加权池化得s_pool并沿时间维广播为S_exp；TCAM——X1=Z_tW_t1，周期性感知余弦门控X1'=X1⊙cos(Z_tW_φ)，通道相关矩阵A_c=softmax((X1')ᵗK_t/√P)，得Z̃_t=X1'A_c；最终O_TSIA=Concat_heads(Z̃_t⊙S_exp)W_out。4) 非对称ST→T更新流：每层先独立更新空间支流，再由更新后的空间上下文经TSIA引导时间支流（空间作为语义锚/空间滤波器）。5) 自适应融合：空间支路用可学习通道权重（CWLP）加权求和；时间支路用MLP注意力池化（softmax）加权聚合；拼接后接MLP分类头，交叉熵损失（含类别权重）。训练：PyTorch，RTX 4090多卡，嵌入维度40、空间维度16、时间/通道Transformer各3层、dropout 0.25，Adam(0.9,0.95)、lr 1e-3、batch 32、最多100轮早停。评测：MI（BNCI2014001/0002/0004、Zhou2016）用CO/CV/LOSO；情绪（SEED、FACED）与SSVEP（Nakanishi2015、Kalunga2016）用跨被试协议；指标ACC与F1。
AI.result: MI分类：LI-DSN在CO/CV/LOSO下均达SOTA，如BNCI2014001 80.95/83.79/77.86%，BNCI2014002 81.57/82.57/77.25%，BNCI2014004 75.19/75.11/71.44%（3通道下仍稳健），Zhou2016 84.65/91.48/86.53%。情绪识别：SEED ACC 82.37±11.05%（最佳，F1 81.34为次佳，EmT F1 82.14最佳）；FACED ACC 62.99±4.41%、F1 77.04±4.02%，优于MSVTNet(62.91/76.79)。SSVEP：Nakanishi2015 ACC 97.04±0.14%、F1 96.89%，Kalunga2016 ACC 73.10±0.49%均创新高。消融（LOSO）：去除层间交互（late fusion）使2014001降至73.25%（>3%降幅），TSIA换简单拼接降至72.37%，去余弦门75.22%、去电极位置嵌入75.65%、去自适应融合73.69%、去位置嵌入74.79%。集成方向对比：双向交互（75.12%）与ST→S均劣于ST→T(77.86%)，印证空间先验单向引导的有效性。超参最优为(N_s,N_t)=(3,3)、嵌入宽度40。复杂度仅121.3K参数、6.12M FLOPs，性价比最优。可视化：SACM/TCAM呈稀疏分块激活；交互后特征图由无序纵向起伏转为稳定横向分层；显著性图符合生理先验（MI集中于C3/C4感觉运动皮层、SSVEP集中于O1/PO枕枕区、情绪集中于T8/FT8、CP2、Pz）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：逐层交互式双流融合可有效突破late-fusion的信息孤岛，TSIA通过空间结构先验单向（ST→T）引导时间动态、以余弦门刻画振荡性，并配合可学习通道权重的自适应融合，在MI、情绪识别与SSVEP三类任务、跨被试与跨时序协议下以显著优势超越13个基线，且模型极轻量（121.3K参数/6.12M FLOPs），适合实时与资源受限的BCI应用；注意力与显著性可视化验证了其神经生理可解释性。局限与展望：交互机制形式仍可扩展（跨模态注意力、动态路由）、需在更多范式上验证泛化性、探索跨范式迁移学习与临床（卒中康复、辅助通信）验证。

title: GaelEval: Benchmarking LLM Performance for Scottish Gaelic
comment: 13 pages, to be published in Proceedings of LLMs4SSH (workshop co-located with LREC 2026; Mallorca, Spain; May 2026)
summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) often exhibit emergent 'shadow' capabilities in languages without official support, yet their performance on these languages remains uneven and under-measured. This is particularly acute for morphosyntactically rich minority languages such as Scottish Gaelic, where translation benchmarks fail to capture structural competence. We introduce GaelEval, the first multi-dimensional benchmark for Gaelic, comprising: (i) an expert-authored morphosyntactic MCQA task; (ii) a culturally grounded translation benchmark and (iii) a large-scale cultural knowledge Q&A task. Evaluating 19 LLMs against a fluent-speaker human baseline ($n=30$), we find that Gemini 3 Pro Preview achieves $83.3\%$ accuracy on the linguistic task, surpassing the human baseline ($78.1\%$). Proprietary models consistently outperform open-weight systems, and in-language (Gaelic) prompting yields a small but stable advantage (+$2.4\%$). On the cultural task, leading models exceed $90\%$ accuracy, though most systems perform worse under Gaelic prompting and absolute scores are inflated relative to the manual benchmark. Overall, GaelEval reveals that frontier models achieve above-human performance on several dimensions of Gaelic grammar, demonstrates the effect of Gaelic prompting and shows a consistent performance gap favouring proprietary over open-weight models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GaelEval，首个针对苏格兰盖尔语的多维度评估基准，包含形态句法MCQA、文化翻译基准和文化知识Q&A三个任务。评估19个LLM后发现Gemini 3 Pro Preview在语言任务上超越人类基线(83.3% vs 78.1%)，专有模型优于开源模型，盖尔语提示带来+2.4%提升。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLM在非官方支持的语言中表现出"隐性"能力，但对于形态句法丰富的少数语言（如苏格兰盖尔语），现有翻译基准无法有效捕捉结构性能力，导致评估不充分。
AI.method: 构建GaelEval基准（三部分：形态句法MCQA任务、文化翻译基准、大规模文化知识Q&A）；评估19个LLM并与30名母语者的人类基线对比。
AI.result: Gemini 3 Pro Preview在语言任务达83.3%准确率（超人类基线78.1%）；专有模型一致优于开源模型；盖尔语提示带来+2.4%稳定优势；文化任务上模型准确率超90%，但盖尔语提示下多数模型表现反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型在盖尔语语法多个维度达到超越人类表现；证实盖尔语提示的有效性；揭示专有模型与开源模型之间持续存在的性能差距。

title: Abnormal Head Movements in Neurological Conditions: A Knowledge-Based Dataset with Application to Cervical Dystonia
summary: Abnormal head movements (AHMs) manifest across a broad spectrum of neurological disorders; however, the absence of a multi-condition resource integrating kinematic measurements, clinical severity scores, and patient demographics constitutes a persistent barrier to the development of AI-driven diagnostic tools. To address this gap, this study introduces NeuroPose-AHM, a knowledge-based dataset of neurologically induced AHMs constructed through a multi-LLM extraction framework applied to 1,430 peer-reviewed publications. The dataset contains 2,756 patient-group-level records spanning 57 neurological conditions, derived from 846 AHM-relevant papers. Inter-LLM reliability analysis confirms robust extraction performance, with study-level classification achieving strong agreement (kappa = 0.822). To demonstrate the dataset's analytical utility, a four-task framework is applied to cervical dystonia (CD), the condition most directly defined by pathological head movement. First, Task 1 performs multi-label AHM type classification (F1 = 0.856). Task 2 constructs the Head-Neck Severity Index (HNSI), a unified metric that normalizes heterogeneous clinical rating scales. The clinical relevance of this index is then evaluated in Task 3, where HNSI is validated against real-world CD patient data, with aligned severe-band proportions (6.7%) providing a preliminary plausibility indication for index calibration within the high severity range. Finally, Task 4 performs bridge analysis between movement-type probabilities and HNSI scores, producing significant correlations (p less than 0.001). These results demonstrate the analytical utility of NeuroPose-AHM as a structured, knowledge-based resource for neurological AHM research. The NeuroPose-AHM dataset is publicly available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19386862).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NeuroPose-AHM：一个覆盖 57 种神经疾病的异常头部运动（AHM）知识型数据集，通过多 LLM 从 1,430 篇同行评议文献中抽取，构建 2,756 条患者组级记录（含运动学指标、临床评分、人口学信息），并在颈性肌张力障碍（CD）上以四任务框架验证其分析价值：多标签 AHM 分类（F1=0.856）、头颈严重度指数 HNSI 的构建、与真实 CD 患者数据的校准验证（重度区间占比对齐 6.7%），以及运动类型概率与 HNSI 的桥接相关分析（p<0.001）。
AI.motivation: 异常头部运动（AHM）广泛存在于多种神经系统疾病中，但目前缺乏整合运动学测量、临床严重度量表评分与患者人口学信息的跨疾病资源，这成为开发 AI 辅助诊断工具的主要障碍。文献抽取式证据分散、各研究对 AHM 类型定义与严重度评估标准不一，阻碍了跨条件的数据驱动建模与严重度量表归一化。因此需要一个统一、结构化、附带可靠性验证的知识型数据集，以支撑下游 AI 方法的开发和可复现研究。
AI.method: 研究采用多 LLM 抽取框架处理 1,430 篇同行评议文献，识别出 846 篇与 AHM 相关的论文，并从中构建 2,756 条患者组级（patient-group-level）记录，覆盖 57 种神经系统疾病，每条记录包含运动学测量参数、临床严重度量表分数及人口学变量。通过 inter-LLM 一致性分析评估抽取可靠性（研究水平分类 kappa=0.822）。在应用层面，以颈性肌张力障碍（CD）为案例建立四任务框架：任务 1 为多标签 AHM 类型分类；任务 2 构造头颈严重度指数（Head-Neck Severity Index, HNSI），用于归一化异质临床评分量表；任务 3 用真实世界 CD 患者数据验证 HNSI 的临床相关性与校准性（重度区间占比 6.7%）；任务 4 进行运动类型概率与 HNSI 分数之间的桥接（bridge）分析。数据集以 Zenodo 公开（doi:10.5281/zenodo.19386862）。
AI.result: 多 LLM 抽取获得 2,756 条患者组级记录、覆盖 57 种疾病，inter-LLM 可靠性良好（研究级分类 kappa=0.822）。四任务应用结果：多标签 AHM 分类 F1=0.856；HNSI 成功将 TWRS 等异质量表归一化为统一指标；与真实 CD 患者数据对比时重度带比例对齐于 6.7%，为高严重度区间的校准提供初步合理性证据；桥接分析显示运动类型概率与 HNSI 呈显著相关（p<0.001）。上述结果证明 NeuroPose-AHM 作为结构化知识型资源具备分析实用性与下游建模潜力。
AI.conclusion: NeuroPose-AHM 填补了跨神经疾病 AHM 数据资源的空白，把分散的文献证据转化为可机器学习利用的结构化记录，并提供了可验证的抽取可靠性与量表归一化工具（HNSI）。基于 CD 的四任务框架表明该数据集可支撑疾病定义型分类、严重度定量、临床数据校准与运动—严重度关联建模。其价值在于为 AI 驱动的 AHM 诊断与严重度评估研究提供统一基准；后续工作可扩展至更多疾病的条件验证、推进严重度区间标定的严谨性，并探索时序运动学与个体水平预测模型的开发。

title: Enhancing the Reliability of Medical AI through Expert-guided Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems accelerate medical workflows and improve diagnostic accuracy in healthcare, serving as second-opinion systems. However, the unpredictability of AI errors poses a significant challenge, particularly in healthcare contexts, where mistakes can have severe consequences. A widely adopted safeguard is to pair predictions with uncertainty estimation, enabling human experts to focus on high-risk cases while streamlining routine verification. Current uncertainty estimation methods, however, remain limited, particularly in quantifying aleatoric uncertainty, which arises from data ambiguity and noise. To address this, we propose a novel approach that leverages disagreement in expert responses to generate targets for training machine learning models. These targets are used in conjunction with standard data labels to estimate two components of uncertainty separately, as given by the law of total variance, via a two-ensemble approach, as well as its lightweight variant. We validate our method on binary image classification, binary and multi-class image segmentation, and multiple-choice question answering. Our experiments demonstrate that incorporating expert knowledge can enhance uncertainty estimation quality by $9\%$ to $50\%$ depending on the task, making this source of information invaluable for the construction of risk-aware AI systems in healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: 提出利用专家分歧生成训练目标的新方法，通过双集成架构分离量化异方差不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），在医疗图像分类、分割和问答任务中实现9%-50%的提升。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI中AI错误不可预测可能导致严重后果，当前不确定性估计方法在量化数据固有噪声（aleatoric uncertainty）方面存在局限，需要更可靠的风险感知系统。
AI.method: 利用专家响应的分歧生成训练目标，结合标准数据标签，通过基于方差分解定律的双集成方法（two-ensemble approach）及其轻量变体，分别估计不确定性的两个组成部分。
AI.result: 在二进制图像分类、多类别图像分割和多选问答任务上验证了该方法，证明整合专家知识可将不确定性估计质量提升9%至50%。
AI.conclusion: 专家知识是构建医疗风险感知AI系统的重要信息源，该方法能有效增强不确定性估计能力，为人机协作决策提供更可靠的支持。

title: Brief Is Better: Non-Monotonic Chain-of-Thought Budget Effects in Function-Calling Language Agents
summary: How much should a language agent think before taking action? Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely assumed to improve agent performance, but the relationship between reasoning length and accuracy in structured tool-use settings remains poorly understood. We present a systematic study of CoT budget effects on function-calling agents, sweeping six token budgets (0--512) across 200 tasks from the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v3 Multiple benchmark. Our central finding is a striking non-monotonic pattern on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: brief reasoning (32 tokens) dramatically improves accuracy by 45% relative over direct answers, from 44.0% to 64.0%, while extended reasoning (256 tokens) degrades performance well below the no-CoT baseline, to 25.0% (McNemar p < 0.001). A three-way error decomposition reveals the mechanism. At d = 0, 30.5% of tasks fail because the model selects the wrong function from the candidate set; brief CoT reduces this to 1.5%, effectively acting as a function-routing step, while long CoT reverses the gain, yielding 28.0% wrong selections and 18.0% hallucinated functions at d = 256. Oracle analysis shows that 88.6% of solvable tasks require at most 32 reasoning tokens, with an average of 27.6 tokens, and a finer-grained sweep indicates that the true optimum lies at 8--16 tokens. Motivated by this routing effect, we propose Function-Routing CoT (FR-CoT), a structured brief-CoT method that templates the reasoning phase as "Function: [name] / Key args: [...]," forcing commitment to a valid function name at the start of reasoning. FR-CoT achieves accuracy statistically equivalent to free-form d = 32 CoT while reducing function hallucination to 0.0%, providing a structural reliability guarantee without budget tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了思维链（CoT）推理长度对函数调用智能体性能的影响，发现了一个显著的非单调关系：简短推理（32 tokens）将准确率从44%提升至64%，而超长推理（256 tokens）反而降至25%以下。基于这一发现，提出了结构化的FR-CoT方法，通过模板化推理格式实现零幻觉的函数路由。
AI.motivation: 当前研究对CoT推理长度与准确率之间的关系缺乏系统理解，尤其是在结构化工具调用场景中，推理长度对性能的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v3 Multiple基准的200个任务上，对六个token预算（0-512）进行系统实验，并进行三层误差分解分析以及神谕分析。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct模型上呈现非单调性能曲线：32 tokens时准确率峰值达64%（相对提升45%），256 tokens时跌至25%；误差分解揭示简短CoT将函数选择错误从30.5%降至1.5%，而长CoT导致28%选择错误和18%幻觉函数；神谕分析表明88.6%可解任务仅需≤32 tokens。
AI.conclusion: 简短CoT主要充当函数路由机制，真正的最优推理长度为8-16 tokens；提出的FR-CoT方法通过强制结构化推理格式（"Function: [name] / Key args: [...]"）实现零幻觉，在保持准确率的同时提供了结构可靠性保证。

title: SenseMath: Do LLMs Have Number Sense? Evaluating Shortcut Use, Judgment, and Generation
summary: Large language models often default to step-by-step computation even when efficient numerical shortcuts are available. This raises a basic question: do they exhibit number sense in a human-like behavioral sense, i.e., the ability to recognize numerical structure, apply shortcuts when appropriate, and avoid them when they are not? We introduce SenseMath, a controlled benchmark for evaluating structure-sensitive numerical reasoning in LLMs. SenseMath contains 4,800 items spanning eight shortcut categories and four digit scales, with matched strong-shortcut, weak-shortcut, and control variants. It supports three evaluation settings of increasing cognitive demand: Shortcut Use (whether models can apply shortcuts on shortcut-amenable problems); Applicability Judgment (whether they can recognize when a shortcut is appropriate or misleading); and Problem Generation (whether they can generate new problem items that correctly admit a given type of shortcut). Our evaluation across five LLMs, ranging from GPT-4o-mini to Llama-3.1-8B, shows a consistent pattern: when explicitly prompted, models readily adopt shortcut strategies and achieve substantial accuracy gains on shortcut-amenable items (up to 15%), yet under standard chain-of-thought prompting they spontaneously employ such strategies in fewer than 40% of cases, even when they demonstrably possess the requisite capability. Moreover, this competence is confined to the Use level; models systematically over-generalise shortcuts to problems where they do not apply, and fail to generate valid shortcut-bearing problems from scratch. Together, these results suggest that current LLMs exhibit procedural shortcut fluency without the structural understanding of when and why shortcuts work that underlies human number sense.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SenseMath基准测试，评估LLM是否具备类似人类的"数感"——识别数值结构、在适当时机使用/避免使用捷径的能力。研究发现模型在显式提示时可成功使用捷径策略，但自发使用率不足40%，且会将捷径过度泛化至不适用的题目，表明当前LLM仅有程序性捷径流畅性，缺乏结构性理解。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型即使在存在高效数值捷径的情况下，仍默认使用逐步计算。这引发了一个基本问题：它们是否具备类似人类的"数感"——即识别数值结构、在适当时应用捷径、在不适用时避免使用的能力？
AI.method: 构建SenseMath基准测试，包含4,800个题目，涵盖8种捷径类别和4种数字规模，设有强捷径、弱捷径和控制变体。支持三种递增认知需求的评估设置：捷径使用（能否应用捷径）、适用性判断（能否识别何时适用/不适用）、问题生成（能否生成承认特定捷径的新题目）。评估了5种LLM（GPT-4o-mini至Llama-3.1-8B）。
AI.result: 显式提示时模型采用捷径策略，在适途题目上准确率提升高达15%；但标准思维链提示下自发使用率不足40%（尽管具备相应能力）。仅在"使用"层面表现尚可；在适用性判断和问题生成层面系统性失败——过度泛化捷径至不适用题目，且无法从零生成有效的捷径题目。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM展现出"程序性捷径流畅性"，但缺乏关于何时及为何捷径有效的人类数感所依赖的结构性理解。这揭示了能力（capability）与行为表现（behavior）之间的关键差距。

title: The Rank and Gradient Lost in Non-stationarity: Sample Weight Decay for Mitigating Plasticity Loss in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) suffers from plasticity loss severely due to the nature of non-stationarity, which impairs the ability to adapt to new data and learn continually. Unfortunately, our understanding of how plasticity loss arises, dissipates, and can be dissolved remains limited to empirical findings, leaving the theoretical end underexplored.To address this gap, we study the plasticity loss problem from the theoretical perspective of network optimization. By formally characterizing the two culprit factors in online RL process: the non-stationarity of data distributions and the non-stationarity of targets induced by bootstrapping, our theory attributes the loss of plasticity to two mechanisms: the rank collapse of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) Gram matrix and the $Θ(\frac{1}{k})$ decay of gradient magnitude. The first mechanism echoes prior empirical findings from the theoretical perspective and sheds light on the effects of existing methods, e.g., network reset, neuron recycle, and noise injection. Against this backdrop, we focus primarily on the second mechanism and aim to alleviate plasticity loss by addressing the gradient attenuation issue, which is orthogonal to existing methods. We propose Sample Weight Decay -- a lightweight method to restore gradient magnitude, as a general remedy to plasticity loss for deep RL methods based on experience replay. In experiments, we evaluate the efficacy of \methodName upon TD3, \myadded{Double DQN} and SAC with SimBa architecture in MuJoCo, \myadded{ALE} and DeepMind Control Suite tasks. The results demonstrate that \methodName effectively alleviates plasticity loss and consistently improves learning performance across various configurations of deep RL algorithms, UTD, network architectures, and environments, achieving SOTA performance on challenging DMC Humanoid tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文从网络优化的理论视角解释深度强化学习中的"可塑性丧失"(plasticity loss)，指出其根源为NTK Gram矩阵秩坍缩与梯度幅值的Θ(1/k)衰减，并据此提出轻量级方法Sample Weight Decay(SWD)：按样本"年龄"线性衰减权重、以加权采样补偿新数据梯度的1/k衰减。SWD即插即用且与现有NTK类方法正交，在MuJoCo/ALE/DMC上配合TD3、Double DQN、SimBa-SAC取得13.7%–30.1%的IQM提升，并在DMC Humanoid任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 深度RL因在线学习的非平稳性而严重遭受可塑性丧失：随训练推进，网络适应新数据与持续学习的能力逐渐下降。已有工作（Network Reset、ReDo/神经元回收、Plasticity Injection、ReGraMa、S&P等）多停留在模型层面的经验性干预，缺乏"为何发生可塑性丧失、不同机制各贡献什么"的理论解释；同时这些方法均未涉及新数据梯度信号随迭代次数被系统性衰减的问题。论文希望补齐经验与理论之间的缺口，并给出有理论依据、可与既有方法正交组合的实用算法。
AI.method: 理论上以Fitted Q-Iteration为载体（可扩展至熵正则化MDP及其他value-based方法）。核心洞察：RL每轮优化都在上一轮解处重新初始化，等价于"非稳态初始化"问题。由此形式化两类非平稳来源——数据分布非平稳（经验分布递推 μ^{k+1}=k/(k+1)μ^k+1/(k+1)d̂^{π^{k+1}}，Prop.1）与自举导致的目标非平稳（Thm.1 的总体损失极限分解为 Bellman 残差项与环境随机性项）；并给出基于平方 Bellman 残差的最优性界（Thm.2/Thm.4）。可塑性丧失被归因于两大机制：(1) NTK Gram 矩阵秩坍缩（解释了重置类/噪声注入类方法为何有效）；(2) 梯度幅值以 Θ(1/k) 衰减（Thm.3：初始化点处梯度 = 1/k·分布漂移项 + 目标漂移项，末端目标为0时仅剩分布漂移项，随 k 增大梯度趋于零，易滞留鞍点）。方法：提出 SWD，对回放池样本按年龄 age_i=t−t_i 赋权 w_i=max(w_min, 1−age_i/T)，按 p_i=w_i/Σw_j 采样，线性加权抵消 1/k 衰减以恢复梯度幅值；并提出基于单调年龄的桶式分层采样近似（O(N)→O(B)，B=2000 时理论加速约500×）。
AI.result: 实验验证：①SWD 在 TD3(MuJoCo 5环境)、Double DQN(ALE 3环境)、SimBa-SAC(DMC 4任务) 上均提升样本效率与最终性能，明显优于 PER，IQM 提升 13.7%–30.1%，DMC Humanoid 达 SOTA；②反向验证 SWA（反向加权老样本）性能、梯度L1范数与GraMa 均更差，验证理论方向性；③GraMa 显示 SWD 主要在训练中后期缓解梯度稀疏，符合理论预测；④UTD=1/2/5 均优于均匀采样，UTD=5 提升最大(+30.1%)；⑤SWD 优于 ReGraMa、S&P、Plasticity Injection，且 SWD+S&P 组合最优，验证正交性；⑥超参(T_decay、w_min) 敏感性低，线性衰减优于指数与多项式衰减（后者甚至低于 SAC 基线）；⑦近似采样将 Humanoid-Run 训练时间从 10.43h 降至 8.70h（基线 8.65h），回报 224.9±17.5 与精确版相当。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了统一的可塑性丧失理论框架，将"秩坍缩"与"梯度衰减"分别对应到NTK类方法与一个新的梯度动力学机制，并据此提出理论驱动、即插即用、开销极小的SWD方法，通过回放采样的时间加权补偿梯度衰减。SWD在不同算法、网络架构、UTD与环境上稳定提升性能，可与既有可塑性保持方法叠加协同，为长时程深度RL的可塑性保持提供了新视角与实用工具。作者承认局限：评测仅限MuJoCo/ALE/DMC；理论框架仍属初步（"冰山一角"），未来需推广到更复杂场景与真实环境，使SWD发展为鲁棒通用的实践工具。

title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. Preprint submitted to a journal
summary: Gait analysis provides an objective characterization of locomotor function and is widely used to support diagnosis and rehabilitation monitoring across neurological and orthopedic disorders. Deep learning has been increasingly applied to this domain, yet most approaches rely on supervised classifiers trained on disease-labeled data, limiting generalization to heterogeneous pathological presentations. This work proposes a label-free framework for joint-level anomaly detection and kinematic correction based on a Transformer masked autoencoder trained exclusively on normative gait sequences from 150 adults, acquired with a markerless multi-camera motion-capture system. At inference, a two-pass procedure is applied to potentially pathological input sequences, first it estimates joint inconsistency scores by occluding individual joints and measuring deviations from the learned normative prior. Then, it withholds the flagged joints from the encoder input and reconstructs the full skeleton from the remaining spatiotemporal context, yielding corrected kinematic trajectories at the flagged positions. Validation on 10 held-out normative participants, who mimicked seven simulated gait abnormalities, showed accurate localization of biomechanically inconsistent joints, a significant reduction in angular deviation across all analyzed joints with large effect sizes, and preservation of normative kinematics. The proposed approach enables interpretable, subject-specific localization of gait impairments without requiring disease labels. Video is available at https://youtu.be/Rcm3jqR5pN4.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer掩码自编码器的无标签步态异常检测与运动学校正框架，仅使用150名成人正常步态数据进行训练，通过两阶段推理程序实现关节不一致性评分和骨骼轨迹校正，无需疾病标签即可实现可解释的步态障碍定位。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习步态分析方法多依赖疾病标注数据的监督分类器，难以泛化到异质性的病理表现，需要一种不依赖疾病标签、能够适应不同病理特征的步态异常检测方法。
AI.method: 采用Transformer掩码自编码器架构，仅在正常步态序列上训练；推理时采用两遍程序：(1)遮挡单个关节估计不一致性评分；(2)排除异常关节后利用剩余时空上下文重建完整骨骼，输出校正后的运动轨迹。使用无标记多摄像头运动捕捉系统采集数据。
AI.result: 在10名模拟七种步态异常的参与者验证中，框架准确定位了生物力学不一致关节，各主要关节的角度偏差显著降低，效果量较大，并保留了正常运动学特征。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了无需疾病标签的可解释、个体化步态障碍定位，为神经和骨科疾病的诊断及康复监测提供了新的无监督异常检测范式。

title: PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning
summary: Estimating optimal individualized treatment rules (ITRs) via outcome weighted learning (OWL) often relies on observed rewards that are noisy or optimistic proxies for the true latent utility. Ignoring this reward uncertainty leads to the selection of policies with inflated apparent performance, yet existing OWL frameworks lack the finite-sample guarantees required to systematically embed such uncertainty into the learning objective. To address this issue, we propose PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning (PROWL). Given a one-sided uncertainty certificate, PROWL constructs a conservative reward and a strictly policy-dependent lower bound on the true expected value. Theoretically, we prove an exact certified reduction that transforms robust policy learning into a unified, split-free cost-sensitive classification task. This formulation enables the derivation of a nonasymptotic PAC-Bayes lower bound for randomized ITRs, where we establish that the optimal posterior maximizing this bound is exactly characterized by a general Bayes update. To overcome the learning-rate selection problem inherent in generalized Bayesian inference, we introduce a fully automated, bounds-based calibration procedure, coupled with a Fisher-consistent certified hinge surrogate for efficient optimization. Our experiments demonstrate that PROWL achieves improvements in estimating robust, high-value treatment regimes under severe reward uncertainty compared to standard methods for ITR estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PROWL（PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning）：在结局加权学习（OWL）框架中引入“单侧奖励证书”R* ≥ R − U(X,A,R)，构造保守奖励 R̄=(R−U)₊，并给出策略依赖的真实价值下界 V*(d) ≥ V_R̄(d)。核心结果：(1) 精确的“认证化归约”定理把鲁棒策略学习严格等价于一个统一、无需样本分裂的成本敏感分类问题；(2) 在联合策略–冗余参数空间 Θ 上导出非渐近 PAC-Bayes 下界，且最大化该下界的唯一后验恰为一次广义贝叶斯更新（general Bayes update）；(3) 给出基于界的全自动学习率/温度校准与 Fisher 一致的认证铰链代理损失。合成实验（两个情景、ρ 与 N 双扫描）显示在严重奖励不确定性下 PROWL 的目标遗憾与稳健遗憾均最低，且优于直接以 R̄ 代入的插件基线；ELAIA-1 急性肾损伤预警试验的真实数据中，PROWL 在所有自适应学习者中取得最高认证价值、最高复合终点价值与最低死亡率，提示率约 50%。
AI.motivation: 个体化治疗规则（ITR）的估计广泛使用结局加权学习（OWL），但 OWL 直接把观测到的奖励当作绝对优化目标。当观测奖励只是潜在真实效用的噪声、延迟、替代终点或系统性乐观代理时，最优策略的“表观价值”被高估，而且这种偏差是策略依赖的：两条名义价值相近的规则，可能在“代理奖励严重失真”的区域做出不同比例的治疗推荐，从而真实价值差异很大。现有 OWL 变体（残差加权、增强、多阶段、稀疏惩罚、贝叶斯化等）大多只提升对离群点/效率/稳定性的鲁棒性，仍把观测奖励视为确定目标，缺乏把奖励不确定性系统嵌入学习目标的有限样本理论；PAC-Bayes 策略学习文献也未处理“价值函数中的奖励本身不确定”的情形。同时，广义贝叶斯推断中学习率（温度）难以选择，长期依赖启发式或公理性设定，缺乏有限样本的决策论依据。
AI.method: 【问题设定】观测 Z=(X,A,R)，A∈{−1,1}，代理奖励 R∈[0,1]，潜在真实奖励 R*∈[0,1] 不可观测；假设一致性、条件可忽略性与严格重叠 π(a|x)≥ε，故 V(d)=E[R·1{A=d(X)}/π(A|X)]、V*(d)=E[R*·1{A=d(X)}/π(A|X)]。【单侧证书】假设存在可测 U: X×{−1,1}×[0,1]→[0,1] 使 R* ≥ R−U 几乎必然成立，定义认证奖励 R̄=(R−U)₊ 与认证价值 V_R̄(d)，得 V*(d) ≥ V_R̄(d)；若 U≤R 则 V*(d) ≥ V(d) − E[U·1{A=d(X)}/π(A|X)]。【精确归约】定义双重稳健式得分 Γ_a^α(Z)=ν_{a,α}(X)+1{A=a}/π(a|X)(R̄−ν_{a,α}(X))，认证优势 D_α=Γ_1^α−Γ_{−1}^α、伪标签 Y_α=sgn(D_α)、权重 W_α=|D_α|；定理1给出 V_R̄(d)=E[Γ_d^α]=C_α^♯−R_01^α(d)，即最大化认证价值等价于最小化加权 0-1 风险，且该等式对任意 α 精确成立，故冗余参数可与策略参数在同一联合空间 Θ=B×A 上共同学习（split-free）。命题2 给出条件方差最优冗余设计：ν_{a,α}=μ_a，最小化 D_α 的条件方差满足 q ν_1 + p ν_{−1}=q μ_1+p μ_{−1}，治疗无关子类最优为 m†=qμ_1+pμ_{−1}（平衡随机化为 E[R̄|X=x]）。【PAC-Bayes 下界】以 c_ε=ε⁻¹、K_ε=2ε⁻¹−1 将认证价值损失 ℓ_val=(c_ε−Γ)/K_ε 归一化到 [0,1]；定理3 给出对所有 Q≪Π0 同时成立的非渐近下界 V*(d_Q) ≥ V̂_R̄,n(d_Q) − K_ε{(KL(Q‖Π0)+log(1/δ))/(ηn)+η/8}，且唯一最大化者为 Q̂_η ∝ exp{ηn V̂_R̄,n/K_ε}Π0 = exp{−ηΣℓ_val}Π0，即一次精确的广义贝叶斯更新（Fisher 一致地对应认证优势加权 OWL 的贝叶斯更新）。【可计算实现】借助 Catoni 型一致界构造 LCB_val(Q;γ)=c_ε−K_ε(1−exp{−c_{n,δ}(Q)−γ L̂_val,n(Q)})/(1−e^{−γ})，其唯一最大化者仍是 Q̂_γ，从而可用可观测的经验 LCB 在网格上自动选温度/学习率（命题4、推论6）；实际实现采用 Fisher 一致的认证铰链损失 ℓ_h=W_α(1−Y_α f_β(X))₊（命题5 证明其全局最小化、最优得分与 Bayes 规则一致且超额风险受控），指数型先验下 MAP 等价于带正则的最小化；实验用有限粒子后验库（锚点+先验粒子+局部扰动+各基线解）+ ridge 冗余回归。证书若需学习，可用独立辅助样本校准，联合置信度至少 (1−α_cert)(1−δ)（推论7）。
AI.result: 【合成实验（30 次 Monte Carlo，独立测试样本 10,000）】情景1（线性边界、平衡随机化、不确定性近似策略无关）作为良性基准：PROWL 与 Q-learning、RWL 基本持平，未见“鲁棒性代价”；情景2（相关协变量、非线性效应、治疗获益集中于中危亚组、处理组代理奖励在临床脆弱区高度乐观、倾向得分随协变量变化）为困难场景：随不确定性水平 ρ∈{0,…,2.0} 增大，OWL/Q-learning/RWL/PolicyTree 与 PROWL(U=0) 的遗憾单调上升，PROWL 始终保持最低目标遗憾与稳健遗憾，且在 ρ=2.0 附近明显优于直接以 R̄ 代入的插件基线，说明增益来自 PAC-Bayesian 学习机制而非简单保守替换；N∈{100,…,2000} 扫描中 PROWL 仍为最优或次优。诊断分析显示 proxy-target gap 远大于 target-certified gap（主要障碍是代理的乐观偏置而非过度保守），主动截断率≈0、证书有效率=1；split-free 版本一致优于诚实的样本分裂版本，差距在情景2中等样本量时最明显。【真实数据（ELAIA-1 AKI 预警试验，48 个随机化前协变量，三分量硬临床效用含偏好不确定集 W_ρ，ρ=1，30 次按医院×处理分层的 70/30 划分，AIPW 评估）】最强的整体规则是“从不预警”（认证价值 0.905、复合终点自由价值 0.918），表明该数据不支持普遍预警；在所有自适应学习者中 PROWL 最优：认证价值 0.904、名义价值 0.917、复合终点自由价值 0.795（最高）、死亡率 0.086（最低），预警率约 0.498；OWL 各变体更激进（预警率 0.67–0.72）而临床表现更差。分层分析显示 PROWL 在非教学医院（尤其最高风险五分位，预警约 30% 对 Q-learning 的 34%/35%）更保守；ρ 增大时 PROWL 预警率单调下降而复合终点价值稳定，PROWL(U=0) 与 Q-learning(R) 几乎不变，说明认证确实改变了所学策略而非事后下界；剔除医院指标的消融、mean-rule/MAP/Gibbs 三种去随机化策略、以及纳入出院回家结局的敏感性分析均保持定性排序。
AI.conclusion: PROWL 把“奖励不确定性”从后验考量提升为学习目标的内生组成部分，形式化连接了因果策略学习、PAC-Bayes 泛化理论与广义贝叶斯推断：认证化归约保证鲁棒策略学习仍可精确化为加权分类（保留 OWL 的算法可及性），而 PAC-Bayes 下界的最优后验恰为广义贝叶斯后验，从而为学习率选择提供了有限样本、决策论依据；证书的构造成为统计决策问题本身的关键部分。局限与未来方向：(1) 证书过松会导致过于悲观、压平目标函数并削弱策略区分度，需强调证书的“策略判别性”（治疗特异性或主动截断），若不确定性惩罚与策略无关则不会移动最优边界；(2) 现有界仅针对随机化 Gibbs 策略 V*(d_Q)，对确定性规则的去随机化遗憾 V*(d_Q)−V*(T(Q)) 仍需借助 margin/解构化 PAC-Bayes 工具推广；(3) 先验与证书必须与策略学习样本独立，否则产生双重过拟合，需分布依赖先验或随机假设集下的同时高概率界；(4) 精确广义贝叶斯更新依赖认证价值对加权 0-1 风险的线性性，推广到非线性/含歧义的价值泛函并同时控制离线评估与证书的不确定性是重要方向；(5) 界刻画的是乐观误差而非精确 oracle 偏差校正，有限样本下可能过保守，需高阶校正或价值感知先验。整体而言，该框架把个体化治疗估计的关注点从“最大化名义价值”转向“可验证的安全性”。

title: Do Lexical and Contextual Coreference Resolution Systems Degrade Differently under Mention Noise? An Empirical Study on Scientific Software Mentions
summary: We present our participation in the SOMD 2026 shared task on cross-document software mention coreference resolution, where our systems ranked second across all three subtasks. We compare two fine-tuning-free approaches: Fuzzy Matching (FM), a lexical string-similarity method, and Context Aware Representations (CAR), which combines mention-level and document-level embeddings. Both achieve competitive performance across all subtasks (CoNLL F1 of 0.94-0.96), with CAR consistently outperforming FM by 1 point on the official test set, consistent with the high surface regularity of software names, which reduces the need for complex semantic reasoning. A controlled noise-injection study reveals complementary failure modes: as boundary noise increases, CAR loses only 0.07 F1 points from clean to fully corrupted input, compared to 0.20 for FM, whereas under mention substitution, FM degrades more gracefully (0.52 vs. 0.63). Our inference-time analysis shows that FM scales superlinearly with corpus size, whereas CAR scales approximately linearly, making CAR the more efficient choice at large scale. These findings suggest that system selection should be informed by both the noise profile of the upstream mention detector and the scale of the target corpus. We release our code to support future work on this underexplored task.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SOMD 2026跨文档软件提及共指消解共享任务中排名第二的系统，对比了两种无需微调的方法：模糊匹配(FM)和上下文感知表示(CAR)。CAR通过结合提及级和文档级嵌入，在官方测试集上始终比FM高出约1个F1点，两者在CoNLL F1上均达到0.94-0.96的竞争力表现。噪声注入实验揭示了两者的互补失败模式：CAR对边界噪声更鲁棒（仅下降0.07 F1），FM在提及替换下更稳定（下降0.52 vs 0.63）。CAR推理时间随语料规模近似线性增长，FM呈超线性增长，提示系统选择应考虑上游提及检测器的噪声特征和目标语料规模。
AI.motivation: 跨文档软件提及共指消解是一个尚未被充分探索的任务。本文旨在比较两种无需复杂微调的实用方法，评估其在不同噪声条件和规模下的表现差异，为实际应用中的系统选择提供依据。
AI.method: 采用两种无需微调的方法：(1) 模糊匹配(FM)，基于词汇字符串相似度；(2) 上下文感知表示(CAR)，结合提及级和文档级嵌入。同时设计了受控噪声注入实验，测试边界噪声和提及替换两种干扰类型。
AI.result: 两种方法均达到CoNLL F1 0.94-0.96的竞争力性能。CAR在官方测试集上始终比FM高出约1个F1点。噪声实验显示：边界噪声下CAR更鲁棒（FM下降0.20 F1，CAR仅下降0.07）；提及替换下FM更稳定（FM下降0.52，CAR下降0.63）。扩展性方面，FM随语料规模超线性增长，CAR近似线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 软件名称的高表面规律性降低了对复杂语义推理的需求，使两种简单方法均表现优异。系统选择应根据上游提及检测器的噪声特征和目标语料规模综合考量：大规模场景推荐CAR，小规模或噪声分布不均场景可考虑FM。

title: How and why does deep ensemble coupled with transfer learning increase performance in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia classification?
summary: Transfer learning (TL) and deep ensemble learning (DE) have recently been shown to outperform simple machine learning in classifying psychiatric disorders. However, there is still a lack of understanding as to why that is. This paper aims to understand how and why DE and TL reduce the variability of single-subject classification models in bipolar disorder (BD) and schizophrenia (SCZ). To this end, we investigated the training stability of TL and DE models. For the two classification tasks under consideration, we compared the results of multiple trainings with the same backbone but with different initializations. In this way, we take into account the epistemic uncertainty associated with the uncertainty in the estimation of the model parameters. It has been shown that the performance of classifiers can be significantly improved by using TL with DE. Based on these results, we investigate i) how many models are needed to benefit from the performance improvement of DE when classifying BD and SCZ from healthy controls, and ii) how TL induces better generalization, with and without DE. In the first case, we show that DE reaches a plateau when 10 models are included in the ensemble. In the second case, we find that using a pre-trained model constrains TL models with the same pre-training to stay in the same basin of the loss function. This is not the case for DL models with randomly initialized weights.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了深度集成学习（DE）与迁移学习（TL）联合使用为何能提升双相障碍（BD）与精神分裂症（SCZ）的单被试分类性能。主要发现：集成 10 个模型即可达到性能与方差下降的"平台期"；迁移学习通过将微调后的模型约束在同一损失盆地内，显著降低模型间方差，优于随机初始化深度学习（RI-DL）。
AI.motivation: 迁移学习（TL）与深度集成学习（DE）已被证明在精神疾病分类上优于传统机器学习，但其内在机制尚不清楚。随机初始化深度学习（RI-DL）模型存在由权重初始化与参数估计不确定性带来的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty），导致每次训练得到不同的权重、预测与潜在表征。现有研究缺少对以下问题的解答：TL 为何能带来性能增益？DE 究竟在多大程度上改善预测？以及需要训练多少个集成成员才能获得显著收益（以节省计算资源）？
AI.method: 数据：3D 全脑解剖 MRI 经 CAT12 计算 VBM 灰质图。SCZ 任务合并 SCHIZCONNECT-VIP、CNP、PRAGUE、BSNIP、CANDI（训练 933/验证 116/测试 133）；BD 任务合并 BIOBD、BSNIP、CNP、CANDI（训练 832/验证 103/测试 131）。划分按年龄、性别、站点、诊断分层，测试集包含训练中从未出现的站点以避免站点偏差。模型：DenseNet-121 骨干；TL 预训练模型在 OpenBHB、HCP、OASIS 3、ICBM 健康被试上以年龄为弱监督的对比学习（age-aware InfoNCE）训练。训练：200 epoch，学习率每 10 epoch 衰减因子 γ（调参取 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8），以 ROC-AUC 评估。DE：对每个样本平均 T 个模型的预测标签以估计 p(y|x,D)，T∈{2,5,10,15,20,30,40,50,60}，从 90 个 TL 与 90 个 RI-DL 模型中有放回自助抽样 P=10^5 个子集。损失景观分析：采用线性插值法 θ_λ=(1−λ)θ₁+λθ₂，λ 取 30 个均匀值，比较 TL–TL、RI-DL–RI-DL、TL–TL*（最优 epoch）、RI-DL–RI-DL*（最优 epoch）四种情形，考察沿插值路径的 ROC-AUC 是否出现性能障碍（barrier）。
AI.result: （1）DE 性能在 T=10 时达到平台期。BD 任务：TL 从无 DE 的 74.68±1.96 提升到 10-DE 的 77.06±0.74、40-DE 的 77.53±0.41（10→40 仅再提升 0.47%）；RI-DL 从 71.19±2.8 提升到 74.55±1.04（10-DE）与 75.07±0.55（40-DE）。SCZ 任务：TL 从 72.76±1.65 提升到 73.94±0.63（10-DE）与 74.12±0.35（40-DE）；RI-DL 从 72.51±2.1 提升到 74.16±0.79（10-DE）与 74.3±0.42（40-DE）。所有情形下集成规模增大时 ROC-AUC 升高、标准差下降，且 TL 的标准差始终更低。（2）TL 在 BD 上显著优于 RI-DL（TL-40DE 比 RI-DL-40DE 高 2.46%），而 SCZ 上两者接近（TL 低 0.18%）。（3）损失景观分析：两 TL 模型之间线性插值的 ROC-AUC 几乎保持直线且维持高水平，说明二者位于同一损失盆地；两 RI-DL 模型插值时 λ 接近 0 与 1 处 ROC-AUC 明显下降，说明存在性能障碍、落入不同局部极小。TL→TL* 曲线保持平坦，说明达到最佳 epoch 后模型仍留在同一盆地；RI-DL→RI-DL* 则出现下降，表明随机初始化模型在最佳 epoch 后会漂移，因而 TL 模型收敛更快、所需训练轮数更少。
AI.conclusion: DE 与 TL 均可通过降低模型间变异来提升 BD/SCZ 分类的性能与稳健性：集成 10 个模型已足以在性能和方差降低上达到饱和（兼顾时间与计算成本），而 TL 的作用机制在于将同一预训练初始化的模型约束在损失函数的同一盆地内，从而产生更一致、更可靠的预测并减少训练轮数。局限与展望：TL 的增益在 BD 上明显而在 SCZ 上有限，作者推测这与 SCZ 更简单的分类任务、SCZ 加速脑老化导致预训练与任务分布重叠，以及"简单性偏置"影响泛化有关；后续工作需解释年龄感知对比学习预训练对不同疾病收益差异的原因。

title: annbatch unlocks terabyte-scale training of biological data in anndata
summary: The scale of biological datasets now routinely exceeds system memory, making data access rather than model computation the primary bottleneck in training machine-learning models. This bottleneck is particularly acute in biology, where widely used community data formats must support heterogeneous metadata, sparse and dense assays, and downstream analysis within established computational ecosystems. Here we present annbatch, a mini-batch loader native to anndata that enables out-of-core training directly on disk-backed datasets. Across single-cell transcriptomics, microscopy and whole-genome sequencing benchmarks, annbatch increases loading throughput by up to an order of magnitude and shortens training from days to hours, while remaining fully compatible with the scverse ecosystem. Annbatch establishes a practical data-loading infrastructure for scalable biological AI, allowing increasingly large and diverse datasets to be used without abandoning standard biological data formats. Github: https://github.com/scverse/annbatch

AI.tldr: annbatch是一个基于anndata的原生小批量数据加载器，支持磁盘直读训练，可将生物数据加载速度提升一个数量级，训练时间从数天缩短至数小时。
AI.motivation: 生物数据集规模已普遍超过系统内存，导致数据访问而非模型计算成为机器学习训练的主要瓶颈。特别是在生物学领域，社区数据格式需要支持异构元数据、稀疏和密集检测，以及在既定计算生态系统中的下游分析。
AI.method: annbatch是基于anndata的原生小批量加载器，支持直接在磁盘-backed数据集上进行核外(out-of-core)训练。
AI.result: 在单细胞转录组学、显微镜和全基因组测序基准测试中，annbatch将加载吞吐量提升高达一个数量级，训练时间从数天缩短至数小时，同时完全兼容scverse生态系统。
AI.conclusion: annbatch为可扩展生物AI建立了实用的数据加载基础设施，使日益增长和多样化的数据集能够在不放弃标准生物数据格式的情况下得到使用。

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
summary: While textual frequency has been validated as relevant to human cognition in reading speed, its relatedness to Large Language Models (LLMs) is seldom studied. We propose a novel research direction in terms of textual data frequency, which is an understudied topic, to the best of our knowledge. Our framework is composed of three units. First, this paper proposes Textual Frequency Law (TFL), which indicates that frequent textual data should be preferred for LLMs for both prompting and fine-tuning. Since many LLMs are closed-source in their training data, we propose using online resources to estimate the sentence-level frequency. We then utilize an input paraphraser to paraphrase the input into a more frequent textual expression. Next, we propose Textual Frequency Distillation (TFD) by querying LLMs to conduct story completion by further extending the sentences in the datasets, and the resulting corpora are used to adjust the initial estimation. Finally, we propose Curriculum Textual Frequency Training (CTFT) that fine-tunes LLMs in an increasing order of sentence-level frequency. Experiments are conducted on our curated dataset Textual Frequency Paired Dataset (TFPD) on math reasoning, machine translation, commonsense reasoning and agentic tool calling. Results show the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将文本频率（Textual Frequency）作为研究LLM的新方向，构建了包含文本频率定律（TFL）、文本频率蒸馏（TFD）和课程文本频率训练（CTFT）的完整框架，通过利用在线资源估计句子级频率，并采用输入改写和课程微调策略提升LLM性能。
AI.motivation: 文本频率已被证实与人类阅读认知相关（阅读速度），但其与LLM的关系尚未被充分研究。本文旨在探索这一空白领域。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心模块：1）TFL：假设频繁文本数据更适合LLM的提示和微调，使用在线资源估计句子级频率，并利用输入改写器将输入转换为更频繁的表达；2）TFD：利用LLM扩展数据集句子以调整初始频率估计；3）CTFT：按句子频率递增顺序对LLM进行课程微调。
AI.result: 在TFPD数据集上的数学推理、机器翻译、常识推理和智能体工具调用任务中验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 文本频率是一个有价值的研究方向，通过频率感知的提示改写和课程微调策略可有效提升LLM在多任务上的表现。

title: ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Exploratory Demonstration Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agentic Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) significantly enhances the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), yet applying it to multi-turn agentic tasks remains challenging due to the long-horizon nature of interactions and the stochasticity of environmental feedback. We identify a structural failure mode in agentic exploration: suboptimal actions elicit noisy observations into misleading contexts, which further weaken subsequent decision-making, making recovery increasingly difficult. This cumulative feedback loop of errors renders standard exploration strategies ineffective and susceptible to the model's reasoning and the environment's randomness. To mitigate this issue, we propose ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Explorative Demonstration RL, shifting exploration from passive selection to active intervention. ProCeedRL employs a process-level critic to monitor interactions in real time, incorporating reflection-based demonstrations to guide agents in stopping the accumulation of errors. We find that this approach significantly exceeds the model's saturated exploration performance, demonstrating substantial exploratory benefits. By learning from exploratory demonstrations and on-policy samples, ProCeedRL significantly improves exploration efficiency and achieves superior performance on complex deep search and embodied tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProCeedRL，通过过程级评论家和基于反思的演示来改进多轮智能体任务中的强化学习探索策略，解决长时域交互中的错误累积问题。
AI.motivation: 将强化学习应用于多轮智能体任务时面临挑战：长时域交互中的错误累积和随机环境反馈导致次优动作产生误导性观测，进而进一步削弱后续决策，形成错误累积循环。标准探索策略在这种累积反馈下变得无效。
AI.method: ProCeedRL采用过程级评论家实时监控交互过程，结合基于反思的演示引导智能体停止错误累积。将探索从被动选择转变为主动干预。
AI.result: 该方法显著超越了模型饱和的探索性能，展现出实质性的探索收益。在复杂的深度搜索任务和具身任务上实现了优异性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从探索性演示和on-policy样本中学习，ProCeedRL显著提升了探索效率，为多轮智能体任务中的强化学习探索提供了有效解决方案。

title: Learn by Surprise, Commit by Proof
summary: We propose LSCP, a self-gated post-training framework for autonomous knowledge acquisition: learning only what a model does not already know, verified against what it does know, at a strength proportional to conviction, with no external oracle. When a passage produces anomalously high per-token loss, LSCP flags it, generates a Q&A chain that forces the model to articulate its own knowledge and identify gaps, then adjusts AdamW's $β_2$ proportionally to conviction depth k (the number of self-verification steps the passage survives) via $β_2 = 0.999 \cdot r^k$. The entire learning intensity is governed by a single parameter $r$. Beyond new knowledge, this process sharpens weakly encoded existing knowledge, which is a primary source of hallucination. The framework is self-extinguishing: as the model learns, per-token loss on learned passages decreases toward the surprisal threshold and the system progressively converges to standard AdamW. This models biological memory consolidation: temporary information in the context window is selectively consolidated into parametric weights, the model's long-term memory. Experiments on the reference model (Qwen3-14B) and across six models (8B--32B, four families) show that standard fine-tuning produces rote memorization (perturbation gap (the ratio of paraphrase to original perplexity) of 11.6 +- 0.2 x baseline) while all LSCP conditions learn semantically (2.7--3.0x). The r=1.0 condition (identical optimizer, nearly identical data, only Q&A format differs) confirms that the training data format, not $β_2$ gating, is the primary mechanism preventing memorization; gating instead protects neighboring knowledge from contamination by corrupt content (93 +- 7% accuracy on adjacent questions at r=0.98 vs. 90% baseline).

AI.tldr: LSCP是一种自门控的后训练框架，通过仅学习模型未知知识（通过高token loss识别）、自验证（Q&A链）和动态调整AdamW的β₂参数（β₂ = 0.999 · r^k）来实现自主知识获取。该方法具有自终止特性，能改善弱编码知识（幻觉根源），并保护相邻知识不被污染。实验表明LSCP实现语义学习（2.7-3.0倍），而标准微调产生机械记忆（11.6倍），Q&A格式而非β₂门控是防止机械记忆的主要原因。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在后训练中容易产生机械记忆（rote memorization）而非真正的语义学习，且存在弱编码知识导致的幻觉问题。现有方法依赖外部oracle，缺乏自主性。
AI.method: 1) 通过per-token loss异常高值识别未知知识；2) 生成Q&A链让模型自我验证并识别知识缺口；3) 根据conviction depth k动态调整AdamW的β₂参数（β₂ = 0.999 · r^k）；4) 单一参数r控制学习强度
AI.result: 标准微调产生机械记忆（perturbation gap 11.6±0.2倍基线），而LSCP所有条件均实现语义学习（2.7-3.0倍）；r=1.0条件证明Q&A格式而非β₂门控是防止机械记忆的主因；r=0.98时门控保护相邻知识免受污染（93±7%准确率 vs 90%基线）
AI.conclusion: Q&A自验证格式是防止机械记忆的核心机制；动态β₂门控主要起保护相邻知识的作用；框架具有自终止特性，模拟生物记忆巩固过程

title: The Expert Strikes Back: Interpreting Mixture-of-Experts Language Models at Expert Level
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become the dominant choice for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), activating only a subset of parameters per token. While MoE architectures are primarily adopted for computational efficiency, it remains an open question whether their sparsity makes them inherently easier to interpret than dense feed-forward networks (FFNs). We compare MoE experts and dense FFNs using $k$-sparse probing and find that expert neurons are consistently less polysemantic, with the gap widening as routing becomes sparser. This suggests that sparsity pressures both individual neurons and entire experts toward monosemanticity. Leveraging this finding, we zoom out from the neuron to the expert level as a more effective unit of analysis. We validate this approach by automatically interpreting hundreds of experts. This analysis allows us to resolve the debate on specialization: experts are neither broad domain specialists (e.g., biology) nor simple token-level processors. Instead, they function as fine-grained task experts, specializing in linguistic operations or semantic tasks (e.g., closing brackets in LaTeX). Our findings suggest that MoEs are inherently interpretable at the expert level, providing a clearer path toward large-scale model interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/jerryy33/MoE_analysis

AI.tldr: 本文研究了MoE架构相比Dense FFN的可解释性问题。通过k-sparse probing方法，发现专家神经元的多义性显著低于Dense FFN神经元，且稀疏性越高差距越大。这表明稀疏性促使神经元和整个专家向单义性演化。基于此，作者将分析单元从神经元提升到专家层面，成功自动解释了大量专家的功能性质，解决了关于专家是否是大规模领域专家的争议——专家实际上是细粒度的任务专家，专注于语言操作或语义任务（如LaTeX括号闭合）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型中广泛采用MoE架构，但其稀疏性是否使其比Dense FFN更易解释尚不明确。研究者希望探究MoE的可解释性特征，并解决"专家究竟是大规模领域专家还是简单token处理器"的争议。
AI.method: 使用k-sparse probing方法对MoE专家和Dense FFN进行对比分析，并将分析单元从神经元层级提升到专家层级，通过自动解释方法分析数百个专家的功能。
AI.result: 专家神经元始终比Dense FFN神经元具有更低的多义性，且稀疏程度越高差异越大。专家既不是广泛领域专家（如生物学），也不是简单的token级处理器，而是细粒度的任务专家，专注于特定语言操作或语义任务（如LaTeX中闭合括号）。
AI.conclusion: MoE在专家层级具有固有的可解释性优势，为大规模模型的可解释性研究提供了更清晰的路径。稀疏性驱动了单义性的演化，使专家成为理解LLM内部工作机制的有效分析单元。

title: ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Trajectory Benchmark for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Evaluating the safety of LLM-based agents is increasingly important because risks in realistic deployments often emerge over multi-step interactions rather than isolated prompts or final responses. Existing trajectory-level benchmarks remain limited by insufficient interaction diversity, coarse observability of safety failures, and weak long-horizon realism. We introduce ATBench, a trajectory-level benchmark for structured, diverse, and realistic evaluation of agent safety. ATBench organizes agentic risk along three dimensions: risk source, failure mode, and real-world harm. Based on this taxonomy, we construct trajectories with heterogeneous tool pools and a long-context delayed-trigger protocol that captures realistic risk emergence across multiple stages. The benchmark contains 1,000 trajectories (503 safe and 497 unsafe), averaging 9.01 turns and 3.95k tokens, with 1,954 invoked tools drawn from pools spanning 2,084 available tools. Data quality is supported by rule-based and LLM-based filtering plus full human audit. Experiments on frontier LLMs, open-source models, and specialized guard systems show that ATBench is challenging even for strong evaluators, while enabling taxonomy-stratified analysis, cross-benchmark comparison, and diagnosis of long-horizon failure patterns.

AI.tldr: ATBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体安全性的轨迹级基准测试，通过风险来源、失败模式和真实世界伤害三个维度进行组织，包含1,000条轨迹（平均9.01轮对话、3.95k tokens），旨在解决现有基准测试在交互多样性、安全故障可观察性和长时域现实性方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在现实部署中面临的风险通常在多步交互过程中逐渐显现，而非孤立的提示或最终响应。现有轨迹级基准测试存在三大局限：交互多样性不足、安全故障可观测性粗糙、长时域现实性较弱。这促使研究者需要一个新的benchmark来更全面地评估智能体安全性。
AI.method: ATBench提出三维度风险分类法：风险来源(risk source)、失败模式(failure mode)和真实世界伤害(real-world harm)。基于该分类法构建轨迹，使用异构工具池和长上下文延迟触发协议(long-context delayed-trigger protocol)来模拟现实风险在多个阶段的涌现。数据质量通过基于规则和LLM的过滤以及完整人工审计保证。
AI.result: benchmark包含1,000条轨迹（503条安全、497条不安全），平均9.01轮对话、3.95k tokens，包含1,954次工具调用（来自2,084个可用工具池）。对前沿LLM、开源模型和专业防护系统的实验表明，ATBench即使对强评估器也具有挑战性，同时支持分类学分层分析、跨基准测试比较和长时域失败模式诊断。
AI.conclusion: ATBench提供了一个结构化、多样化且现实的智能体安全评估基准，能够支持细粒度的风险分类分析，并在多种模型上验证了其挑战性，为LLM智能体安全研究提供了重要的评估工具。

title: Generalization Bounds and Statistical Guarantees for Multi-Task and Multiple Operator Learning with MNO Networks
summary: Multiple operator learning concerns learning operator families $\{G[α]:U\to V\}_{α\in W}$ indexed by an operator descriptor $α$. Training data are collected hierarchically by sampling operator instances $α$, then input functions $u$ per instance, and finally evaluation points $x$ per input, yielding noisy observations of $G[α][u](x)$. While recent work has developed expressive multi-task and multiple operator learning architectures and approximation-theoretic scaling laws, quantitative statistical generalization guarantees remain limited. We provide a covering-number-based generalization analysis for separable models, focusing on the Multiple Neural Operator (MNO) architecture: we first derive explicit metric-entropy bounds for hypothesis classes given by linear combinations of products of deep ReLU subnetworks, and then combine these complexity bounds with approximation guarantees for MNO to obtain an explicit approximation-estimation tradeoff for the expected test error on new (unseen) triples $(α,u,x)$. The resulting bound makes the dependence on the hierarchical sampling budgets $(n_α,n_u,n_x)$ transparent and yields an explicit learning-rate statement in the operator-sampling budget $n_α$, providing a sample-complexity characterization for generalization across operator instances. The structure and architecture can also be viewed as a general purpose solver or an example of a "small'' PDE foundation model, where the triples are one form of multi-modality.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为多算子/多任务神经算子学习（MNO架构）给出了基于覆盖数的定量泛化保证：把度量熵（metric entropy）显式界与MNO逼近定理结合，得到显式的"逼近–估计"权衡，其最终学习率仅依赖算子采样数 n_α，为 O(((log log n_α)/(log log log n_α))^{-2/d_W})，常数与 n_α, n_u, n_x 无关。
AI.motivation: 多算子学习旨在学习由描述参数 α 索引的算子族 {G[α]: U→V}（如参数化积分算子、参数化 PDE 解算子、以符号/文本描述索引的算子族）。此前工作已给出 MNO 等可分离架构的表达性证明与逼近尺度律（scaling laws），但缺少量化的统计泛化保证，即无法说明在有限（分层）数据下模型对未见三元组 (α, u, x) 的误差如何随采样预算下降。数据按层级采集：先采样算子实例 α，再每个算子采输入函数 u，最后每个输入采评估点 x，故需要能透明展示 n_α, n_u, n_x 依赖的理论，并指导"算子多样性 vs. 局部过采样"的预算分配。
AI.method: 采用"逼近–估计"（approximation–estimation）范式与统一化分析：(1) 定义受限/稀疏（sparsity budget K）、参数幅值受限（κ）、宽度 p、深度 L 的 ReLU 网络类 F_NN，先证明其 L∞ 覆盖数上界 N ≤ C(L(p²+p), K)·(⌊2κ/h⌋+1)^K（Prop 2.13），并给出输出与输出差的 Lipschitz 稳定性估计；(2) 对 MNO 的可分离结构 Σ_{p,k,ℓ} θ_{pkℓ} l_p(α) b_k(u) τ_ℓ(x) 联合量化三个子网参数与系数阵列 θ，得到裁剪类 Cl_a 的覆盖数（Prop 3.1），显式依赖深度、宽度、稀疏度、参数幅值与乘积重数 P,H,N；(3) 引入 Clip_{β_V} 算子（两层 ReLU 精确实现）保证输出有界，且不损失逼近能力（Cor 2.9）；(4) 风险分解 T₀ = T₁ + T₂：T₁ 用逼近项 2ε² 与噪声交叉项（Lemma 4.1，η-网 + 矩母函数 + union bound）控制；T₂ 为数据依赖预测子的泛化差距，用 ghost sample 对称化 + 平移类离散化 + 矩母函数 + union bound（Lemma 4.2/4.3）得到 1/n_α 的熵项；(5) 最后由 Prop 3.1 给出 log N(η) 关于 ε 的显式嵌套指数刻画，并取 ε=ε(n_α)、η=4β_V n_α^{-1} 做平衡。
AI.result: 定理 3.5（主尺度律）：E[测试误差] ≤ 4ε² + η(8σ+6) + (8ση/√(n_α n_u n_x))·√(log N(η)+log2) + (16σ²/(n_α n_u n_x))·(log N(η)+log2) + (112β_V²/(3n_α))·log N(η/(4β_V))，其中 σ² 为观测噪声的次高斯方差代理。推论 3.6：log N(η) ≲ ε^{-δ₁ ε^{-δ₂ ε^{-d_W}}} (1+log(η^{-1}))，δ₁ = d_U(1+d_V)(1+d_W/2)+d_W(d_V+1)/2+(d_V+1)，δ₂ = d_U(1+d_V)(1+d_W/2)，并与总非零参数量 N# ≲ ε^{-γ₁ ε^{-γ₂ ε^{-d_W}}} 等价。推论 3.8：取 ε = ((d_W/2δ₂)·log log n_α / log log log n_α)^{-1/d_W}，η = 4β_V/n_α 后，期望泛化误差 = O(((log log n_α)/(log log log n_α))^{-2/d_W})，隐含常数与 n_α, n_u, n_x 无关；且 n_α^{-1} 项的熵因子增长远慢于 n_α^{-1}，故该 1/n_α 项在所选 ε 下被近似项主导（Remark 4.4 指出精确平衡无闭式解）。
AI.conclusion: 论文为多算子/多任务学习提供了首个该类别的覆盖数型泛化界，形式化了两点实践意义：跨算子实例的摊销（amortization）与分层采样指引（层级预算 n_α, n_u, n_x 的显式依赖）；并为以 α 为显式描述符的 PDE 基础模型（"小型" PDE 基础模型）提供了间接理论支撑。局限与展望：假设训练为经验风险的精确最小化，未含优化/次优项与正则化、early stopping；使用全局 L∞ 覆盖数（类较大），可用局部化或数据依赖复杂度改进；分析限于可分离 MNO 类，未覆盖注意力式算子架构；在现有全局复杂度控制下误差被 n_α 项瓶颈化，固定 n_α 后过度采样 (u,x) 无法补偿，故需研究自适应/主动的算子实例选择策略。

title: Neuro-RIT: Neuron-Guided Instruction Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Language Model
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) have demonstrated significant potential in knowledge-intensive tasks; however, they remain vulnerable to performance degradation when presented with irrelevant or noisy retrieved contexts. Existing approaches to enhance robustness typically operate via coarse-grained parameter updates at the layer or module level, often overlooking the inherent neuron-level sparsity of Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this limitation, we propose Neuro-RIT (Neuron-guided Robust Instruction Tuning), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from dense adaptation to precision-driven neuron alignment. Our method explicitly disentangles neurons that are responsible for processing relevant versus irrelevant contexts using attribution-based neuron mining. Subsequently, we introduce a two-stage instruction tuning strategy that enforces a dual capability for noise robustness: achieving direct noise suppression by functionally deactivating neurons exclusive to irrelevant contexts, while simultaneously optimizing targeted layers for evidence distillation. Extensive experiments across diverse QA benchmarks demonstrate that Neuro-RIT consistently outperforms strong baselines and robustness-enhancing methods.

AI.tldr: Neuro-RIT通过神经元级精细调控提升检索增强语言模型对噪声上下文的鲁棒性，通过属性溯源挖掘区分相关/无关上下文的神经元，并采用双阶段指令微调策略实现噪声抑制与证据蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有RALM在处理不相关或噪声检索上下文时性能下降严重；现有增强鲁棒性的方法采用粗粒度的层或模块级参数更新，忽视了LLM固有的神经元级稀疏性这一重要特性。
AI.method: 提出Neuro-RIT框架，核心包括：(1)基于属性溯源的神经元挖掘，明确分离处理相关上下文与无关上下文的神经元；(2)两阶段指令微调策略——通过功能性地失活专属于无关上下文的神经元实现直接噪声抑制，同时优化目标层进行证据蒸馏。
AI.result: 在多个QA基准数据集上的实验表明，Neuro-RIT持续优于强基线和现有鲁棒性增强方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将LLM适应范式从密集参数调整转向精准神经元对齐，验证了神经元级稀疏性在提升RAG系统鲁棒性中的关键作用。

title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
summary: General-purpose world models promise scalable policy evaluation, optimization, and planning, yet achieving the required level of robustness remains challenging. Unlike policy learning, which primarily focuses on optimal actions, a world model must be reliable over a much broader range of suboptimal actions, which are often insufficiently covered by action-labeled interaction data. To address this challenge, we propose World Action Verifier (WAV), a framework that enables world models to identify their own prediction errors and self-improve. The key idea is to decompose action-conditioned state prediction into two factors -- state plausibility and action reachability -- and verify each separately. We show that these verification problems can be substantially easier than predicting future states due to two underlying asymmetries: the broader availability of action-free data and the lower dimensionality of action-relevant features. Leveraging these asymmetries, we augment a world model with (i) a diverse subgoal generator obtained from video corpora and (ii) a sparse inverse model that infers actions from a subset of state features. By enforcing cycle consistency among generated subgoals, inferred actions, and forward rollouts, WAV provides an effective verification mechanism in under-explored regimes, where existing methods typically fail.
