However, many existing techniques are tailored to specific model architectures, particularly within the Transformer family, and often require backpropagation, resulting in nearly double the GPU memory usage and increased computational cost. A lightweight, model-agnostic approach for attention visualization remains lacking. In this paper, we introduce a model-agnostic token importance visualization technique to better understand how generative AI systems perceive and prioritize information from input text, without incurring additional computational cost. Our method leverages perturbation-based strategies combined with a three-matrix analytical framework to generate relevance maps that illustrate token-level contributions to model predictions. The framework comprises: (1) the Angular Deviation Matrix, which captures shifts in semantic direction; (2) the Magnitude Deviation Matrix, which measures changes in semantic intensity; and (3) the Dimensional Importance Matrix, which evaluates contributions across individual vector dimensions. By systematically removing each token and measuring the resulting impact across these three complementary dimensions, we derive a composite importance score that provides a nuanced and mathematically grounded measure of token significance. To support reproducibility and foster wider adoption, we provide open-source implementations of all proposed and utilized explainability techniques, with code and resources publicly available at https://github.com/Infosys/Infosys-Responsible-AI-Toolkit

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模型无关的token重要性可视化技术，通过扰动策略和三矩阵分析框架（角度偏离矩阵、幅度偏离矩阵、维度重要性矩阵）来理解生成式AI如何处理输入文本中的信息，无需额外计算成本即可生成token级别的相关性图。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力可视化技术多针对特定Transformer架构设计，且需反向传播计算，导致GPU内存占用翻倍和计算成本增加。缺乏一种轻量级、模型无关的注意力可视化方法。
AI.method: 采用基于扰动的策略，通过系统性地移除每个token并测量其在三个维度上的影响：①角度偏离矩阵（捕获语义方向变化）、②幅度偏离矩阵（测量语义强度变化）、③维度重要性矩阵（评估各向量维度的贡献）。最终通过融合三个矩阵得出复合重要性分数。
AI.result: 该方法能够在不增加额外计算成本的情况下生成token级别的相关性图，清晰展示每个token对模型预测的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架为token重要性提供了细致且数学上严谨的度量方式，有助于更好地理解和解释生成式AI系统的信息处理机制。开源实现已发布以支持复现和广泛应用。

title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Control under Time-Varying Dynamics
comment: 15 pages, 5 figues, 2 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Learning-based control methods typically assume stationary system dynamics, an assumption often violated in real-world systems due to drift, wear, or changing operating conditions. We study reinforcement learning for control under time-varying dynamics. We consider a continual model-based reinforcement learning setting in which an agent repeatedly learns and controls a dynamical system whose transition dynamics evolve across episodes. We analyze the problem using Gaussian process dynamics models under frequentist variation-budget assumptions. Our analysis shows that persistent non-stationarity requires explicitly limiting the influence of outdated data to maintain calibrated uncertainty and meaningful dynamic regret guarantees. Motivated by these insights, we propose a practical optimistic model-based reinforcement learning algorithm with adaptive data buffer mechanisms and demonstrate improved performance on continuous control benchmarks with non-stationary dynamics.

AI.tldr: 研究非平稳动态系统下的强化学习控制问题，采用高斯过程动态模型，通过自适应数据缓冲机制限制过时数据的影响，在持续学习设置下实现动态遗憾保证，并在连续控制基准测试中验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现实系统因漂移、磨损或工况变化而违反平稳性假设，传统学习方法依赖平稳动态条件，无法适应随时间变化的系统特性，需要专门处理非平稳性的RL方法。
AI.method: 采用持续模型化RL框架和高斯过程动态模型，在频繁变化预算假设下分析问题；设计乐观模型化RL算法配合自适应数据缓冲机制，主动限制过时数据的权重以保持校准的不确定性。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，持续性非平稳性要求显式限制过时数据的影响以维持校准的不确定性和有意义的动态遗憾保证；实验验证了算法在非平稳动态连续控制基准测试中的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的乐观模型化RL算法通过自适应数据缓冲有效应对非平稳动态，为时变系统控制提供了一种实用的学习控制方案。

title: When to ASK: Uncertainty-Gated Language Assistance for Reinforcement Learning
comment: In Proceedings of International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents often struggle with out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, leading to high uncertainty and random behavior. While language models (LMs) contain valuable world knowledge, larger ones incur high computational costs, hindering real-time use, and exhibit limitations in autonomous planning. We introduce Adaptive Safety through Knowledge (ASK), which combines smaller LMs with trained RL policies to enhance OOD generalization without retraining. ASK employs Monte Carlo Dropout to assess uncertainty and queries the LM for action suggestions only when uncertainty exceeds a set threshold. This selective use preserves the efficiency of existing policies while leveraging the language model's reasoning in uncertain situations. In experiments on the FrozenLake environment, ASK shows no improvement in-domain, but demonstrates robust navigation in transfer tasks, achieving a reward of 0.95. Our findings indicate that effective neuro-symbolic integration requires careful orchestration rather than simple combination, highlighting the need for sufficient model scale and effective hybridization mechanisms for successful OOD generalization.

AI.tldr: ASK方法通过将小型语言模型与强化学习策略选择性结合，在Out-of-Distribution场景下实现稳健导航（迁移任务奖励达0.95），证明有效的神经符号集成需要精心设计而非简单组合。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体在分布外(OOD)场景中表现不佳，导致高不确定性和随机行为；大型语言模型虽包含世界知识，但计算成本高且在自主规划中存在局限。
AI.method: ASK方法：结合小型语言模型与训练好的RL策略，通过Monte Carlo Dropout评估不确定性，仅当不确定性超过阈值时查询LM获取行动建议，实现选择性协同。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake环境中，ASK在域内任务无明显提升，但在迁移任务中展现稳健导航能力，达成0.95的奖励值。
AI.conclusion: 有效的神经符号集成需精心编排而非简单组合；成功实现OOD泛化需要足够的模型规模和有效的混合机制。

title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization
summary: Agent skills, structured packages of procedural knowledge and executable resources that agents dynamically load at inference time, have become a reliable mechanism for augmenting LLM agents. Yet inference-time skill augmentation is fundamentally limited: retrieval noise introduces irrelevant guidance, injected skill content imposes substantial token overhead, and the model never truly acquires the knowledge it merely follows. We ask whether skills can instead be internalized into model parameters, enabling zero-shot autonomous behavior without any runtime skill retrieval. We introduce SKILL0, an in-context reinforcement learning framework designed for skill internalization. SKILL0 introduces a training-time curriculum that begins with full skill context and progressively withdraws it. Skills are grouped offline by category and rendered with interaction history into a compact visual context, teaching he model tool invocation and multi-turn task completion. A Dynamic Curriculum then evaluates each skill file's on-policy helpfulness, retaining only those from which the current policy still benefits within a linearly decaying budget, until the agent operates in a fully zero-shot setting. Extensive agentic experiments demonstrate that SKILL0 achieves substantial improvements over the standard RL baseline (+9.7\% for ALFWorld and +6.6\% for Search-QA), while maintaining a highly efficient context of fewer than 0.5k tokens per step. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SkillZero.

AI.tldr: SKILL0是一个用于将外部技能内部化到LLM Agent参数中的框架，通过上下文强化学习训练，使Agent能够在零样本情况下自主执行任务，无需运行时技能检索。该框架包含渐进式撤回技能上下文的课程学习和基于在策有用性评估的动态课程，在保持高效上下文（每步<0.5k tokens）的同时，显著提升Agent性能。
AI.motivation: 当前推理时技能增强方法存在三大固有局限：检索噪声导致无关引导、注入技能内容带来大量token开销、以及模型仅是"遵循"技能而非真正"习得"知识。研究者探索将技能内部化到模型参数中，实现零样本自主行为。
AI.method: SKILL0采用两阶段课程学习框架：(1) 训练时课程从完整技能上下文开始，逐步撤回；(2) 动态课程评估每个技能文件的在策有用性，仅保留当前策略仍可从中受益的技能，在线性衰减预算内迭代，直到Agent达到完全零样本运行状态。技能按类别离线分组并与交互历史一起渲染为紧凑视觉上下文。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和Search-QA任务上的Agent实验表明，SKILL0相比标准RL基线分别提升+9.7%和+6.6%，同时保持极高的上下文效率（每步少于0.5k tokens）。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文强化学习实现技能内部化是可行且有效的，Agent可在不依赖运行时技能检索的情况下实现高性能表现，为解决LLM Agent技能增强的固有局限提供了新思路。

title: Answering the Wrong Question: Reasoning Trace Inversion for Abstention in LLMs
summary: For Large Language Models (LLMs) to be reliably deployed, models must effectively know when not to answer: abstain. Reasoning models, in particular, have gained attention for impressive performance on complex tasks. However, reasoning models have been shown to have worse abstention abilities. Taking the vulnerabilities of reasoning models into account, we propose our Query Misalignment Framework. Hallucinations resulting in failed abstention can be reinterpreted as LLMs answering the wrong question (rather than answering a question incorrectly). Based on this framework, we develop a new class of state-of-the-art abstention methods called Trace Inversion. First, we generate the reasoning trace of a model. Based on only the trace, we then reconstruct the most likely query that the model responded to. Finally, we compare the initial query with the reconstructed query. Low similarity score between the initial query and reconstructed query suggests that the model likely answered the question incorrectly and is flagged to abstain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Trace Inversion effectively boosts abstention performance in four frontier LLMs across nine abstention QA datasets, beating competitive baselines in 33 out of 36 settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型语言模型（尤其是推理模型）的错误回答问题，提出了"查询错位框架"（Query Misalignment Framework）。核心思想是将幻觉和错误拒绝重新解释为模型回答了错误的问题。通过"轨迹反转"（Trace Inversion）方法——生成推理轨迹、重构原始查询、比较相似度——来判断模型是否正确理解了问题。实验表明，该方法在4个前沿LLM和9个数据集的36个设置中，在33个设置上超越了竞争基线。
AI.motivation: 推理模型（Reasoning models）虽然在大复杂任务上表现出色，但已被证明具有更差的拒绝回答（abstention）能力。当模型无法正确回答时，它们倾向于"产生幻觉"而不是选择不回答，这可能导致不可靠的部署。
AI.method: 提出Query Misalignment Framework，将失败拒绝重新解读为"回答错误问题"而非"错误回答问题"。基于此框架开发Trace Inversion方法：(1)生成模型的推理轨迹；(2)仅基于轨迹重构最可能的原始查询；(3)比较初始查询与重构查询的相似度，低相似度表明模型可能答错问题，应触发拒绝。
AI.result: Trace Inversion方法在4个前沿LLM和9个abstention QA数据集上进行了广泛实验，在36个设置中的33个上超越了竞争基线，达到了最先进的abstention性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM的幻觉和失败拒绝重新概念化为"查询错位"问题，可以有效提升推理模型的拒绝回答能力。Trace Inversion提供了一种无需外部工具或训练的新方法类别，显著改善了LLM部署的可靠性。

title: Crystalite: A Lightweight Transformer for Efficient Crystal Modeling
comment: 39 pages, 13 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/joshrosie/crystalite
summary: Generative models for crystalline materials often rely on equivariant graph neural networks, which capture geometric structure well but are costly to train and slow to sample. We present Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal modeling built around two simple inductive biases. The first is Subatomic Tokenization, a compact chemically structured atom representation that replaces high-dimensional one-hot encodings and is better suited to continuous diffusion. The second is the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), which injects periodic minimum-image pair geometry directly into attention through additive geometric biases. Together, these components preserve the simplicity and efficiency of a standard Transformer while making it better matched to the structure of crystalline materials. Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction benchmarks, and de novo generation performance, attaining the best S.U.N. discovery score among the evaluated baselines while sampling substantially faster than geometry-heavy alternatives.

AI.tldr: Crystalite 是一个轻量级扩散 Transformer 晶体生成模型，通过两个归纳偏置——Subatomic Tokenization（用 34 维化学描述子/PCA 压缩替代高维 one-hot 元素编码）与 GEM（把周期最小镜像几何以加性偏置形式注入注意力）——在保持标准 Transformer 简洁高效的前提下获得晶体结构先验。在 CSP 基准上取得 SOTA（MP-20 MR 66.09%、RMSE 0.0337；MPTS-52 MR 31.56%；Alex-MP-20 MR 68.26%），在 de novo 生成中取得评估基线中最佳 S.U.N. 分数（47.49%），且采样速度远快于几何重基线（22.36 s/1k，bf16 优化后 5.14 s/1k，对比 FlowMM 1560 s、MatterGen 2639 s）。
AI.motivation: 晶体生成的主流做法是等变图神经网络（EGNN/GemNet 等），虽然几何表达能力强，但架构复杂、训练昂贵、采样缓慢；而轻量 Transformer（ADiT、CrystalDiT、OXtal 等）又往往只弱式或间接地引入晶体几何。核心问题是：一个不含显式等变消息传递的标准扩散 Transformer 能否通过恰当方式注入周期几何与化学结构，从而在晶体建模上与等变模型竞争？作者的目标不是去除几何归纳偏置，而是以更简单、模块化的形式把它加回来。
AI.method: 晶体表示为三元组 C=(A,F,L)，含原子类型、分数坐标与晶格矩阵。①Subatomic Tokenization：为每种元素构造由周期(onehot 7)、族(onehot 19)、区(onehot 4)、价层占据数(s/p/d/f)组成的 34 维描述符，按特征组做标准化与按维数平方根倒数再平衡，最后 ℓ₂ 归一化；DNG 中进一步用固定 PCA 基压缩至 16 维。扩散在连续 token 空间进行，采样时用余弦最近原型解码回离散元素，使训练/解码几何一致。②扩散形式：采用 EDM 框架，对 (H,F,y) 三通道联合加噪，其中晶格用下三角对角取指数的 6 维潜变量 y 参数化；坐标在中心化立方体中加噪后回绕到 [0,1)，损失用分数空间逐分量 wrap 残差；原子 token 与晶格潜变量用欧氏 MSE；三通道 EDM 预条件与加权损失。③架构：每原子一 token（类型嵌入 E_H + 分数坐标 Fourier 特征嵌入 E_F 相加）+ 一个全局晶格 token，经 AdaLN 条件化（c_noise=¼logσ）的标准 Transformer 主干，输出头分别预测 Ĥ、F̂、ŷ；CSP 时固定组成、屏蔽类型损失。④GEM：由当前分数坐标与 L(y) 重建晶格，在 G=LLᵀ 度量下于有限偏移集 Ω_R 做 metric-aware 最小镜像搜索，得归一化距离 d̄_ij 与位移；构造每头的距离惩罚偏置（斜率 w_h≤0）与 MLP 边偏置（Fourier 位移特征 + RBF 距离 + 晶格描述符），再乘噪声相关门控 g_h(σ)，加到注意力 logits（仅原子-原子作用，晶格 token 置零）。⑤采样：可选通道级 anti-annealing，用辅助 Karras 调度得 α_i^(q)=max(1, Δ̃/Δ)，对 H/F/lat 通道分别缩放 Heun 漂移项。DNG 配置：14 层、d=512、16 头、PCA 16 维 token；CSP 配置：14 层、d=1024、使用原子序数特征。数据为 MP-20、MPTS-52、Alex-MP-20。
AI.result: 【CSP】MP-20: MR 66.09%、RMSE 0.0337（此前最佳 KLDM 65.83/0.0517，RMSE 降 34.8%）；MPTS-52: MR 31.56%、RMSE 0.0711（此前最佳 KLDM 23.93/0.1276，RMSE 降 44.3%）；Alex-MP-20: MR 68.26%、RMSE 0.0317（此前最佳 OMatG 64.71/0.1251，RMSE 降 74.7%），平均约 51%。消融显示 GEM 对 MR 影响很小，但持续带来约 20% 的 RMSE 改善，即主要作用是细化几何精度而非决定结构模态。【DNG，MP-20，1 万样本】结构有效性 99.61%、组成有效性 81.72%、Unique 95.24%、Novel 79.30%、UN 77.33%、Stable 69.72%、S.U.N. 47.49%（基线中最高，优于 MatterGen 42.29、CrystalDiT 41.70、DiffCSP 38.60、ADiT 36.76、FlowMM 31.64）；wdist-ρ 0.051、wdist-N-ary 0.127；采样 22.36 s/1k（†bf16 优化 5.14 s/1k），远快于 FlowMM 1560 s、MatterGen 2639 s、DiffCSP 237 s、ADiT 84.81 s、CrystalDiT 73.72 s。外部管线验证：MatterGen 管线 S.U.N. 24.26；LeMat-GenBench 榜单 Valid 97.20、Unique 95.80、Novel 53.20、Stable 51.60、SUN 22.60、MSUN 1.50、E above hull 0.0905 eV、Relax RMSD 0.1320 Å（预弛豫组中 SUN 最高）。消融：Subatomic Tokenization 在匹配稳定性曲线后仍持续提升 UN/SUN；GEM 提升稳定性侧并全程提高 SUN；anti-annealing 对 DNG/CSP 均不敏感，CSP 中 aa_coords=aa_lattice=4 同时取得最高 MR 与最低 RMSE。大规模采样（10⁶）下 Crystalite 的 UN 与唯一性优于 ADiT。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级扩散 Transformer 通过恰当注入周期几何（GEM）与化学结构（Subatomic Tokenization）即可匹敌甚至超越重型等变模型，说明晶体建模的强性能并不必然要求完全等变架构。Crystalite 在 CSP 上达到 SOTA，在 de novo 生成中取得最佳 S.U.N. 且采样快一个数量级以上，为可扩展的材料发现提供了简洁高效的路线。作者同时强调：训练存在"稳定性—多样性"权衡（分布拟合改善会牺牲新颖性/唯一性），需谨慎做检查点选择与损失加权（如大幅下调类型损失）；MLIP（NequIP）稳定性估计是实用的模型选择信号；并建议样本广延型指标（Unique/UN/SUN）必须与生成样本量一同报告，只有样本密集型指标（有效性、稳定性、Wasserstein 距离）才能由子集可靠估计。

title: Do Emotions in Prompts Matter? Effects of Emotional Framing on Large Language Models
summary: Emotional tone is pervasive in human communication, yet its influence on large language model (LLM) behaviour remains unclear. Here, we examine how first-person emotional framing in user-side queries affect LLM performance across six benchmark domains, including mathematical reasoning, medical question answering, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning and social inference. Across models and tasks, static emotional prefixes usually produce only small changes in accuracy, suggesting that affective phrasing is typically a mild perturbation rather than a reliable general-purpose intervention. This stability is not uniform: effects are more variable in socially grounded tasks, where emotional context more plausibly interacts with interpersonal reasoning. Additional analyses show that stronger emotional wording induces only modest extra change, and that human-written prefixes reproduce the same qualitative pattern as LLM-generated ones. We then introduce EmotionRL, an adaptive emotional prompting framework that selects emotional framing adaptively for each query. Although no single emotion is consistently beneficial, adaptive selection yields more reliable gains than fixed emotional prompting. Together, these findings show that emotional tone is neither a dominant driver of LLM performance nor irrelevant noise, but a weak and input-dependent signal that can be exploited through adaptive control.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了用户查询中的第一人称情感表述如何影响大语言模型（LLM）表现。通过六个基准领域（数学推理、医学问答、阅读理解、常识推理和社会推理）的实验发现：静态情感前缀对准确率的影响通常较小，但这种稳定性在社会性任务中表现不一。引入EmotionRL——一种自适应情感提示框架，可根据查询动态选择情感表述。结论是情感语调既非LLM性能的主导因素，也非无关噪声，而是一种可通过自适应控制加以利用的弱输入依赖信号。
AI.motivation: 情感语调在人类交流中普遍存在，但其对LLM行为的影响尚不明确。研究旨在系统性地探索情感表述是否可作为改善LLM性能的可靠干预手段。
AI.method: 在六类基准任务上测试不同情感前缀（静态前缀、人类撰写 vs LLM生成前缀、不同情感强度）对模型准确率的影响；提出并评估EmotionRL自适应情感选择框架。
AI.result: 静态情感前缀仅产生小幅准确率变化，属轻度扰动而非可靠干预；社会性任务中情感效应更不稳定；自适应EmotionRL框架比固定情感提示获得更可靠的增益。
AI.conclusion: 情感语调是弱且输入依赖的信号，既非LLM性能的主导驱动因素，也非无关噪声，可通过自适应控制加以利用。

title: Unifying Group-Relative and Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Sample Routing
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, its coarse credit assignment uniformly penalizes failed rollouts, lacking the token-level focus needed to efficiently address specific deviations. Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) addresses this by providing denser, more targeted logit-level supervision that facilitates rapid early improvement, yet it frequently collapses during prolonged training. We trace this late-stage instability to two intrinsic flaws: self-distillation on already-correct samples introduces optimization ambiguity, and the self-teacher's signal reliability progressively degrades. To resolve these issues, we propose Sample-Routed Policy Optimization (SRPO), a unified on-policy framework that routes correct samples to GRPO's reward-aligned reinforcement and failed samples to SDPO's targeted logit-level correction. SRPO further incorporates an entropy-aware dynamic weighting mechanism to suppress high-entropy, unreliable distillation targets while emphasizing confident ones. Evaluated across five benchmarks and two model scales, SRPO achieves both the rapid early improvement of SDPO and the long-horizon stability of GRPO. It consistently surpasses the peak performance of both baselines, raising the five-benchmark average on Qwen3-8B by 3.4% over GRPO and 6.3% over SDPO, while simultaneously yielding moderate response lengths and lowering per-step compute cost by up to 17.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRPO方法，通过样本路由机制结合GRPO和SDPO的优势，并引入熵感知动态加权机制解决SDPO的晚期不稳定性问题，在5个基准测试上实现性能提升和计算效率优化。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法存在两大问题：GRPO的粗粒度信用分配对所有失败样本统一惩罚，缺乏token级精细指导；而SDPO虽能提供密集的logit级监督实现快速早期改进，但长期训练时容易出现性能崩溃。
AI.method: 提出Sample-Routed Policy Optimization (SRPO)框架：(1) 样本路由机制将正确样本导向GRPO的奖励对齐强化学习，将失败样本导向SDPO的定向logit级纠正；(2) 熵感知动态加权机制抑制高熵不可靠的蒸馏目标，强调高置信度目标。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和两种模型规模上，SRPO实现了SDPO的快速早期改进和GRPO的长期稳定性。Qwen3-8B上平均性能提升3.4%（相比GRPO）和6.3%（相比SDPO），同时缩短响应长度并降低17.2%的每步计算成本。
AI.conclusion: SRPO通过统一框架有效融合两种方法的互补优势，解决了SDPO的晚期不稳定性问题，验证了样本级路由和熵感知动态加权策略的有效性。

title: De Jure: Iterative LLM Self-Refinement for Structured Extraction of Regulatory Rules
summary: Regulatory documents encode legally binding obligations that LLM-based systems must respect. Yet converting dense, hierarchically structured legal text into machine-readable rules remains a costly, expert-intensive process. We present De Jure, a fully automated, domain-agnostic pipeline for extracting structured regulatory rules from raw documents, requiring no human annotation, domain-specific prompting, or annotated gold data. De Jure operates through four sequential stages: normalization of source documents into structured Markdown; LLM-driven semantic decomposition into structured rule units; multi-criteria LLM-as-a-judge evaluation across 19 dimensions spanning metadata, definitions, and rule semantics; and iterative repair of low-scoring extractions within a bounded regeneration budget, where upstream components are repaired before rule units are evaluated. We evaluate De Jure across four models on three regulatory corpora spanning finance, healthcare, and AI governance. On the finance domain, De Jure yields consistent and monotonic improvement in extraction quality, reaching peak performance within three judge-guided iterations. De Jure generalizes effectively to healthcare and AI governance, maintaining high performance across both open- and closed-source models. In a downstream compliance question-answering evaluation via RAG, responses grounded in De Jure extracted rules are preferred over prior work in 73.8% of cases at single-rule retrieval depth, rising to 84.0% under broader retrieval, confirming that extraction fidelity translates directly into downstream utility. These results demonstrate that explicit, interpretable evaluation criteria can substitute for human annotation in complex regulatory domains, offering a scalable and auditable path toward regulation-grounded LLM alignment.

AI.tldr: De Jure 是一个全自动化的领域无关管道，用于从原始监管文档中提取结构化规则，无需人工标注。该系统包含四个阶段：文档标准化、语义分解、多标准LLM评估（19维度）和迭代修复。在金融、医疗和AI治理三个领域的实验表明，该方法在下游合规问答任务中显著优于先前工作（73.8%-84.0%偏好率）。
AI.motivation: 将密集的层级法律文本转换为机器可读规则仍依赖昂贵的专家标注，缺乏可扩展的自动化方案。如何在不依赖人工标注的情况下，从监管文档中提取高质量结构化规则是一个重要挑战。
AI.method: 提出四阶段管道：① 将源文档规范化为结构化Markdown；② 使用LLM进行语义分解提取结构化规则单元；③ 从元数据、定义和规则语义三个维度（19项标准）进行LLM-as-judge评估；④ 在有限修复预算内迭代修复低分提取结果，优先修复上游组件。
AI.result: 在金融领域，De Jure实现一致且单调的提取质量提升，三次迭代内达到峰值性能；成功泛化至医疗和AI治理领域，在开源和闭源模型上均保持高性能。下游RAG问答评估中，基于De Jure提取规则的响应在单规则检索深度下获得73.8%偏好，三规则检索下达84.0%。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可解释的评估标准可替代人工标注用于复杂监管领域，为监管对齐LLM提供了一条可扩展且可审计的路径。

title: Taming the Exponential: A Fast Softmax Surrogate for Integer-Native Edge Inference
summary: Softmax can become a computational bottleneck in the Transformer model's Multi-Head Attention (MHA) block, particularly in small models under low-precision inference, where exponentiation and normalization incur significant overhead. As such, we suggest using Head-Calibrated Clipped-Linear Softmax (HCCS), a bounded, monotone surrogate to the exponential softmax function, which uses a clipped linear mapping of the max centered attention logits. This approximation produces a stable probability distribution, maintains the ordering of the original logits and has non-negative values. HCCS differs from previous softmax surrogates as it includes a set of lightweight calibration parameters that are optimized offline based on a representative dataset and calibrated for each individual attention head to preserve the statistical properties of the individual heads. We describe a hardware-motivated implementation of HCCS for high-throughput scenarios targeting the AMD Versal AI Engines. The current reference implementations from AMD for this platform rely upon either bfloat16 arithmetic or LUTs to perform the exponential operation, which might limit the throughput of the platform and fail to utilize the high-throughput integer vector processing units of the AI Engine. In contrast, HCCS provides a natural mapping to the AI Engines' int8 multiply accumulate (MAC) units. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first int8 optimized softmax surrogate for AMD AI engines that significantly exceeds the speed performance of other reference implementations while maintaining competitive task accuracy on small or heavily quantized MHA workloads after quantization-aware retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Head-Calibrated Clipped-Linear Softmax (HCCS)，一种用于替代Transformer中Softmax函数的有界单调近似方法，专为AMD Versal AI Engines的int8硬件设计，可显著提升小模型低精度推理的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: Transformer的Multi-Head Attention (MHA)模块中，Softmax函数的指数运算和归一化在小模型低精度推理场景下开销巨大，成为计算瓶颈。AMD AI Engine平台现有参考实现依赖bfloat16或LUT来执行指数运算，无法充分利用平台的高吞吐量整数向量处理单元。
AI.method: 1. 设计HCCS：使用截断线性映射替代指数函数，基于最大中心注意力logits生成有界、单调的概率分布；2. 离线校准：为每个注意力头引入轻量级校准参数，基于代表性数据集优化以保持各头统计特性；3. 硬件映射：将HCCS自然映射到AI Engine的int8 MAC单元。
AI.result: 该方法首次在AMD AI引擎上实现int8优化的softmax替代方案，在小模型或重度量化MHA工作负载上经量化感知重训练后，任务精度具有竞争力，且吞吐量显著超越现有参考实现。
AI.conclusion: HCCS通过硬件感知的近似设计，在保持模型精度的同时有效解决了Transformer推理中Softmax的计算瓶颈问题，为低精度高吞吐量场景提供了可行方案。

title: go-$m$HC: Direct Parameterization of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections via Generalized Orthostochastic Matrices
comment: 29 pages, 30 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Doubly stochastic matrices enable learned mixing across residual streams, but parameterizing the set of doubly stochastic matrices (the Birkhoff polytope) exactly and efficiently remains an open challenge. Existing exact methods scale factorially with the number of streams ($d$), while Kronecker-factorized approaches are efficient but expressivity-limited. We introduce a novel exact parameterization grounded in the theory of generalized orthostochastic matrices, which scales as $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ and exposes a single hyperparameter $s$ which continuously interpolates between a computationally efficient boundary and the fully expressive Birkhoff polytope. Building on Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections ($m$HC), a framework for learned dynamic layer connectivity, we instantiate this parameterization in go-$m$HC. Our method composes naturally with Kronecker-factorized methods, substantially recovering expressivity at similar FLOP costs. Spectral analysis indicates that go-$m$HC fills the Birkhoff polytope far more completely than Kronecker-factorized baselines. On synthetic stream-mixing tasks, go-$m$HC achieves the minimum theoretical loss while converging up to $10\times$ faster. We validate our approach in a 30M parameter GPT-style language model. The expressivity, efficiency, and exactness of go-$m$HC offer a practical avenue for scaling $d$ as a new dimension of model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出go-mHC方法，基于广义正交随机矩阵理论，以O(d³)复杂度精确参数化Birkhoff多面体，解决了精确方法与高效方法之间的表达力权衡问题。在合成任务和30M参数GPT模型上验证了方法的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有精确参数化Birkhoff多面体的方法随残差流数量d呈阶乘级增长，计算代价极高；而Kronecker分解方法虽高效但表达力受限。如何在O(d³)复杂度内实现完全表达力的精确参数化是关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出基于广义正交随机矩阵（generalized orthostochastic matrices）的精确参数化方法，引入超参数s实现从计算高效边界到完全表达Birkhoff多面体的连续插值。在mHC框架上实现为go-mHC，可与Kronecker分解方法自然组合。
AI.result: go-mHC在Birkhoff多面体内占据更完整的空间；合成流混合任务中达到理论最小损失，收敛速度提升10倍；30M参数GPT风格语言模型验证有效。
AI.conclusion: go-mHC在表达力、效率和精确性三方面取得平衡，为将d作为模型容量的新维度提供了可行途径。

title: Novel Memory Forgetting Techniques for Autonomous AI Agents: Balancing Relevance and Efficiency
summary: Long-horizon conversational agents require persistent memory for coherent reasoning, yet uncontrolled accumulation causes temporal decay and false memory propagation. Benchmarks such as LOCOMO and LOCCO report performance degradation from 0.455 to 0.05 across stages, while MultiWOZ shows 78.2% accuracy with 6.8% false memory rate under persistent retention. This work introduces an adaptive budgeted forgetting framework that regulates memory through relevanceguided scoring and bounded optimization. The approach integrates recency, frequency, and semantic alignment to maintain stability under constrained context. Comparative analysis demonstrates improved long-horizon F1 beyond 0.583 baseline levels, higher retention consistency, and reduced false memory behavior without increasing context usage. These findings confirm that structured forgetting preserves reasoning performance while preventing unbounded memory growth in extended conversational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长时对话智能体中的记忆管理问题，提出了自适应预算遗忘框架，通过相关性引导评分和有界优化来调控记忆内容，在保持上下文使用量不变的前提下，提升了长时对话F1指标，降低了错误记忆率。
AI.motivation: 当前长时对话智能体面临记忆累积引发的两大核心问题：一是时间衰减导致的性能退化（LOCOMO基准中性能从0.455降至0.05），二是错误记忆传播（MultiWOZ中错误记忆率达6.8%）。现有方法缺乏对记忆内容的有效筛选机制，导致上下文无限增长而信噪比持续下降。
AI.method: 提出了自适应预算遗忘框架，核心机制包括：（1）相关性引导评分，整合了时效性（recency）、频率（frequency）和语义对齐（semantic alignment）三个维度；（2）有界优化约束，在受限上下文条件下进行记忆内容的动态取舍。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：长时F1指标提升至0.583以上，保持了更高的记忆保留一致性，显著降低了错误记忆发生率，且上下文使用量未增加。
AI.conclusion: 结构化遗忘策略能够有效维持推理性能，同时防止扩展对话场景中的无限记忆增长。该框架为持久记忆场景下的对话系统提供了一种可控、可解释的记忆管理范式。

title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement: A Task-Scaling Law for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models employing Chain-of-Thought reasoning achieve strong performance but suffer from excessive token consumption that inflates inference costs. Existing efficiency methods such as explicit length penalties, difficulty estimators, or multi-stage curricula either degrade reasoning quality or require complex training pipelines. We introduce Batched Contextual Reinforcement, a minimalist, single-stage training paradigm that unlocks efficient reasoning through a simple structural modification: training the model to solve N problems simultaneously within a shared context window, rewarded purely by per-instance accuracy. This formulation creates an implicit token budget that yields several key findings: (1) We identify a novel task-scaling law: as the number of concurrent problems N increases during inference, per-problem token usage decreases monotonically while accuracy degrades far more gracefully than baselines, establishing N as a controllable throughput dimension. (2) BCR challenges the traditional accuracy-efficiency trade-off by demonstrating a "free lunch" phenomenon at standard single-problem inference. Across both 1.5B and 4B model families, BCR reduces token usage by 15.8% to 62.6% while consistently maintaining or improving accuracy across five major mathematical benchmarks. (3) Qualitative analyses reveal emergent self-regulated efficiency, where models autonomously eliminate redundant metacognitive loops without explicit length supervision. (4) Crucially, we empirically demonstrate that implicit budget constraints successfully circumvent the adversarial gradients and catastrophic optimization collapse inherent to explicit length penalties, offering a highly stable, constraint-based alternative for length control. These results prove BCR practical, showing simple structural incentives unlock latent high-density reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出批量上下文强化学习（BCR），通过训练LLM在共享上下文窗口中同时解决N个问题来隐式创建token预算，在降低15.8%-62.6% token消耗的同时保持或提升准确率，实现了"免费午餐"现象。
AI.motivation: 链式思维推理虽性能优异但token消耗过大，导致推理成本高企。现有效率优化方法（长度惩罚、难度估计器、多阶段课程）存在降低推理质量或需要复杂训练流程的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出批量上下文强化学习（BCR），一种单阶段训练范式。核心修改：训练模型在共享上下文窗口中同时解决N个问题，仅以每实例准确率为奖励。隐式token预算机制使模型自主调节效率。
AI.result: （1）发现新任务-扩展律：N增大时每问题token消耗单调下降，准确率比基线更平稳衰减；（2）1.5B和4B模型系列均实现"免费午餐"：token减少15.8%-62.6%，五个数学基准测试准确率持平或提升；（3）定性分析显示模型自发消除冗余元认知循环；（4）隐式预算约束成功规避显式长度惩罚的对抗性梯度和灾难性优化崩溃。
AI.conclusion: BCR证明简单的结构激励可释放LLM潜在的高密度推理能力，提供稳定、无需复杂训练的约束型长度控制方案。

title: Beyond the Assistant Turn: User Turn Generation as a Probe of Interaction Awareness in Language Models
summary: Standard LLM benchmarks evaluate the assistant turn: the model generates a response to an input, a verifier scores correctness, and the analysis ends. This paradigm leaves unmeasured whether the LLM encodes any awareness of what follows the assistant response. We propose user-turn generation as a probe of this gap: given a conversation context of user query and assistant response, we let a model generate under the user role. If the model's weights encode interaction awareness, the generated user turn will be a grounded follow-up that reacts to the preceding context. Through experiments across $11$ open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.5, gpt-oss, GLM) and $5$ datasets (math reasoning, instruction following, conversation), we show that interaction awareness is decoupled from task accuracy. In particular, within the Qwen3.5 family, GSM8K accuracy scales from $41\%$ ($0.8$B) to $96.8\%$ ($397$B-A$17$B), yet genuine follow-up rates under deterministic generation remain near zero. In contrast, higher temperature sampling reveals interaction awareness is latent with follow up rates reaching $22\%$. Controlled perturbations validate that the proposed probe measures a real property of the model, and collaboration-oriented post-training on Qwen3.5-2B demonstrates an increase in follow-up rates. Our results show that user-turn generation captures a dimension of LLM behavior, interaction awareness, that is unexplored and invisible with current assistant-only benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「用户轮生成」（user-turn generation）作为探针：给模型一个（用户提问 + 助手回复）的对话上下文，让它在用户角色下继续生成；若生成的下一轮用户话语是对前文的实质性回应（grounded follow-up），即说明模型权重编码了「交互感知」（interaction awareness）。在 11 个开源模型（Qwen3.5 0.8B–397B-A17B、gpt-oss 20B/120B、GLM-4.7）与 5 个数据集上的实验表明：交互感知与任务准确率基本解耦（Qwen3.5 家族 GSM8K 准确率从 41.6% 升到 96.8%，贪心解码下真实后续率却近乎为零）；提高温度可把潜在能力「逼出来」（最高约 22%–47%）；受控扰动（截断助手回复、追加显式提问）与协作式后训练（CollabLLM 式 SFT/PPO）都能按可解释方向移动该指标。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 基准只评测「助手轮」：模型对输入生成回复，验证器打分，分析即告结束。这留下了一个未被测量的问题——模型是否编码了对助手回复之后会发生什么的认知（对用户反应的预判，即交互感知）。虽然后训练语料同时包含用户侧与助手侧文本，模型可以 GSM8K 拿到 96% 的分数，却在被迫扮演用户角色时彻底崩塌：表现为复述上一轮提示、以助手口吻继续（身份漂移/identity drift）、或输出规划性伪影等「退化用户轮」。这一缺口直接关系到多智能体协作、自博弈（self-play）、需要用户反应作为训练信号的多轮后训练，以及 LLM 的心智理论/伙伴建模研究。作者明确区别于「用户模拟器」方向：不构建可复用的用户代理，而是把用户轮生成当作探测助手模型自身权重的行为性探针。
AI.method: 问题形式化：给定用户查询 q 与助手回复 a，令 u = M_θ([q; a])，即在用户角色头下生成序列 u；两种设定——self-generated（a 由模型自己生成，探测模型对自己回复的「用户反应」能力）与 held-out（a 来自真实多轮对话，移除最后一个用户轮后让模型生成，用于后训练迁移与评审器验证）。度量：定义 genuine follow-up（u 与上下文 (q,a) 有实质 grounding：引用、回应、延展具体内容）为真；degenerate 包括逐字复述 q、以用户身份续写助手回复、输出规划伪影、生成新任务指令等。用 LLM 评审器 FollowUpEval(q,a,u) 输出 {rationale, 二值判定 σ, 主标签 ℓ∈{previous_turn_restate, new_task_prompt, assistant_turn_restate, malformed_artifact, meta_planning, degenerate_short, plausible_followup, other}}，主指标为 genuine-followup rate；评审器用 gpt-5.4-mini，与盲法人工标注一致性 κ=0.726（附录 D 另有同族评审器与人工 packet 分析）。实验配置：vLLM + 修改后的 chat template 允许用户角色续写，H200 GPU；主用 T=0 贪心，另做 T∈{0.3,0.7,1.0} 温度扫描；数据集为 GSM8K、IFEval、IFBench、GPQA Main/Diamond（可验证任务准确率），外加 held-out 的 HealthBench 与 Coval 子集；模型为 8 个 Qwen3.5（0.8B→397B-A17B）、2 个 gpt-oss、GLM-4.7。验证手段：（1）受控扰动——截断助手回复末尾 max(25, ⌈0.25n⌉) tokens，以及在助手回复后追加通用问句（如 “What do you think?”）作为正对照；（2）协作导向后训练——将 CollabLLM 配方用于 Qwen3.5-2B，用 200 道 MATH level-5 题扩展为约 5k 条多轮样本（约 5 轮），分别做助手轮掩码损失的 SFT 与基于多轮 rollout/对话奖励的 PPO 在线 RL，均不显式训练用户轮生成。
AI.result: 1) 跨族解耦：任务准确率与后续率大体不相关。gpt-oss-20b/120b 在 GPQA Diamond 上后续率 17%–21%，尽管其准确率（61%–67%）低于 GLM-4.7（66.4%，后续率 1.5%）与 Qwen3.5-397B（86.1%，后续率 0.5%）；Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 在 IFBench 上后续率最高（9.7%）但在 GPQA 上很弱。2) 能力是潜在的：贪心解码下 8 个 Qwen3.5 中有 5 个在 GSM8K 上后续率为 0.0%，而 GSM8K 准确率从 41.6% 单调升到 96.8%；升温后 Qwen3.5-27B 在 GSM8K 从 0%→22%、GPQA Diamond 从 1.5%→35.9%、IFBench 从 1%→30.7%，GLM-4.7 达 15.2%/35.4%；gpt-oss 对温度不敏感（gpt-oss-120b 在 GSM8K 的 T=1.0 仍为 0.1%），说明其在该上下文下可能真正缺失而非仅被抑制。3) 规模不预测能力：即使在采样下也不单调（IFBench T=1.0 时 0.8B 达 27.7%、9B 36%、397B 43.7%；MoE 的 35B-A3B、122B-A10B 持续落后于同规模稠密模型），呈非单调且数据集相关；同为 GPQA 化学题正确作答时，9B 生成对助手推理的批判性追问，而大 3 倍的 27B 逐字复述原提示。4) 失败模式具有家族特征：Qwen3.5 以 previous_turn_restate 为主（78.5%，GSM8K 上 27B 近乎 100% 复述），gpt-oss 以 assistant_turn_restate 为主（70.2%，泄漏 <|channel|>analysis 内部校验），GLM-4.7 以 meta_planning 为主（43.0%，10.8% malformed_artifact）。5) 扰动验证指标有效：截断使 GLM-4.7 在 GSM8K 由 1.0%→55.0%、gpt-oss-120b 由 0.0%→24.2%（GPQA Diamond 由 20.7%→65.7%），而 Qwen 模型几乎无反应；追加显式问句使 gpt-oss-120b 在 IFBench 由 1.3%→25.7% 且 99% 的用户轮文本改变，GLM 改变率 99% 但真实后续率几乎不变（4.7%→5.0%），Qwen3.5-397B 甚至下降（7.7%→4.7%）。6) 后训练可移动该指标（Qwen3.5-2B）：SFT 将 IFBench/GPQA-Diamond 后续率由 1.0%/2.0% 提升到 48.0%/46.0%，HealthBench 36.7%→54.4%，但 GSM8K 准确率由 62.9% 跌到 40.3%（约 5k 样本上过拟合/遗忘）；RL(PPO) 在保持 67.4% 准确率的同时在所有数据集取得中等增益（10.0%/9.1%/46.5%/29.0%）。评测集与训练集无重叠，故为迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 用户轮生成可以作为一个低成本、有诊断力的「交互感知」行为探针，填补了纯助手轮基准的盲区。第一，仅评测助手回复会漏掉对交互式部署举足轻重的维度；把模型改作用户代理用于自博弈或多智能体流水线时，其失败根源在于交互感知缺失，而非任务能力不足（也解释了为何“换更大的模型”得不到更好的伙伴模型）。第二，交互感知既非任务准确率、也非模型规模的单调函数，呈现家族特有且数据集相关的失败谱系，说明它是由后训练数据构成与优化目标塑造的一族行为，而非单一能力；近零值很可能反映单轮后训练数据与聊天模板约定等训练产物。第三，该指标对因果扰动（截断、显式提问）与训练干预（SFT/RL）均按可解释方向响应，可作为协作质量与后训练设计的一个可衡量轴；即便未显式训练用户轮，协作导向的多轮训练也会把交互感知作为副产品诱导出来。第四，探针测量的是模型在用户角色下的默认行为输出而非内部表征，因此结论限于「模型产出什么」；表征层面的探针分析仍可补充。局限：依赖 LLM 评审器（κ=0.726，主标签一致性较低 0.481），仅测“能否产出有 grounding 的后续”而非“能否还原被留出的人类续写”，评测域为英文对话、未覆盖多语/代码/超长轮次，最强条件下真实后续仍属少数行为，温度扫描每例仅一次采样，后训练实验仅初步且限于单一家族，下游用途（best-of-N 选答、重排序、自博弈数据生成）留待未来。
